title: Techno Commercial Professional
description:
**Techno\-Commercial – Dairy \& Food Ingredients** 




  





**Department:** 
 Sales \& Business Development
 



**Location:** 
 Navi Mumbai
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Fulltime
 



**Website:** 
 https://www.sheekharr.com/
 



  





**“Turn technical understanding into customer solutions and business growth”** 




  





**About Company:** 




**Sheekharr Innovations Pvt Ltd** 
 ., formerly known as
 **Sheekharr Starch Pvt. Ltd.,** 
 is an R\&D\-driven ingredients company working across dairy ingredients and modified starches, with a focus on developing application\-oriented solutions for the food and dairy industry.
 



  





**Summary:** 




 As a Techno\-Commercial professional, you will
 **own the complete sales cycle and be accountable for converting technical customer requirements into commercial business opportunities.** 




 You will
 **identify and develop new business, build customer relationships, understand technical and application requirements, drive product trials, develop commercial proposals, negotiate with decision\-makers, and convert opportunities into revenue.** 




 You will work directly with customers and cross\-functional teams to
 **solve application challenges, drive trials to closure, develop new accounts, and build repeat business.** 
 The role carries clear responsibility for
 **business development, customer conversion, revenue generation, and market expansion.** 




  





**Responsibilities \& Ownership:** 



* **Own and drive** 
 new business development across the dairy and food ingredients industry.
* **Build, manage and convert** 
 a strong pipeline of prospective customers into active business opportunities.
* **Identify and understand** 
 customer requirements, applications, formulation challenges and commercial expectations.
* **Present and position** 
 Sheekharr's products and application\-based solutions based on customer requirements.
* **Plan, coordinate and drive** 
 product sampling and customer trials through timely technical and commercial follow\-up.
* **Translate customer requirements into actionable solutions** 
 in coordination with R\&D and technical teams.
* **Own the complete opportunity lifecycle:** 
 lead generation → customer interaction → sampling → trials → negotiation → order conversion → repeat business.
* **Prepare, present and negotiate** 
 quotations, commercial proposals and commercial terms in line with customer requirements and company objectives.
* **Develop and strengthen customer relationships** 
 while identifying cross\-selling, upselling and business expansion opportunities.
* **Track and take ownership of** 
 sales activities, customer interactions, trials, conversions and revenue pipeline.
* **Identify market opportunities** 
 by monitoring customer requirements, market developments and competitor activity.
* **Drive market expansion and contribute directly to business and revenue targets.**
* **Maintain accurate sales data and provide timely MIS and performance updates** 
 to management.
* **Convert customer feedback and market insights into actionable inputs** 
 for product positioning, application development and sales strategy.



  





**Who will Thrive in this Role:** 




 This role requires a professional who can
 **take ownership of the complete techno\-commercial sales process, understand customer applications, translate technical requirements into business solutions, and deliver measurable commercial outcomes.** 



* 2–8 years of experience in technical sales / techno\-commercial sales / business development within the dairy, food ingredients or related industries.
* **Education:** 
 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Food Technology, Dairy Technology, Food Science, Dairy Science, Food Processing, Biotechnology, Chemistry, or a related technical discipline.
* **Strong understanding** 
 of dairy and food applications and ingredient functionality.
* Ability to
 **engage effectively with R\&D, production, procurement, QA/QC and business decision\-makers** 
 and drive discussions towards solutions.
* Strong customer\-facing, presentation and negotiation skills.
* Ability to
 **independently own and execute the complete sales cycle from lead generation to closure.**
* Strong commercial understanding with a
 **clear focus on revenue and business targets.**
* Ability to
 **plan and execute customer visits, product demonstrations and application trials** 
 and drive them towards commercial conversion.
* Strong follow\-up, organization, reporting and execution skills.
* Willingness to travel as required for customer meetings and trials.



  





**Growth \& Exposure:** 



* **Own business opportunities end\-to\-end** 
 within an R\&D\-driven ingredients business.
* Gain hands\-on exposure to
 **dairy and food ingredient applications, customer requirements and technical problem\-solving.**
* **Drive the complete commercial journey** 
 from identifying opportunities to converting them into business.
* Direct interaction with customers and cross\-functional teams across R\&D, technical and commercial functions.
* **Contribute directly to market expansion, customer acquisition and revenue growth.**
* Build professional expertise and career growth in a business where
 **individual ownership, contribution and results are visible and meaningful.**



  





**At Sheekharr, we believe strong business relationships begin with understanding the customer's need and strong solutions begin with understanding the product. This role brings both together.**

description:

Extensive training and support is provided, and involves working in close partnership with account managers, solution consultants, customer success managers and product teams to proactively drive revenue growth.

title: Consultant - Passenger &  VIP Charter
description:
**Are you ready to charter your own career?** 




**The runway to success in global aviation begins here…** 




 Are you looking for an opportunity to work for a global brand where you can use your skills, be part of a diverse team and grow with a dynamic company? We are looking for an experienced
 **VIP \& Passenger Charters Consultant** 
 to join our team based in
 **Mumbai, India.** 




  





**Purpose of the Role** 




  




* Client Acquisition and Relationship Management: Proactively source potential clients through cold calling, nurturing established relationships and developing new connections to secure charter flight contracts
* Aircraft Sourcing and Contracting: Utilise a variety of tools, industry connections, and methods to source suitable aircraft at competitive prices, liaising with operators to deliver tailored solutions for client needs and contracting the client and operators accurately and efficiently
* Comprehensive Flight Management: Oversee all aspects of flight operations from booking to completion, including compliance, finance coordination, catering, ground handling, slots, and permits, ensuring seamless service delivery until passengers leave the arrival airport to ensure consistent high standards across all flights, every time



  





**Key Responsibilities Of The Role** 




  




* Maintain a high and consistent volume of cold calls to identify potential clients, generate new business opportunities and achieve sustained results that meet or exceed KPI expectations
* Follow\-up promptly and consistently on all calls and leads to build a strong sales pipeline
* Log business activity of calls and meetings on the Company CRM accurately describing development of the business opportunity and consistently follow up to ensure maximising potential deals and bookings
* Explore new business opportunities and untapped markets through research, cold calling, and industry networking to grow the client portfolio
* Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, ensuring their needs are met and they receive excellent service
* Demonstrate excellent aircraft knowledge to identify and source the most suitable options for each client’s specific requirements
* Stay informed on industry trends and operational updates, continuously improving knowledge and skills to enhance service delivery and maintain a competitive edge
* Work closely with internal teams, including Risk and Compliance, Legal, and Finance, to deliver seamless services to clients and ensure all processes adhere to regulatory requirements, contractual obligations and Company standards
* Meet and exceed the expected KPI targets and objectives set for cold calling, client acquisition, and business development, ensuring consistent performance and alignment with company goals
* Travel as required in line with business requirements, ensuring full flexibility to support operational demands



  





**What will our ideal candidate have?** 




  




* Minimum 2 years of relevant experience within Aviation
* Experience in PAX sales / airchartering
* Knowledge of the regional IMEA market
* Be proactive in the market to identify business development opportunities
* Turkish/Russian and English language skills at an effective operational command
* Ability to successfully balance client needs with business objectives



  





**What’s In It For You** 




  




* Comprehensive benefits package
* Opportunity to join a global company and be part of a diverse international team
* Professional development and career opportunities
* Unlimited access to thousands of courses on LinkedIn Learning platform



  





 With more than 50 years of experience, the Chapman Freeborn group provides a diverse range of aviation\-related services on a global basis. Our expertise in all areas of the air charter industry makes us the number one choice for many of the world’s leading logistics providers, multinational corporations, travel partners, and well\-known names from the entertainment business.
 



 Whether it’s arranging the delivery of oil equipment to a remote location, organizing flights for a professional sports team, or booking private jets to an island resort, the sky’s the limit when it comes to the charter business.
 



 Chapman Freeborn is a family member of Avia Solutions Group, a leading global aerospace services group with almost 100 offices and production stations providing aviation services and solutions worldwide. Avia Solutions Group unites a team of more than 11\.500 professionals, providing state\-of\-the\-art solutions to the aviation industry and beyond.
 



 Chapman Freeborn aims to promote equality, diversity, fairness and respect for future and current staff at all levels of the organization. We aim to provide equal opportunities in all aspects of employment and to ensure that the talent and skills of all individuals are maximized.

title: International BPO Sales Executive
description:

 Tech Hub IT Solutions Pvt. Ltd. is a globally focused outsourcing and business solutions company that supports organizations in optimizing operations, strengthening customer relationships, and driving sustainable growth. As a trusted partner for US\-based enterprises, the company delivers high\-quality, cost\-effective, and scalable services aligned with modern business requirements. Its core expertise includes International Sales, Customer Support, Lead Generation, and Back\-Office Operations, backed by a skilled and performance\-driven team. Headquartered in Navi Mumbai, Tech Hub IT Solutions operates with a client\-centric approach rooted in professionalism, transparency, integrity, and accountability. The company emphasizes long\-term strategic partnerships that enable innovation, operational excellence, and competitive advantage in the global marketplace.
 



**Role Description** 
 The International BPO Sales Executive is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Navi Mumbai. * Prior experience in international BPO sales or outbound voice processes (US or other global markets) is highly preferred.
* Relevant education such as a diploma or bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field is beneficial.
* Willingness to work in rotational shifts aligned with international time zones and adhere to company policies and compliance standards.

title: Senior Data Analyst
description:
Responsible for conducting data analysis to extract actionable insights, exploring datasets to uncover patterns and anomalies, analyzing historical data for trend identification and forecasting, investigating data discrepancies, providing user training and support on data analysis tools, communicating findings through compelling visualizations, supporting data projects, and ensuring data accuracy and integrity.
   

  

 Grade \- T4
   

  

 Please note that the Job will close at 12am on Posting Close date, so please submit your application prior to the Close Date
   

  

****What Your Main Responsibilities Are:****
* Conduct data analysis to extract actionable insights and drive decision\-making.
* Explore and visualize datasets to uncover patterns, trends, and anomalies.
* Analyze historical data to identify trends and develop forecasts for future performance.
* Investigate and identify root causes of issues or discrepancies in data.
* Provide training and support to users on data analysis tools and techniques.
* Communicate findings and insights through compelling data visualizations and narratives.

 We are looking for a highly analytical and strategic thinker to join our team as a Senior Analyst – Pricing and Marketing Analytics. This role will own analytics for complex pricing, build solutions, and enable pricing teams to optimize and deliver pricing excellence to enable long\-term business growth.
   

  

 The ideal candidate brings strong problem\-solving rigor, attention to detail, and is comfortable to work in ambiguity. Has the ability to translate high level abstract problem into actionable data and system problems to enable execution.
   

  

****What Your Main Responsibilities Are****
**Strategic Analytics \& Insight Generation**
* Apply structured problem\-solving and root cause analysis to uncover key drivers of pricing performance, revenue leakage, and profitability
* Apply critical thinking to identify long\-term trends in customer pricing, price elasticity, competitive dynamics, and business outcomes.
* Develop scalable dashboards and reporting solutions to track pricing performance and enable self\-serve analytics for commercial teams.


**Data Science \& Decision Support**
* Utilize advanced data analysis, SQL, and Python to build predictive pricing models, opportunity sizing frameworks, and optimization models to support strategic planning and operational decision\-making. Conduct scenario analysis and simulations to inform pricing structures, promotional discounting strategies, and rate changes.
* Design and evaluate experiments (e.g. cohort analysis) to drive product and service pricing optimization.
* UI/UX for Business Users: Experience designing intuitive, highly interactive dashboard solutions (e.g., Tableau, PowerBI) commercial teams can actually use to make daily pricing decisions.

 FedEx was built on a philosophy that puts people first, one we take seriously. We are an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer and we are committed to a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workforce in which we enforce fair treatment, and provide growth opportunities for everyone.
   

  

 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of age, race, color, national origin, genetics, religion, gender, marital status, pregnancy (including childbirth or a related medical condition), physical or mental disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.
   

  

 Our Company
   

  

 FedEx is one of the world's largest express transportation companies and has consistently been selected as one of the top 10 World’s Most Admired Companies by "Fortune" magazine. Every day FedEx delivers for its customers with transportation and business solutions, serving more than 220 countries and territories around the globe. We can serve this global network due to our outstanding team of FedEx team members, who are tasked with making every FedEx experience outstanding.
   

  

 Our Philosophy
   

  

 The People\-Service\-Profit philosophy (P\-S\-P) describes the principles that govern every FedEx decision, policy, or activity. FedEx takes care of our people; they, in turn, deliver the impeccable service demanded by our customers, who reward us with the profitability necessary to secure our future. The essential element in making the People\-Service\-Profit philosophy such a positive force for the company is where we close the circle, and return these profits back into the business, and invest back in our people. Our success in the industry is attributed to our people. Through our P\-S\-P philosophy, we have a work environment that encourages team members to be innovative in delivering the highest possible quality of service to our customers. We care for their well\-being, and value their contributions to the company.
   

  

 Our Culture
   

  

 Our culture is important for many reasons, and we intentionally bring it to life through our behaviors, actions, and activities in every part of the world. The FedEx culture and values have been a cornerstone of our success and growth since we began in the early 1970’s. While other companies can copy our systems, infrastructure, and processes, our culture makes us unique and is often a differentiating factor as we compete and grow in today’s global marketplace.

title: Proposal Consultant

Behind our customers \- amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life\-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility \- our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.

**Job Description**
**Proposal Consultant**
 Pune/Noida \- India
   

  

**Proposal Consultant** 
 responsible for preparing and delivering techno\-commercial proposals for MV/LV MCCs, VFDs, and automation solutions. The role includes RFQ review, technical solution development, costing, proposal preparation, and customer requirement analysis while collaborating with sales, engineering, and manufacturing teams. **Key Competencies**
* Commercial acumen and cost estimation capability
* Effective stakeholder management
* Customer\-focused mindset
* Cross\-functional collaboration

* Relevant Experience of more than 4\+ years in Proposal Engineering for MV/LV MCC, Electrical knowledge and Automation Engineering

* Employee Assistance Program
* Personalized wellbeing programs through our OnTrack program

* and other local benefits!


*At Rockwell Automation we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this or other roles.*
 Rockwell Automation’s hybrid policy aligns that employees are expected to work at a Rockwell location at least Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays unless they have a business obligation out of the office.

title: Business Development Executive
description:
TCC works as an extended design team for marketing agencies.
 



 We partner with agencies that need additional design capacity, creative support or a reliable team to handle ongoing client work. We work behind the scenes through a white\-label model, allowing agencies to expand what they can deliver while continuing to own their client relationships.
 



 We also work directly with selected clients when it aligns with the company’s current growth goals.
 



  

  





**The Role:**




 We’re looking for a Business Development Executive whose primary goal will be to get TCC into conversations with the right agencies and, when required, selected direct clients.
 



  





 You’ll identify relevant prospects, reach out to decision\-makers, start conversations, follow up and book qualified appointments for our team.
 



  





 This is primarily an outreach and appointment\-setting role. You will not be expected to close deals. Your responsibility is to find the right opportunities and get them to the meeting stage.
   





**Expectations:**



* Research and identify marketing agencies that could work with TCC
* Reach out to founders and decision\-makers through calls, LinkedIn, email, WhatsApp and other relevant channels
* Approach selected direct clients based on quarterly company goals
* Explain TCC’s white\-label design offering clearly and confidently
* Introduce TCC’s direct design services when approaching clients
* Follow up consistently with interested prospects
* Qualify potential agencies and clients before setting up meetings
* Book qualified appointments for the team
* Maintain an organised record of conversations, follow\-ups and opportunities
* Experiment with different outreach messages and approaches to improve responses



**Requirements:**



* 6 months to 1 years of experience in business development, inside sales, telecalling or outbound sales
* Comfortable making cold calls and starting conversations with new people
* Good spoken and written English
* Comfortable using LinkedIn, email and WhatsApp for outreach
* Strong follow\-up skills
* Someone who can communicate naturally without sounding like they’re reading a sales script
* Target driven and comfortable working towards monthly appointment goals
* Experience selling agency, marketing, design, technology or B2B services is a plus



**Goals:**




 Your primary KPI will be
 **qualified appointments.** 




  





 We’re not looking for random meetings just to hit a number. We want conversations where there is a genuine possibility of working together.
   






 Salary and Incentives:
 




 Fixed CTC: ₹1\.8 LPA
 



 Plus 5% of the first billing of every client that closes from an opportunity generated by you.
 



 There is no cap on this incentive.
   





**Work Setup:**




 This is a full\-time hybrid role. There is no field sales or client travel involved. The role is focused on research, calling, messaging, follow\-ups and appointment setting.
 



  





 The role will have a 2\-month probation period. During this period, we’ll primarily evaluate outreach consistency, communication quality, follow\-ups, appointment quality and overall fit with the role.
   





**Who we are looking for:**




 Someone early in their sales career who enjoys talking to people, isn’t afraid of cold outreach and wants their effort to have a direct connection to how much they can earn.
 



  





 If you can find the right agencies, spot the right clients, start good conversations and get people onto a call, we’d like to talk.

Additionally, this role acts as a mentor for new Sales Colleagues and Clinical Support Representatives within a designated geographic area. Case support coordination, conversion of new business opportunities and some business analysis are required in this role.

The DM is responsible for supporting current business in the Recon range of products, and to actively grow the business by gaining new accounts and increasing Market Share.

As a pivotal role within the organization, the DM acts as a liaison point between the customer and the various internal departments (eg. **Technical Learning and Skill Development (5%)**

 Deloitte’s Tax Technology Consulting team helps organizations transform tax operations through the use of enterprise technology, automation, and scalable process design. The team works at the intersection of tax, finance, and technology to support implementation of indirect tax solutions that align with client business requirements. Professionals in this group collaborate across global teams to deliver practical, technology\-enabled outcomes for complex tax environments.
   

  

**Location: All Locations**
**Qualifications**
 Required:
   

  

* 4\+ years of experience in enterprise resource planning implementation or support in SAP or Oracle environments
* 2\-4 years of hands\-on experience with OneSource Indirect Tax Determination or Vertex O Series
* Experience integrating Procure\-to\-Pay, Order\-to\-Cash, and Record\-to\-Report processes with SAP Finance and third\-party tax engines
* Experience configuring OneSource Indirect Tax Determination or Vertex O Series for indirect tax calculation

description:
**Role:** 
 Growth Marketing Manager
   

  

**Location:** 
 Bengaluru
   

  

**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
   

  

**Experience Level:** 
 Senior Travel
   

  

**About ElderGo**
 Somewhere in Bangalore there's a 63\-year\-old who has quietly decided her travelling days are behind her. They aren't. Your job is to find her.
   

  

 ElderGo runs all\-inclusive group tours for Indian travellers aged 55 and above. Last year, 200 of them went with us across 8 countries — and seven in ten came back for another trip. The product works. The trips sell.
   

  

 The gap is reaching more of the right people.
   

  

**The Role**
 You'll own how ElderGo finds its travellers. That starts with paid — running our campaigns, building the creative, knowing why one ad works and another doesn't. You'll be sharper at this than we are, and you'll have room to run.
   

  

 But it doesn't end there. There are far more people out there who'd love these trips than we're currently reaching, and finding them is the real work of this role. We have a clear sense of where to look next. We're hiring someone who'll have a better one.
   

  

 Our sales team is about to grow from 4 people to 12\. This role is what makes that possible.
   

  

**Who You Might Be**
* You've run consumer campaigns yourself — hands on the account, over months, not a slide deck about them.
* You've marketed something people think about before buying, not something they add to a cart.
* You've started something where there was nothing, and you liked that part.
* You've carried a number that was yours to answer for.
* You're in Bengaluru, or happy to be.


 Coming from B2B or SaaS? The instincts tend not to transfer — this is a different craft.
   

  

**Why This One**
 Marketing here isn't a support function. It's the thing that decides how fast the company grows, and right now nobody owns it. You'd work directly with the founders, on a product people write thank\-you letters about, in a category almost nobody in India is serving properly. It's a lot of room for one person. That's the offer.
   

  

 Skills: consumer marketing,b2c,growth marketing

title: Content Marketing Specialist  (12-month contract)
description:
**About The Group/Team**
 CJKI is the group responsible for making Canva feel like a local product in four of its most dynamic markets \- China, Japan, Korea, and India. We sit within Canva's International Supergroup, whose mission is to empower those closest to our international customers to drive Truly Local growth across our top 40 markets.
   

  

 Our group operates with genuine autonomy, building in\-market functions across marketing, product, engineering, data, and user voice \- with the support of Canva's central teams behind us.
   

  

 India is one of our most active and ambitious subgroups, with growing teams in SEO, marketing, and product all working toward the same goal: making Canva indispensable for Indian creators, educators, and businesses, and growing our active user base in the country.
   

  

**Job Description**
**About the Role/Specialty**
 This is a opportunity to help build Canva's marketing presence for Indian users across touchpoints. You'll plan \& create content that shows up where Indian users actually are: on Canva's homepage, in the product itself, on their social feeds, and on YouTube where hundreds of millions of Indians search for how\-tos, tools, and inspiration every day.
   

  

 You'll work closely with the India Marketing team, with clear direction and room to develop your craft. This isn't a single\-channel role \- you'll stretch across planning content, writing scripts, writing product interface copy, producing content, coordinating with agencies to make production\-heavy content, and CMS management. You will get a real view of what full\-funnel content marketing looks like in one of the world's most exciting digital markets.
   

  

**What You’ll Do (responsibilities)**
* Plan content across touchpoints \- from a social ad to a YouTube tutorial to a product surface \- so every piece of content is shaped for the context in which it lands.
* Script \& produce a bank of short\-form video content for multiple touchpoints \- so the Marketing team always has fresh, tested content to work with.
* Brief and coordinate with external agencies or internal creative teams to make production\-heavy content, specially video content.
* Experiment with new content formats for Canva's product surfaces \- including the homepage, landing pages and other surfaces, such as highlights, videos, learning cards, etc.
* Manage end\-to\-end content execution \- content scheduling, CMS uploads, A/B tests across platforms and surfaces.
* Coordinate localisation across languages where needed \- a working understanding of Hindi is required, as most India localisation will be in this language.
* Measure the impact of the content, and calibrate future plans according to new insights and learnings.


**Qualifications**
**What we're looking for**
* You write clearly and versatilely across formats \- from punchy Shorts scripts to instructional video copy to product interface language.
* You're an avid Canva user who knows the product's workflows and use cases inside out \- you can speak credibly about what Canva can do, and that knowledge shows up naturally in the content you create.
* You think in channels and touchpoints \- you instinctively ask "where will someone see this, and what do they need from it at that moment?" before you write or brief a single word.
* You are comfortable facing the camera, and have a good screen presence to represent a brand like Canva in India.
* You have a sharp eye for social and design trends \- you're the kind of person who spots an emerging content format or visual style early, and can translate that into new ideas.
* You take genuine ownership of your output \- you flag blockers early, manage your own time across multiple content surfaces, and care about whether your work actually lands with users.
* You're comfortable working to a brief and taking feedback in your stride \- you see revision as part of the craft, not a setback.
* You have a good understanding of Hindi and are comfortable reviewing or briefing localised content to ensure it reads naturally for Indian users \- not just translated, but truly local.
* You're based in Bangalore and ready to contribute across a range of content types from day one.


**Additional Information**
**What you will learn and how you will develop at Canva**
* Multi\-surface content marketing \- you'll develop real experience writing \& producing social content, product content, and YouTube in a single role, giving you a rounded view of how content works across the funnel.
* Stakeholder and project management \- you'll learn how to brief external agencies, manage feedback loops, and keep multiple content workstreams moving at once, building production and stakeholder coordination skills that are invaluable in any marketing role.
* YouTube \& social content strategy \- you'll learn how to build a content funnel designed around search behaviour, create for discoverability, and grow an audience in one of the world's most competitive YouTube markets.
* A strong, full\-funnel content portfolio \- over 12 months, you'll have published work across social media, product interfaces, homepage, and other touchpoints.

* Resolve suppressed or inactive listings, variation issues, incorrect attributes, duplicate ASINs, image issues, and other catalogue errors.
* Conduct keyword research and optimize product detail pages for improved visibility and conversion.
* Ensure catalogue accuracy, consistency, completeness, and compliance with Amazon policies and Brand Registry requirements.


 Sales and Performance Monitoring
 * Monitor daily, weekly, and monthly sales performance at SKU and ASIN level.
* Analyse revenue, units sold, traffic, conversion, pricing, returns, inventory availability, and advertising contribution.
* Identify underperforming and high\-growth SKUs and recommend actions to improve sales and profitability.
* Monitor competition, pricing, ratings, reviews, rankings, and marketplace visibility.


 Vendor Central Operations
 * Manage Vendor Central activities including purchase orders, confirmations, shipment coordination, operational issues, and related reporting.
* Monitor purchase order status, fulfilment, shortages, cancellations, and discrepancies.
* Coordinate internally to ensure timely order processing and compliance with Amazon requirements.
* Track and resolve Vendor Central claims, shortages, deductions, and operational issues in coordination with relevant teams.


 Amazon Advertising
 * Manage and monitor Amazon Advertising campaigns across Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Sponsored Display.
* Coordinate keyword targeting, budgets, bids, and campaign performance.
* Monitor key metrics including ACOS, ROAS, CPC, CTR, conversion rate, advertising sales, and spend.
* Identify campaign performance gaps and recommend optimization actions.
* Support advertising plans for new product launches, promotions, and major Amazon sale events.


 Inventory and FBA Management
 * Monitor FBA and warehouse inventory, sales velocity, stock cover, and projected demand.
* Identify stock\-out and excess inventory risks and coordinate timely replenishment.
* Plan and track FBA shipments and resolve receiving discrepancies.
* Monitor stranded, unfulfillable, reserved, and aged inventory.
* Coordinate inventory availability for launches, promotions, and major sale events.


 Pricing and Promotions
 * Monitor product pricing, Buy Box status, competitive pricing, and marketplace offers.
* Manage coupons, promotions, deals, and sale\-event participation.
* Ensure pricing and inventory are aligned with promotional and business plans.


 Returns and Reimbursements
 * Analyse customer returns, refunds, and product\-level return reasons.
* Coordinate corrective actions for products with high return rates.
* Track FBA inventory discrepancies, lost or damaged inventory, reimbursements, claims, and Vendor Central deductions.
* Raise and follow up on eligible cases until closure and coordinate reconciliation with the Accounts team.


 Account Health and Compliance
 * Monitor Amazon Account Health, policy notifications, listing compliance, and performance risks.
* Resolve policy violations, listing restrictions, suppressed listings, and other account\-related issues within required timelines.
* Monitor customer feedback, ratings, reviews, and Voice of the Customer where applicable.
* Ensure compliance with Amazon marketplace policies and operational requirements.


 Reporting
 * Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly reports covering sales, inventory, advertising, returns, reimbursements, Vendor Central operations, and account health.
* Maintain trackers for catalogue issues, support cases, FBA shipments, purchase orders, claims, and marketplace action items.
* Analyse marketplace data and highlight performance gaps, risks, opportunities, and recommended actions for management review.


 Required Skills and Experience
 * **2 to 4 years of hands\-on experience in Amazon Marketplace Operations** 
 , preferably in consumer electronics, gaming accessories, or related categories.
* **Strong hands\-on knowledge of both Amazon Seller Central and Vendor Central is mandatory.**
* **Strong experience in Amazon catalogue and listing management is essential** 
 , including ASIN creation, variations, flat files, backend attributes, listing optimization, and catalogue troubleshooting.
* Good working knowledge of Amazon Advertising, including campaign management and key performance metrics such as ACOS, ROAS, CPC, CTR, and conversion rate.
* Sound understanding of FBA operations, inventory planning, purchase orders, pricing, promotions, returns, reimbursements, claims, and account health.
* Experience with Amazon Brand Registry will be an advantage.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, SUMIFS, and business reporting.
* Strong analytical, communication, coordination, and problem\-solving abilities.
* High attention to detail and demonstrated ability to independently manage Amazon marketplace operations and take ownership of assigned responsibilities.

title: Community Manager
description:
**About The Role**
 We're looking for a
 **Community Manager** 
 to build and scale a thriving tech community around Masai.
   

  

 You'll own the community experience end\-to\-end — from attracting the right members and creating meaningful conversations to running high\-impact events, building partnerships, and turning community insights into action.
   

  

 This is a
 **hands\-on, high\-ownership role** 
 for someone who understands how tech communities work, knows how to create engagement beyond vanity metrics, and enjoys bringing developers, students, founders, and industry professionals together.
   

  

 If you enjoy building communities from the ground up, creating experiences people genuinely want to participate in, and turning members into long\-term advocates, this role is for you.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Build \& Grow the Community
* Build and manage tech and developer communities across platforms such as Discord, Slack, LinkedIn, and other relevant channels.
* Develop strategies to attract high\-quality members and continuously improve member acquisition and retention.
* Create an active community culture through discussions, peer\-to\-peer interactions, challenges, AMAs, and other engagement initiatives.
* Identify community champions and turn highly engaged members into long\-term advocates.
* Own Events \& Community Programs
* Plan and execute engaging online and offline events, including hackathons, workshops, webinars, meetups, AMAs, and networking sessions.
* Build recurring community programs that create consistent value and participation.
* Own the end\-to\-end execution — planning, speakers, partnerships, promotion, registrations, engagement, and post\-event follow\-ups.
* Experiment with new formats to continuously improve participation and member experience.
* Content \& Community Communication
* Create newsletters, community updates, social posts, event content, and other communication that keeps members informed and engaged.
* Develop content that sparks conversations rather than simply broadcasting information.
* Act as the voice of the community internally and ensure member feedback reaches the right teams.
* Identify emerging conversations, trends, and community needs and turn them into content or programs.
* Partnerships \& Community Growth
* Build relationships with universities, student communities, startups, developer groups, tech companies, creators, and industry leaders.
* Develop ambassador, referral, and campus/community partner programs to accelerate growth.
* Collaborate with marketing, product, partnerships, and other teams to create mutually beneficial community initiatives.
* Represent Masai at relevant tech and startup events and build a strong external community presence.
* Measure, Learn \& Improve
* Define and track community metrics such as member growth, engagement, activation, retention, event participation, referrals, and ambassador performance.
* Use data and member feedback to understand what is working and what isn't.
* Regularly report community performance and translate insights into actionable improvements.
* Build experiments, measure outcomes, and continuously improve the community strategy.


**What We're Looking For**
* 0–4 years of experience in community management, developer relations, community growth, or a similar role, preferably in a tech, startup, education, or developer\-focused environment.
* Strong understanding of developer ecosystems, startup culture, and technology communities.
* Proven experience in building, growing, or managing an online community.
* Experience planning and executing events, meetups, workshops, hackathons, webinars, or community programs.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to adapt communication for different audiences.
* Hands\-on experience with platforms such as Discord, Slack, Circle, Reddit, LinkedIn, or similar community platforms.
* Ability to work cross\-functionally with marketing, product, partnerships, content, and business teams.
* Strong ownership and execution skills — you should be comfortable taking an idea from “this could work” to actually making it happen.
* Data\-driven mindset with the ability to understand community metrics and use insights to improve strategy.
* Empathetic, curious, proactive, and genuinely interested in building meaningful communities.


**Nice to Have**
* Experience in Developer Relations (DevRel) or developer advocacy.
* Experience managing open\-source communities or developer\-focused programs.
* Experience building ambassador, campus, referral, or creator programs.
* Familiarity with tools such as Google Analytics, Mixpanel, Orbit, HubSpot, or community analytics platforms.
* Experience creating content for LinkedIn, newsletters, blogs, YouTube, or other social platforms.
* Existing network across developer, startup, university, or tech communities.
* Experience working in an early\-stage startup or fast\-paced environment.


**What Success Looks Like**
 In this role, success isn't just about having a large community. It's about building a
 **high\-quality, active, and valuable community** 
 .
   

  

**You’ll Be Successful If You Can**
* Grow the community with the right members, not just more members.
* Increase meaningful member\-to\-member engagement.
* Build events and programs that people actively want to attend.
* Develop strong partnerships that contribute to community growth.
* Turn active members into ambassadors and advocates.
* Use community data and feedback to continuously improve the experience.
* Build a community that strengthens Masai's presence and credibility in the tech ecosystem.

description:
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following:
 **Gurugram, Haryana, India; Bengaluru, Karnataka, India; Mumbai, Maharashtra, India**

 **Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 9 years of experience in partnerships, corporate business development, management consulting, or enterprise negotiation within the technology, media, telecom, or consumer conglomerate sectors.
* Experience in non\-cash asset valuation, value\-in\-kind structuring, intellectual property licensing, and risk management.
* Experience with emerging technologies (e.g., AI and agentic capabilities) for marketing partnerships.
* Experience structuring and facilitating multi\-party commercial agreements or alliances with C\-suite executives.


**Preferred qualifications:**
* MBA or Master’s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field.
* Matrix Leadership: Exceptional ability to lead through influence across complex, matrixed global organizations, aligning cross\-functional teams (Product, Marketing, Legal, Finance) behind a shared goal.
* Ecosystem Expertise: Deep commercial understanding of the Indian consumer ecosystem, digital landscape, and cultural touchpoints (Gaming, Entertainment, Sports, Vernacular).


**About The Job**
 Whether you're on a consumer product (like Gmail, Search, Maps, Chrome, Android) or a business product (Google Ads, AdSense, Google Marketing Platform, Analytics), you take part in a complete marketing experience as you lead every facet of the product's journey. From determining positioning, naming, competitive analysis, feature prioritization and external communications, you help shape the product and help it grow a consumer base. This means you work with a cross\-functional team across Sales, corporate communications, legal, webmasters, product development, engineering and more. In this role, you'll be involved with product marketing strategy from beginning to end.
   

  

 The Strategic Alliances Center of Excellence (SA CoE) is Google India Marketing’s horizontal strategic engine with a mission to transform Google’s partnership strategy from traditional, outbound commercial sponsorships into high\-leverage ecosystem alliances. Operating across all major Product Areas including Gemini, Search, YouTube, Google Pay, Pixel, Android, and Play the CoE creates defensible market moats and drives user habituation across some of the core User Segments: Youth, Premium, Merchants, and Bharat, among others.
   

  

 As the Senior Strategic Alliance Lead, you will play a role in hunting and scoping, architecting high\-impact agreements and be the strategic steward of Google India’s partnership portfolio. You will shape the overarching strategy for asset exchanges, negotiate multi\-year mega\-alliances with C\-suite executives across India’s leading conglomerates, and establish institutional governance across Google Marketing. This is a leadership role requiring strategic goal, enterprise commercial acumen, and the ability to rally matrixed leadership across cross\-product, cross\-functional but also local, regional, and global teams.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Transform Partner Ecosystems: Play a role in shifting Google India's marketing partnerships from transactional investments to multi\-year alliances that build strategic moats across key growth priorities (Gen Z, Premium, Bharat).
* Architect large Alliances: Lead the end\-to\-end strategy, structuring, and high\-stakes C\-suite negotiations for complex, multi\-party alliances with media, CPG, among others.
* Design Cross\-Product Proposals: Synthesize various capabilities across Google’s Product Areas (Gemini, Search, YouTube, Google Pay) into cohesive value propositions.
* Govern Portfolio and Risk: Enforce commercial discipline using Strategic Screening tools to prioritize high\-leverage agreements, define guardrails, and audit ecosystem performance.
* Drive Executive Alignment: Partner with senior Google leaders across multiple areas (Marketing, Legal, PR, Partnerships) to secure strategic commitments and upskill the broader marketing organization.


 Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. title: Marketing Claim Verification Program Manager
description:

* Managing the implementation of the Marketing Claim Verification Program.
* Provides overall leadership and support.
* Acts as front\-line contact on program related activities, issues, and risks.
* Manages risks and issues and takes corrective measurements.
* Interfaces with C\-Suite Executives, Business Unit Leaders and finance to develop ROI and other financial measures.

**Responsibilities**

* Present proposals and claims for governance review, ensuring technical substantiation and compliance with established verification processes.
* Support commercial growth through customer engagement, opportunity development, proposal preparation, and guidance on value propositions and claim positioning.
* Maintain program documentation, oversee issuance of verification deliverables, monitor program performance, and drive continuous process improvement.


**Skills**
**QUALIFICATIONS**
* Ability to identify, develop, and commercialize new service offerings and business opportunities by partnering with sales, business development, marketing, engineering, and operations teams.
* Proven ability to lead cross\-functional teams through the full lifecycle of a program, from opportunity identification and solution development through launch, sustainment, and renewal.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, including presenting recommendations and business cases to leadership, customers, and technical subject matter experts.
* Ability to translate technical data, testing methodologies, and engineering concepts into customer\-focused value propositions and market\-facing solutions.
* Strong program management, analytical, and business planning skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent projects, priorities, deadlines, and customer commitments.
* Ability to drive continuous improvement, establish scalable processes, and support growth initiatives across multiple business units and market segments.
* Sound business judgment with the ability to make independent decisions, resolve complex issues, and balance customer, commercial, and technical considerations.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with commercial and technical teams to develop, implement, and govern customer\-facing programs and services.


**EXPERIENCE** 
  

  

* Bachelor's degree required in Business, Marketing, Engineering, Science, Project Management, or a related discipline.
* Advanced degree preferred, such as an MBA, MA in Project Management, or a master's degree in Engineering, Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Experience leading complex cross\-functional programs involving sales, marketing, engineering, operations, and customer\-facing stakeholders.
* Proven ability to develop, launch, and manage customer\-facing service offerings, programs, or strategic business initiatives.
* Experience driving collaboration between technical subject matter experts and commercial teams to deliver business results.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with experience presenting recommendations, business cases, and program updates to leadership and executive audiences.
* Demonstrated ability to identify growth opportunities, support business development efforts, and bring new solutions to market
* Experience managing multiple projects and priorities while driving alignment among diverse stakeholders
* Proven ability to translate complex technical concepts into customer\-focused value propositions and commercial opportunities.
* Demonstrated success working independently and exercising sound judgment in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment.


**About Us**
 A global leader in applied safety science, UL Solutions (NYSE: ULS) transforms safety, security and sustainability challenges into opportunities for customers in more than 110 countries. UL Solutions delivers testing, inspection and certification services, together with software products and advisory offerings, that support our customers’ product innovation and business growth. The UL Mark serves as a recognized symbol of trust in our customers’ products and reflects an unwavering commitment to advancing our safety mission. We help our customers innovate, launch new products and services, navigate global markets and complex supply chains, and grow sustainably and responsibly into the future. Our science is your advantage.

title: Senior Field Marketing Specialist (Remote)
description:

We are looking for a candidate with strong professional maturity who can operate with a high degree of ownership. Qualifications:* Experience: 4\+ years of experience in Field Marketing or Event Marketing, ideally within B2B SaaS

title: Performance Marketer
description:
Apex Brando is a growth\-focused marketing agency helping brands scale through creative storytelling, performance marketing, and strategic digital campaigns. We work closely with clients to turn marketing efforts into measurable business results.
 



  





 We're looking for a Performance Marketer who can plan, execute, monitor, and optimize paid advertising campaigns for multiple clients. The candidate should have strong hands\-on experience with Meta Ads and Google Ads, with a focus on lead generation, conversions, traffic, and overall campaign performance.
 



  





**Roles \& Responsibilities** 




  





**Client Management** 




  




* Communicate directly with clients to understand business goals, campaign objectives, and expectations
* Discuss campaign performance, results, and improvement strategies with clients
* Conduct regular performance reviews and communicate campaign updates
* Understand client requirements and translate them into effective advertising strategies



  





**Campaign Strategy \& Planning** 




  




* Develop paid advertising strategies based on client goals and target audiences
* Plan campaigns for lead generation, conversions, traffic, awareness, and sales
* Research target audiences, competitors, keywords, and market trends
* Plan campaign structures, budgets, targeting, creatives, and testing strategies



  





**Meta Ads Management** 




  




* Set up and manage Meta Ads campaigns across Facebook and Instagram
* Handle campaign objectives, audience targeting, placements, budgets, and bidding
* Create and manage retargeting and remarketing campaigns
* Test different audiences, creatives, hooks, offers, and campaign structures
* Monitor campaign performance and continuously optimize for better results

* Set up and manage Google Ads campaigns
* Conduct keyword research and competitor analysis
* Manage Search, Display, Performance Max, and other relevant campaign types
* Optimize keywords, search terms, bids, budgets, ad copies, and targeting
* Monitor CPC, CTR, CPL, CPA, conversion rate, ROAS, and other key metrics

* Monitor campaigns daily and identify performance issues or opportunities

* Improve CPL, CPA, ROAS, conversion rates, and overall campaign efficiency
* Conduct A/B testing of audiences, creatives, ad copies, landing pages, and offers

* Prepare weekly/monthly performance reports for clients
* Present campaign results, key metrics, insights, and recommendations
* Clearly explain what is working, what is not working, and what needs to be improved
* Maintain accurate records of campaign performance and budgets

* Work closely with the Social Media and Creative teams to develop high\-performing ad creatives
* Provide creative briefs based on campaign objectives and audience insights
* Suggest new hooks, offers, angles, and creative concepts based on campaign data

title: Ecommerce Executive
description:
Run our marketplace business end to end \- listings, pricing, inventory, advertising, and daily operations across Amazon, Flipkart, Meesho, and other online platforms.
   

  

 Listing \& Catalogue Management
   

  

* Create new listings on Amazon Seller Central, Flipkart Seller Hub, Meesho Supplier Panel, JioMart, and Myntra with complete and accurate product data.
* Write keyword\-rich titles, bullet points, and descriptions that follow each marketplace's content policy and character limits.
* Upload and maintain product images, size charts, and A\+ content for brand\-registered listings.
* Maintain master catalogue sheets with SKU codes, EAN/GTIN, HSN codes, MRP, weight, and package dimensions.
* Run bulk uploads and corrections through flat files, and fix catalogue errors, suppressed listings, and listing quality flags.
* Map size, colour, and pack\-size variations correctly under parent\-child listings.
* Keep content consistent across every platform whenever a product, price, or pack size changes.


 Pricing \& Margin Control
   

  

* Set and revise selling prices on each marketplace after accounting for commission, shipping, fulfilment, and return costs.
* Track competitor pricing daily and adjust to stay competitive without giving away margin.
* Work on Buy Box ownership on Amazon and Flipkart and act on pricing recommendation reports.
* Maintain MRP and minimum selling price discipline so our own channels do not undercut each other.
* Plan discounts, coupons, bank offers, and combo pricing along with the sales and finance teams.
* Flag loss\-making SKUs and recommend price, pack, or packaging corrections.


 Inventory \& Fulfilment
   

  

* Monitor stock across FBA, Flipkart Smart Fulfilment, and self\-ship, and raise replenishment requests before a stockout.
* Create and track inbound shipments to marketplace warehouses with correct labelling and documentation.
* Keep marketplace inventory in sync with internal stock to avoid oversell, cancellations, and penalties.
* Coordinate with the warehouse and logistics team on pickups, dispatch SLAs, and packaging standards.
* Track ageing and slow\-moving stock and plan clearance or bundling action.


 Orders, Returns \& Customer Experience
   

  

* Process daily orders and keep late dispatch and cancellation rates within platform limits.
* Handle returns, refunds, and replacements, and analyse return reasons SKU by SKU.
* File and follow up claims for lost, damaged, and non\-returned shipments until reimbursement is received.
* Respond to buyer messages, product questions, and reviews within the platform response time.
* Work with the product and packaging teams to bring down damage and quality related returns.


 Advertising \& Growth
   

  

* Run and optimise Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Flipkart PLA campaigns within agreed budgets.
* Track ACOS, ROAS, CTR, and conversion rate, and move spend towards the SKUs that convert.
* Do keyword research for both listing content and ad targeting.
* Plan participation in platform events such as Great Indian Festival, Big Billion Days, and Meesho sale campaigns.
* Support new launches with launch pricing, review generation, and ad support.


 Account Health, Compliance \& Reporting
   

  

* Monitor account health dashboards, performance notifications, and policy warnings on every platform.
* Keep seller metrics such as order defect rate, return rate, and seller rating within safe limits.
* Maintain brand registry, category approvals, and product compliance documents.
* Reconcile marketplace settlements and payment reports against orders and escalate short payments.
* Build weekly and monthly reports on sales, category performance, ad spend, and returns for leadership.


 Who Can Apply
   

  

* Freshers with strong Excel skills or 1\-3 years of hands\-on experience running marketplace seller accounts.
* Working knowledge of Amazon Seller Central, Flipkart Seller Hub, or Meesho Supplier Panel is a strong advantage.
* Comfortable with Excel/Google Sheets \- filters, VLOOKUP, and pivot tables for catalogue and sales data.
* Understanding of marketplace commissions, shipping fees, and settlement reports.
* Basic knowledge of search keywords and marketplace advertising is a plus.
* Detail\-oriented and organised, with the patience to work through large product sheets.
* Fluency in English and Tamil.

title: Digital Marketing Executive (B2B)
description:
Location: Hyderabad (On\-site) 
 





 Experience: 2–3 years 
 





 CTC: ₹4 LPA – ₹5 LPA 
 





 Type: Full\-time (Hiring Immediately)
 




  





  






 COMPANY DESCRIPTION
 





 Group Welkin is a corporate and bulk\-order solutions group with over 50 years of experience rooted in the Indian kitchenware and household products industry. Alongside our B2B corporate gifting vertical, the group operates consumer retail brands and produces content\-led ventures including a podcast and a mentorship programme. We are building structured digital systems across all of these to drive consistent visibility, inbound interest, and lead generation.
 




  





  






 JOB DESCRIPTION
 




  






 This is a full\-time, on\-site Digital Marketing Executive role in Hyderabad, weighted toward technical execution.
 




  






 We are looking for someone who can do the work, not just plan it. Our main website is hard\-coded with a CMS. You will be reading page structure, writing schema, fixing redirects, and working directly with a developer to get changes shipped.
 




  






 The role spans three areas. First, owning search visibility for Group Welkin end\-to\-end, including making us findable in AI\-generated answers, not only in traditional search results. Second, running and growing our podcast channel on YouTube. Third, building the digital presence for a mentorship programme from scratch. Alongside all of that, you will set up and run paid campaigns on Meta, Google, and LinkedIn.
 




  






 This is a broad role, and it moves between very different audiences in the same week. We are looking for someone who
 
 can handle multiple threads at once and who can keep them moving without
 
 waiting for help.
 




  





  






 WORK LOCATION
 





 Hyderabad
 




  





  






 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
 





 Technical SEO (the core of this role)
 



* Run full technical audits of our websites: crawl errors, broken links, redirect chains, indexation issues, sitemap and robots configuration, and page speed
* Implement and maintain structured data markup, including Organisation, Product, FAQ, Article, and Video schema, and validate it
* Own on\-page SEO across a hard\-coded static site: title tags, meta descriptions, heading structure, internal linking, image optimisation, and canonical tags
* Set up and maintain 301 redirects, and clean up legacy URLs
* Work directly with our developer to get technical fixes implemented, and verify them afterwards
* Manage Google Search Console and Google Business Profile, and monitor indexation, coverage, and search performance



  






 Content and search strategy
 



* Conduct keyword research for B2B corporate gifting queries, starting with Hyderabad\-specific searches
* Write content briefs and optimise published content for search intent
* Build and maintain internal linking structure across the site and blog



  






 AEO and GEO
 



* Structure content so it is surfaced and cited in AI\-generated answers on Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, and Gemini
* Track our visibility across these platforms and report on how it changes
* Maintain consistent entity information about the company across the web



  






 YouTube and podcast channel
 



* Own YouTube SEO: titles, descriptions, tags, thumbnails, chapters, end screens, and playlists
* Publish and schedule episodes and Shorts on a consistent cadence
* Track watch time, retention, click\-through rate, and subscriber growth, and act on what the data shows
* Work with our video team to identify clips worth cutting into Shorts



  






 Paid campaigns
 



* Set up, launch, and optimise campaigns across Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, and LinkedIn Campaign Manager
* Implement and maintain conversion tracking: Google Tag Manager, GA4 events, Meta Pixel, and the LinkedIn Insight Tag
* Build LinkedIn Lead Gen Forms and monitor lead quality with the sales team
* Manage daily budget pacing, audience testing, and creative rotation



  






 Content operations and reporting
 



* Schedule and publish organic content across LinkedIn, Instagram, and YouTube using scheduling tools
* Use AI tools actively to draft, adapt, and optimise content, and edit output to match our brand voice
* Brief our design and video team on creative and content requirements
* Deliver a structured weekly report covering technical work completed, search performance, campaign results, channel growth, and key observations



  





  






 QUALIFICATIONS
 



* 2 to 3 years of hands\-on digital marketing experience with a clear technical SEO component
* Demonstrated experience doing technical SEO on a coded or static website, not only through a CMS plugin
* Hands\-on experience implementing schema markup and validating it
* Working knowledge of Google Search Console, Google Analytics 4, and Google Tag Manager
* Practical experience with at least one SEO crawler or audit tool, such as Screaming Frog, Ahrefs, or Semrush
* Hands\-on campaign experience in Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads. LinkedIn Campaign Manager experience is an advantage
* Working knowledge of AEO and GEO, how AI platforms select and cite sources, and how content can be structured to appear in them
* YouTube SEO and channel management experience is a strong advantage
* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Mass Communication, Engineering, or a related discipline preferred



  






 SKILLS AND REQUIREMENTS
 



* Able to read HTML and understand how a page is constructed. You do not need to be a developer, but you should be able to explain a technical fix to one and check whether it was done correctly
* Actively uses AI tools as part of daily content and research workflow, with judgement about where they help and where they do not
* Comfortable with social media scheduling tools such as Buffer or Later
* Strong written English for B2B communication and content briefs
* Able to read campaign and analytics data and form a view from it, rather than only reporting numbers
* Organised enough to hold several brands and channels at once without dropping threads
* Self\-driven, able to maintain content schedules and reporting without follow\-up
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, growth\-stage environment
* WordPress and WooCommerce familiarity is an advantage
* Office presence is mandatory



  





  






 COMPENSATION
 





 CTC: ₹4 LPA – ₹5 LPA (based on experience and demonstrated technical skills).
 





 Includes PF and other mandatory deductions. We will issue the offer letter and annexure after the office visit and discussion with management at the head office in Gandimaisamma.
 




  





  






 LANGUAGES

title: Off-Page SEO Specialist
description:
**About Keka** 




 Keka is India's \#1 People Operations Platform, trusted by 10,000\+ businesses to manage their HR, payroll, attendance, and performance processes. We are on a mission to make HR delightful — and we're looking for passionate people to help us scale that mission through world\-class marketing.
 



  





**Role snapshot** 




**Experience:** 
 3\-4 years in off\-page SEO, link building or outreach.
 



**Markets:** 
 India, United States, UAE / GCC
 



**Location:** 
 Hyderabad (On\-site)
 



  





**What you'll own** 




**Backlink campaign planning** 



* Build a quarterly link plan mapped to specific target pages and keyword clusters, rather than a fixed monthly link count. Plan anchor text and target\-page distribution deliberately, and maintain a natural link velocity.
* Run link\-gap analysis against defined competitors in each market using Ahrefs or Semrush, and prioritise prospects by how realistically they can be won. Segment them into tiers, each with its own approach: editorial and media, HR communities and associations, partner and integration pages, SaaS directories and roundups, guest contributions, and resource pages.
* Commission linkable assets with the content team, including survey data, calculators, statistics pages and templates, and then promote them. Maintain a single prospect database recording owner, status, last contact and outcome.
* Prospect and verify contacts, and write outreach that is short, specific and built around a single clear request.
* Manage replies through to completion, including negotiation and decisions on paid placements, and follow up until the link is live. Track reply rate, positive reply rate and link\-live rate by template, and discontinue approaches that do not perform.
* Establish Keka's presence in the sources AI systems draw from: “best HR software” and “best payroll software” roundups, comparison articles, and review platforms including G2, Capterra, GetApp, Software Advice, TrustRadius and SoftwareSuggest.
* Participate genuinely in the community surfaces that appear in AI answers, including relevant subreddits, Quora, LinkedIn and HR forums.
* Maintain consistent brand entity information wherever Keka is described, and correct outdated third\-party facts such as old pricing, discontinued features and comparisons with retired products.
* Run a fixed prompt set across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Copilot and Google AI Mode, recording which brands are named and which sources are cited, and target those sources. Report on\-site gaps, such as schema, content structure and llms.txt, to the SEO lead.
* Improve LLM citation performance through backlinks, analysing which platforms, directories, review sites, communities and other sources need to be reached out to in order to increase Keka’s visibility and citations across AI systems.
* Manage directory listings and review site listings, ensuring Keka is consistently represented across relevant directories, software listing platforms and review sites, and identify new platforms where a listing or backlink can strengthen search and LLM visibility.
* Audit links gained, links lost and spam exposure each month, and disavow only where clearly warranted. Reclaim links pointing to 404 pages or redirect chains, and raise the underlying fix with the SEO lead.
* Maintain a live reporting dashboard covering referring domains gained, weighted by the linking domain's organic traffic, links per target page, ranking movement on target pages, and AI citation share of voice.



**What you need to have** 



* 3\-4 years of experience in off\-page SEO, link building or outreach, in\-house or agency\-side.
* Strong written English. The role involves a high volume of written outreach.
* Hands\-on experience with Ahrefs, Semrush or Moz, and familiarity with Google Search Console.
* Experience running cold email at volume, with an understanding of deliverability fundamentals.
* Examples of live links you have personally built, with an explanation of how each was secured.



**Nice to have** 



* Experience in B2B SaaS or HR technology.
* Outreach experience with US, UK or GCC audiences.
* Experience with an outreach platform such as Pitchbox, BuzzStream, Instantly or Smartlead.
* Experience tracking AI search visibility, using a tool such as Peec, Profound or Otterly, or a manually maintained prompt log.

* Explain strategy and campaign performance.

title: Digital Marketing Manager
description:
Location: Bengaluru, Pune — on\-site
 



 This regional real\-estate developer has always sold through brokers and word of mouth in its home city. Its next project is in a second city where it has no existing broker network and no name recognition, which means digital is now the primary way it will reach buyers rather than a supporting channel. The company has partnered with Flexiple to hire a Digital Marketing Manager to own that shift.
 



**What you'd be building** 




 You will set up and run digital demand generation for a project launch from close to zero: paid search and social aimed at homebuyers researching a new city, a landing page and lead\-capture flow, and a retargeting sequence for people who visit a show apartment but do not book on the spot. Real estate lead cycles are long and this is not a lead\-farming role — you will be measured on qualified site visits and bookings, not raw form fills.
 



**How the launch team runs** 



* You report to the head of sales and marketing and work alongside the on\-ground sales team that handles site visits
* You manage the budget and agency relationship for paid media directly
* You track cost per qualified lead and cost per booking, and adjust spend weekly based on what sales is closing



**Who this role needs** 




 Two to seven years in digital or performance marketing, ideally with some real\-estate, high\-ticket, or long\-cycle\-purchase experience. You should be comfortable owning a paid budget directly, reading a CRM to understand what is actually converting to bookings rather than just leads, and working closely with an on\-ground sales team rather than at arm's length from them.
 


* Hands\-on experience with Google Ads and Meta Ads, including landing\-page and retargeting setup
* Comfort with a CRM and basic funnel reporting



**What you'd get out of it** 




 You would be the first owner of a real digital budget at this company, not inheriting someone else's dashboards, with direct visibility into what converts to actual bookings and a straight line to the head of sales and marketing.
 



**How this moves** 




 A short case exercise on the launch, one round with the head of sales and marketing, and a decision within two weeks.
 



 This application also puts you forward for other digital marketing roles we are currently hiring for.

 DesignCafe is a leading home interior solutions brand in India, founded in Bengaluru and now operating in 15 cities across the country. DesignCafe combines design expertise, technology, and streamlined execution to transform how home interiors are conceived and delivered in India. From individual kitchens and wardrobes to complete home projects, solutions are tailored to each homeowner’s lifestyle and needs, supported by Experience Centres across major cities and an online presence at DesignCafe.com.  DesignCafe is hiring a Senior Paid Media Analyst who really knows Google Ads and Meta Ads inside out and can plan, launch, and optimize campaigns end to end. We want someone who's spent enough time in these platforms to understand how the auctions and algorithms actually behave, not just someone who knows which buttons to click.
 



 Paid media execution looks quite different today than it did even a couple of years ago, with automated bidding, AI\-driven campaign types, and generative tools now part of everyday work. So we're also looking for someone who's comfortable using AI tools for things like creative generation, copy testing, and reporting, while still applying good judgement on strategy and optimization.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



 • Campaign Execution: Plan, set up, launch, and manage campaigns end to end across Google Ads (Search, Display, YouTube, Performance Max) and Meta Ads (Facebook, Instagram, Advantage\+).
 



 • Platform Depth: Bring a solid, current understanding of how Google Ads and Meta Ads actually work: auction dynamics, automated bidding, audience signals, and algorithm behaviour, and use that to push performance beyond the basics.
 



 • AI\-First Execution: Use AI tools for ad copy and creative generation, creative testing, performance insights, and reporting to work faster and get more done.
 



 • Daily Optimization: Monitor and optimize bids, budgets, targeting, and creatives on a daily basis to keep improving performance.
 



 • Creative \& Landing Page Testing: Run structured A/B and multivariate tests on ad creatives and landing pages, using data and AI\-assisted analysis to find winning variants faster.
 



 • Reporting \& Insights: Build and maintain performance dashboards and reports, and use AI tools to help pull out trends and insights rather than just raw numbers.
 



 • Attribution \& Tracking: Set up and QA pixels, events, UTM tracking, GA4, and attribution so the data you're working with is clean and reliable.
 



 • Lead Quality: Track lead\-to\-sale conversion and flag lead quality issues early, based on what the funnel data is telling you.
 



 • Staying Current: Keep an eye on new platform features, automated campaign types, AI\-driven ad products, and other tools worth bringing into your day\-to\-day work.
 



 Skills \& Experience
 



 • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field.
 



 • 3\+ years of hands\-on experience in performance marketing or paid media, with strong, demonstrable expertise in Google Ads and Meta Ads. This is a must.
 



 • Experience managing paid media budgets of ₹10 Cr\+ (cumulative or annualized) across campaigns.
 



 • Good understanding of bidding strategies, audience targeting, campaign structuring, and platform algorithms, and the reasoning behind what works, not just how to execute it.
 



 • Hands\-on experience with Performance Max, Advantage\+, and other automated or AI\-driven campaign types.
 



 • Comfortable using AI tools for creative generation, copywriting, data analysis, and workflow automation as part of everyday execution.
 



 • Proficiency in Google Analytics (GA4\), Google Tag Manager, and Excel.
 



 • Strong analytical mindset with the ability to turn data into clear, actionable decisions.
 



 • High ownership and attention to detail, with the ability to execute independently in a fast\-paced environment.
 



 • Genuinely curious about how paid media platforms and AI\-driven marketing tools keep evolving
 



  





  





 Interested, Drop in your CV to radhika.an@designcafe.com
