**Deal Desk \& Compliance:** Support the field sales team on complex deal structuring, pricing configuration, and non\-standard contract terms while ensuring compliance with corporate policies.
  
**Cross\-Functional Strategy:** Partner with Marketing for seamless lead management and with Finance for compensation planning, budgeting, and commission tracking.
  
**Team Enablement:** Train, onboard, and support the sales organization on new tools, policies, and best practices to drive platform adoption.
  
Qualifications and Experience
  
**Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Analytics, or a related field (Master’s or MBA preferred).
  
**Experience:** Minimum of 5 to 7\+ years of experience in a sales operations, revenue operations, or commercial analytics role.
  
**CRM Mastery:** Advanced, hands\-on administration experience with leading CRMs like Salesforce or HubSpot .
  
**Technical Acumen:** High proficiency with data visualization tools (Tableau, PowerBI), advanced Excel modeling, and SQL/VBA logic.
  
**Industry Background:** Prior experience in technology\-related fields, SaaS, B2B enterprise sales, or management consulting is highly desired

title: AWS Partnership Manager
description:
**THIS ROLE IS NOT WITH 2070 HEALTH**


This role will be responsible to runs day to day engagement with AWS partner managers and solutions teams, ensure every Associated program requirement are met and managed for Contiinex. Some of the active engagement today are:


1\. An active pipeline driving Sales through Marketplace and ISV programs


2\. Service track built around delivery and co\-sell motions with AWS teams for our Contiinex consumption driver in AWS


3\. Software track engagement

 **Requirements** **Roles \& Responsibilities:**

* Program management across both tracks: AWS ISV Accelerate, AWS Marketplace listings, AWS Partner\-Led/Co\-Sell (ACE), and any future programs Contiinex qualifies for.
* The day\-to\-day relationship with AWS partner managers, solutions architects, and program leads the first point of contact for anything AWS\-side.
* Manage BOX partnerships with other AWS partners who are building toolkit for Contiinex
* Partnership\-sourced pipeline and revenue: build the co\-sell motion with AWS sales teams, track deals through ACE, and report progress against target.
* Renewals and requirements: track every program's certification, technical review, and renewal deadline so Contiinex never lapses on standing.
* Cross\-functional coordination with product, sales, and marketing to keep AWS\- facing narratives, case studies, and Marketplace listings current and as per the competency.
* Representation at AWS events, partner reviews, and joint business planning sessions. Maintain a clear, recurring view for leadership: program status, pipeline sourced, status, revenue closed, and what is needed next from Contiinex to keep both tracks moving.

**Experience:**

* 4–5 years of experience managing a hyperscaler partnership, AWS strongly preferred including direct exposure to ISV, SI, or Marketplace programs.
* Exposure to AWS for US account
* Working knowledge of the AWS Partner Network: program tiers, ACE co\-sell, Marketplace mechanics, and funding programs.
* A track record of turning partner programs into measurable pipeline and revenue, not just program compliance.
* Strong stakeholder management, confidence in engaging AWS partner teams, Contiinex leadership, and delivery partners in the same week.
* Healthcare, RCM, or US enterprise exposure is a plus, given Contiinex's focus on US healthcare Revenue Cycle Management.

**Role KPI Metrics**

* Partnership\-sourced pipeline and closed revenue, tracked quarter over quarter.
* Programs active and in good standing across both tracks, without missing renewal or recertification deadlines.
* Co\-sell deals registered and advanced through ACE.
* Marketplace listing health and Partnership\-led content shipped on schedule.

title: Principal Systems Engr
description:
**About us:**

Join a company that's reintroducing itself to the aviation community we've helped advance for more than a century. At Honeywell Aerospace (NASDAQ: HONA), we're launching as an independent, publicly traded aerospace and defense company built on a legacy of operational excellence and mission\-focused execution.  



Our new brand identity pairs that heritage with real momentum, as we build technology that helps pilots navigate with confidence, aircraft operate more efficiently, and operators stay ahead of change. With our systems on board 90% of the world's aircraft, your work here has reach that's rare to find anywhere else.  



Focusing on our customers, investing in innovation, and building a culture of accountability and performance is how we're shaping what comes next.


Every horizon. Every mission. Every day.


**Principal Systems Engineer**

Technically Lead, develop, and motivate engineering teams responsible for the System design and development of Business Jet programs. You will be responsible for defining, executing the technical content by working with high performing System engineers. You will participate in all phases of Program development and drive high impact growth projects.


Develop, mentor and inspire engineers who work to develop innovative products and technologies. Influence \& challenge engineer teams to effectively solve complex engineering problems.
  

Build and guide highly talented engineering teams to deliver exceptional solutions.


**Essential Skills:**

This role will be primarily responsible for


* **Execution Excellence**
	+ Technical Lead for a project, including project’s overall technical solution, system level performance, configuration management, quality, and certification
	+ Managing System requirements, controlling scope, and executing baseline change management
	+ Leading critical stage gates and objectives of programs viz., Technical Concept Review (TCR), Preliminary Design Reviews (PDRs), Critical Design Reviews (CDRs), Phase gate exits, SOI/SR (Supplier Review) Audits and Customer \& Cert authority reviews as required.
	+ Define and drive the ARP4754A/B practices across the programs by demonstrating strong adherence and compliance with the same
	+ Responsible to ensure Programs are compliance to TSO standards (TSO C\-165a/b, C\-195b) for the applicable products and meet System/Software Certification Requirements
	+ Participates in Systems and Software architecture, Requirement and Design reviews.
	+ Drive strong System/Software Architectures and reduce the integration cost of inserting the products into program
	+ Strategically own and drive key initiatives viz., System Engineering Improvements (content development plans, Integrated Verification Test Plans (IVTP), Use Cases, System Test Integration Checkouts) and influence stakeholders on early adaption and incremental outcomes.
	+ Drive efficiencies across the COEs and drive productivity
	+ Strategically own and drive key initiatives viz., Systems Test Integration Testing, Model based development and influence stakeholders on early adaption and incremental outcomes.
	+ Driving strong Basis of Estimates (BOE) across each of the Quotation estimates of responsible program for the content by working through PEs, Systems Leads, functional leads and technical managers as required.
	+ Provides hands\-on engineering support, mentor and groom engineers on the programs and their technical career path
* **Technology and Business**
	+ Responsible for System technical solution development (Design \& interface definition). Demonstrate thought leadership with focus on System architecture with increased reusability and drive reduction in program cost.
	+ Establishes strong working relationships with key stakeholders ( Product Managers, Chiefs, Human Factors ) to drive growth through NPI’s (New Product Introduction).
	+ Engages in software architecture, design and requirement reviews as a key input provider, first level approver.
	+ Drive robust plan and pipeline of rapid prototypes for the near\-term risk avoidance to the program and medium\-term features which bring revenue potential through POC (Proof of Concept), POVs (Point of View) / Agile model.
* **Strategic Impact**
	+ Works with Engineering Managers to develop capability in Systems expertise
	+ Collaborate effectively as required on High Growth Regions pursuits, participate in industry/customer visits, share knowledge gained through conference participation etc.
	+ Imbibes and role model Honeywell Aerospace behaviors and values and act as change agent.
	+ Supporting Strategic Plan revenue targets through competitive intelligence and product line software architecture frameworks
	+ Driving technology initiatives and feature insertion per M\&PM (Marketing \& Product Management) Displays programs roadmap \& strategies

title: Manager-Brand Marketing (Retail)
description:
**About the Role:**

The Marketing Manager – Retail Training will be responsible for driving demand, lead generation, and enrolments for CloudThat's retail training business. The role will own the end\-to\-end marketing strategy and execution across digital channels, CRM, content, events, webinars, and partner initiatives to achieve revenue and enrolment targets.

This role requires a hands\- on marketing leader who can develop growth strategies, optimize marketing funnels, manage teams, and collaborate with internal stakeholders to drive measurable business outcomes. The individual will lead marketing initiatives from awareness to conversion while ensuring effective utilization of budgets, channels, and resources.

**Key Responsibilities:**

·

· Develop and execute annual and quarterly marketing plans to achieve retail training revenue, enrolment, and growth targets.

· Own end\-to\-end demand generation and lead generation across paid, organic, referral, webinar, event, partnership, and community channels.

· Plan, execute, and optimize integrated marketing campaigns across digital channels including paid media, social media, email marketing, SEO, and website.

· Drive webinars, workshops, bootcamps, masterclasses, events, and other engagement initiatives to generate quality leads and registrations.

· Own lead lifecycle management through CRM platforms, including lead tracking, segmentation, nurturing, drip campaigns, and conversion optimization.

· Collaborate with sales, SME’s, training operations, and other stakeholders to improve lead quality, conversion rates, and enrolment outcomes.

· Review and guide the development of marketing content, landing pages, emailers, ad creatives, brochures, and other marketing collateral to ensure quality and effectiveness.

· Monitor and optimize website performance, landing pages, customer journeys, and SEO initiatives to improve traffic, engagement, and conversions.

· Analyze marketing performance, derive actionable insights, and present regular reports on traffic, leads, registrations, enrolments, CPL, CAC, and ROI to leadership.

· Lead, mentor, and manage the marketing team, ensuring effective delegation, execution excellence, stakeholder alignment, and achievement of business objectives.

**Requirements (Must\-Have):**

· 5\+ years of experience in B2C marketing, preferably for products, services, or training businesses.

· 3\+ years of experience in Education, EdTech, Training, or related industries.

· Proven experience in lead generation, demand generation, and customer acquisition.

· Strong understanding of email, WhatsApp, SMS, social media, webinars, and community\-led marketing.

· Hands\-on experience with CRM and marketing automation platforms (Lead Squared, Meritto, Zoho, HubSpot, or similar).

· Experience in lead nurturing, drip campaigns, segmentation, and conversion optimization.

· Good understanding of website management, landing pages, conversion funnels, and SEO fundamentals.

· Strong analytical skills with experience in Google Analytics, Looker Studio, and marketing reporting.

· Experience managing cross\-functional teams and marketing projects end\-to\-end.

**Good to Have:**

· Working knowledge of Google Ads, Meta Ads, and LinkedIn Ads.

· Experience in cloud, technology, certification, or skilling businesses.

· Experience managing webinars, workshops, bootcamps, or community programs.

· Familiarity with AI\-powered marketing and automation tools.

· MBA in Marketing or relevant certifications in Digital Marketing, CRM, or Marketing Automation.

**What We Offer:**

* Competitive salary and performance bonuses.
* Learning \& development opportunities.
* Collaborative and diverse team environment.
* Be a part of the ONLY company in the world to be recognized by Microsoft, AWS, and Google Cloud with prestigious awards in 2025\.

**Application Process:**Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for a Virtual/Face to Face interview. Our process includes a \[5–rounds of interview].

**About VBlue \& The Opportunity**

VBlue manufactures and supplies eco\-friendly Diesel Exhaust Fluid (DEF / AdBlue), built around sustainable, pre\-filled packaging that improves vehicle SCR performance and reduces plastic waste. This is a ground\-floor opportunity to join a fast\-growing, feet\-on\-street launch team with clear KRAs, monthly incentives, and a defined growth roadmap.

The Territory Sales Manager will own Bangalore's key B2B accounts and distributor growth for VBlue's DEF range, while coaching a team of on\-ground Business Development Managers (BDMs).

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage, coach and drive daily productivity of assigned Business Development Managers (BDMs) across Bangalore City \& Bangalore Outskirts
* Own key B2B account acquisition – fleet owners, transporters, logistics parks, industrial SCR users and highway truck hubs
* Lead distributor identification, qualification, onboarding and credit\-terms alignment across Bangalore's Tier 1, 2 and 3 markets
* Run weekly territory reviews covering market intelligence, competitor price tracking and pipeline health
* Conduct monthly distributor business reviews focused on secondary sales, not just billing
* Coordinate with the team to ensure CRM is kept current and leads from retail/petrol\-pump touchpoints are converted
* Support on\-site product demonstrations of VBlue's anti\-crystallization DEF formula for fleet and industrial clients

* **B2B: Fleet owners, transporters, logistics companies, industrial SCR/genset users, bus operators, OEM/dealer workshops**
* **B2C: BS6 diesel car/SUV owners, retail walk\-in customers via petrol pumps, genset owners**
* **Channel: Bangalore\-based distributors/stockists, petrol pump \& auto\-parts store networks, mechanic cooperatives**

**Requirements**

* 5\-8 years in B2B/channel field sales, preferably in automotive lubricants, industrial chemicals, auto\-ancillary or FMCG
* Demonstrated experience managing a field sales team (BDM/TSE) and building distributor networks
* Strong negotiation, key\-account management and local market knowledge of Bangalore City \& outskirts
* Comfortable with CRM/reporting tools and KRA/KPI\-driven performance tracking
* Graduate in any discipline; MBA in Sales/Marketing is a plus

**Compensation \& Benefits**

**Fixed Monthly Salary**

**Performance Incentive**

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Paid sick time

title: Sr. Manager Data Analytics-1
description:
**About us:**


As a Fortune 50 company with more than 400,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of America's leading retailers.


Working at Target means the opportunity to help all families discover the joy of everyday life. Caring for our communities is woven into who we are, and we invest in the places we collectively live, work and play. We prioritize relationships, fuel and develop talent by creating growth opportunities, and succeed as one Target team. At our core, our purpose is ingrained in who we are, what we value, and how we work. It’s how we care, grow, and win together.
 

A role in Merchandising Capabilities means partnering with Merchandising, technology, data science and analytics leaders to co\-create solutions that maximizes business value and enables key strategies that are critical to the enterprise and for the experiences we create for our guests. Truly an owner and expert of your product and underlying processes, you will set the vision, align on the roadmap and mobilize teams to deliver needed outcomes. Given most strategies have a business impact, you will also serve as a trusted resource to guide other enterprise partners in their solutions to ensure the success and integrity of end\-to\-end deliverables.


As a Sr. Manager, Data Analytics in Merchandising, you will be accountable for setting the vision, strategy, roadmap, and quality expectations for data, reporting, analytics, automation, and AI capabilities for a specific business function within our Merchandising organization. You will serve as an advocate of our data\-driven culture and a trusted advisor to business leaders, helping identify where analytics and AI can create the greatest business value. In partnership with your team of Data Analysts, you will translate business priorities into a portfolio of scalable solutions, ensure measurable outcomes, and build an effective analytics ecosystem that informs and influences decisions. You will build a high\-performing team through talent pipeline planning, hiring, coaching, setting clear expectations, capability development, and performance management. You will partner closely with Merchandising, Product Management, Data Science, Technology, and other analytics teams to align solutions, address capability gaps, and democratize trusted data and insights.


Core responsibilities of this job are described within this job description. Job duties may change at any time due to business needs.

**As a Sr****.** **Manager****,** **Data** **Analytics** **for** **Target's** **Merch Data Analytics team** **you'll****:**


Lead an analytics team that supports our world\-class Merchandising leadership with data, insights, automation, and AI capabilities that enable faster, smarter, and more scalable decision\-making. Collaborate with stakeholders to understand their priorities and roadmaps, translate business problems into a clear portfolio of work, and hold the team accountable for delivering measurable business outcomes.

* Set the vision, strategy, and roadmap for data, reporting, analytics, automation, and AI capabilities for the business area, and prioritize work based on business value, urgency, scalability, and strategic alignment.
* Provide thought leadership in the application of data and analytics, helping business leaders identify opportunities where insights, automation, Generative AI, AI agents, or agentic AI can materially improve decisions and outcomes.
* Translate complex and ambiguous business problems into a portfolio of scalable analytical and AI\-enabled solutions, defining clear success measures and ensuring the team remains focused on business outcomes rather than isolated technical deliverables.
* Guide and challenge the team's analytical and solution\-design approach, establishing expectations for technical quality, scalability, maintainability, and appropriate use of statistical, analytical, and AI methods.
* Ensure the team has the capability to work effectively with large\-scale datasets and modern data ecosystems, including platforms and technologies such as GCP BigQuery, Spark, SQL\-based data warehouses, and data pipelines using Airflow or similar orchestration tools.
* Establish standards for evaluating and monitoring AI\-driven analytical workflows, including defining appropriate quality metrics such as accuracy and relevance, assessing reliability, and measuring adoption and business impact of AI\-enabled solutions.
* Identify and prioritize high\-impact Generative AI opportunities and guide the adoption of AI\-agent\-enabled and agentic AI capabilities to automate repeatable analytical work, improve productivity, accelerate insight generation, and enable faster decision\-making.
* Establish and promote responsible and scalable AI practices, including data privacy, governance, bias and risk considerations, explainability, human oversight, and integration with the broader data and analytics ecosystem.
* Ensure analytical methodologies, AI solutions, key assumptions, evaluation approaches, and reusable patterns are appropriately documented to improve transparency, maintainability, knowledge sharing, and reuse across the team.
* Partner closely with Merchandising, Product Management, Data Science, Technology, and analytics partners to align roadmaps, resolve dependencies, identify capability gaps, and democratize access to trusted data and insights.
* Develop trusted relationships with business leaders and communicate complex analytical and technical concepts in clear business terms, ensuring recommendations are actionable and connected to measurable business drivers.

Job Summary
  
  

* Group Internal Audit and Investigations (GIAI) is looking for an accomplished and highly motivated audit professional with a robust background and strong expertise around the key risks and controls in the Human Resources (HR); Corporate Affairs Brand and Marketing (CABM) and Strategy portfolio which fall within the wider Functions and Group Chief Operating Officer (GCOO) portfolios..
* The role\-holder will be an integral part of the Functions and GCOO Audit teams. The team provides independent assessments of risk management and internal control environment of HR, CABM and Strategy globally.
* We pride ourselves in being auditors of the future, forward\-looking and agile with a keen focus on smarter auditing. When you join us, you will enter a role that challenges the status quo and moves mindsets and be a part of the future of banking


Key Responsibilities
  
  

Strategy
  
* Support Audit Directors and Senior Audit Managers where required, in the development of the GIA risk assessment and development of an appropriate audit plan for the HR, CABM and Strategy portfolio;
* Propose audits for coverage during the audit cycle based on their knowledge of the business;
* Audits assigned to the individual in the audit plan should address the key risks identified in the detailed risk assessment and in the audit planning process and meet relevant regulatory requirements and expectations that are required to be covered by GIAI.
* Ensure that audit team operates in line with the Audit Charter during engagements, remains independent from management and free from interference.
* Build the knowledge, awareness and confidence across the GIAI teams so that over time, support for HR, CABM and Strategy audits outside of the GCOO and Functions team can be tailored to need and that functional and product teams are confident in completing relevant audit tests.


Business
  
* Effectively manage the cost of assigned audits within the allocated budget for their areas within audit engagements


Processes
  
* To act as Team Lead/ Team Member on assigned audit work across the Group.
* Provide technical input and challenge on audit work being undertaken within the scope of assigned product area of responsibility. This will include working with the audit team to produce outputs of high quality which address the areas of greatest risk.
* When Team Leading to provide clear guidance, detailed review and supervision of the audit team’s work so that audit deliverables meet quality standards and timelines in line with the GIA methodology.
* When Team Leading to provide guidance on business/audit technical knowledge and management skills to team members to enable them to effectively deliver their assigned contributions for an audit.
* Support adherence to the GIA methodology in all areas of the audit engagement, as well as raising awareness and understanding of the methodology.
* Demonstrate sound knowledge of both business/technical areas and expert knowledge in the audit process, including the GIAI system, so that audit work is carried out to a high standard that meets all methodology and GIAI system requirements.
* Monitor the implementation/delivery of the agreed issues/audit plans for the audits assigned, understanding the key risks arising, provide advice on resolution of issues to auditees/action plan owners and escalate audit findings that remain unresolved.
* Demonstrates strong foundational analytics skills, with the ability to independently design, execute and interpret data driven audit tests. Proficient in using data analytics tools (e.g., SQL, Python, Excel advanced functions, Tableau, Power BI, or equivalent) to support audit planning, fieldwork and continuous monitoring activities.


Analytics Responsibilities
  
* Apply data and analytics techniques during the audit cycle for better efficiency and effectiveness
* Contribute to the design and implementation of effective continuous monitoring and automated testing strategies using analytics
* Work with key stakeholders to understand data flow, data points for key systems relevant to the audit portfolio


People \& Talent
  
* Share knowledge to increase specialism within the function.
* Influence change within the department by highlighting potential enhancements.
* Identify growth areas on an ongoing basis and identify how best to develop them.
* When Team Leading provide performance feedback, as appropriate at the end of an audit.
* Identify and successfully complete key internal training for self\-development.
* Facilitate the development of audit team members by providing on the job training and recommending formal training to support GIAI activities.


Risk Management
  
* Assist in the update of the assigned Continuous Risk Assessment on a regular basis to identify changes in risk profiles and document these in a timely manner, proposing changes to the assigned audit plan, as appropriate.
* Promote early identification and escalation of risks, issues, trends and developments to relevant stakeholders. Be prepared to raise issues/concerns outside the normal audit process.
* Adopt an anticipatory approach to risk assessment through stakeholder engagement and monitoring of the external environment to improve audit planning; and
* Review MI and reports regularly to keep up\-to\-date with key trends within the business and audit deliverables.


Governance
  
* Manage the relevant portfolio stakeholders and establish good working relationships to help the businesses improve the control environment and keep updated with changes in the business impacting their risk profile.
* Use networks and relationships to build engagement and achieve results.
* Escalate delays in the execution of audit work, both to auditee management and GIA Management.
* Be able to clearly explain issues identified along with the risks and root causes to GIA and business management, using language designed to be understood by non\-experts


Regulatory \& Business Conduct
  
* Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
* Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
* Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.


Key stakeholders
  
* Designated business stakeholders, typically related to assigned portfolio; and
* GIAI stakeholders – team leaders, team members, team managers, Audit Directors, Senior Audit Directors.


Other Responsibilities
  
* Embed Here for good and Group’s brand and values in GIA; and
* Perform other responsibilities assigned under Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures.


Skills and Experience
  
  

* GIA Methodology and Systems
* Stakeholder Engagement
* Risk Assessment
* Audit Planning
* Audit Report Writing
* Continuous Monitoring
* Ability to work within a global team
* Data analysis
* Data insights (generation and interpretation)
* Basic Tools (MS Excel, Power BI etc.)


Qualifications
  
  

* Experience in Audit, Governance, Risk or business environment.
* Professional Audit or Accounting Certification preferred
* Good Communicator, both written and verbal, with an ability to influence and gain respect of senior management, stakeholders, peers and their teams.
* Confident and courageous to raise / escalate issues in a pro active, professional and timely manner.
* Self\-directed and able to work with minimum supervisions
* Demonstrates understanding and commitment to the Group’s Core Values
* Familiarity with Banking Regulations,
* Working experience with analytics/visualisation tools such as PowerBI, Tableau, or similar tools, and is able interpret and generate data insights using data visualisation
* Certifications around analytics and AI/Gen AI will be an advantage


About Standard Chartered
  
  

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.
  
  

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.
  
  

**Together we:**  

Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  
Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  
Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term
  
What we offer
  
  

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
  
  

Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  
Time\-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  
Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  
Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market\-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first\-aiders and all sorts of self\-help toolkits
  
A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  
Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies \- everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

VBlue manufactures and supplies eco\-friendly Diesel Exhaust Fluid (DEF / AdBlue), built around sustainable, pre\-filled packaging that improves vehicle SCR performance and reduces plastic waste. This is a ground\-floor opportunity to join a fast\-growing, feet\-on\-street launch team with clear KRAs, monthly incentives, and a defined growth roadmap.

The Territory Sales Manager will own Bangalore's key B2B accounts and distributor growth for VBlue's DEF range, while coaching a team of on\-ground Business Development Managers (BDMs).

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage, coach and drive daily productivity of assigned Business Development Managers (BDMs) across Chennai \& Chennai Outskirts
* Own key B2B account acquisition – fleet owners, transporters, logistics parks, industrial SCR users and highway truck hubs
* Lead distributor identification, qualification, onboarding and credit\-terms alignment across Bangalore's Tier 1, 2 and 3 markets
* Run weekly territory reviews covering market intelligence, competitor price tracking and pipeline health
* Conduct monthly distributor business reviews focused on secondary sales, not just billing
* Coordinate with the team to ensure CRM is kept current and leads from retail/petrol\-pump touchpoints are converted
* Support on\-site product demonstrations of VBlue's anti\-crystallization DEF formula for fleet and industrial clients

**Who You Will Sell To / Work With**

* **B2B: Fleet owners, transporters, logistics companies, industrial SCR/genset users, bus operators, OEM/dealer workshops**
* **B2C: BS6 diesel car/SUV owners, retail walk\-in customers via petrol pumps, genset owners**
* **Channel: Bangalore\-based distributors/stockists, petrol pump \& auto\-parts store networks, mechanic cooperatives**

**Requirements**

* 5\-8 years in B2B/channel field sales, preferably in automotive lubricants, industrial chemicals, auto\-ancillary or FMCG
* Demonstrated experience managing a field sales team (BDM/TSE) and building distributor networks
* Strong negotiation, key\-account management and local market knowledge of Bangalore City \& outskirts
* Comfortable with CRM/reporting tools and KRA/KPI\-driven performance tracking
* Graduate in any discipline; MBA in Sales/Marketing is a plus

**Compensation \& Benefits**

**Fixed Monthly Salary**

**Performance Incentive**

**Allowances**

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 \- ₹35,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Paid sick time

Solenis is a leading global producer of specialty chemicals focused on partnering with water\-intensive operations to solve complex water treatment, process improvement and hygiene challenges with advanced chemical and equipment solutions for consumer, industrial, institutional, food \& beverage, and recreational pool and spa water markets.


The product portfolio of Solenis includes a broad array of water treatment chemistries, process aids, functional additives, and cleaners and disinfectants, as well as state\-of\-the\-art monitoring and control systems. description:
**Description**
 The Manager III, Program Management role will lead the Fee Strategy Operations (FSO) team — Amazon's central execution and operations arm for fee strategy, seller incentive programs, and Go\-To\-Market (GTM) delivery across worldwide marketplaces. You will manage a team of program managers, business analysts, and operations specialists working at the intersection of Fee Strategy, Product, Tech, Operations, and cross\-functional stakeholder teams to drive execution across key workstreams including annual and peak fee changes, seller incentive programs (NSI, NSP, GSI), Gen AI–powered automation, and seller experience improvements.
   

  

 Our environment is fast\-paced and high\-impact — the team manages GTM execution across 19\+ marketplaces, coordinates with 40–50 cross\-functional POCs per launch, and drives programs projected to generate billions in incremental seller GMS. This role requires a self\-starter who is detail\-oriented, analytical, and comfortable leading through ambiguity while managing multiple concurrent programs, partners, and senior leadership stakeholders.
   

  

 The Fees Team is looking for an experienced, enthusiastic, and diligent Manager who can deliver on complex cross\-functional programs while aligning with organizational goals and partnering across Product, Tech, Finance, Legal, Tax, Marketing, and Seller Support teams. You should understand business problems end\-to\-end and have the ability to prevent or mitigate consequences of poor business decisions. As the owner of the program, you should be able to look at the bigger business picture, drive outcomes by understanding relevant business requirements, and scale operations through automation and AI\-driven solutions.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Lead and develop a team of program managers, analysts, and operations specialists responsible for worldwide fee strategy execution and incentive program management
* Own end\-to\-end GTM execution for annual fee changes, peak fee changes, and policy updates across US, CA, EU, JP, AU, and emerging marketplaces — managing 100\+ tasks, 20\+ milestones, and coordination across 15\+ teams per cycle
* Drive program management for seller incentive programs (New Seller Incentives, New Selection Program, Global Selling Incentives) including launch readiness, enrollment acceleration, credit utilization campaigns, and causal measurement
* Partner with cross\-functional teams including Fee Strategy Product Managers, Tech, Legal, Tax, Finance, Marketing, and Seller Support to understand business requirements and deliver integrated execution plans
* Identify, quantify, and escalate technical issues across incentive programs — driving root cause analysis, impact assessment, reimbursement execution, and seller communications
* Champion Gen AI and automation initiatives to scale operations, including AI\-powered ticket resolution, content generation agents, and automated data quality auditing
* Communicate regularly with senior leadership and stakeholders; define and track relevant KPIs to report program health, seller impact, and operational performance
* Plan resourcing, analyze and report weekly and monthly metrics; identify trends and opportunities to improve processes and reduce seller friction
* Execute high\-priority, cross\-functional projects to improve operations performance and seller experience
* Design and implement automation solutions that remove manual processes and enable stakeholders to manage the business more effectively
* Build and maintain centralized data stores and reporting dashboards to enable self\-serve analytics for worldwide tenant and internal teams


 A day in the life
   

  

* Be a part of BRD review for an upcoming annual fee change, aligning GTM timelines and RACI ownership across 17 teams
* Review metrics on fee incentive programs (NSI, NSP, GSI) with business stakeholders — tracking enrollment, credit consumption, and iGMS impact
* Manage a seller escalation related to fee discrepancies, coordinating root cause analysis and reimbursement execution
* Develop a working backwards plan for seller communications related to a fee policy change across multiple worldwide marketplaces
* Review AI agent performance metrics — assessing auto\-resolution rates for the NSI/NSP Resolver Agent and identifying expansion opportunities
* Align with Product and Tech teams on upcoming incentive program launches, ensuring operational readiness and test order validation


**Basic Qualifications**
* 6\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* 6\+ years of team management experience
* 6\+ years of cross functional project delivery experience
* 5\+ years of program or project management experience
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience managing, analyzing and communicating results to senior management
* Experience driving GTM execution for fee changes, incentive programs, or seller/merchant\-facing initiatives across multiple marketplaces
* Experience operating in a WW (worldwide) program management capacity across multiple geographies and regulatory environments
* Familiarity with Gen AI tools and automation frameworks (e.g., AI agents, workflow automation) to scale operational processes

title: Manager III, Program Manager, Seller Economics & Fees
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


The Manager III, Program Management role will lead the Fee Strategy Operations (FSO) team — Amazon's central execution and operations arm for fee strategy, seller incentive programs, and Go\-To\-Market (GTM) delivery across worldwide marketplaces. You will manage a team of program managers, business analysts, and operations specialists working at the intersection of Fee Strategy, Product, Tech, Operations, and cross\-functional stakeholder teams to drive execution across key workstreams including annual and peak fee changes, seller incentive programs (NSI, NSP, GSI), Gen AI–powered automation, and seller experience improvements.  

Our environment is fast\-paced and high\-impact — the team manages GTM execution across 19\+ marketplaces, coordinates with 40–50 cross\-functional POCs per launch, and drives programs projected to generate billions in incremental seller GMS. This role requires a self\-starter who is detail\-oriented, analytical, and comfortable leading through ambiguity while managing multiple concurrent programs, partners, and senior leadership stakeholders.  

The Fees Team is looking for an experienced, enthusiastic, and diligent Manager who can deliver on complex cross\-functional programs while aligning with organizational goals and partnering across Product, Tech, Finance, Legal, Tax, Marketing, and Seller Support teams. You should understand business problems end\-to\-end and have the ability to prevent or mitigate consequences of poor business decisions. As the owner of the program, you should be able to look at the bigger business picture, drive outcomes by understanding relevant business requirements, and scale operations through automation and AI\-driven solutions.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Lead and develop a team of program managers, analysts, and operations specialists responsible for worldwide fee strategy execution and incentive program management
* Own end\-to\-end GTM execution for annual fee changes, peak fee changes, and policy updates across US, CA, EU, JP, AU, and emerging marketplaces — managing 100\+ tasks, 20\+ milestones, and coordination across 15\+ teams per cycle
* Drive program management for seller incentive programs (New Seller Incentives, New Selection Program, Global Selling Incentives) including launch readiness, enrollment acceleration, credit utilization campaigns, and causal measurement
* Partner with cross\-functional teams including Fee Strategy Product Managers, Tech, Legal, Tax, Finance, Marketing, and Seller Support to understand business requirements and deliver integrated execution plans
* Identify, quantify, and escalate technical issues across incentive programs — driving root cause analysis, impact assessment, reimbursement execution, and seller communications
* Champion Gen AI and automation initiatives to scale operations, including AI\-powered ticket resolution, content generation agents, and automated data quality auditing
* Communicate regularly with senior leadership and stakeholders; define and track relevant KPIs to report program health, seller impact, and operational performance
* Plan resourcing, analyze and report weekly and monthly metrics; identify trends and opportunities to improve processes and reduce seller friction
* Execute high\-priority, cross\-functional projects to improve operations performance and seller experience
* Design and implement automation solutions that remove manual processes and enable stakeholders to manage the business more effectively
* Build and maintain centralized data stores and reporting dashboards to enable self\-serve analytics for worldwide tenant and internal teams

  

A day in the life  

1\. Be a part of BRD review for an upcoming annual fee change, aligning GTM timelines and RACI ownership across 17 teams  

2\. Review metrics on fee incentive programs (NSI, NSP, GSI) with business stakeholders — tracking enrollment, credit consumption, and iGMS impact  

3\. Manage a seller escalation related to fee discrepancies, coordinating root cause analysis and reimbursement execution  

4\. Develop a working backwards plan for seller communications related to a fee policy change across multiple worldwide marketplaces  

5\. Review AI agent performance metrics — assessing auto\-resolution rates for the NSI/NSP Resolver Agent and identifying expansion opportunities  

6\. Align with Product and Tech teams on upcoming incentive program launches, ensuring operational readiness and test order validation**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience managing, analyzing and communicating results to senior management

You'll be directly accountable for hitting D2C growth targets set in the Annual Operating Plan (AOP), decide how budget is allocated across products, and build the team needed to scale that ownership over time. You'll work closely with the organic/content team, the creative team, and the website team — this starts as a hands\-on individual role, but is expected to grow into leading a small team as the channel scales.
 



  





**What You'll Own** 




**D2C Revenue Growth \& Ownership** 




 • Own the D2C (earthful.me) revenue number end\-to\-end, driven primarily through performance marketing across Meta, Google, and other paid channels
 



 • Be directly accountable for hitting D2C growth targets set in the AOP
 



 • Coordinate with the organic/content team so paid and organic efforts reinforce each other rather than working at cross purposes
 



**Creative Pipeline for Performance** 




 • Direct the creative team's output for performance — a steady flow of new hooks, angles, and formats
 



 • Run structured creative testing across campaigns
 



 • Brief the next round of creative based on what the data shows is actually working
 



**Budget, ROAS \& Site Conversion** 




 • Decide how budget is allocated across products — what to scale up, what to scale down, and the ROAS target for each
 



 • Own website conversion end\-to\-end — landing page CVR, checkout drop\-off, and AOV — directing the website team's roadmap around what actually moves conversion
 



 • Own the full D2C P\&L view — revenue, ad spend, and contribution margin — not just a topline growth number

title: Associate Key Account Manager (Sales) - Mumbai
description:
**Experience \-** 0\-2 years in any service selling: insurance, edtech, fintech, real estate, hospitality, SaaS, staffing, telecom. Freshers with genuine hustle welcome.

**Build, Plan \& Close ₹1 crore worth multi media campaigns before you turn 25\.**

Excellent Publicity is a full\-service advertising and media agency. Since 2011 we have planned and bought media for 5,000\+ brands including the likes of Google, RBI, IIM\-A, Amazon, Uber and Apple, across 3,00,000\+ successful campaigns, spanning hoardings, airports, metro and transit, newspapers, radio, cinema, television, digital, performance, influencer \& sports.

We are an energetic young team of almost 100 people across Ahmedabad, Mumbai, Delhi, Bengaluru \& Dubai, with a strong in\-house tech team building superlative AI\-powered products, having built \& released two such products already: EPitch, which builds detailed media plans \& strategies in hours that most agencies take a fortnight to produce, and Atlas, which makes offline advertising as measurable \& transparent as digital.

We are hiring Associate Key Account Managers into four sales pods. This is not a support role. From month three you carry your own accounts, your own target and your own incentive cheque.

**What you will actually do:**

* Entire World is your territory. You decide which brands are worth chasing and you build the list yourself, along with the inbound inquiries, referrals \& research based potentials.
* Get to the decision maker. Marketing Heads, CMOs, founders. Cold calls, LinkedIn, email, WhatsApp, walk\-ins, industry events. We do not prescribe the method, we look at the meetings.
* Sit in the pitch. In the room from week one. Presenting parts of it yourself by the end of quarter one.
* Build the commercial. Work with our media team to turn a client brief into a media plan, a costing and a proposal that wins.
* Close, then keep. Renewals and upsells on your own accounts earn you incentive again. The book you build is the book you are paid on.

**Your first 90 days:**

1st \& 2nd Week\- Media 101, how OOH, print, radio, cinema, TV and digital are actually bought and priced. Shadow live client calls. Be in the room in real client meetings.

3rd – 6th Week \- Build your prospect list. First 100 outbound conversations. Sit in on live pitches. Also handle our inbound inquiries from our Media buying platform as well as the GTM we run.

7th – 12th \- Run your own first\-meeting pitches. Co\-own live proposals. First closure expected inside month four.

**What you will earn:**

Salary Range \- ₹3,60,000 \- ₹5,00,000 p.a.

Incentive \- Uncapped, linked to gross profit on every deal you close, paid quarterly

Realistic Year\-1 total, on target ₹6,20,000 \- ₹8,00,000

Fixed band is benchmarked to experience. The incentive is where the money is, and there is no ceiling on it. Our strongest performers have crossed ₹10 L in total earnings inside two years.

**Where this goes:**

Month 0 – 3 \- Learn the media landscape. Shadow live pitches. Build your prospect list.

Month 3 – 12 \- Carry an individual target. Close your first accounts.

Month 12 – 18 \- Promotion to Key Account Manager. Larger mandates, key accounts, materially higher fixed band.

Beyond City or category ownership. We are opening new markets and we promote from inside.

**Who we are looking for:**

* You can hold a conversation with someone twenty years senior without folding.
* You are fine being told "no" eight times before you get a "yes".
* You write a clear email and put together a decent PowerPoint.
* You are curious about brands, why they advertise where they do, and why they spend what they spend.
* Fluent English and Hindi. Gujarati is a strong plus for Ahmedabad; Marathi for Mumbai.
* Any graduate. A track record of selling something, even a college fest sponsorship, matters more than the degree.

Not required: advertising experience, an MBA, or a marketing degree. We have built strong sellers out of people from insurance, edtech inside sales, telecom, real estate and retail.

**How to apply:**

Do not send only a CV. We get hundreds and most read identical.  
Send two things to chahal@excellentpublicity.com or WhatsApp \+917486031011

1\. Your CV.  
2\. A 60\-second voice note answering: "Pick any brand you have noticed advertising in your city in the last month. Where did you see it, and who do you think they were trying to reach?"  
There is no right answer. We are listening for how you think and how you speak, which is the job.

**About ACCESS:**
  

ACCESS Development Services is a national livelihoods promotion organization that incubates innovations and builds sustainable models of livelihood promotion for the poor — implementing programmes on the ground (Tier I); partnering civil society, government, the corporate sector and multilateral agencies (Tier II); and shaping national policy and the enabling environment (Tier III). Headquartered in New Delhi, ACCESS works across 14 project offices. More at www.accessdev.org


**Project Summary:**  

Annapurna – Catalysing Women Entrepreneurship in Food Processing is a 36\+3\-month initiative supported by Bajaj Holdings \& Investment Limited, administered by the Bajaj Finserv CSR team, running from 1 August 2026 to 31 October 2029\. It works with 12,000 women from 1,200 Self Help Groups across 15 blocks of Thane, Pune and Raigad districts of Maharashtra — 4,000 women, 400 SHGs and 5 Annapurna Resource Centres (ARCs) per district, each ARC serving about 80 SHGs through centralised (at\-ARC) and decentralised (home\-based) support. Maharashtra State Rural Livelihoods Mission (UMED) is proposed as a facilitation partner.


**Position Summary:**  

One Officer per district builds the demand side of Annapurna — moving product out of five ARCs into real, repeatable markets. The role covers channel development, buyer relationships, exhibitions and government e\-marketplaces, packaging and brand execution, and order\-to\-delivery discipline. ACCESS is looking for someone who has actually sold food products and can work patiently with first\-generation women entrepreneurs on quality, cost and timelines.


**Responsibilities:**

**1\. Market Development and Sales**


* Map buyers, channels and price points for the project’s value chains; build a live pipeline of institutional, retail, aggregator and channel\-partner buyers
* Secure and service access to SARAS, e\-SARAS, Umed Mart, GeM, Womaniya and state exhibition platforms through UMED facilitation
* Negotiate and document buyer terms — volume, price, quality specification, delivery, payment cycle and return liability
* Plan and execute district and state exhibitions, melas, buyer\-seller meets and B2B events
**2\. Product, Packaging and Brand**


* Work with the Production Coordinator to convert buyer requirements into product specification, grammage, shelf\-life and price

**3\. Transaction Discipline and Reporting**


* Ensure every sale is transacted by the community institution or enterprise group. Sales revenue must not pass through ACCESS accounts at any stage.
* Maintain buyer agreements, order registers and market transaction records as project means of verification
* Support enterprise\-level costing so that women see gross margin, not just turnover, and report monthly on orders, dispatches, realisation and receivables
**Education \& Experience::**

* Graduate in any discipline; MBA or PG in Marketing, Agribusiness or Rural Management preferred
* 3–5 years in sales, distribution or rural marketing, with 3\+ years handling food, FMCG, agri\-processed or SHG/handicraft products
* Hands\-on experience of retail or institutional listing, exhibition sales, and/or e\-commerce, ONDC or GeM onboarding; prior work with FPOs, SHG federations or producer collectives is a strong advantage
* Working familiarity with FSSAI labelling, legal metrology, GST and GTIN/barcoding for packaged food

* Fluency in Marathi essential, with working Hindi and English
* Real negotiation ability and a buyer network that can be called on from day one
* Numerate — comfortable with landed cost, margin, credit period and working capital
* Patience to build the seller’s capability rather than bypass her; two\-wheeler with valid license
**Travel Requirement:**

Market and field travel within and outside the assigned district; 15\+ field days a month.

 Location: India
   

  

 Title: Director, Channel Partnership Enablement

Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.

 The Channel Partnership Enablement (CPE) team is responsible for the end\-to\-end enablement, processes and tools across the entire sales cycle from lead to billing.
   

  

 This highly visible Director, Channel Partnership Enablement role will be critical to advancing the team’s priorities through close collaboration with stakeholders across the company. This is an ideal opportunity for someone ready to lead a small but growing team while gaining exposure to a broad set of functions, including Finance, Marketing, Product and Operations. The role will report to the VP, Channel Partnership Enablement.
   

  

 Responsibilities will vary based on the most pressing business needs and may include:
   

  

 End\-to\-end enablement, processes and tools
   

  

* Engage with Partnerships sales teams to understand business needs and define required updates to sales processes and tools.

* Support Partnership Account Managers with requests related to end\-to\-end sales, implementation and operational processes.
* Work with cross\-functional partners, including Product, Legal and Billing, to support, drive and implement pricing and billing optimization initiatives as needed.


 Strategic Initiatives/Other
   

  

* Participate in and collaborate on strategic projects initiated by Global or regional leadership.
* Lead ad hoc projects and requests that support evolving business priorities.


**All About You**
* Highly motivated, with a strong work ethic and the ability to act with urgency and flexibility to drive results in ambiguous environments.
* Strong interpersonal and collaboration skills, with the ability to build relationships and partnerships across a broad range of stakeholders.
* Self\-starter who is motivated to work independently and contribute as an effective team member.
* Confident and comfortable engaging executives and presenting with clarity and conviction.
* Strong analytical and modeling skills, with proficiency in tools such as Excel, Power BI and SQL.
* Intellectually curious, creative and analytical, with strong data proficiency; knowledge of Mastercard data sources, including Warehouse and Incentives, is a plus.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Bachelor’s degree required; MBA preferred.


**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Startup & ISV Manager
description:
Startup \& ISV Manager
 



**Location \-** 
 Delhi NCR/Bengaluru
 



  





  





 India's AI economy is being built right now — and the startups and ISVs at the centre of it need infrastructure that scales with their ambition. At Yotta, we are looking for someone who can own the GTM motion for this segment end\-to\-end: from shaping how we position ourselves in the startup ecosystem, to closing the deals that put Yotta's GPU cloud at the heart of the next generation of AI\-native companies.
 



 This is a commercially driven role with strategic depth. You will define how Yotta shows up for founders and product teams, build the relationships that convert early conversations into long\-term platform commitments, and work across functions to ensure our messaging, campaigns, and outreach are consistently sharp and effective.
 



 What You Will Do
 


* Define and evolve Yotta's GTM approach for the startup and ISV segment — including positioning, messaging, target profiles, and channel strategy.
* Build and manage a portfolio of accounts across growth stages, structuring the right commercial engagements and ensuring long\-term platform retention.
* Drive pipeline through well\-timed campaigns, ecosystem partnerships, and direct outreach to Founders, CTOs, and product leadership.
* Work on and refine content narratives and sales assets — collateral, thought leadership, and technical proof points — that help the Yotta story land with technical and business buyers alike.
* Cultivate relationships with the VC and startup incubator/accelerator ecosystem — to get Yotta in front of portfolio companies early.
* Collaborate with Solutions, Product, and Marketing teams to ensure what we promise in the market reflects what we deliver.
* Identify ISV co\-sell opportunities and structure joint GTM motions with software platforms embedding Yotta into their customer stack.
* Track pipeline, forecast accurately, and continuously evaluate what is working — optimising based on data and market feedback, not instinct alone.



  





 What We're Looking For
 



 We want someone who can think strategically and stay close to execution — not one or the other. The Indian startup ecosystem rewards people who move fast, speak credibly, and follow through.
 


* 6–10 years in enterprise or startup sales, GTM, growth, or ecosystem roles within cloud, SaaS, or technology infrastructure.
* Strong grasp of B2B SaaS and cloud ecosystems — how buying decisions get made, how budgets move, and how infrastructure fits into a startup's build vs. buy calculus.
* Ability to craft messaging and positioning that resonates — with a technical CTO and a commercial CFO in the same conversation.
* Existing relationships in the Indian startup ecosystem, whether through prior roles, community involvement, or investor networks.
* Experience in early\-stage or high\-growth environments where you have built process, not just followed it.
* Data\-driven mindset — focused on outcomes, not just activity.
* Comfort operating across functions and driving alignment without relying on hierarchy to get things done.

**About Achyutam Aahar**

Achyutam Aahar is an MSME\-registered, ZED Bronze Certified food \& wellness brand committed to delivering **100% natural, unprocessed, chemical\-free** products inspired by India’s traditional Ayurvedic and Vedic heritage.  
Our product range includes:

* **Raw Honey (multiple regional varieties)**
* **Infused Honey (Slow Infusion Process)**
* **A2 Cow Ghee \& Medicated Ghee**
* **Turmeric Latte \& Immunity Formulations**
* **Organic Spices \& Pulses**

* **Handmade Soaps \& Rose Water**
* **Premium Gift Hampers**

We focus on **quality, purity, sustainability**, and **farm\-to\-table value creation**, catering to both domestic and export markets. With strong growth momentum and expanding distribution, Achyutam Aahar is looking for dynamic professionals to drive B2B partnerships.

**Position: Business Development Manager (B2B Sales)Role Objective**

To accelerate Achyutam Aahar’s B2B expansion by acquiring and managing partnerships with **retailers, distributors, corporates, hotels, wholesalers, gifting companies, Ayurveda centres, wellness chains, and institutional buyers**.

**Key Responsibilities1\. New Business Acquisition**

**3\. Sales Strategy \& Targets**

* Achieve monthly/quarterly sales targets and contribute to revenue growth.

**5\. Branding \& Market Activation**

**Education**

**What Achyutam Aahar Offers**

* Competitive salary \+ performance incentives
* Opportunity to work with a premium, fast\-growing natural products brand
* Professional growth in both domestic and export sales
* Supportive work culture driven by quality, ethics, and innovation

title: Associate Key Account Manager (Sales) - Delhi
description:
**Openings –** 1 in Delhi  
**Experience \-** 1\-3 years in any service selling: insurance, edtech, fintech, real estate, hospitality, SaaS, staffing, telecom. Freshers with genuine hustle welcome.

**Build, Plan \& Close ₹1 crore worth multi media campaigns before you turn 25\.**

Excellent Publicity is a full\-service advertising and media agency. Since 2011 we have planned and bought media for 5,000\+ brands including the likes of Google, RBI, IIM\-A, Amazon, Uber and Apple, across 3,00,000\+ successful campaigns, spanning hoardings, airports, metro and transit, newspapers, radio, cinema, television, digital, performance, influencer \& sports.

We are an energetic young team of almost 100 people across Ahmedabad, Mumbai, Delhi, Bengaluru \& Dubai, with a strong in\-house tech team building superlative AI\-powered products, having built \& released two such products already: EPitch, which builds detailed media plans \& strategies in hours that most agencies take a fortnight to produce, and Atlas, which makes offline advertising as measurable \& transparent as digital.

We are hiring Associate Key Account Managers into four sales pods. This is not a support role. From month three you carry your own accounts, your own target and your own incentive cheque.

**What you will actually do:**

* Entire World is your territory. You decide which brands are worth chasing and you build the list yourself, along with the inbound inquiries, referrals \& research based potentials.
* Get to the decision maker. Marketing Heads, CMOs, founders. Cold calls, LinkedIn, email, WhatsApp, walk\-ins, industry events. We do not prescribe the method, we look at the meetings.
* Sit in the pitch. In the room from week one. Presenting parts of it yourself by the end of quarter one.
* Build the commercial. Work with our media team to turn a client brief into a media plan, a costing and a proposal that wins.
* Close, then keep. Renewals and upsells on your own accounts earn you incentive again. The book you build is the book you are paid on.

**Your first 90 days:**

1st \& 2nd Week\- Media 101, how OOH, print, radio, cinema, TV and digital are actually bought and priced. Shadow live client calls. Be in the room in real client meetings.

3rd – 6th Week \- Build your prospect list. First 100 outbound conversations. Sit in on live pitches. Also handle our inbound inquiries from our Media buying platform as well as the GTM we run.

7th – 12th \- Run your own first\-meeting pitches. Co\-own live proposals. First closure expected inside month four.

**What you will earn:**

Salary Range \- ₹4,80,000 \- ₹6,00,000 p.a.

Incentive \- Uncapped, linked to gross profit on every deal you close, paid quarterly

Realistic Year\-1 total, on target ₹6,20,000 \- ₹8,00,000

Fixed band is benchmarked to experience. The incentive is where the money is, and there is no ceiling on it. Our strongest performers have crossed ₹10 L in total earnings inside two years.

**Where this goes:**

Month 0 – 3 \- Learn the media landscape. Shadow live pitches. Build your prospect list.

Month 3 – 12 \- Carry an individual target. Close your first accounts.

Month 12 – 18 \- Promotion to Key Account Manager. Larger mandates, key accounts, materially higher fixed band.

Beyond City or category ownership. We are opening new markets and we promote from inside.

**Who we are looking for:**

* You can hold a conversation with someone twenty years senior without folding.
* You are fine being told "no" eight times before you get a "yes".
* You write a clear email and put together a decent PowerPoint.
* You are curious about brands, why they advertise where they do, and why they spend what they spend.
* Fluent English and Hindi.
* Any graduate. A track record of selling something, even a college fest sponsorship, matters more than the degree.

Not required: advertising experience, an MBA, or a marketing degree. We have built strong sellers out of people from insurance, edtech inside sales, telecom, real estate and retail.

**How to apply:**

Do not send only a CV. We get hundreds and most read identical.  
Send two things to chahal@excellentpublicity.com or WhatsApp \+917486031011

1\. Your CV.  
2\. A 60\-second voice note answering: "Pick any brand you have noticed advertising in your city in the last month. Where did you see it, and who do you think they were trying to reach?"  
There is no right answer. We are listening for how you think and how you speak, which is the job.

title: Director, Commercial Strategy // Technology, Media & Telecommunications Insights
description:
Portage Point Partners is a Chicago\-headquartered advisory, interim management and investment banking firm focused on serving the middle\-market. Backed by New Mountain Capital, the firm has grown at over 30% annually since its founding in 2016 and today operates from ten offices across the United States.
   

  

 The firm delivers integrated financial and operational solutions across Transaction Advisory Services, Transaction Execution Services, Office of the CFO, Valuations, Performance Improvement, Turnaround \& Restructuring and Investment Banking. Engagement teams are lean and execution\-oriented, working directly with senior stakeholders to navigate complex transitions and transformations.
   

  

 Triple P India (TPI) is a strategic extension of the firm’s platform, established to build a high\-quality team that operates as an integrated part of U.S.\-based teams. Professionals in TPI are involved in live engagements from the outset, contributing to analysis, execution and client deliverables in coordination with colleagues across the firm. The platform is designed to provide meaningful responsibility, direct exposure to senior leadership and long\-term growth in a high\-performance environment.
   

  

 The Commercial Strategy team is responsible for optimizing the firm’s go\-to\-market strategy, commercial operations and business development infrastructure. The team partners closely with firm leadership and practice leaders to drive revenue growth, enhance client engagement, improve pipeline visibility and strengthen decision\-making through technology, data and process optimization. By leveraging platforms such as Intapp DealCloud and related business systems, the Commercial Strategy team delivers scalable solutions that improve collaboration, increase operational efficiency and support the firm’s continued expansion.
   

  

 The Director, Commercial Strategy // Technology, Media \& Telecommunications (TMT) Insights is a credentialed industry Subject Matter Expert (SME) who owns the commercial agenda for the TMT vertical within the firm's Commercial Enablement (CE) function. Reporting to the Head of Commercial Enablement, this leader is the firm's sector SME and the source of market insight that equips MDs, Practice Line Leaders (PLLs) and Account Teams to drive origination in the sector.
   

  

 The role owns the vertical's commercial point of view (POV) – the market updates, sector analysis and origination\-focused thought leadership that position the firm with prospects and clients – working closely with PLLs, MDs, Account Teams and Marketing to translate that insight into firm\-facing content and external presence.
   

  

 Success is measured by the firm's positioning in the TMT sector, the quality and timeliness of the vertical's commercial intelligence, its presence in firm marketing and external content, and the degree to which market\-facing teams treat the vertical as the firm's authoritative source for sector insight.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Own the commercial agenda for the TMT vertical, serving as the firm’s sector SME
* Partner with senior team members across the firm to drive recurring deliverables, including sector POVs, quarterly outlooks, market maps, origination theses, account whitespace analysis, MD briefing packs and pitch / proposal support
* Equip MDs, PLLs and Account Teams with the sector context and briefings needed to pursue whitespace and cross\-sell opportunities ahead of priority meetings and pursuits
* Monitor industry trends, market signals and competitive dynamics specific to the TMT sector and translate them into actionable commercial direction
* Support business development efforts with sector\-specific positioning, insight and supporting analysis
* Provide expertise to maintain a credible external presence in the TMT sector by developing materials and content to be used for bylined content, conference participation and other public\-facing channels
* Partner with Marketing to align vertical content, campaigns and external presence with firm go\-to\-market strategy and thought leadership
* Coordinate with peer industry vertical leaders to maintain a consistent commercial POV format and cadence across the CE function
* Partner with the VP, Account and VP, Pipeline to ensure sector insight is reflected in account plans and pursuit strategy
* Share and manage best practices as well as lead internal trainings where required
* Support talent acquisition and firm development efforts
* Contribute to creating a high\-performing and inclusive culture


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree from a top undergraduate program required
* Willing to relocate to or be primarily present in Gurgaon
* 10 plus years in the TMT sector, in commercial strategy, business development, consulting, investment banking or an industry\-facing advisory role
* Recognized subject matter expertise in TMT, with a credible origination, investment banking or advisory track record in that sector
* Demonstrated track record of producing credible, market\-facing commercial content for an external audience
* Experience operating within professional services, consulting, investment banking or private equity environments
* High attention to detail, responsiveness and a process\- and ownership\-oriented mindset
* Strong project management and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously in a fast\-paced environment
* Experience within the middle market private equity and advisory ecosystem, preferably serving U.S. clients
* Familiarity with Intapp DealCloud, HubSpot or equivalent commercial platforms preferred
* Experience producing thought leadership or market commentary published in industry\-recognized channels preferred
* Superior written and verbal communication, including executive\-ready presentation and reporting, with the ability to influence stakeholder and work effectively across technical and non\-technical teams
* Proven ability to thrive in lean, fast\-moving teams
* High attention to detail, responsiveness and ownership mindset
* Track record of success in high\-pressure, client\-facing environments

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. title: Ecommerce Lead
description:
**About the Role** 




 This is a P\&L\-owning mandate to build and scale the Beauty.coms \& other marketplaces. across our brand portfolio. The person will lead a cross\-functional team of KAMs and performance marketers and carry direct accountability for close to a third of the company's total e\-commerce business.
 



 This is not a caretaker role. We need someone who can sit inside genuine ambiguity, shifting algorithms, unclear ownership lines? and still drive a sharp, numbers\-backed plan forward. Equally, this is a high\-stakes relationship seat: the person will be the face of the business to some of the most demanding, tough negotiating counterparts in Indian e\-commerce, and needs to be able to hold their own without burning the relationship.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. P\&L Ownership \& Commercial Management** 




 \- Own the full P\&L for the beauty.coms portfolio \& other marketplaces across all brands.
 



 \- Drive topline growth without trading away contribution margin, pricing, trade terms, marketing spend efficiency, returns/RTO.
 



 \- Run quarterly and annual business planning: revenue targets, margin targets, and investment allocation across platforms and brands.
 



 \- Own the key commercial levers end\-to\-end: ASP, discounting, platform fees/commissions, marketing ROI, inventory health? and be answerable for movement in each.
 



  





**2\. Analytical Rigor \& Reporting** 




 \- Build a real\-time, no\-blind\-spots view of performance? platform\-wise, brand\-wise, SKU\-wise.
 



 \- Convert raw data (sales, ad spend, funnel metrics, competitive benchmarks) into decisions, not just decks.
 



 \- Diagnose performance dips from first principles \- never accept a platform's explanation at face value.
 



  





**3\. Problem Solving in Ambiguity** 




 \- Operate comfortably where the playbook doesn't exist yet ?? new platforms, shifting policies, unclear internal ownership.
 



 \- Identify and act on growth levers across platforms ?? new brand launches, category expansion, platform\-exclusive programs.
 



 \- Get ahead of algorithm/policy shifts and competitive moves rather than reacting to them.
 



 \- Cut through complexity fast ?? make a call with 80% information rather than waiting for the last 20%.
 



  





**4\. Relationship Management at the Highest Stakes** 




 \- Own senior relationships with category and business heads at Nykaa, Myntra, Tira, and other key platforms ?? this is the most demanding part of the role and needs someone who can genuinely excel at it, not just survive it.
 



 \- Negotiate trade terms, marketing budgets, and visibility placements firmly, without burning the relationship.
 



 \- Manage difficult, ego\-heavy counterparts ?? internal and external ?? with equal parts spine and tact.
 



 \- Know precisely when to hold a line and when to build the other side an exit that lets them save face.
 



  





**5\. Team Leadership** 




 \- Lead and develop a team of Key Account Managers and Performance Marketing professionals.
 



 \- Set clear goals, review cadences, and coaching plans; raise the bar on analytical and commercial thinking across the team.
 



 \- Build a culture of ownership: the team should operate like founders of their respective platforms.
 



  





**Qualifications** 




 Criteria \| Requirement
 



 Designation: DGM / GM (preferred)
 



 Experience \| 8\+ years, with direct experience in Beauty x E\-commerce, either from the brand side (D2C/FMCG e\-commerce team) or the retailer/platform side.
 



  





 Education \| MBA \|
 



 Core strength 1 \| Demonstrated ability to handle ambiguity and complexity? must have operated without a fixed playbook, not just executed an existing one.
 



  





 Core strength 2 \| Must peak on complex relationship management? this role lives or dies on the person's ability to manage tough, high\-ego counterparts at the senior\-most level.
 



  





**Additional Requirements** 




 \- Demonstrated ownership of a multi\-crore P\&L, accountable for both growth and margin? not just topline.
 



 \- Strong analytical muscle, comfortable building models, dissecting data, and drawing conclusions independently.
 



 \- Experience managing and developing a team (KAMs and/or performance marketing).
 



 \- A track record of negotiating with large platforms/partners at a senior stakeholder level, not just day\-to\-day account operations.
 



  





**Success Metrics (First 12 Months)** 




 \- Revenue growth and margin improvement across the beauty.coms portfolio vs. plan.
 



 \- Improved platform relationship health measured via visibility, trade term quality, and escalation resolution speed.
 



 \- A high\-performing, well\-coached KAM and performance marketing team with clear ownership of platform\-level metrics.
 



 \- A reliable analytical/reporting cadence that leadership can act on without needing to chase data.

title: Associate Director - Brand Marketing

This global role, based in India, will lead the development of a distinctive and relevant brand narrative across the US, Europe, and APAC. The role offers the opportunity to build and evolve the RateGain brand as we integrate acquired businesses, unify capabilities, and bring together our product and customer ecosystems.
