* Proven experience in a senior brand, integrated marketing, or strategic marketing role within a B2B SaaS, enterprise technology, or product\-led organisation.
* Demonstrated experience developing and executing global brand strategies across the US, Europe, and APAC, with the ability to adapt messaging to regional customer and market needs.
* Experience leading a significant rebrand, M\&A integration, portfolio consolidation, or company repositioning from strategy through execution.
* Strong ability to simplify a complex portfolio of products, technologies, and business capabilities into a clear, compelling, and differentiated customer narrative.
* Experience building brand strategy, messaging frameworks, and marketing operating models in an evolving or high\-growth environment.
* Strong integrated marketing capability across campaigns, content, thought leadership, digital marketing, and stakeholder engagement.
* Commercially minded, with the ability to link brand and marketing investment to measurable business outcomes.
* AI\-native mindset, with hands\-on experience using AI to materially improve marketing research, ideation, development, execution, and productivity.
* Exceptional communication, storytelling, stakeholder\-management, and cross\-functional collaboration skills.

 .

* Develop and execute a comprehensive talent acquisition strategy that supports company goals and growth objectives

* 3 to 6 years of end\-to\-end talent acquisition experience, ideally within fast\-paced environments such as high\-growth tech startups, e\-commerce, or BFSI

* Hands\-on proficiency with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS), talent market intelligence, and recruitment analytics
* Exceptional communication, collaboration and interpersonal skills, with the ability to align business leadership
* Strong analytical problem\-solving skills with a data\-first approach to optimising recruitment funnels and timelines
* High ownership, adaptability, and resilience to thrive in an evolving, fast\-paced environment
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field



  





**The Navi OS** 




 The Navi OS is our Operating System for how we work every day. Success at Navi is defined by living these core values.
 



  




* **Start with the customer**
* **Master the details**
* **Act with urgency**
* **Own the outcome**
* **Build for a decade, not a day**



  





**Win as one** 




 We hire talented individuals who already show these strengths, because those who share these values thrive at Navi and grow with the organisation. To read more about the Navi OS, visit
 **navi.com/our\-values**
 .

 Life at Navi is fast\-paced, ambitious and deeply collaborative. Beyond work, teams come together through sports, celebrations, offsites, music jams, team outings and many more shared experiences that make the journey exciting and memorable.

Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.
  

  

Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance\-focused culture.


**About the team**

People Solutions Excellence exists to drive executional excellence in HR operations, services and transactions. We help improve how People Solutions operates by making processes simpler, services better, decisions more data\-driven, and change more successful.


We're a global team of experts in process improvement, people experience, service excellence, data and analytics, reporting, and project delivery. Working closely with our HR Centres of Excellence and People Solutions teams, we solve problems, streamline ways of working, and drive continuous improvement.


Our role is to create consistent, scalable solutions that work globally while allowing for local needs where required. We bridge the gap between business requirements and operational delivery; helping People Solutions deliver better experiences, stronger outcomes, and lasting adoption of change.


Our Global Process Owners (GPOs) in our Global Process Solutions team are critical to helping us deliver this ambition; ensuring business need is translated into clear, standardised and scalable process solutions, enabling consistent ways of working and driving improved service outcomes.


**About the role**

As **GPO for Payroll, Time \& Attendance** you will be responsible for partnering closely with the Payroll team to design, govern and continuously improve our payroll processes across the globe and ensure we have cost effective, automated and easy to use time \& attendance solutions.


Key responsibilities:


* Own the end\-to\-end global Payroll, Time \& Attendance process framework, driving standardisation, governance and continuous improvement across all markets.
* Define, maintain and optimise global Payroll and Time \& Attendance processes, ensuring they are efficient, scalable, compliant and aligned with Haleon’s operating model.
* Act as subject matter expert for Payroll and Time \& Attendance processes, providing guidance and decision\-making support to People Solutions, HR teams, Digital \& Technology teams and business stakeholders.
* Partner with HR Business Partners, Payroll, People Solutions, Finance, Risk \& Compliance, and Digital \& Technology teams to drive process simplification, automation and service excellence.

title: Intern - Learning & Development
description:
Learning \& Development Intern
   





**Role Overview** 
  





 Join a fast\-paced L\&D team supporting workforce operations. As a Learning \& Development Intern, you will combine data analytics, digital tools, and operational support to streamline learning programs and elevate the global employee experience. This role is ideal for an MBA graduate looking to gain hands\-on, end\-to\-end exposure in enterprise talent development.
   





**Key Responsibilities** 
  





**1\. Research \& AI\-Assisted Content Curation** 
  





 ● Conduct market research on emerging industry skills, leadership frameworks, and L\&D best practices.

 ● Audit third\-party learning catalogs to help curate targeted learning pathways for cross\-regional teams.
   





**2\. Analytics \& Reporting** 
  





 ● Aggregate post\-training survey data, attendance, and assessment scores into executive dashboards using Excel or Power BI.
   





 ● Perform routine data audits across regional LMS records to ensure high reporting accuracy across time zones.
   





 ● Track and summarize learner Net Promoter Scores (NPS) to highlight actionable trends for L\&D leadership.
   





**3\. Program \& Virtual Logistics** 
  





 ● Co\-facilitate global virtual training sessions on Google Meet, Zoom and Microsoft Teams (managing technical setups, breakout rooms, and live Q\&A).
   





 ● Organize program schedules, calendar invites, and asynchronous communications across distinct regional time zones.
   





 ● Maintain central knowledge repositories, training calendars, and internal resource sites (Notion, SharePoint, or Teams).
   





**4\. Vendor \& Project Operations** 
  





 ● Assist in sourcing third\-party training vendors, gathering Request For Proposals (RFPs), and building cost comparison sheets.
   





 ● Track project timelines, purchase orders, and administrative workflows for global learning initiatives.
   





**Qualifications \& Requirements** 
  





 ●
 **Education:** 
 Recent MBA graduate or final\-year candidate (Human Resources, Organizational Development, or General Management preferred).

 **Technical Agility:** 
 Strong proficiency in MS Excel (Pivot Tables, XLOOKUP), PowerPoint, and comfort using generative AI tools for productivity.

 Crisp written and verbal English skills, with natural cross\-cultural fluency and strong asynchronous communication habits.
   





 ●

 Exceptional attention to detail, proactive problem\-solving, and a genuine interest in adult learning and organizational growth.
   





**What You Will Gain** 
  





 ● Direct, strategic exposure to multi\-region L\&D operations across four major international hubs.
   





 ● Practical mastery of corporate talent metrics, vendor handling, and modern instructional design tools.

description:
Tericsoft is building AI products and delivering technology services for global customers. As the company grows, we are looking for someone who can build exceptional teams while creating the people processes that help them succeed. This is not a role where you inherit a mature HR function—you will help shape it. From hiring great talent to improving employee experience, you will work directly with the founders and leaders to build a high\-performing, people\-first organisation.
 



  





**What you will do :** 



* Own end\-to\-end recruitment for both technical and non\-technical roles, from role definition and sourcing through interviews, offers and successful joining.
* Partner with hiring managers to understand business needs, write job descriptions and build strong candidate pipelines.
* Deliver a seamless onboarding and induction experience, ensuring documentation, asset allocation and HR formalities are completed on time.
* Coordinate payroll inputs, attendance, leave management and statutory compliance with the accounts and finance team.
* Drive the performance review and appraisal cycle, ensuring timely reviews, feedback and documentation.
* Plan and execute employee engagement initiatives, internal communication and culture\-building activities throughout the year.
* Build, maintain and continuously improve HR policies, employee handbooks, HRMS records and people operations processes.
* Own the campus hiring and internship programme, including partnerships with universities and other institutions.
* Generate HR reports and dashboards on hiring, onboarding, retention and people metrics to support business decisions.
* Continuously improve HR processes by identifying opportunities to automate, simplify and scale people operations.



  





**Who we are looking for :** 



* Qualification: MBA in Human Resources or an equivalent qualification.
* Experience: Two to four years in an IT or technology services company with hands\-on experience in technical recruitment.
* Recruitment: Strong understanding of sourcing, screening and hiring for engineering and business roles.
* Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the confidence to work closely with candidates, managers and leadership.
* Organisation: Highly organised with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple hiring pipelines and HR initiatives simultaneously.
* Mindset: Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, founder\-led environment where processes are built, improved and challenged continuously rather than simply followed.
* Tools: Experience with HRMS platforms, LinkedIn, job portals, spreadsheets and recruitment tools. Familiarity with AI\-powered recruiting tools is an advantage.



  





**What you will walk away with :** 



* Direct exposure to building the People function in a fast\-growing AI and technology company.
* Ownership across the entire employee lifecycle, from hiring through performance and engagement.
* The opportunity to build scalable HR systems and processes rather than maintain existing ones.
* Close collaboration with founders and leadership, with significant influence on how the company grows.
* Experience balancing strategic HR initiatives with hands\-on execution in a high\-growth environment.



  





**What success looks like at six months :**

This role sits in the center of that motion, supporting high\-volume Customer Support hiring through coordinated, well\-run hiring events and strong recruitment operations.

 We're looking for a highly organized, proactive Talent Acquisition Coordinator to own the logistics behind large\-scale hiring events for Customer Support roles in India. **You're excited about this opportunity because you will…**
* Own end\-to\-end coordination for on\-site and virtual hiring events, including scheduling, venue logistics, candidate communications, and day\-of support.

**We're excited about you because you have…**
* 1 to 3 years of experience in recruiting coordination, HR operations, event coordination, or a fast\-paced administrative role.

* Clear written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Comfort working with scheduling tools, spreadsheets, ATS systems, and shared calendars.

* Interest in high\-volume hiring, candidate experience, and building repeatable processes.

**Nice to have**

* **Onboarding Support:** 
 Collaborate closely with the HR team to facilitate smooth candidate transitions and a seamless onboarding experience for new hires.



  





  





**Required Skills \& Competencies** 



* **Recruitment Expertise:** 
 In\-depth knowledge of modern recruitment methodologies, sourcing channels, and full\-lifecycle talent acquisition strategies.

 Hands\-on proficiency with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS), HR Information Systems (HRIS), and modern recruitment tools.
* **Communication \& Interpersonal Skills:** 
 Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with strong stakeholder management capabilities.
* **Agility \& Multitasking:** 
 Proven ability to prioritize, manage multiple open mandates simultaneously, and deliver against urgent hiring deadlines.

 Experience analyzing recruitment metrics, tracking hiring data, and leveraging dashboards for decision\-making.
* **Branding \& Candidate Experience:** 
 Strong understanding of candidate engagement practices and employer branding strategies.



  





  





**Qualifications \& Experience** 



* **Educational Background:** 
 Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* **Professional Experience:** 
 Minimum of
 **3\+ years** 
 of core experience in full\-cycle recruitment.

 Demonstrated track record of sourcing and hiring across both
 **technical and non\-technical** 
 roles.
* **Certifications (Preferred):** 
 Professional certifications in HR or Talent Acquisition (e.g., SHRM, PHR, LinkedIn Recruiter certification) are preferred but not mandatory.



  





  





**Performance Metrics \& KPIs** 



* **Time\-to\-Fulfill:** 
 Speed of filling critical open positions without compromising quality.
* **Quality\-of\-Hire:** 
 Retention rates, performance ratings, and hiring manager feedback for new hires.
* **Cost\-of\-Hire:** 
 Optimization of recruitment spend and channel efficiency.
* **Diversity Hiring Ratios:** 
 Achievement of organizational diversity and inclusion hiring targets.
* **Stakeholder Satisfaction:** 
 Satisfaction levels of hiring managers and internal business leaders.
* **Pipeline Strength:** 
 Availability of pre\-screened talent pools for key and recurring roles.
* **AI Integration:** 
 Effective adoption of AI techniques and tools to enhance hiring workflows.

title: Commodities Index Senior Developer
description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------


Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.


**Job Overview**
----------------


We are seeking a talented and motivated Developer to join our dynamic Commodities Index Technology Team.


In this role, you will be responsible for the design, development, and maintenance of the software and infrastructure that powers our suite of proprietary and benchmark commodities indices.


You will work closely with quantitative researchers, traders, and index managers to implement new index methodologies, ensure data integrity, and optimize our calculation engines for performance and accuracy.


This is a critical role that combines expertise in software engineering with a deep understanding of financial markets, specifically in the commodities space.


You will be responsible for green field index re\-engineering projects as well as managing and maintaining existing index platforms.


**Key Responsibilities**


* **System Development:**

Design, build, test, and deploy robust and scalable software for the calculation, publication, and analysis of commodity indices.


* **Methodology Implementation**:

Collaborate with quantitative analysts to translate complex index rules and methodologies (including weighting, rebalancing, and corporate actions) into high\-quality, production\-ready code.


* **Data Integration \& Management**:

Develop and maintain data pipelines to source, validate, and process commodity price data from various vendors and exchanges (e.g., Bloomberg, Refinitiv, CME, ICE).


* **Back\-testing \& Analytics**:

Create and enhance tools for the historical back\-testing of index strategies, performance attribution, and risk analysis.


* **Performance Optimization**:

Profile and optimize the index calculation engine and data processing workflows to ensure low latency and high throughput.


* **Production Support**:

Provide ongoing support for the index platform, troubleshoot production issues, and ensure the accuracy and timeliness of all index calculations and data distributions.


* **Documentation**:

Maintain comprehensive documentation for the index methodologies, system architecture, and operational procedures.


* **Stakeholder Collaboration:**

Work effectively with cross\-functional teams, including research, trading, operations, and technology infrastructure.


**Required Qualifications**


* **Education**:

Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, or a related quantitative field.


* **Programming Proficiency:**

3\+ years of strong, hands\-on development experience in an object\-oriented language such as Python, C\+\+, or Java.


* **Data \& Algorithms**:

Solid foundation in data structures, algorithms, and software design principles.


* **Database Skills:**

Proficiency in SQL and experience with relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, SQL Server).


* **Financial Acumen**:

A strong interest in financial markets and a foundational understanding of financial instruments.


* **Problem\-Solving**:

Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills with a keen attention to detail.


* **Communication:**

Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders.


**Preferred Qualifications**


* **Domain Expertise:** Prior experience working directly with commodities (Energy, Metals, Agriculture), financial indices, futures, and/or other derivatives.
* **Quantitative Libraries:** Hands\-on experience with numerical and data analysis libraries in Python (e.g., **Pandas**).
* **Cloud \& DevOps:** Familiarity with cloud computing platforms and CI/CD practices.

title: Human Resources Business Partner
description:
**ABOUT PLUM** 




 Plum is India's leading employee benefits and health insurance platform, helping companies take better care of their people. We're on a mission to make healthcare accessible, transparent, and delightful, and we're growing fast. As we scale, our People function is central to how we build, retain, and grow our talent.
 



  





**ABOUT THE ROLE** 




  





 We're looking for a Senior HRBP who is a genuine thought partner, someone who deeply understands people, business, and the nuance between the two. You'll embed with business teams (with a preference for Sales, Marketing, or Customer\-facing functions), navigate the complex human dynamics of a fast\-scaling startup, and help leaders build resilient, high\-performing cultures.
 



 This is not a transactional HR role. We want someone who thinks in systems, listens before advising, and brings both emotional intelligence and business acuity to every conversation.
 



  





**WHAT YOU'LL DO** 




  




* **Strategic Partnership.** 
 Act as a strategic thought partner to business leaders, helping them navigate org design, team dynamics, and talent decisions.
* **Conflict Resolution.** 
 Handle sensitive and complex employee situations with discretion, empathy, and sound judgment, from performance conversations to team conflict.
* **Stakeholder Relationships.** 
 Build deep relationships across your business unit; understand their goals, pressures, and the human context behind decisions.
* **Manager Enablement.** 
 Coach managers on leadership, feedback, and people practices, enabling them to grow as leaders rather than creating dependency on HR.
* **People Programs.** 
 Drive critical people programs like engagement, retention, and talent reviews with a bias for impact over process.
* **Culture \& EQ.** 
 Spot cultural signals early and bring them to the surface; be the connective tissue between people and leadership.
* **Cross\-functional Collaboration.** 
 Partner with Talent Acquisition, L\&D, and Comp \& Benefits teams to deliver a seamless people experience.



  





**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR** 



* **Experience.** 
 5\-7 years of HRBP or People Partner experience, ideally in a B2B who has seen the 1\-10 Journey.
* **Conflict Competence.** 
 Demonstrated ability to manage conflict, have difficult conversations, and hold space for complexity without losing composure.
* **Emotional Intelligence.** 
 High EQ, you read rooms well, build trust quickly, and know when to push and when to listen.
* **Business Acumen.** 
 You understand revenue, growth targets, and what it means to operate in a fast\-paced commercial environment.
* **Functional Context.** 
 Exposure to Sales, Marketing, or Customer Success orgs is a strong plus.
* **Academic Background.** 
 Background or training in Psychology, Organizational Behavior, or Human Development is preferred.
* **Builder Mindset.** 
 You're energized by ambiguity and motivated to create, not just run, people processes.



  





**YOU'LL THRIVE HERE IF** 




  




* You've been in the room when a startup scaled through chaos and helped the people come out better for it.
* You find yourself naturally curious about why people behave the way they do.
* You can hold a business leader accountable while still being their biggest champion.
* You don't wait for a playbook, you write the playbook.
* You're as comfortable with data and dashboards as you are with a 1:1 that goes emotionally deep.



  





**WHAT PLUM OFFERS** 



* A seat at the table with real influence on how we build our people culture at scale.
* Comprehensive health insurance (of course, we're Plum).
* Flexible hybrid work environment from Bangalore.
* A leadership team that takes people seriously as a competitive advantage.

title: HR Business Partner - GCC
description:
Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose\-driven, world\-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.
   

  

 Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.
   

  

 Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance\-focused culture.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The HR Business Partner for Haleon Global Capability Center (GCC) will partner with senior leaders in the center to deliver the people agenda in support of business priorities.
   

  

 The role will act as a trusted advisor to business leaders, translating center and functional priorities into integrated people plans that enable performance, engagement, retention, organizational effectiveness and long\-term capability building. Operating in a global matrix environment, the role will collaborate closely with global HRBPs, HR Centers of Excellence and local HR teams to deliver consistent, scalable and business\-focused HR solutions for the functional groups supported.
   

  

**Role Responsibilities**
**Organisation Effectiveness \& Workforce Planning**
* Support the delivery of organisational change and transformation initiatives across the D\&T function.
* Maintain and improve workforce data quality to support reporting, headcount management and workforce planning.
* Review and analyze people data and business insights to identify trends, risks and opportunities related to performance, retention, engagement, workforce planning and employee experience
* Partner with global HRBPs and HR Centers of Excellence on organization effectiveness, grading, talent, reward, employee relations, team culture and people risks


**Talent, Recruitment \& Inclusion**
* Partner with leaders and Talent Acquisition to attract and hire diverse, high\-quality talent.
* Develop and coordinate early talent initiatives to strengthen future talent pipelines.
* Support talent and succession planning activities across the function
* Support the delivery of inclusion and diversity initiatives that enhance engagement and representation across D\&T.


**Culture \& Capability**
* Support initiatives that strengthen a high\-performance and inclusive culture.
* Coach leaders and managers to lead inclusively, build team effectiveness, improve manager capability and embed an agile high performance culture.
* Help deliver programmes that support employee development, career growth and engagement.


**HR Partnership \& Delivery**
* Provide HR guidance and support to managers and employees across the employee lifecycle.
* Drive delivery of key annual people processes for supported groups in India and Malaysia, including performance, talent, engagement, reward and succession activities Partner with HR Operations and Centres of Excellence to deliver key people processes and programmes.
* Ensure consistent application of HR policies, processes and employment practices.


***Why you?***
**Basic Qualifications:**
* 8 to 11 years of experience in a HR Business Partner role or similar strategic HR role, demonstrating an understanding of the full employee life cycle and ability to work with autonomy on the HR agenda.
* Proven experience partnering with senior leaders in a matrixed, global or multi\-country environment.
* Strong business partnering capability, with the ability to translate business priorities into practical people plans and measurable outcomes.
* Strong analytical skills, with experience using HR data and insights to diagnose trends, identify risks and recommend actions.

title: Global People Relations Partner
description:
**Global Lead – Employee Relations:\-**
 Sapiens is looking for a Global Lead – Employee Relations to lead our Global Employee Relations function, based in Bangalore. If you're a seasoned ER professional ready to take your career to the next level with an established, globally successful company, this role could be the right fit for you.
   

  

**What You'll Do:\-**
 The Global Lead – Employee Relations role is a critical position within Sapiens' People Success function, responsible for maintaining a positive and productive work environment and ensuring regulatory compliance reporting to the VP, Global People Success – Regions. The successful candidate will manage and enhance Employee Relations strategies, handle complex employee issues, and develop policies and processes that contribute to our DNA of “Advance the Possible”. This role designs and governs global ER frameworks centrally, partners with local People Success Partners for regional implementation, and acts as a strategic advisor across all geographies.
   

  

* Employee Relations Strategy: Develop and implement strategies to address and resolve employee relations issues, promote a positive workplace culture, and enhance employee engagement and retention.
* Conflict Resolution: Act as a mediator and advisor for complex employee relations issues and disputes, providing guidance and resolution in line with company policies and legal requirements.
* Policy Development: Create, review, and update employee relations policies and procedures to ensure compliance with current employment laws and best practices.
* Data Analysis: Monitor and analyze employee relations metrics and trends, using AI\-powered analytics and reporting tools to identify patterns, predict risk areas, and prepare recommendations for senior management to drive continuous improvement.
* Compliance and Legal: Ensure the company's practices adhere to state and local employment laws and regulations. Partner with legal counsel when necessary to address compliance issues.
* Communication: Foster open lines of communication between employees and management; counsel managers and employees on ER\-related matters; facilitate effective dialogue to address concerns and promote a transparent work environment.
* Training: Develop and deliver training programs for managers and employees on employee relations topics, including conflict resolution, performance management, and harassment prevention — leveraging AI tools to build, personalize, and scale training content.
* Case Management: Oversee the investigation and resolution of employee complaints and grievances, using AI\-enabled case management tools to ensure a fair, thorough, and efficient process.
* Global ER Ownership: Design and own the global ER framework and operating model, establishing Sapiens' India\-based ER function for all geographies. Define global ER policies and practices centrally, enabling local teams to manage regional implementation with appropriate nuance.
* People Success Partnership: Collaborate with country People Success Leaders and local People Success Partners to implement ER frameworks regionally, acting as a trusted advisor and subject matter expert across all geographies, including India, APAC, and globally.
* Shared Services Integration: Partner closely with case managers within the Shared Services team to ensure seamless end\-to\-end ER case management, driving consistency and quality in case resolution outcomes globally.
* AI\-Driven Efficiency: Actively identify and implement opportunities to use AI and automation tools across ER processes — case triage, policy drafting, sentiment/trend analysis, and reporting — to improve speed, consistency, and decision quality.
* Recruitment \& Compliance Support: Participate in recruitment and dismissal processes and govern employee background checks.


**What To Have For This Position**
**Must\-Have Skills:\-**
* Experience required: 10–15 years
* At least 7\+ years of experience in employee relations roles in global companies
* MA in Organizational Psychology, Behavioural Science, or a related field, or MBA/HR
* In\-depth knowledge and experience of employment laws globally, with expertise across India, Europe and North America
* Mandatory — AI Tool Proficiency: Working proficiency with AI tools (e.g., generative AI, AI\-assisted analytics, and case/workflow automation platforms), and comfort using AI to support case management, policy drafting, data analysis, and reporting
* Excellent interpersonal skills
* Exceptional written and verbal communication
* Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail
* Strong problem\-solving ability
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information with discretion
* Cultural sensitivity and empathy
* Ability to build trust and rapport with employees at all levels of the organization


**About Sapiens:\-**
 Sapiens International Corporation is a global leader in intelligent insurance software solutions. With Sapiens' robust platform, customer\-driven partnerships, and rich ecosystem, insurers are empowered to future\-proof their organizations with operational excellence in a rapidly changing marketplace. We help insurers harness the power of AI and advanced automation to support core solutions for property and casualty, workers' compensation, and life insurance, including reinsurance, financial \& compliance, data \& analytics, digital, and decision management. Sapiens has a longtime global presence, serving over 600 customers in more than 30 countries with its innovative SaaS offerings. Recognized by industry experts and selected for the Microsoft Top 100 Partner program, Sapiens is committed to partnering with our customers for their entire transformation journey and is continuously innovating to ensure their success. title: Oracle Payroll Fast formula Developer
description:
Cleaned Document
  

**About the role**  

  

We are seeking an experienced Oracle HCM Cloud professional with deep expertise in Payroll Fast Formula development and strong knowledge of Oracle Payroll processing and configuration. This role will focus on designing, developing, troubleshooting, and optimizing complex Fast Formulas that support payroll calculations and business requirements. The ideal candidate will also have experience developing Fast Formulas across other Oracle HCM modules and a strong understanding of how formulas interact with HCM configuration, integrations, and downstream processes.  

  

**Responsibilities*** Design, develop, test, and maintain complex Oracle Payroll Fast Formulas supporting payroll calculations and business requirements.
* Develop formulas supporting earnings, deductions, taxes, benefits, balances, eligibility, proration, retroactive processing, and other payroll calculations.
* Analyze complex payroll requirements and translate them into scalable and maintainable Fast Formula solutions.
* Troubleshoot payroll calculation and formula issues, perform root cause analysis, and implement sustainable solutions.
* Review and optimize existing Fast Formulas for performance, maintainability, and accuracy.
* Develop and support Fast Formulas across other Oracle HCM areas, including Time \& Labor, Absence Management, Compensation, Benefits, and Core HR.
* Partner with Payroll functional teams to understand payroll configuration, calculation requirements, and processing impacts.
* Support end\-to\-end testing of formulas, including unit testing, payroll validation, regression testing, and production deployment.
* Analyze the impact of formula changes across Payroll, Time \& Labor, Absence, integrations, reports, and downstream systems.
* Support Oracle quarterly releases by assessing potential impacts to existing formulas and validating critical payroll calculations.
* Maintain technical and functional documentation for complex formula logic and calculation designs.

**Requirements*** Strong hands\-on experience with Oracle HCM Cloud Payroll Fast Formula development.
* Deep understanding of Oracle Payroll calculations, elements, balances, inputs, payroll processing, and retroactive processing.
* Proven experience designing and developing complex Fast Formulas for payroll calculations.
* Strong experience troubleshooting Fast Formula and payroll calculation issues.
* Experience using database items, contexts, inputs, functions, arrays, and other Fast Formula capabilities to implement complex business logic.
* Experience with Fast Formula development outside Payroll, such as Time \& Labor, Absence Management, Compensation.
* Strong understanding of the relationship between Fast Formula, Oracle HCM configuration, payroll processing, and integrations.
* Experience supporting full lifecycle development, including requirements, design, development, testing, deployment, and production support.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to understand and troubleshoot complex calculation logic.

**Preferred qualifications*** Extensive experience developing Fast Formulas in large\-scale or complex Oracle Payroll environments.
* Experience with global or multi\-country Oracle Payroll implementations.
* Strong functional knowledge of Oracle Payroll in addition to Fast Formula development expertise.
* Experience with Time \& Labor and Absence Fast Formulas and their integration with Payroll.
* Experience analyzing and optimizing complex or high\-volume Fast Formulas.
* Understanding of Oracle HCM Extracts, HDL/HSDL, BI Publisher, and HCM integrations.
* Experience supporting Oracle quarterly releases and regression testing of payroll calculations.
* Strong documentation and communication skills, with the ability to explain complex calculation logic to functional and technical teams.

title: ITSM Administrator/Developer
description:
Be an essential element to a brighter future.


We work together to transform essential resources into critical ingredients for mobility, energy, connectivity and health. Join our values\-led organization committed to building a more resilient world with people and planet in mind. Our core values are the foundation that make us successful for ourselves, our customers and the planet.


**Job Description**

**The Role**

The Freshservice Developer \& Administrator owns the configuration, automation, integration, and day\-to\-day administration of Albemarle's enterprise ITSM platform. Following the transition of Service Management from ServiceNow to Freshworks — this role is central to sustaining and scaling the platform across IT and business workspaces (HR, Facilities, Supply Chain, Finance, Procurement, Manufacturing \& Engineering, Accounts Payable etc).


The role blends two hats:


* **Administrator** — configuring, securing, and maintaining the workspace and account environment so agents have the right access, tools, and workflows to deliver service.
* **Developer** — designing, building, testing, and promoting automations within the federated "DEV\-to\-PROD" governance model, where individual IT teams build in a controlled DEV environment and a central team governs, reviews, and promotes to production.

It supports Albemarle's broader strategic direction of Digital Transformation through automation as the foundation for AI\-driven processes, including Freshservice as the "front door" to HR and other functions.


**Key Skill Set:**

**Platform \& Administration**

* Deep hands\-on Freshservice administration across both **Workspace Admin** and **Account Admin** scopes — branding, business hours, SLAs/OLAs, service catalog, field/form management, and RBAC (custom roles and permissions).
* Command of core ITSM modules: **Incident, Major Incident, Problem, Change (normal/emergency/expedited), Release, Service Request, Asset/ITAM, and Alert Management** .
* CMDB / Configuration Management and Device42 integration (discovery, CI data accuracy, incident/change linkage).

**Automation \& Development**

* Expert in **Workflow Automator, Scenario Automations, Supervisor rules, Scheduler, and orchestration/business rules** .
* Ability to build well\-structured workflows — triggers, nested conditions, labelled branches, single\-action nodes, and error paths for external calls.

**Integrations \& APIs**

* Experience integrating Freshservice with **Active Directory / Azure (Entra ID) orchestration via the Freshservice App \+ PowerShell** , **Workday Connector (RaaS\-based and event\-based onboarding/offboarding journeys)** , **UiPath RPA** , **SAP, MS Exchange, SharePoint Search Connector, and BlueCoat** .
* Familiarity with REST APIs, OAuth 2\.0 / API\-key / Basic auth, webhooks, and custom HTTP\-based flows; awareness of **Copilot Studio and the Freshservice MCP Server** for advanced/AI\-driven scenarios.
* Understanding of AI service agent integration *(Aisera)* for ticket create/update/close, KB ingestion, and Freddy AI capabilities.

**Governance, Knowledge \& Analytics**

* Analytics, dashboards, KPIs, SLA compliance reporting, and audit\-readiness.
* Comfort operating within a **sandbox\-first** approach — testing new configurations and major updates before syncing to production.

**Soft skills**

Process standardization mindset, cross\-functional collaboration (HR, IT, IAM, Security, Infrastructure), clear documentation, and stakeholder communication.


**What will you be doing?**

**Administration \& Configuration**

* **Configure and maintain workspaces (branding, business hours, SLAs/OLAs, service catalogs, custom fields, forms, and templates) tailored to departmental needs.**
* **Manage agents, groups, roles, and RBAC; configure the Change Advisory Board (CAB) for change processes.**
* **Administer all Freshservice modules and monitor platform health, troubleshooting performance and proactively addressing risks.**
* **Review Freshworks biannual/product release notes, test updates in sandbox, re\-activate/republish affected configurations, and communicate changes to agents and end users.**

**Development \& Automation**

* **Design, build, and test automations in the DEV environment following the naming convention (Module – Trigger – Action), testing every condition branch and failure scenario before submission.**
* **Complete pre\-work documentation and DEV\-to\-PROD promotion checklists; submit via Freshservice change requests with test evidence for central\-team review.**
* **Own and maintain automations post\-production across their full lifecycle.**

**Integrations**

* **Build and support integrations for onboarding/offboarding (Workday** **Freshservice Journeys), user/AD group provisioning, mailbox/distribution\-group management, RPA\-driven ticket automation, and CMDB sync with Device42\.**
* **Coordinate with IAM, IT Security, Infrastructure, HRIS, and vendor teams (Freshworks, Infosys, Aisera) to configure and validate integrations securely.**

**Knowledge, Analytics \& Continuous Improvement**

* **Build meaningful dashboards, KPIs, and SLA/analytics reports; drive process standardization, adoption, and automation opportunities.**
* **Configure Announcements for centralized service communication.**

**Who you are:**

**Essential**

* **4–7\+ years** in IT Service Management, with **2\+ years hands\-on Freshservice** administration and/or development (Enterprise plan preferred). Prior ServiceNow experience is a strong plus given the migration context.
* Demonstrable experience configuring ITIL\-aligned processes: Incident, Problem, Change, Release, Request Fulfillment, Knowledge, and Configuration/Asset Management.
* Proven track record building automations in Workflow Automator (including approvals, multi\-step workflows, and external integrations).
* Scripting/integration experience — **PowerShell** for AD/Entra orchestration and REST API / OAuth\-based integrations (Workday, UiPath, SAP, Exchange, SharePoint).
* Working knowledge of CMDB/ITAM concepts and tools such as **Device42** .

**Desirable**

* ITIL v4 Foundation certification; Freshservice/Freshworks Academy certifications (Fundamentals, Workflow Automator – Getting Started \& Advanced Logic, SR \& Catalogue Management, Reporting \& Audit Logs).
* Exposure to AI/GenAI service agents (Aisera, Freddy AI, Copilot Studio, MCP Server) and RAG\-based knowledge retrieval.
* Experience operating within a **federated/governed automation model** with DEV/PROD separation, change\-controlled promotions, and central review tiers.
* Strong documentation, stakeholder management, and cross\-functional collaboration skills in a global, multi\-vendor environment.

**Benefits of Joining Albemarle**

* Competitive compensation
* Comprehensive benefits package
* A diverse array of resources to support you professionally and personally.

We are partners to one another in pioneering new ways to be better for ourselves, our teams, and our communities. When you join Albemarle, you become our most essential element and you can anticipate competitive compensation, a comprehensive benefits package, and resources that foster your well\-being and fuel your personal growth. Help us shape the future, build with purpose and grow together.

title: Specialist, Employee Relations India and APAC
description:
Overview:

ROLE AT A GLANCE:  

The Employee Relations Specialist plays an important and increasingly independent role in delivering ER support within their market as part of the local team. Reporting to the Director of Global Employee Relations, this role owns low‑to‑moderate complexity ER cases end‑to‑end, leads investigations with a growing degree of autonomy, and actively contributes to policy, training, and change initiatives within our global ER framework.  

The Specialist helps ensure that employee concerns are addressed thoroughly, fairly, and promptly — with clear and accurate documentation, sound judgment, and consistent application of policies aligned with local labor law and our global standards. It's a hands‑on role that combines solid ER execution with developing advisory capability, and a meaningful contributor to a positive, trusted employee experience across the organization  

HOW YOU’LL MAKE AN IMPACT:  

Investigations* Lead and own fact‑finding investigations for low‑to‑moderate complexity matters — including document review, preliminary and follow‑up interviews, evidence gathering, and drafting findings summaries — exercising sound judgment throughout.
* Align with the Global Director of Employee Relations before finalizing investigation conclusions or recommendations, ensuring consistency on approach, documentation quality, and risk considerations.
* Contribute meaningfully to more complex investigations by conducting discrete workstreams, coordinating logistics, taking detailed notes, and preparing well‑organized draft summaries
* Apply established investigation protocols consistently and maintain strict confidentiality at every stage.
* Maintain accurate, thorough, and confidential case documentation in HR systems.

  

Policy Guidance \& ER Support* Serve as a reliable go‑to resource for HR and ER policy questions in the market, providing practical guidance grounded in established frameworks and local labor law, and escalating complex or ambiguous matters to the Global Director.
* Apply a solid working knowledge of local employment law and global ER policies to advise employees and managers on standard‑to‑moderate ER matters with confidence.
* Contribute to maintaining and strengthening local SOPs, templates, and ER resources, identifying opportunities for improvement and flagging gaps to the Global Director

  

Grievance \& Conflict Resolution* Independently manage standard‑to‑moderate workplace concerns — including interpersonal conflicts, recurring issues, and situations involving multiple parties — from intake through closure, ensuring timely, fair, and consistent handling.
* Support mediation efforts by preparing materials, coordinating logistics, capturing key notes, and tracking follow‑up actions; escalate formal mediation facilitation to the Global Director as appropriate.
* Maintain thorough, accurate, and confidential case documentation in HR systems, ensuring records meet quality standards

  

Performance Management Support* Provide managers with confident, practical guidance on performance documentation, feedback conversations, and standard‑to‑moderate performance improvement processes, escalating higher‑risk or senior‑level situations to the Global Director.
* Draft well‑structured performance improvement plans (PIPs) and supporting documentation, incorporating knowledge of policy and local requirements, for Global Director review and alignment before issuance.
* Identify when performance situations carry elevated risk and proactively loop in the Global Director early in the process

  

Change Management Support* Take ownership of assigned ER workstreams within organizational change efforts, including drafting employee and manager communications, coordinating logistics, and tracking employee questions and concerns.
* Proactively surface and escalate employee concerns raised during change efforts, ensuring they are assessed and routed to the right partners, including the Global Director where needed

  

Corrective Action Support* Guide managers through standard‑to‑moderate corrective action processes with confidence, ensuring decisions are grounded in policy, consistent with precedent, and appropriately documented.
* Draft corrective action documentation — including written warnings and performance improvement plans — with attention to accuracy, policy alignment, and local legal requirements, for Global Director review prior to issuance.
* Maintain meticulous documentation and records for all corrective action cases, ensuring proper storage and confidentiality.

  

Training \& Education* Contribute to the design and delivery of ER training by developing materials, coordinating logistics, and managing follow‑up communications.
* Facilitate portions of ER training sessions — including policy education and manager guidance topics — with coaching and oversight from the Global Director.
* Actively help build ER knowledge and awareness across the India market through consistent engagement with HRBPs and proactive communication on ER topics.

  

Additional duties as assigned  

TEAM DYNAMICS:  

We’re building our Global Employee Relations team from the ground up, which means you’ll be part of shaping how ER shows up across the company for years to come. This is a truly global effort—supporting employees and leaders in different regions, cultures, and regulatory environments.  

We partner closely with our HR Business Partners, Ethics \& Compliance, and Legal teams to ensure we’re approaching situations with consistency, fairness, and a shared commitment to our values. It’s a highly collaborative space where thoughtful problem‑solving and strong relationships really matter. If you enjoy meaningful work that helps create a positive, trusted employee experience, this is a team where you can make a real impact.  

QUALIFICATIONS FOR SUCCESS:  

Education* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Law, Business, Psychology, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

  

Experience* 4\-6 \+ years of HR or Employee Relations experience, including exposure to case management, investigations, performance management and corrective action.

  

Technical and professional skills* Solid working knowledge of local labor and employment law, with a genuine commitment to continued growth in ER expertise.
* Demonstrated experience leading investigations, including document review, fact‑finding interviews, evidence analysis, and drafting clear, well‑supported case summaries.
* Ability to draft high‑quality, policy‑aligned ER documentation (PIPs, corrective action letters, investigation summaries) that requires minimal rework at senior review.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in local language; working English proficiency is required.
* Proficiency with HRIS and case management tools; able to manage a portfolio of open cases with attention to quality and deadlines.
* High integrity and sound judgment; able to handle sensitive and confidential information with discretion and care.
* Strong attention to detail and organizational skills; consistent and thorough in documentation practices.
* Empathy and strong listening skills; able to build genuine trust with employees and managers across different situations.
* Solid conflict‑resolution skills; able to navigate emotionally charged or sensitive interpersonal situations with composure and fairness.
* Growth mindset, openness to coaching and feedback, and comfort working effectively in a matrixed, global environment across time zones and cultures

title: Welfare Officer
description:
**Job Purpose:**


We are looking for a dynamic and people\-oriented People Experience Partner to support the HR function at our manufacturing plant in Arakkonam.


The role will be responsible for day\-to\-day HR operations, employee welfare, employee engagement, HR documentation, benefits administration and employee lifecycle activities at the plant. The role will also support the Plant HR Head in Industrial Relations, statutory compliance, contract labour management and workforce\-related activities.


The position will serve as an important interface between employees, contract workmen, supervisors and the HR team, ensuring timely resolution of employee queries and delivery of a positive employee experience at the plant

**Key Responsibilities:**

**HR Operations \& Employee Lifecycle**

* Manage day\-to\-day HR operations for plant employees and support end\-to\-end employee lifecycle activities.
* Coordinate with Payroll and relevant stakeholders on attendance, leave, payroll inputs and employee\-related queries.
* Support preparation of regular HR MIS and plant HR reports.

**Employee Welfare \& Engagement**

* Act as a point of contact for employee welfare\-related matters and provide timely support to employees.
* Understand employee concerns and grievances and escalate matters appropriately to the Plant HR Head.
* Coordinate employee welfare activities, celebrations, recognition initiatives and other plant\-level employee engagement programmes.
* Maintain a positive and employee\-friendly work environment while ensuring alignment with business requirements.
* Support awareness programmes relating to employee welfare, safety and wellbeing.

**Employee Relations \& Industrial Relations Support**

* Maintain regular interaction with employees and shop\-floor teams to understand workplace concerns.
* Support disciplinary and employee\-relations processes, documentation and follow\-up as directed by the Plant HR Head.

**Statutory Compliance \& Regulatory Coordination**

* Support the Plant HR Head in ensuring compliance with applicable labour laws, employment regulations and factory\-related requirements.
* Maintain required HR, employee welfare and statutory records and registers.
* Support preparation of documents and information required for statutory inspections, audits and reviews.
* Coordinate with relevant internal teams and external agencies for compliance\-related activities.
* Assist in ensuring timely renewal, documentation and maintenance of relevant licences, registrations and records.
* Support liaison and coordination with statutory authorities and external agencies whenever required.

**Contract Labour Management**

* Support the Plant HR Head in the administration and monitoring of contract labour.
* Coordinate with contractors regarding attendance, manpower deployment and employee documentation.
* Support monitoring of statutory compliance by contractors, including PF, ESI, wages, bonus and other applicable requirements.

**Recruitment \& Workforce Support**

* Support hiring of shopfloor, blue\-collar and other plant positions based on manpower requirements.
* Coordinate with recruitment consultants, local sourcing channels, ITIs, skill centres and other sources as required.
* Assist in screening, interview coordination, selection documentation and joining formalities.
* Coordinate pre\-employment documentation and Background Verification (BGV) processes for Pan India locations.

**Background Verification \& Employee Documentation**

* Liaise with BGV agencies and internal stakeholders to ensure timely completion of verification.
* Track pending cases, follow up on exceptions and maintain appropriate records.
* Ensure employee documentation is complete, accurate and appropriately maintained.

**Employee Benefits \& Insurance Administration**

* Support Corporate People Experience team in administration of Group Medical Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance, Life Insurance and other applicable employee benefit programmes.
* Coordinate employee enrolment, additions, deletions and corrections under applicable benefit schemes.
* Support employees with insurance claims and coordinate with brokers, TPAs and service providers for resolution of queries and escalations.
* Support annual renewal and related employee communication activities.

**HR MIS, Employee Communication \& Audit Support**

* Prepare and maintain regular HR MIS relating to headcount, attendance, attrition, recruitment, employee movements, welfare activities and other plant HR metrics.
* Conduct or coordinate employee communication sessions and awareness programmes.
* Support internal and external HR audits and provide required documentation.
* Maintain appropriate records of vendor activities, audits and corrective actions.

**Other Responsibilities**

* Undertake any other HR, employee welfare or plant\-related responsibilities assigned by the reporting manager.
* The incumbent will be the designated Welfare Officer for the Arakkonam plant and will discharge the responsibilities of the Welfare Officer as applicable to the plant.

**Preferred Experience \& Qualifications**

* MLM / MSW in Human Resources or a related discipline.
* 4\-7 years of experience in HR, preferably in a manufacturing, industrial or plant environment.
* Freshers with relevant academic qualifications and strong interest in Plant HR / Employee Relations may also be considered.
* Exposure to labour laws, Industrial Relations or employee welfare will be an advantage.
* Strong interest in working closely with shop\-floor employees and the plant workforce.
* Strong interpersonal, follow\-up and coordination skills.
* Comfortable working with MS Excel, PowerPoint and HR systems.
* Knowledge of HRMS platforms such as Workday, SAP, Oracle, or PeopleSoft.


We offer all employees access to a dedicated recognition platform, empowering you to celebrate achievements, share appreciation and stay connected globally.

title: Assistant People and Culture
description:
**About HB Leisure**


HB Leisure is the world's leading attraction partner, operating games and arcades at some of the biggest theme parks and attractions across UK, Europe, America, Asia, the Middle East and Australia.


We're a global business with thousands of seasonal and permanent employees who create memorable experiences for millions of guests every year. Attracting exceptional people is key to our success.


This is an exciting opportunity for a motivated marketing or business graduate who wants to combine creativity, digital marketing and talent acquisition in a truly international organisation.


**The Role**


The Assistant People \& Culture – India provides administrative and operational support to the HR function, assisting with recruitment, onboarding, employee records, HRMS administration, attendance, statutory compliance, employee engagement and HR reporting.


**Key Responsibilities**


**HR Administration**


* Maintain employee personnel records, both physical and digital, ensuring accuracy, confidentiality, and compliance.
* Update employee information within grey HR/HRMS systems.
* Prepare and issue employee correspondence, including confirmation, promotion, transfer, warning and experience letters.
* Ensure all employee documentation is complete, accurate and compliant with company policies and statutory requirements.


**Attendance \& Payroll Support**


* Monitor employee attendance, leave records and timekeeping data.
* Process attendance regularization and leave applications in a timely manner.
* Coordinate with the payroll team to ensure accurate employee records and seamless payroll processing.


**Statutory Compliance**


* Assist in the administration of statutory compliance requirements including Provident Fund (PF), Employee State Insurance (ESI), Labor Welfare Fund (LFW) and related documentation.
* Maintain statutory records and support internal and external compliance audits.


**Reporting**


* Prepare and circulate weekly and monthly HR reports.
* Maintain and analyse recruitment, attendance, attrition, and manpower reports to support workforce planning and decision\-making


**General Responsibilities**


* Support the planning and execution of employee engagement and welfare initiatives.
* Collaborate with departmental managers and employees on HR\-related matters.
* Undertake any other reasonable duties and responsibilities assigned by the Manager – People and Culture to support business and HR objectives.


**About You**


We're looking for someone keen, enthusiastic, creative and keen to build a career in employer branding and recruitment.


### **Essential**


* Bachelor's Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration or related field.
* 0–2 years HR experience (fresh graduates with strong communication skills may also apply).
* Knowledge of MS Excel, Word, PowerPoint and Outlook.
* Understanding of labour laws, PF and ESI.
* Strong organisational skills, confidentiality and attention to detail.

### **Desirable**


* Experience using greytHR or other HRMS.
* Experience in a multi\-site organisation.
* Knowledge of payroll processes.


**What We Offer**


* Opportunity to work in a global organisation.
* Exposure to all aspects of Human Resources.
* Career development and learning opportunities.
* Supportive and collaborative working environment.
* Employee benefits as per company policy.


**Why Join Us?**


This role offers an excellent opportunity to build a career in People \& Culture while supporting a fast\-paced international business. You will gain practical experience across recruitment, employee relations, compliance, HR systems and reporting while working with experienced HR professionals.

title: Senior Associate Staffing
description:
**Job Description**
 The Supply Partner is responsible for staffing a pod\* of up to 250\-300 people throughout their tenure at Publicis Sapient providing them with great experiences throughout their stay in regards to their utilization, their career and growth aspiration preferences, feedbacks and performances. Staffing Partner proactively offers and nominates the individuals from their Pod across books/account/projects to the right opportunity/role.
   

  

* Pod: Group of people in a specific geography and potentially possessing similar skill set.


 Staffing partner owns the pod and is responsible to staff them to the right opportunity/role throughout their tenure at Publicis Sapient keeping in mind their individual career aspirations, business requirements and utilization.
   

  

**Your Impact OR Responsibilities:**
**Pod Management**
* Deploys a pod of capacity 250\-300 people to the right opportunity/role throughout their tenure at Publicis Sapient keeping in mind the individual career aspirations, business requirements and utilization.
* Provides nominations and guidance for filling open needs\- either directly in the system or in collaboration with the respective Capacity Partners.
* Maintains the data accuracy and continuity of context (history of roles, feedbacks, performance, etc.), roll off dates, competencies, primary capabilities, resumes, time\-cards, Supervisor Assignment, travel readiness (Visa process with GPM) for the Pod.
* Provides visibility about skills and availability to the business/delivery organization with respect to pod people.
* Holds meaningful discussions/ difficult conversations with pod people with respect to individual career aspirations, business requirements and utilization.
* Reaches out to business/delivery/account leadership directly, if additional clarity on roles/skills is needed.
* Proactively offers and nominates people from the pod to respective Capacity Partners and provides alternatives to improve utilization.

* Pod/individual and geography.
* Actively facilitates the on\-boarding of New Hires in their pod

* Supports the supervisors and people strategists in the Performance Management process and the related outcomes (feedback processes, assessment, promotion readiness, PIP etc.)
* Be the point of contact for all individuals in their pod for any concerns and issues regarding utilization, deployment and growth aspirations throughout their association with the pod.
* Cooperates /supports /escalates to People Strategist on all people issues outside of staffing focus such as Leave of absence, accidents, harassment, etc.
* Bench Management \- Manages individuals on the bench actively by finding opportunities for internal assignments, growth and development conversations, checking motivational issues and potential attrition issues with stakeholders approving Time Cards for bench time.

* Informs and supports the capacity planning issues and resolutions

* Keep abreast of overall pod strategic and tactical staffing and skill needs by analyzing the ongoing Staffing operation, i.e. utilization, open needs reports etc.

* Proactively work on Travel readiness (India) and support VISA processes in collaboration with GPM
* Keeps the quality check with respect to staffing right people on the right places, based on business, client and individual feedback.
* Company Contribution \- Actively participates in, and assists with, company events such as hiring, training and internal initiatives.


**Qualifications**

* Minimum 5\+ years of experience in bench management and staffing.

* This person should be highly organized, adapt quickly to change, and thrive in a fast\-paced organization.

title: Chief Financial Officer (CFO)
description:
**Job Description – Chief Financial Officer (CFO)**

**Organization:** VITS Kamats Hospitality Group  
**Location:** Corporate Office – Mumbai

**Role Overview**

VITS Kamats Hospitality Group is looking for an experienced, strategic, and result\-oriented **Chief Financial Officer (CFO)** to lead the organization’s overall financial strategy, governance, financial planning, risk management, and business performance.

The CFO will be responsible for driving **financial sustainability, profitability, cash flow optimization, compliance, and strategic decision\-making** across the corporate office and multiple hotel units.

The role will work closely with the **Managing Director, Promoters, Senior Management, Operations, Projects, HR, Legal, Purchase, and other business functions** to support business growth, expansion, new hotel projects, and long\-term organizational objectives.

**Key Roles \& Responsibilities**

**1\. Financial Strategy \& Leadership**

* Develop and lead the organization’s overall financial strategy in alignment with business objectives
* Provide strategic financial insights and recommendations to the Promoters and Senior Management
* Drive long\-term financial planning, profitability, growth, and financial sustainability
* Evaluate business performance and identify opportunities for revenue enhancement and cost optimization
* Establish financial targets, KPIs, and performance benchmarks across business units
* Support management in evaluating strategic business decisions, investments, and expansion plans

**2\. Financial Planning, Budgeting \& Forecasting**

* Lead the annual budgeting and business planning process across corporate and hotel units
* Develop financial forecasts, business projections, and scenario\-based financial models
* Monitor actual performance against budgets and forecasts and recommend corrective actions
* Evaluate financial feasibility of new hotels, projects, leases, management contracts, and other business opportunities
* Develop financial models for expansion, capital expenditure, and new business initiatives
* Provide periodic financial performance reviews to Senior Management

**3\. Corporate Finance \& Financial Operations**

* Oversee the overall finance and accounting functions of the organization
* Ensure accurate and timely preparation of financial statements, MIS, P\&L, balance sheets, cash flow statements, and management reports
* Strengthen financial systems, processes, controls, and reporting structures across all units
* Ensure effective revenue accounting, credit control, collections, procurement controls, expense management, and inventory controls
* Ensure proper accounting practices and financial reporting in accordance with applicable accounting standards, including Ind AS
* Drive standardization of finance processes and reporting across all hotel properties

**4\. Cash Flow \& Working Capital Management**

* Provide strategic oversight of organizational cash flow and working capital management
* Develop and monitor short\-term and long\-term cash flow projections
* Optimize receivables, payables, inventory, and working capital cycles
* Monitor fund requirements across corporate and hotel units
* Establish appropriate controls over cash, banking, collections, and payments
* Maintain strong relationships with banks and financial institutions
* Evaluate and manage funding requirements for business operations and expansion

**5\. Banking, Funding \& Financial Institutions**

* Manage relationships with banks, financial institutions, lenders, and other financial stakeholders
* Evaluate and negotiate working capital facilities, loans, credit lines, and other financial arrangements
* Monitor interest costs, borrowing structures, repayment schedules, and financing arrangements
* Support the organization in raising funds for expansion and new projects where required
* Ensure timely submission of financial information and documentation to lenders and financial institutions
* Optimize the organization’s overall financing structure

**6\. Business Expansion \& Investment Evaluation**

* Provide financial leadership for new hotel projects, acquisitions, leases, management contracts, and strategic investments
* Conduct financial feasibility studies and ROI analysis for proposed projects
* Review project budgets, capital expenditure, operating projections, and funding requirements
* Assess financial risks and returns associated with new business opportunities
* Support Senior Management in investment and expansion decisions
* Monitor financial performance of new projects from development through stabilization

**7\. Compliance, Governance \& Risk Management**

* Ensure compliance with GST, TDS, Income Tax, PF, ESIC, Professional Tax, LWF, Companies Act, and other applicable statutory requirements
* Ensure timely filing of statutory and regulatory returns
* Establish and strengthen financial governance and internal control systems
* Identify and mitigate financial, operational, tax, and business risks
* Ensure adherence to internal financial policies, SOPs, and delegated authority frameworks
* Maintain appropriate financial controls across corporate and hotel operations
* Work closely with legal and professional advisors on financial and regulatory matters

**8\. Audit \& Financial Controls**

* Oversee internal, statutory, tax, and other financial audits
* Coordinate with auditors and ensure timely closure of audit observations
* Strengthen internal audit mechanisms and financial control systems
* Ensure accuracy, transparency, and integrity of financial information
* Identify control gaps and implement appropriate corrective measures
* Establish effective risk management and fraud prevention controls

**9\. Hospitality Finance \& Property Performance**

**COMPANY OVERVIEW**

We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.

  

**JOB OVERVIEW**

The Associate Consultant serves as the operational subject matter expert (SME) for the contingent workforce program within their designated location(s) and group(s). This role will support India professional contingent worker engagements for India Foods and GIC and will provide backup support for D\&T engagements. This role is responsible for the day\-to\-day management of program activities, ensuring the achievement of operational Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and Service Level Agreements (SLAs), and maintaining high quality standards. The Associate Consultant will provide guidance to resource managers and vendors on program processes and contribute to data\-driven improvements in the contingent workforce program.  



**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES**

* **Operational Management:**


	+ Oversee and manage all day\-to\-day operations of the contingent workforce program within the designated location(s) / group(s).
	+ Act as the primary point of contact for contingent workforce program\-related issues.
	+ Ensure compliance with local labor laws, regulations, and company policies related to contingent workers.
* **Performance Monitoring \& Achievement:**


	+ Develop and implement strategies to improve performance and address any identified gaps.
	+ Maintain high quality standards in all aspects of the contingent workforce program.
	+ Troubleshoot and resolve operational issues in a timely and effective manner.
* **Program Initiatives \& Improvement:**


	+ Identify areas for improvement within the contingent workforce program and propose solutions to enhance efficiency, effectiveness, and compliance.
	+ Contribute to the development and implementation of best practices for contingent workforce management.
* **Stakeholder Management:**


	+ Build and maintain strong relationships with internal stakeholders, including resource managers, HR business partners, and procurement teams.
	+ Provide guidance to resource managers on contingent workforce program processes and requirements.
	+ Collaborate with resource managers to understand their talent needs and ensure appropriate use of contingent workers.
* **Vendor Management:**


	+ Partner with vendors to facilitate sourcing of contingent staffing needs.
	+ Collaborate with vendors to ensure a thorough understanding of staffing requirements, enabling effective sourcing of qualified contingent workers and timely, efficient fulfillment.
	+ Verify vendor adherence to program policies
	+ Maintain vendor POC lists
* **Reporting \& Analysis:**


	+ Monitor program performance, including KPIs, SLAs, and cost savings.
	+ Analyze data to identify trends and opportunities for improvement.
	+ Present findings and recommendations to program leadership.
	+ Identify and report on cost savings opportunities within the contingent workforce program.
* **Compliance:**


	+ Ensure compliance with all applicable labor laws and regulations related to contingent workers in India.
	+ Ensure compliance with program requirements.

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

* **Experience:**
* At least 3 years of experience in contingent workforce management, HR operations, or a related field.
* **Skills:**


	+ Strong understanding of contingent workforce management principles and best practices.
	+ Knowledge of local labor laws and regulations related to contingent workers in India.
	+ Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills.
	+ Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
	+ Experience with Vendor Management Systems (VMS), specifically Workday VNDLY.
	+ Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
	+ Strong organizational and time management skills.
* **Key Competencies:**


	+ Results\-Oriented: Demonstrates a strong focus on achieving results and meeting deadlines.
	+ Problem\-Solving: Identifies and resolves problems effectively and efficiently.
	+ Communication: Communicates clearly and effectively with all stakeholders.
	+ Teamwork: Works collaboratively with others to achieve common goals.
	+ Adaptability: Adapts to changing priorities and requirements.
	+ Continuous Improvement: Seeks opportunities to improve processes and performance.

Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

 Medicine moves forward here. So will you.

 Ergomed Group brings together Ergomed CRO, PrimeVigilance, Prudentia, and ADAMAS Consulting to help biopharmaceutical companies develop, deliver and safeguard therapies in oncology, rare disease and other complex areas of medicine. Across the Group, our teams turn the signals that clinical trials, safety systems and quality data generate into insight that helps bring safer treatments to patients around the world.
   

  

 The science and analysis that guides our work is demanding. And this is where we excel. What defines us, though, is how we work together. Across countries, cultures and time zones, we bring kindness, curiosity and a shared sense of purpose to work that genuinely matters. Ideas are welcome here. Growth is expected. And every person has room to make a real difference to patients' lives.
   

  

 Whether you are early in your career or bringing decades of experience, we want you to feel valued for what you do and for who you are. If that sounds like the place you have been looking for, we would love to hear from you.
   

  

**Job Description**
 The Global People Services Associate acts as a support in a central hub for transactional HR activities. The Global People Services Associate provides efficient, consistent support to all employees and managers.
   

  

* Employee Support: Responding to HR\-related questions from employees and managers (benefits, policies, time\-off).
* Ticket Management: Act as the first point of contact for employee HR inquiries (benefits, payroll, leave, policies) via Freshservice, managing, prioritizing, and resolving tickets within defined Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
* Data Management: Accurate data entry for new hires, terminations, promotions, transfers, and updating employee records in HRIS.
* Onboarding/Offboarding: Administering the hiring process, creating offers, tracking probation, and processing leavers.
* Payroll \& Benefits: Assisting with basic payroll processing, managing benefit enrollments, and pension administration.
* Process Adherence: Following Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and Service Level Agreements (SLAs) to ensure consistency.


**Qualifications**
 University Degree, or equivalent experience, preferably in HR or business administration.
   

  

**Additional Information**
 When you join Ergomed Group, you make a difference by helping to bring safe and effective pharmaceutical treatment to patients around the world. You’ll join a passionate and collaborative team of experts in clinical research, pharmacovigilance, and quality consulting.
   

  

 We are diverse in many ways, yet our values unite us. Our values are how we work, not words on a wall. If they sound like you, you will feel at home here.
   

  

* Quality: we hold ourselves to the standard patients deserve.
* Integrity and trust: we do the right thing, especially when it is hard.
* Drive and passion: we care about the outcome, because someone is waiting on it.
* Agility and responsiveness: we move quickly, because patients cannot wait.
* Belonging: everyone is welcome, and every voice counts.
* Collaborative partnerships: we go further by going together.


 We look forward to welcoming your application.
