description:
**About Northern Trust**

  

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.  



  

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.  



  

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.  



  

  

**Role Overview**


We are seeking a seasoned **Techno\-Leadership Director** to lead the **Engineering function for Backup, Recovery, and Cyber Resilience** across hybrid enterprise environments. This role will drive strategy, architecture, and execution of advanced backup and recovery solutions spanning **Azure, AWS, and on‑premise private cloud**, ensuring operational resilience and regulatory compliance for mission\-critical systems.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Leadership \& Strategy**


	+ Provide visionary leadership for enterprise backup and recovery engineering teams.
	+ Define and execute long\-term strategies for **backup, disaster recovery (DR), point\-in\-time recovery, and cyber vault recovery (clean room environments)** across hybrid cloud platforms.
	+ Partner with senior executives, risk governance, and compliance stakeholders to align recovery capabilities with regulatory mandates.
* **Engineering \& Operations**


	+ Architect, engineer, and optimize enterprise backup solutions leveraging **Cohesity, Rubrik, Azure, AWS, and private cloud platforms**.
	+ Lead design and implementation of **cyber recovery vaults, immutable backups, and clean room recovery environments**.
	+ Establish and enforce standards for **data protection, recovery SLAs, and resilience testing** across global infrastructure.
	+ Drive automation, orchestration, and modernization of backup workflows to improve efficiency and reduce recovery times.
* **Risk \& Compliance**


	+ Ensure adherence to industry frameworks (NIST, ISO, COBIT, DORA, PRA, Federal Reserve, CSA CCM, CIS Controls).
	+ Partner with risk and audit teams to demonstrate compliance with financial industry regulations.
	+ Lead resilience exercises, cyber recovery simulations, and regulatory reporting.
* **Team \& Stakeholder Management**


	+ Lead and mentor engineering teams across regions, fostering a culture of innovation and accountability.
	+ Collaborate with application owners, infrastructure teams, and cybersecurity leaders to ensure seamless recovery integration.

title: Mid Specialist - Human Resources
description:
**About the Department** 




 Invest India is the National Investment Promotion and Facilitation Agency under the Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT), Ministry of Commerce and Industry, Government of India. It hosts teams working with various government initiatives such as Make in India, Startup India and PMG
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Onboarding \& Offboarding** 




 Own the end\-to\-end employee lifecycle transitions to ensure every joiner and leaver experiences a well\-structured, compliant, and professional process.
 


* Design and continuously improve the onboarding journey \- pre\-boarding communication, documentation, induction, and role/team integration
* Own the offboarding process end\-to\-end \- resignation/separation formalities, clearance coordination, full and final settlement, and knowledge transfer
* Conduct structured exit interviews; analyse findings to identify attrition drivers and feed insights back into retention strategy
* Track onboarding and offboarding TAT, new\-hire satisfaction, and early attrition metrics; report trends to leadership
* Maintain accurate, audit\-ready employee records and documentation throughout the lifecycle



**2\. Performance Management System (PMS)** 




 Own the design, governance, and execution of the organization's performance management framework.
 


* Design and administer the annual/bi\-annual performance review cycle \- goal\-setting, mid\-year check\-ins, final appraisals, and calibration
* Partner with functional and business leaders to ensure fair, consistent, and timely rating calibration across teams
* Build manager and employee capability on goal\-setting, feedback, and performance conversations through training and toolkits
* Administer performance improvement plans (PIPs) in partnership with business leaders and ensure documentation and due process are followed
* Link performance outcomes to rewards, promotions, and development planning in coordination with relevant stakeholders
* Continuously evaluate and refine the PMS framework based on organizational maturity, feedback, and best practice benchmarking



**3\. Grievance Management \& Employee Relations** 




 Serve as a trusted, neutral point of contact to ensure a fair and psychologically safe workplace.
 


* Own the grievance redressal mechanism end\-to\-end \- intake, investigation, resolution, and closure — with strict confidentiality
* Ensure full compliance with the POSH Act and other applicable labor and workplace regulations, including committee coordination and reporting
* Advise managers and employees on policy interpretation, conflict resolution, and disciplinary processes
* Maintain grievance and case\-management logs; analyze recurring themes and recommend systemic/policy\-level fixes
* Escalate high\-risk or sensitive matters to leadership and legal counsel as appropriate, with sound judgment and discretion



**4\. HR Automation** 




 Drive the digitization and automation agenda to make HR processes efficient, consistent, and scalable.
 


* Identify manual, high\-effort HR processes (onboarding, PMS, grievance tracking, documentation, letters) and lead automation
* Partner with HRMS vendors on system implementation, configuration, enhancement, and issue resolution
* Drive employee and manager adoption of self\-service HR tools and workflows
* Own data hygiene, access controls, and process governance across HR systems
* Stay current on HR\-tech trends and evaluate new tools/platforms that could improve HR service delivery



**5\. HR Analytics \& Dashboards** 




 Turn HR data into a decision\-making asset for leadership.
 


* Build and maintain live dashboards covering headcount but not limited to attrition, engagement, PMS completion, L\&D participation, and grievance trends
* Deliver monthly/quarterly HR MIS and insight decks to leadership, highlighting risks and opportunities
* Standardize HR metrics definitions and reporting cadence across the function for consistency and accuracy
* Conduct ad\-hoc, leadership\-requested analyses (e.g., attrition deep\-dives, cost\-to\-serve, span\-of\-control reviews)
* Ensure data governance, accuracy, and confidentiality of all HR reporting outputs



**6\. Other HR Operations** 




 Support the broader people agenda beyond the core pillars above.
 


* Draft, review, and update HR policies and the employee handbook in line with evolving organizational needs and regulations
* Design and drive employee engagement, wellness, and culture\-building initiatives
* Partner with Finance, IT, Admin, and Legal on cross\-functional people matters



  





**Qualifications** 




  




* MBA/PGDM in Human Resources or a related discipline from a recognized institute
* 10–13 years of progressive HR experience, with demonstrable ownership of PMS, L\&D, and core HR operations in a mid\-to\-large organization
* Proven experience implementing or scaling HRMS/HR automation and building HR analytics/dashboards
* Strong working knowledge of labor laws, POSH compliance, and grievance redressal frameworks
* Experience managing end\-to\-end onboarding and offboarding at scale



  




* **Functional Skills**
* HR analytics and BI tools (Excel, Power BI, or equivalent)
* HRMS/HRIS configuration and process automation
* Employee Lifecycle Management
* Performance management design and calibration facilitation
* Policy drafting and statutory/compliance management



  




* **Behavioral Competencies**
* Strong stakeholder management and executive communication
* Sound judgment, discretion, and integrity in handling sensitive matters
* Structured, data\-driven problem\-solving
* Ownership mindset with the ability to balance strategic thinking and hands\-on execution
* Ability to lead and develop team members

 Talent Acquisition

### **Employee Engagement \& Retention**

* Analyze engagement survey results and recommend action plans.
* Support retention strategies for critical talent and high performers.
* Monitor employee experience initiatives and career development programs.

### **HR Analytics \& Reporting**

* Generate and analyze talent\-related dashboards and reports.
* Track KPIs such as attrition, internal mobility, succession coverage, performance distribution, and leadership pipeline health.
* Present insights and recommendations to HR leadership and business stakeholders.

* Act as a trusted advisor on talent development and workforce planning initiatives.

* Stakeholder Management

* Contribute to building a strong, collaborative, performance\-driven, and employee\-centric culture.

* Headcount \& Attrition

* Employee Turnover
* Absenteeism
* Performance \& Productivity
* Employee Engagement

description:

Industry leaders with a history of innovation, Cineverse is powering the future of Entertainment.
   

  

 Job Title: Global Payroll Coordinator
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are seeking a highly detail‑oriented Payroll Specialist to provide operational and compliance support to our Payroll Managers across the US, Europe, and India. This role is ideal for someone who excels in U.S. state tax/UI setup, jurisdiction compliance, data validation, and cross‑functional coordination. You will not own or process payroll directly; instead, you will ensure payroll managers have accurate data, correct state registrations, reconciled reports, and compliant system setups. You’ll also support payroll‑related accounting tasks and help maintain the integrity of our payroll processes globally.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Payroll Support – U.S., Europe \& India
   

  

* Provide day\-to\-day operational support to Payroll Managers for each region.
* Work with payroll managers and HR to ensure all data has been captured for the current payroll run (new hires, terminations, compensation changes, variable pay).
* Audit payroll reports for accuracy before final approval by Payroll Managers.


 U.S. State Tax \& UI Setup \+ Compliance
   

  

* Manage state tax and unemployment insurance (UI) account registrations and ongoing maintenance.
* Set up new jurisdictions in payroll systems and verify rates, SUI accounts, and withholding requirements.
* Monitor compliance updates and partner with Payroll Managers to implement changes.
* Maintain documentation of tax accounts, filings, and notices across all applicable states.


 Global Payroll Coordination
   

  

* Support local payroll leads (Europe, UK, Moldova, India) with data collection, audit files, and reporting needs.
* Track statutory changes globally and escalate potential impacts to the appropriate payroll owner.
* Coordinate with external payroll vendors to troubleshoot discrepancies or missing data.


 Accounting \& Reporting Support
   

  

* Prepare payroll journal entries and assist with monthly close activities in partnership with Finance.
* Reconcile payroll accounts, statutory payments, and benefits invoices.
* Assist with year\-end reporting activities (e.g., W‑2 reconciliation, global equivalents).


**Qualifications**
 Required
   

  

* 3–5\+ years of experience in payroll support, payroll operations, or related roles.
* Strong hands\-on experience in US State tax setup, SUI registration, and multi\-state compliance.
* Experience supporting multi\-country payroll teams (US required; EU/India preferred).
* Working knowledge of accounting concepts and payroll GL reconciliation.
* Proficiency with payroll or HRIS systems (you can customize with your company’s stack).
* Strong Excel skills and comfort working with complex data sets.
* Excellent attention to detail and ability to operate with confidentiality.


**Preferred**
* Payroll certifications (FPC or CPP).
* Experience in high\-growth or multi\-entity environments.
* Familiarity with Workday, BambooHR, Rippling, ADP, Deel, Remote.com, or similar platforms.


 Soft Skills
   

  

* Highly organized and able to manage work across multiple time zones.
* Strong problem‑solving skills and ability to identify discrepancies quickly.
* Excellent communication skills and a collaborative mindset.
* Comfortable in a fast\-paced, evolving environment.

title: Onboarding & Implementation Manager
description:
**About BiteSpeed**




  





 Hey there! We are a
 **Sequoia\-backed SaaS startup** 
 building an AI\-native Marketing, Support \& Sales suite for
 **e\-commerce brands.** 




  





 We’re currently working with
 **3000\+ e\-commerce brands** 
 globally across 50\+ countries and are fortunate to have
 **raised $5\.5M\+** 
 along the journey with marquee investors like Sequoia Capital India, Kunal Shah, Gaurav Munjal \& more backing us.
 



  





  





**Check out more about us here \-** 
 https://www.bitespeed.co/ and do read through our 200\+ odd 5\-star reviews to get a sense of what our customers say about us here \- https://apps.shopify.com/bitespeed\-fb\-messenger\-chatbot (we openly brag about this 😉)
 



  





  





**We’ve had some solid investors back us** 
 (making it easier for you to stalk us since you’d do this anyway):\-
 



  




* **BiteSpeed Raises USD 3\.5M Funding, Led by Peak XV’s Surge\-** 
 https://www.businesswireindia.com/e\-commerce\-ai\-startup\-bitespeed\-raises\-usd\-3\-5m\-funding\-led\-by\-peak\-xvs\-surge\-92455\.html



  




* **E\-commerce AI start\-up BiteSpeed raises $3\.5 million funding led by Peak XV’s Surge\-**

**About the role**




  





 We want to keep our

 . To do that, customer success is probably going to be our most important function and we want to treat it like that. So far our customer success function has been

 We're now at a point where we’ve scaled 10X in the past year and to do that again next year we want to double down on our existing customers. This role involves owning

title: Enterprise Account Manager
description:
**ABOUT CULTUREMONKEY** 





 CultureMonkey is an AI\-powered employee engagement and experience platform that helps organizations build exceptional workplaces through continuous listening, people analytics, and action planning. Trusted across 100\+ countries and rated 4\.7/5 on G2, we partner with HR and business leaders \- at companies like Bausch Health, Yahoo, Sony and United Bank.
 




  





**THE ROLE \- OWN KEY ACCOUNTS** 





 Our Customer Success team in Chennai supports customers superbly, day in and day out. What we're building on top of that is the relationship layer: staying ahead of account health, building genuine rapport with the people who matter.
 





 You will own that for our most important accounts. You are their relationship and commercial owner, accountable for their satisfaction, their renewals and the expansion that follows when customers genuinely succeed. CS and product own onboarding, configuration, and day\-to\-day resolution.
 
**You own the relationship and the outcome. Think of yourself as the CEO of these top accounts.** 




  





**WHAT YOU'LL OWN** 



* **Own the relationship.** 

 Real rapport with champions, economic buyers, and executive sponsors across every top account \- the trusted first call, never just the ticket\-closer.
* **Stay ahead of account health.** 

 Keep a live health view on every account, and catch risk through usage, sentiment, and stakeholder signals long before it ever reaches a renewal.
* **Connect goals to value.** 

 Track what each customer set out to achieve, map it against what they've actually gotten, and lead the conversations that close the gap out loud.
* **Own renewals end to end.** 

 Run 90/60/30\-day cadences, keep an honest forecast, lead the commercial conversation and negotiation \- and make renewals feel like a formality, not a scramble.
* **Grow the account.** 

 Spot expansion rooted in real need \- new teams, use cases, modules / new features \- and carry those conversations from opening to close.
* **Make business reviews matter.** 

 Run monthly and quarterly reviews as strategic partnership conversations tied to outcomes, never status updates.
* **Own every escalation.** 

 When something breaks, own the customer's experience of the fix end to end \- pulling in CS, product, and engineering while the relationship stays steady.



  





**WHAT WINNING LOOKS LIKE** 



* **First 30 days \-** 

 Know top accounts inside out. Build account plans, relationship maps, health views, customer goals, and renewal calendars. Start having meaningful customer conversations.
* **3 months \-** 

 Strong relationships across the portfolio. Risks are identified early. Customer goals are actively tracked. Business reviews are strategic, not status updates. Renewals feel predictable.
* **6 months \-** 

 Our top customers are genuinely happy, referenceable, and seeing measurable value. Renewals are healthy, expansion comes from real customer needs.



  





**HOW TO MEASURE** 



* **Customer happiness \-** 

 CSAT / NPS, qualitative sentiment, advocacy, referenceability.
* **Relationship health \-** 

 Multi\-threaded relationships, executive engagement, stakeholder coverage.
* **Customer outcomes \-** 

 Goals achieved, adoption, value realisation, business reviews.
* **Commercial outcomes \-** 

 GRR/NRR, renewal predictability, expansion, accurate account forecasting.



  





**AI\-FIRST, BY DEFAULT** 





 AI should be part of your everyday workflow. Use it for account research, stakeholder mapping, call preparation, meeting summaries, follow\-ups, account plans, risk identification, customer insight synthesis, and finding leverage across your book of business. The more AI is second nature to you, the bigger your edge in this role.
 




  





**YOU'LL THRIVE HERE IF…** 



* You genuinely enjoy talking to customers and building relationships, not just managing workflows.
* You remember what matters to people and follow through without being asked.
* You are commercially aware without becoming transactional.
* You can have uncomfortable conversations early and respectfully.
* You are naturally curious about the customer's business and can connect product usage to business outcomes.
* You take ownership when something is broken, even when another team technically owns the task.



  





**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR** 



* **6–10 years** 

 in Account Management, Customer Success, or Enterprise Sales at a B2B company \- carrying commercial ownership, not just support.
* A track record you can name: renewals you protected and expansions you personally closed.
* You've carried satisfaction as a number \- retention, NRR, CSAT, or NPS on your scorecard.
* The presence to talk value, ROI, pricing, and contract structure with senior and C\-suite stakeholders.
* An AI\-first mindset, and comfort with US/EMEA\-hours overlap and travel to key accounts when it counts.



  





**HOW TO APPLY: 1\-MINUTE VIDEO REQUIRED** 





 Along with your application, send us a one\-minute video of yourself.
 
**No video \- auto\-reject.** 




  






 Tell us who you are and why you'd be a great fit at CultureMonkey. It doesn't need to be polished \- raw, unscripted, and just you is exactly what we want. We care about the person, not the production. That's the fastest way to stand out with us.
 



* Record a 1\-minute video \- keep it to 60–75 seconds maximum.
* Attach it to your application email. If it's too large, upload to Google Drive or WeTransfer and share the link, set to
 
*“anyone with the link can view.”*
* **Subject line:** 

 Enterprise Account Manager Application – \[Your Name]
* **Send to:** 
**interviews@culturemonkey.io**



  





***If you want to be the reason our biggest customers stay, grow, and rave about us \- we want to talk to you.***

title: Manager IT Implementation
description:
**About Rippling** 




  





 Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.
 



  





 Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.
 



  





 Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.4B from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.
 



  





 We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.
 



  





**About the role** 




  





 Rippling’s Product Specialist team ensures customers see incredible business transformation through Rippling's most complex products.
 



  





 Our engagements are consultative. Our specialists deeply understand the customers’ unique pain points, offer creative solutions, and build/set up their Rippling environment to address their needs. Hence, our specialists serve as a bridge between the customer and product teams. They are instrumental in driving adoption.
 



  





 As a Manager, IT Implementation, you will lead a team of \~7/8 specialists to drive the exponential impact of adoption and customer lifetime value (LTV) across Rippling’s IT product offerings (Identity and Access Management, Device Management, Inventory Management, and Third\-Party IdP).
 



  





 The ideal candidate has a proven track record of leading client\-facing implementation, professional services, or technical client support teams in a fast\-paced B2B SaaS environment, combined with the technical ability needed to guide specialists through complex customer environments.
 



  





**What you will do** 




  




* Direct a global team of IT Product Specialists, fostering accountability, continuous professional development, and execution excellence.
* Lead the front\-line execution of IT implementations from client kickoff through go\-live, ensuring your team hits key milestones and maximizes product adoption.
* Identify and mitigate risks associated with implementation projects, act as an escalation point for complex client implementations and technical issues
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with Rippling Sales, Technical Account Management, and Support teams to create a seamless customer journey
* Collaborate with Product \& Engineering to continuously improve product functionality based on customer feedback in Implementation
* Monitor key performance metrics and continuous improvement on KPIs while helping to optimize playbooks and frameworks for increased simplicity and efficiency



  





**What you will need** 




  




* 2\+ years of professional experience directly managing teams within a customer\-facing organization, such as Professional Services, Customer Implementation and Technical Client Support.
* Strong foundational knowledge of corporate IT landscapes. You must be comfortable coaching a team that works daily with MDM, identity provisioning (SSO, SAML/OIDC), Zero Touch deployment, and Endpoint Lifecycle Management (e.g., Google Workspace, Azure AD, Okta).
* 5\+ years of overall experience in customer onboarding or software implementation, with a clear understanding of managing external customer relationships and project timelines.
* A track record of developing, tracking, and optimizing operational metrics, team capacity, and project timelines.
* Self\-starter with a bias towards action, energized by ambiguity and a fast\-paced environment, with a strong desire to build.



  





**Note** 



* **This is a hybrid role and will require you to work out of our Bangalore office three days a week.**
* **This job requires you a to work in the EST/PST shift.**



  





**Additional Information** 




  





 Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accomodations@rippling.com
 



 Rippling highly values having employees working in\-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office\-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

title: Customer Experience Manager
description:
Fresh Platter is looking for a Customer Experience Manager to own the day\-to\-day experience of working with us.
 **Our goal is simple: customers should find Fresh Platter exceptionally easy, responsive and dependable to do business with \- even when the answer is not what they want to hear.** 




  





**Fresh produce is fast\-moving and perishable. Quantities change, prices move, quality issues can arise, vehicles get delayed, POs may be pending, and customer indents can be higher or lower than expected. These realities will not disappear. This role exists to make sure they are managed calmly, proactively and methodically, so the customer always knows what is happening and never has to repeatedly chase Fresh Platter for an answer.** 




  





**This is not a traditional sales\-acquisition role, an accounts role or an operations role.** 
 It is the customer\-facing coordination layer across all of them. You will be the dependable day\-to\-day point of contact for customers while working closely with Sales, Procurement, Operations, Dispatch and Accounts to close every loop from start to finish.
 



  





  





**What you will own**




 ·       
 **Customer communication:** 
 Be the single dependable day\-to\-day point of contact for customer indents, forecasts, rates, availability, POs, dispatches, delivery updates, quality issues, claims and routine commercial matters.
 



 ·       
 **Indents and order flow:** 
 Collect indents on time, clarify changes, follow up for missing information, communicate confirmed quantities internally and ensure the customer receives timely confirmation.
 



 ·       
 **Rates and commercial communication:** 
 Communicate and negotiate rates within approved commercial boundaries, handle difficult rate conversations calmly, obtain customer confirmation and ensure agreed rates are properly recorded.
 



 ·       
 **Availability management:** 
 Communicate shortages, excess availability, substitutions or changes early. Work with the customer and internal teams to find the best practical outcome instead of allowing surprises at the last minute.
 



 ·       
 **Exception handling:** 
 Manage quality complaints, rejections, short supply, oversupply, packing delays, vehicle delays, missed timelines and other issues without panic. Keep the customer informed, coordinate the internal response, propose the next action and drive the matter to closure.
 



 ·       
 **Proactive follow\-through:** 
 Customers should not have to keep calling Fresh Platter for updates. Track every commitment, follow up before deadlines and close open items completely.
 



 ·       
 **Cross\-functional coordination:** 
 Obtain information from Sales, Procurement, Operations, Dispatch and Accounts and communicate one clear, consistent response to the customer. Bring customer requirements back into the company in the same disciplined manner.
 



 ·       
 **Commercial closures:** 
 Coordinate customer\-facing follow\-up on debit notes, credit notes, rate confirmations, claims and other commercial documentation, while Accounts continues to own accounting and financial records.
 



 ·       
 **Customer compliance and administration:** 
 Handle customer\-facing documentation and portal requirements, including sharing updated FSSAI, GST and other relevant company documents, ensuring customer records are updated, completing customer/vendor portals and tracking any compliance\-related requests to closure.
 



 ·       
 **MIS and records:** 
 Maintain accurate customer\-wise MIS covering indents, rates, supply commitments, open issues, claims, documentation, follow\-ups and closures.
 



 ·       
 **Systems and standardization:** 
 Work through defined systems, templates and workflows rather than ad\-hoc messages or information stored in personal memory. Enter the relevant facts, use standardized communication wherever possible, and maintain a complete record of what was communicated, promised and closed.
 



 ·       
 **Process improvement:** 
 Build and continuously improve repeatable processes for recurring situations \- shortages, quality complaints, delayed dispatches, pending POs, rate discussions, excess availability and other customer scenarios \- so the company becomes less dependent on individual firefighting.
 



  





**What we are looking for**




 ·       5\+ years of relevant experience in fresh produce, perishables, food distribution, grocery, modern trade, quick commerce, FMCG supply chains or a closely related environment.
 



 ·       Hands\-on exposure to the realities of a perishable supply chain. You should already understand concepts such as shrinkage, quality rejection, variable availability, short/excess supply, time\-sensitive dispatches and customer service failures \- we are not looking to teach these basics from scratch.
 



 ·       Strong customer\-facing experience. You should be able to walk into the role, understand the problem quickly and say, "I will handle it," rather than becoming uncomfortable when conversations get difficult.
 



 ·       Excellent spoken and written English is mandatory. Emails, WhatsApp messages and formal communication must be clear, polished, professional and unambiguous.
 



 ·       Fluent spoken Kannada is mandatory. You should be completely comfortable and natural engaging Kannada\-speaking customers in Kannada. Additional knowledge of Telugu, Tamil or Hindi is an advantage.
 



 ·       Calm, emotionally steady and thick\-skinned. You should be able to handle disagreement, pressure, complaints and uncomfortable conversations without becoming defensive, flustered or abrasive.
 



 ·       Street\-smart and commercially sensible. You should know when to persuade, when to hold your ground, when to offer an alternative and when to escalate.
 



 ·       Methodical and disciplined. If an item needs to be recorded, followed up, reported or closed, you do it every time \- not only when someone reminds you.
 



 ·       Agile and comfortable multitasking. Several customer issues may move simultaneously and priorities can change quickly.
 



 ·       Comfortable using software, structured workflows, customer portals, MIS tools and standardized communication systems. Process discipline is non\-negotiable.
 



 ·       Flexible with working hours. Fresh produce does not always operate on a strict 9\-to\-6 rhythm, and important customer matters occasionally require attention earlier in the morning or later in the evening.
 



  





**What success looks like**




 ·       Customers experience Fresh Platter as responsive, reliable, and extremely easy to work with.
 



 ·       Customers should never chase us for routine information or updates.
 



 ·       Indents, rates, availability, POs, dispatch information and open issues are tracked clearly and closed on time.
 



 ·       Problems are communicated early and managed professionally before they become escalations.
 



 ·       Internal teams receive clear customer information, and customers receive one consistent version from Fresh Platter.
 



 ·       As Fresh Platter expands into more fruits, vegetables, customers and cities, the customer experience function scales through systems and processes rather than becoming person\-dependent.
 



  





**About Fresh Platter**



* Fresh Platter is a Bengaluru\-based, tech and data\-driven fresh produce company building a better farm\-to\-retail supply chain. Bananas are our current flagship category, and we are expanding across fresh produce. We work in a demanding operating environment where quality, timing, availability and commercial discipline matter every day \- and we want the experience of working with Fresh Platter to be as strong as the supply chain we are building.

title: Senior Account Manager

 **Senior Account Manager**

* Build and execute account expansion strategies aligned to customer business goals
* Own renewals, retention, and churn risk mitigation
* Develop strong relationships with key stakeholders and decision\-makers
* Conduct Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to showcase ROI and uncover growth opportunities

**Requirements**

* Proven track record of upselling, cross\-selling, and driving account growth (Must Have)

title: Telecom Roaming Expert & Interconnect Partnerships
description:
**The world still has coverage blind spots. You could help eliminate them at Skylo.**
 Skylo has pioneered a standards\-based approach to satellite connectivity. We connect smartphones and IoT devices directly to satellites. No special hardware, no entirely new networks. Just billions of existing devices, suddenly reachable anywhere on Earth. We're not building toward this future. We're already in it.
   

  

 Our direct\-to\-device service is live on millions of activated devices across five continents, covering more than 72 million square kilometers, in partnership with leading satellite operators, mobile network operators, Tier\-1 chipset makers, and OEMs worldwide. And we're just getting started.
   

  

 At the heart of it all is Skylo's commercial NTN vRAN: a 3GPP standards\-based, cloud\-native platform that seamlessly bridges terrestrial and satellite networks. It's the infrastructure that makes true anywhere, anytime connectivity possible.
   

  

 When you join Skylo, you'll work at the intersection of three markets reshaping how the world stays connected: mass\-market consumer devices, automotive, and industrial IoT. Enabling people outdoors and critical workflows in the world's most remote places.
   

  

**This is a rare chance to work on technology that matters, at a company that's already proving it works**
*This role is located in Bangalore, India where we are onsite 3 days a week in office.*
**About The Role**
 We are seeking a senior commercial\-technical leader to own Skylo’s IPX, hubbing, and clearing\-partner ecosystem. You will be accountable for the contracts, operating cadence, service performance, escalation paths, and redundancy strategy that determine how quickly new roaming partners reach production.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Partner \& Vendor Management**
* Lifecycle Ownership: Manage and develop relationships with international roaming partner operators, owning the full lifecycle of the agreements.
* Connectivity Providers: Manage the relationship with international connectivity and signalling providers (IPX/GRX carriers, roaming hubs, SS7/Diameter signalling providers), including selection, contracting, and SLA monitoring.
* Clearing Houses: Manage the relationship with data and financial clearing houses and hub providers, monitoring billing, disputes, and reconciliations.


**Technical Coordination \& Operations**
* Testing \& Implementation: Coordinate the opening of new roaming relationships and testing.
* Data Exchange: Oversee the exchange of files and documentation between operators: TAP/RAP (Transferred/Returned Account Procedure), NRTRDE (Near Real Time Roaming Data Exchange), RAEX (IR.21, IR.85, IOT), and the related clearing and reconciliation processes.


**Strategy, Commercials \& Compliance**
* Contract Negotiation: Negotiate, draft, and maintain agreements, and manage the related signing and update process.
* Business Analytics: Analyse roaming performance (traffic, quality, revenue, cost, margin) and define optimisation strategies for tariffs, steering of roaming, and fraud management.
* Regulatory Compliance: Ensure compliance with applicable regulations and standards (e.g., GSMA, EU roaming regulation "Roam Like At Home”, and any local regulation), overseeing regulatory impacts on the business.
* Cross\-Functional Leadership: Interface with internal functions (Network, IT/BSS, Finance, Legal, Wholesale, Marketing) to ensure delivery and evolution of the service.


**Professional Experience**
**REQUIRED SKILLS \& QUALIFICATIONS**
* Industry Tenure: 10\+ years of experience in a roaming / wholesale roaming role within a mobile operator (or at a hub/IPX provider), with proven direct management of relationships with international operators and carriers.
* Interconnect Expertise: 10\+ years of experience in carrier interconnect, wholesale roaming, IPX/GRX, telecom vendor management, or a closely related field.
* Leadership Depth: Senior\-level ownership of strategic suppliers and complex partner relationships.


**Telecom \& Standards Knowledge**
* Roaming Business: In\-depth knowledge of the international roaming business: commercial models, value chain, tariff mechanisms (IOT, wholesale), steering, settlement, and clearing.
* GSMA Standards: Thorough knowledge of GSMA standards and procedures: RAEX/IR.21, AA.12, TAP/RAP, NRTRDE, BCE, IREG, and TADIG processes and workflows.


**Technical \& Systems Depth**
* Network Architecture: Solid understanding of the Network and IT aspects supporting roaming: 2G/3G/4G/5G architectures and network elements involved (HLR/HSS, UDM, MSC, SGSN/GGSN, MME, S/PGW, UPF, SMF, DRA, STP).
* Signaling \& Routing: Working depth in SS7/MAP and Diameter signalling, GT/point\-code and realm routing, DEA/STP, DNS, and IPX interconnect operations.
* Advanced Roaming: Strong knowledge of SMS interworking, VoLTE roaming (S8HR/LBO), and 5G roaming (SEPP).
* BSS/OSS Infrastructure: Knowledge of the supporting BSS/OSS systems (mediation, rating/charging, wholesale billing, clearing systems, TAP processing, fraud management, steering systems).


**Core Competencies \& Logistics**
* Business Acumen: Demonstrated success negotiating complex telecom agreements, pricing models, service levels, credits, and executive escalations.
* Problem Solving: Ability to turn ambiguous cross\-functional issues into structured governance and measurable outcomes, with strong analytical and coordination skills.
* Communication: Fluent English (written and spoken) is mandatory.
* Travel: Availability for international travel and participation in industry events/working groups (e.g., GSMA, bilateral partner meetings).


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Advanced Networking: Experience with NTN (Non\-Terrestrial Networks), NB\-IoT, IoT roaming, or rapidly scaling multi\-MNO networks.
* Visibility Tools: Familiarity with GSMA processes and signaling or network\-visibility platforms.
* Tooling: Experience with Jira, Confluence, Slack, partner portals, and operational scorecards.


**What We Offer**
 With employees working across three continents, Skylo is proud to be an equal opportunity employer dedicated to building an inclusive and diverse workforce. Our worldwide and inclusive culture encourages a flexible approach to work, and we also offer an attractive range benefits such as:
   

  

* Competitive compensation packages including a stock option based equity program
* Comprehensive benefits plan
* Monthly allowances for wellness and education reimbursement
* A generous time off policy, holidays, and the opportunity to temporarily work abroad
* Once in a lifetime opportunity to be a part of developing and running world’s first commercial, live direct\-to\-device satellite network and service
* Access to world\-class team and talent across tech domains: software, hardware, chipsets, telecom, satellite and network virtualization
* Open, transparent, inclusive culture that blends the Silicon Valley, Nordic and South Asia characteristics


**EEO STATEMENT**
 Skylo is an equal\-opportunity employer and we celebrate diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, ancestry, national origin, caste, sex, sexual orientation, parent or caregiver status, political affiliation, gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic makeup, marital status, or military service consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws.
   

  

 We are also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. Please let us know if you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability.

description:

 The Kantata Cloud for Professional Services™ gives businesses the clarity, control, and confidence they need to optimize resource planning and elevate operational performance. Our purpose\-built software is helping over 2,500 professional services organizations in more than 100 countries focus on and optimize their most important asset: their people. By leveraging Kantata, professionals gain access to the information and tools they need to win more business, ensure the right people are always available at the right time, and delight clients with exceptional project delivery and outcomes.
   

  

 Kantata is well\-capitalized, hiring, and growing our loyal and diversified customer base faster than we ever have. Most importantly, we have a clear vision of where we’re going and how to get there. (Hint: It involves you.) Did we mention that Kantata is also an awesome place to work? You’ll have the opportunity to work in a dynamic environment with a team that loves what they do. A talented team, great perks, and an amazing culture \= an employee\-rated Best Place to Work!
   

  

 Did we mention that Kantata is an awesome place to work? You’ll have the opportunity to work in an energetic environment with a smart team that loves what they do.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Kantata is building a connected customer journey spanning implementation, adoption, optimization, renewal, and expansion. We’re seeking an AI Transformation Manager to lead the application of AI, automation, and workflow redesign across our post\-sales organization.
   

  

 You will own a portfolio of AI transformation initiatives from opportunity discovery through adoption and measurable business impact. Working across Professional Services, Customer Success, CX Operations, Digital Engagement, Education Services, and Renewals, you will redesign workflows, build and test solutions, lead pilots, and scale what works.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on transformation role—not a research or traditional project\-management position. You’ll be expected to turn business problems into solutions that teams trust and use.
   

  

 What You’ll Do
   

  

* Develop and manage the internal post\-sales AI transformation roadmap.
* Identify and prioritize opportunities based on customer impact, business value, feasibility, risk, and time to value.
* Map and redesign workflows to reduce manual work, improve handoffs, accelerate cycle times, and strengthen customer continuity.
* Build prototypes and lightweight solutions using approved AI, agent\-building, and no\-code or low\-code tools.
* Lead initiatives from discovery and requirements through testing, launch, adoption, and optimization.
* Partner with IT, Engineering, Data, Security, and governance teams to transition successful prototypes into secure, scalable solutions.
* Create reusable AI plays, prompts, agents, and digital experiences that extend team capacity.
* Lead training, communications, documentation, and champion programs that drive sustained adoption.
* Establish appropriate human oversight, quality standards, monitoring, and exception processes.
* Measure adoption and business impact, including capacity released, cycle\-time improvements, customer outcomes, cost to serve, and renewal readiness.
* Communicate portfolio priorities, progress, risks, and results to executive leadership.


 Initial opportunities may include implementation automation, customer\-health insights, next\-best\-action recommendations, AI\-generated customer review preparation, renewal\-risk detection, and role\-based copilots.
   

  

 What You Bring
   

  

* 7\+ years of experience in business transformation, product or program management, operations, professional services, customer success, revenue operations, or a related field; B2B SaaS experience is strongly preferred.
* A track record of redesigning and scaling cross\-functional processes with measurable business results.
* Strong knowledge of the post\-sales customer lifecycle, including implementation, adoption, value realization, renewal, and expansion.
* Practical experience applying generative AI, workflow automation, copilots, agentic workflows, or no\-code and low\-code tools to real business processes.
* A product mindset with strengths in problem framing, user discovery, prioritization, experimentation, adoption, and outcome measurement.
* Familiarity with enterprise platforms such as Salesforce, Gainsight, PSA systems, support tools, product analytics, learning platforms, or knowledge systems.
* Strong analytical judgment and the ability to build business cases, establish baselines, and quantify value.
* Experience leading organizational change and influencing teams without direct authority.
* Sound judgment regarding data quality, privacy, security, responsible AI, and human oversight.
* Excellent written, verbal, facilitation, and executive communication skills.


**Preferred Experience**
* Leading an AI, automation, transformation, or center\-of\-excellence portfolio.
* Working with PSA platforms or services\-oriented SaaS businesses.
* Building workflows with tools such as Workato, Zapier, Make, n8n, Power Automate, Retool, Glean, or comparable platforms.
* Moving prototypes into secure, monitored production environments with Engineering or IT.
* Applying Lean, service design, process mining, change management, or value\-stream mapping.
* Understanding services P\&L, utilization, and delivery\-efficiency metrics.


 How You’ll Work
   

  

 You are a customer\-focused systems thinker and hands\-on builder. You can move from an executive roadmap discussion to a frontline workflow session, create a practical first version, test it with users, and apply the rigor required to scale it responsibly.
   

  

 Why This Role Matters
   

  

 AI is central to Kantata’s vision for delivering exceptional customer outcomes without linear headcount growth. This role offers the opportunity to shape how AI transforms post\-sales operations, with executive sponsorship and broad cross\-functional partnership.
   

  

 Kantata offers competitive compensation and benefits, flexible time off, a remote\-first environment, and professional\-development support. Benefits are based on location and applicable local programs.
   

  

 Kantata is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Performance Manager
description:
The Performance Manager is responsible for driving operational performance, reporting excellence and administrative compliance across client account. This role ensures that facilities management and workplace services are delivered in line with contractual obligations, client expectations and JLL quality standards.
   

  

 Working closely with the Account Director, on\-account functional leads and key client stakeholders, this role serves as the central point of accountability for performance reporting, contract governance, quality assurance and team administration. The right individual will be comfortable in a fast\-paced environment and at ease with challenging the status quo in pursuit of higher standards.
   

  

**Major Responsibilities**
**Performance Reporting \& Contract Management**
* Develop and deliver key contractual reports including Monthly Management Reports, Quarterly Business Reviews and annual performance summaries in line with the agreed governance framework.
* Ensure the contract is translated into meaningful performance matrices including CPIs, KPIs and SLAs for ongoing measurement and tracking.
* Review monthly and quarterly business performance data for accuracy, completeness and alignment with Master Service Agreement (MSA) obligations.
* Track and update action plans to address performance gaps and ensure adherence to contractual obligations.
* Act as point of contact for MSA\-related enquiries from client, country and regional teams to minimise risk and ensure consistent understanding.
* Deliver ad\-hoc reports as required by the Account Director and senior leadership.


**Quality Assurance \& Data Governance**
* Develop and implement procedures and performance measures to ensure simplification, accuracy and reliability of work methods.
* Maintain governance of SharePoint trackers and document repositories to ensure data integrity and relevancy.
* Ensure all non\-compliances are recorded, reported and actioned in a timely manner.
* Perform data integrity gap analyses and ensure controls are in place across key operational applications.
* Oversee QMS documentation including Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and other procedural documents.


**Administration \& Office Management**
* Oversee day\-to\-day administrative operations for the client account, ensuring efficient and consistent support to the account team.
* Manage onboarding and offboarding processes for account personnel and contingent workers, ensuring full compliance with JLL and client requirements.
* Maintain accurate records, filing systems and document control processes in line with JLL and client data governance standards.
* Coordinate procurement of office supplies, services and facilities as required, ensuring value for money and compliance with procurement policy.
* Manage meeting schedules, logistics and coordination for key governance forums including client meetings, QBRs and internal reviews.


**Stakeholder \& Client Relationship Management**
* Proactively develop and manage relationships with client stakeholders, ensuring expected service levels are consistently achieved.
* Serve as a key point of contact for performance, reporting and administrative matters on the account.
* Liaise with on\-account teams, central JLL functions and client representatives to gather data requirements and resolve issues promptly.
* Keep account leadership appraised of performance trends, compliance matters and operational updates.


**Risk \& Compliance**
* Develop and maintain a risk reporting framework in line with client and ISO standards.
* Monitor and report any financial or non\-financial control breaches, including cyber and data policy obligations.
* Ensure all existing and proposed technology solutions and operational practices comply with client information security requirements.


**People \& Team Leadership**
* Actively encourage an environment that supports teamwork, collaboration and performance excellence.
* Support the Account Director in executing agreed goals for team and business growth.


**KEY RESULT AREAS**
* Contractual reporting deliverables completed accurately and on time.
* KPI, CPI and SLA performance targets met or exceeded in line with MSA obligations.
* Quality assurance and compliance frameworks maintained with zero unresolved critical non\-compliances.
* Smooth and compliant administration of account onboarding, offboarding and vendor management processes.
* Positive client satisfaction outcomes as reflected by feedback and survey results.
* Team development plans in place and succession pathways identified for key roles.
* Continuous improvement initiatives identified and implemented across account operations.


**CANDIDATE SPECIFICATION: KEY SELECTION CRITERIA**
**Essential Experience And Skills**
* Minimum 5 years’ experience in operations, performance management, administration or a related field within a corporate or facilities management environment.
* Demonstrated experience in performance reporting, contract governance or quality assurance.
* Strong organisational skills and meticulous attention to detail.
* Proven ability to develop and manage KPIs, CPIs and SLAs within a managed services or outsourcing environment.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite including advanced Excel, Word, PowerPoint and SharePoint.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Ability to manage multiple complex workstreams simultaneously and meet tight deadlines.
* Experience working in a client\-facing environment with complex stakeholder structures.
* Strong understanding of Lean, Six Sigma or Agile methodologies highly desirable.
* Prior experience in Integrated Facilities Management or Corporate Real Estate is highly advantageous.


**CRITICAL COMPETENCIES FOR SUCCESS**
**Client Focus \& Relationship Management – ‘I Value my Customers’**
* Demonstrates a proactive and professional approach to customer service and stakeholder engagement.
* Ability to interact with a wide range of client staff, including senior levels.
* Ability to manage conflict and balance between client and firm requirements.
* Has a customer service\-oriented attitude and natural communication acumen.


**People Management and Team Leadership – ‘I am a Team Player’**
* Ability to lead a team effectively, coach and develop team members and promote open, constructive and collaborative relationships at all levels.
* Demonstrates honesty, trustworthiness and high ethical standards.
* Works effectively with diverse teams across different functions and cultures.


**Program Management \& Organisational Skills – ‘I Am Proactive’**
* Excellent planning and organisational skills to prioritise work and meet tight deadlines.
* Proven ability to manage multiple and complex operational matters simultaneously.
* Able to own, drive and deliver results with a structured approach to managing a complex workload.


**Problem Solving \& Strategic Thinking – ‘I am Innovative’**
* Capacity to deal with ambiguity and resolve complex problems effectively using root\-cause analysis.
* Proven analytical ability to solve problems using a quantitative approach.
* Employs holistic approaches and looks for long\-term, sustainable solutions.
* Open to new ideas and willing to challenge the status quo to drive improvement.
* Hands\-on, pragmatic approach to identifying and establishing improvements to standards and operations.


**Other Personal Characteristics**
* Natural communicator who enjoys engaging at all levels of the organisation.
* Self\-motivated, confident and resilient in a dynamic and fast\-paced environment.
* Flexible and comfortable working with ambiguity and change.
* Organised with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
* Demonstrates cultural sensitivity and ability to work effectively across diverse teams.

title: Financial Consulting Manager - Finance as a Service
description:
We are the leading provider of professional services to the middle market globally, our purpose is to instill confidence in a world of change, empowering our clients and people to realize their full potential. Our exceptional people are the key to our unrivaled, inclusive culture and talent experience and our ability to be compelling to our clients. You’ll find an environment that inspires and empowers you to thrive both personally and professionally. There’s no one like you and that’s why there’s nowhere like RSM.
   

  

**Transition Manager** 
**– Finance as a Service (FaaS)**
**About RSM USI**
 RSM US Integrated Services India Private Limited is looking for a Transition Manager to join our Finance as a Service (FaaS) practice. Changing economies, evolving accounting standards, and complex client landscapes require structured, low\-risk, and well\-governed transitions. With more than 90 years of industry expertise, RSM helps clients confidently transform and scale their finance operations. Our FaaS team supports clients across industries including Financial Services, Technology, Not\-for\-Profit, Family office channel, Manufacturing, and Commercial sectors, delivering end\-to\-end finance operations through global delivery models.
   

  

**Role Summary**
 The FaaS Transition Manager is responsible for leading end\-to\-end transition of finance processes from clients or incumbent vendors into RSM’s India FaaS delivery model. This role focuses on knowledge transfer, process stabilization, risk management, stakeholder communication, and readiness for steady\-state delivery.
   

  

**Qualification And Minimum Entry Requirements**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Commerce, or related discipline
* 8–12 years of experience in Finance \& Accounting operations
* 4–6 years of transition / migration experience (FAO / FaaS / BPO)
* Strong understanding of R2R, P2P, O2C
* US GAAP exposure preferred
* Offshore delivery experience
* Willingness to work US hours


**Position Responsibilities**
 Transition \& Onboarding Management
   

  

* Lead end\-to\-end transitions of finance processes (R2R, P2P, O2C) from client teams and/or incumbent vendors to RSM’s India delivery model, ensuring minimal disruption to business\-as\-usual operations.
* Develop and manage detailed transition plans including scope, timelines, resourcing, dependencies, milestones, and cutover approach; maintain RAID logs and drive closure of actions, risks, and issues.
* Plan and execute Knowledge Transfer (KT) through a structured shadow–perform–review model; validate process understanding, address gaps, and confirm readiness through sign\-offs and competency assessments.
* Create/refresh transition documentation including SOPs, process maps, SLAs/KPIs, RACI matrices, and operating calendars; ensure document control, versioning, and alignment to client expectations.
* Proactively identify transition risks (people/process/technology/data/compliance), define mitigation and contingency plans, and monitor early warning indicators during stabilization.


**Client \& Stakeholder Management**
* Serve as the primary client point of contact during transition, managing expectations, clarifying requirements, and ensuring timely decision\-making on scope, controls, service levels, and cutover.
* Establish and run transition governance cadence (daily/weekly status, risk reviews, steering committee updates), ensuring clear minutes, action tracking, and escalation paths.
* Coordinate across internal stakeholders (FaaS operations, controls, IT, HR, training, quality) and external stakeholders (client SMEs, auditors, third parties) to align deliverables and timelines.
* Provide concise executive reporting on progress, key decisions, risks/issues, and financial/operational impact; highlight trade\-offs and recommend actions to keep transition on track.


 Process, Controls \& Compliance
   

  

* Assess current\-state processes and controls to identify gaps, inefficiencies, and compliance risks; document findings and agree remediation actions with client and internal leadership.
* Align transitioned processes to RSM delivery standards, including standard workpapers, review checklists, segregation of duties, approval matrices, and quality expectations.
* Validate control design and operating effectiveness during parallel runs and early production; partner with internal risk/compliance teams to ensure controls are sustainable in BAU.
* Maintain audit\-ready documentation (process narratives, control matrices, evidence repositories) and support internal/external audit requests related to transitioned processes.


**Team Leadership**
* Build, onboard, and train transition and delivery teams; define role expectations, learning plans, and domain/ERP enablement to meet service commitments.
* Allocate work across team members based on complexity and skills; set daily priorities, monitor capacity, and remove blockers to ensure milestone adherence.
* Review key deliverables for accuracy and completeness (SOPs, reconciliations, month\-end files, reporting packs) and embed a continuous improvement mindset across the team.


**Systems \& Data Transition**
* Coordinate finance system/ERP transitions and integrations (e.g., NetSuite, SAP, Oracle) in partnership with client IT and RSM technology teams; define access, roles, workflows, and reporting requirements.
* Oversee data migration/validation activities, including master data checks, opening balances, historical transaction sampling, and reconciliation of key reports to ensure data integrity.
* Confirm end\-to\-end system readiness (UAT support, connectivity, report outputs, security/access, ticketing process) and ensure users are trained prior to go\-live.


**Stabilization \& Handover**
* Manage parallel runs and hypercare, closely monitoring accuracy, cycle times, backlog, and exception trends; drive rapid issue resolution with clear ownership.
* Define and obtain sign\-off for entry/exit criteria for each transition phase (KT completion, pilot success, parallel run stability, BAU acceptance) to ensure controlled go\-live.
* Conduct post\-transition reviews and capture lessons learned; update playbooks, templates, and standard methodologies to improve future transitions.
* Execute formal handover to BAU teams with complete documentation, metric baselines, open item logs, and governance routines; ensure sustained performance against agreed SLAs.


 At RSM, we offer a competitive benefits and compensation package for all our people. We offer flexibility in your schedule, empowering you to balance life’s demands, while also maintaining your ability to serve clients. Learn more about our total rewards at https://rsmus.com/careers/india.html.
   

  

 RSM does not tolerate discrimination and/or harassment based on race; colour; creed; sincerely held religious beliefs, practices or observances; sex (including pregnancy or disabilities related to nursing); gender (including gender identity and/or gender expression); sexual orientation; HIV Status; national origin; ancestry; familial or marital status; age; physical or mental disability; citizenship; political affiliation; medical condition (including family and medical leave); domestic violence victim status; past, current or prospective service in the Indian Armed Forces; Indian Armed Forces Veterans, and Indian Armed Forces Personnel status; pre\-disposing genetic characteristics or any other characteristic protected under applicable provincial employment legislation.
   

  

 Accommodation for applicants with disabilities is available upon request in connection with the recruitment process and/or employment/partnership. RSM is committed to providing equal opportunity and reasonable accommodation for people with disabilities. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete an application, interview, or otherwise participate in the recruiting process, please send us an email at careers@rsmus.com.

FABDIZ and FABCURO are growing premium brands in the interiors, architecture, luxury wall décor, and artefacts space. We are looking for an experienced **Head of IT \& Software Development** to lead our technology and software development function.

This role is ideal for a **Software Development / Engineering leader** who has progressed into a technology leadership position and understands how to build, manage, improve, and scale business\-critical software systems.

You will be responsible for leading the development team, managing our existing technology infrastructure and applications, developing new software solutions, integrating business systems, and ensuring that technology supports the company's growth.

We are looking for someone who can **understand business requirements, guide technical teams, make practical technology decisions, and personally contribute to solving complex software and IT problems when required.**

Your Key Responsibilities1\. Software Development \& Technology

* Lead the overall software development and IT function.
* Manage the development, maintenance, and improvement of business applications.
* Plan and execute the company's technology roadmap.
* Ensure software applications are reliable, secure, scalable, and easy to maintain.
* Review existing systems and identify areas for improvement.
* Guide the team on architecture, coding standards, development practices, and technology choices.
* Oversee development of websites, internal applications, portals, CRM systems, ERP integrations, and other business software.
* Manage third\-party software, APIs, integrations, and technology vendors.
* Ensure proper documentation, version control, testing, deployment, and backup processes.

2\. Team Leadership

* Lead, mentor, and manage the software development / IT team.
* Allocate projects and responsibilities based on team capabilities.
* Set development standards and timelines.
* Review team performance and provide technical and managerial guidance.
* Build a strong culture of ownership, accountability, quality, and continuous learning.
* Work closely with senior management to communicate project progress, challenges, and technology requirements.

3\. Business Applications

You will oversee technology solutions supporting areas such as:

* CRM and lead management
* Sales and quotation systems
* Project management
* Customer and vendor portals
* Internal business applications
* ERP and accounting integrations
* Marketing and sales systems
* Inventory / operations systems
* Reporting and management dashboards
* Website and e\-commerce platforms
* API and third\-party integrations

4\. IT Infrastructure \& Security

* Oversee cloud infrastructure and hosting.
* Ensure website and application security.
* Manage access controls, backups, monitoring, and disaster recovery.
* Coordinate with external IT / infrastructure vendors where required.
* Ensure systems remain stable, secure, and available for business operations.
* Establish appropriate IT policies, processes, and technology standards.

5\. Automation \& AI

* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive business processes.
* Evaluate and implement practical AI tools where they provide genuine business value.
* Support integration of AI into sales, marketing, customer service, reporting, and internal workflows.
* Work with the development team to integrate APIs and automation platforms.

**The role does not require you to be an AI specialist. Strong software development and technology leadership experience is the primary requirement.**

What We're Looking ForExperience

* **8\+ years of experience in Software Development / IT / Engineering.**
* Proven experience in a **Software Development Manager, Engineering Manager, Head of IT, Head of Engineering, Technical Lead, or similar leadership role.**
* Strong experience managing software development teams.
* Experience building and managing business\-critical applications.
* Experience handling multiple software projects simultaneously.
* Strong understanding of software development life cycle (SDLC).
* Experience working directly with business stakeholders and senior management.
* Experience managing external technology vendors and development partners is an advantage.

Technical Background

Candidates should come from a **strong software development background** and have practical understanding of several of the following:

* React / Angular / Vue
* Node.js / Python / PHP / Laravel / Java / .NET
* REST APIs
* SQL / MySQL / PostgreSQL
* MongoDB or other NoSQL databases
* Cloud platforms – AWS / Azure / Google Cloud
* Git / GitHub
* CI/CD
* Docker
* Web application architecture
* API integrations
* CRM / ERP integrations
* Website development and management
* Application security
* Cloud infrastructure

**You do not need to be an expert in every technology listed above. We are primarily looking for strong software engineering fundamentals, leadership ability, and the capability to understand and manage modern technology systems.**

Leadership \& Business Skills

We are looking for someone who:

* Can lead and motivate a technical team.
* Takes complete ownership of technology projects.
* Can translate business requirements into practical technology solutions.
* Can communicate technical matters clearly to non\-technical stakeholders.
* Is comfortable working directly with senior management.
* Can prioritize projects based on business impact.
* Understands budgets, timelines, resources, and technology trade\-offs.
* Is hands\-on enough to understand technical challenges.
* Can build processes and discipline within a development team.
* Solves problems proactively rather than waiting for instructions.
* Is comfortable working in a fast\-growing and changing business environment.

What Success Looks Like

Within the first 6–12 months, you will be expected to:

* Establish strong processes for software development and IT management.
* Improve the stability and performance of existing applications.
* Build and strengthen the software development team.
* Deliver important business applications and integrations.
* Reduce dependency on manual processes through automation.
* Improve reporting and visibility for management.
* Strengthen application and IT security.
* Improve development quality, documentation, testing, and deployment processes.
* Create a practical technology roadmap aligned with business growth.
* Introduce AI and automation where it creates measurable business value.

Education

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field preferred.
* Relevant professional experience may be considered in place of formal qualifications.

Industry Experience

Experience in any of the following industries will be an advantage:

* Interior Design
* Architecture
* Furniture
* Luxury Retail
* Home Décor
* E\-commerce
* SaaS
* PropTech
* Retail
* Manufacturing
* Digital / Technology Services

**However, industry experience is not mandatory. Strong software development and leadership experience is more important.**

Why Join FABDIZ \& FABCURO?

* Lead the technology function of two growing premium brands.
* Work directly with the leadership team.

* Lead and grow a technology team.
* Have significant ownership and decision\-making responsibility.

title: End User Training Consultant
description:
**End User Training Consultant**
================================

**Blue Yonder Supply Chain Solutions**

**Position Overview**
---------------------


The **End User Training (EUT) Consultant** is a client\-facing learning and enablement professional who supports the design, development, and delivery of learning programs for Blue Yonder supply chain transformations. Working with Senior and Principal EUT Consultants, this role helps customers build the knowledge, skills, and confidence needed to successfully adopt new technologies, processes, and ways of working.


The EUT Consultant combines **instructional design, content development, facilitation, customer enablement, and consulting skills** to translate business processes, system functionality, roles, and organizational impacts into practical, role\-based learning experiences.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Support EUT activities and deliverables across enterprise supply chain transformation programs.
* Conduct and support **learning discovery, stakeholder interviews, learning needs assessments, and role\-based training analysis**.
* Partner with customer stakeholders to understand business objectives, operational processes, learner needs, and implementation requirements.
* Translate business processes, solution functionality, roles, and change impacts into **learning objectives and role\-based learning requirements**.
* Support development of **training plans, curricula, learning journeys, course outlines, content development plans, and training schedules**.
* Design and develop instructor\-led, virtual, blended, digital, and performance\-support learning materials.
* Develop presentations, facilitator guides, participant materials, exercises, scenarios, job aids, videos, assessments, and other learning resources.
* Customize learning content and examples to reflect customer business processes, use cases, roles, and implementation objectives.
* Apply **adult learning, instructional design, learning experience, and content development best practices**.
* Apply foundational **Organizational Change Management principles** to understand how business and role impacts, readiness, communications, and adoption influence learning requirements.
* Deliver **instructor\-led, virtual instructor\-led, workshops, knowledge\-transfer, and customer enablement sessions**.
* Facilitate interactive and hands\-on learning experiences aligned with customer use cases and operational processes.
* Adapt learning and facilitation approaches for different audiences, including **business users, super users, system administrators, support teams, managers, and leaders**.
* Support **train\-the\-trainer, super\-user enablement, instructor readiness, and knowledge\-transfer activities**.
* Help customers build user proficiency, confidence, and greater self\-sufficiency in using implemented solutions.
* Work with functional and solution experts to ensure learning accurately reflects configured solutions and future\-state business processes.
* Participate in curriculum design, content review, validation, and training readiness sessions.
* Follow established content\-development, quality, version\-control, review, and approval processes.
* Work collaboratively with **OCM, project management, Professional Services, solution, product, Customer Success, Education, and client teams** to align learning with implementation milestones and business outcomes.
* Maintain EUT work plans, content trackers, review logs, and supporting project documentation.
* Support development of **learning assessments and evaluation approaches** and analyze learner feedback, training effectiveness, and adoption indicators.
* Use feedback, product enhancements, and implementation lessons learned to continuously improve learning content and delivery.
* Contribute lessons learned, templates, examples, best practices, and ideas that support **continuous improvement and standardization of EUT methodologies and delivery assets**.
* Develop knowledge of Blue Yonder solutions, supply chain processes, implementation methodologies, and enterprise transformation.

**What We’re Looking For**
--------------------------

* **3\+ years of experience in end\-user training, Learning \& Development, instructional design, customer enablement, software implementation, professional services, or a related discipline.**
* Experience designing and developing training content for **enterprise software, SaaS platforms, business applications, or digital transformation initiatives**.
* Experience delivering instructor\-led, virtual instructor\-led, or other facilitated learning experiences.
* Foundational knowledge of **adult learning, instructional design, curriculum development, and training content development practices**.
* Understanding of the relationship between **Organizational Change Management, business readiness, learning, and end\-user adoption**.
* Ability to understand both **business\-process and technology concepts** and translate complex information into clear, practical learning experiences.
* Strong written and verbal communication, presentation, facilitation, and interpersonal skills.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Ability to establish effective working relationships with customers, subject matter experts, solution consultants, and project stakeholders.
* Ability to manage multiple learning deliverables, reviews, schedules, and priorities in a consulting environment.
* Professional, adaptable, self\-directed, and customer\-focused approach to delivery.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* **Experience with or exposure to Blue Yonder solutions or other enterprise supply chain solutions and platforms.**
* Experience in **supply chain, retail, manufacturing, logistics, planning, warehouse operations, transportation, or related business environments**.
* Experience supporting learning and enablement for supply chain capabilities such as **Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Inventory Optimization, Integrated Business Planning, Allocation and Replenishment, Warehouse Management, Transportation Management, or related solutions**.
* Experience supporting software implementations or broader business transformation programs.
* Experience facilitating workshops, stakeholder discussions, hands\-on learning, knowledge\-transfer, or train\-the\-trainer programs.
* Familiarity with Prosci, ADKAR, SAP Activate, or other Organizational Change Management approaches.
* Experience with learning management systems, content development tools, digital learning, video, simulation, or related learning technologies.
* Professional services, enterprise software, or consulting experience.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------


Success means consistently delivering **high\-quality, customer\-focused learning experiences** that build learner proficiency and confidence, support successful knowledge transfer, and contribute to solution adoption and implementation success.


The EUT Consultant is expected to progressively develop from executing defined learning activities into independently conducting discovery, designing learning solutions, facilitating client sessions, advising stakeholders, and managing increasingly complex EUT deliverables.


Success is demonstrated through **training effectiveness, learner proficiency, customer satisfaction, stakeholder relationships, solution adoption, and consistent delivery quality**, while contributing to continuous improvement of EUT methodologies and learning assets.

**Our Values**

  

If you want to know the heart of a company, take a look at their values. Ours unite us. They are what drive our success – and the success of our customers. Does your heart beat like ours? Find out here: Core Values


All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.
