title: Senior Engineering Manager - SRE
description:
Join OneAdvanced:
**About the Role**


OneAdvanced's Site Reliability Engineering function is responsible for how well we can see into our own systems, and how fast we can act on what we see. As Senior Manager, Site Reliability Engineering, you'll own the monitoring and observability roadmap across our full product portfolio — spanning Health, Legal, Education, Workforce Management, and other sectors — and lead a team of 15\-20 SRE engineers to deliver it.


You'll also push the function further: building and deploying AI agents that handle monitoring, alerting, and incident resolution directly — reducing how much of this work depends on a person watching a dashboard, and moving us toward a more autonomous operating model.

**Mandate:** To lead OneAdvanced's Site Reliability Engineering function — building the monitoring and observability roadmap that gives every product across Health, Legal, Education, Workforce Management, and other sectors real visibility into its own health, and increasingly uses AI agents to detect, alert on, and resolve incidents before they need a person.


What You Will Do:
**Key Responsibilities:**

**Monitoring \& Observability Roadmap**

* Own and drive the monitoring and observability roadmap across the product portfolio — Health, Legal, Education, Workforce Management, and other sectors.
* Set the standard for what “well\-monitored” means for a product, and hold the portfolio to it.
* Evaluate, select, and evolve the monitoring toolset to match the scale and complexity of the estate.
* Lead, coach and inspire a high\-performing team of Site Reliability Engineers.
* Shape and deliver our Site Reliability Engineering roadmap alongside the Head of Platform.
* Champion modern engineering practices including SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, observability and automation.
* Improve the reliability, scalability and performance of our cloud platforms and digital services.
* Partner with Engineering, Security, Data and Product teams to embed operational excellence from design through to production.
* Drive the adoption of our observability platform, helping teams gain deeper insight into the health and performance of their services.
* Lead incident learning, continuous improvement and automation initiatives that reduce operational toil.
* Provide technical leadership across AWS, Kubernetes, Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD and distributed system

**AI\-Driven Monitoring \& Incident Resolution**

* Design, build, and deploy AI agents that handle monitoring, alerting, and first\-line incident resolution.
* Identify where agentic automation can safely replace manual triage, and where human judgment still needs to stay in the loop.
* Continuously improve agent accuracy and trust based on real incident outcomes.

**Incident Management**

* Partner closely with Major Incident Management to ensure observability data drives faster detection and diagnosis during live incidents.
* Drive root cause analysis for monitoring or alerting gaps that contributed to incident impact or delay.
* Ensure post\-incident learnings translate into concrete monitoring and alerting improvements.

**Team Leadership**

* Lead, grow, and mentor a team of 10–15 SRE engineers, building deep observability and automation expertise.
* Own hiring, performance management, and career development for the team.
* Build a culture of ownership, curiosity, and continuous improvement.

**Cross\-Functional Partnership**

* Work closely with Engineering, Services, and Customer Success teams to ensure monitoring reflects what actually matters to product reliability and customer experience.
* Represent SRE \& Observability in cross\-functional planning and governance forums.
* Act as an escalation point for observability and monitoring gaps raised by any stakeholder team.


\#LI\-PB1


What You Will Have:
* 10\+ years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering, observability, or platform engineering, including people leadership experience.
* A proven track record leading teams of 15\+ engineers.
* Hands\-on experience building and operating monitoring and observability platforms at scale.
* Practical experience building or deploying AI agents for monitoring, alerting, or incident resolution — not just familiarity with the concept.
* Experience partnering with incident management functions to improve detection and response.
* Strong communication skills, comfortable working across engineering, services, and customer\-facing teams.
* Experience leading Site Reliability Engineering, Platform Engineering, DevOps or Cloud Infrastructure teams.
* Strong technical expertise in cloud\-native technologies, ideally within AWS, Azure and Private cloud platforms.
* Experience operating and improving large\-scale distributed systems.
* A passion for coaching, mentoring and helping engineers thrive.
* Experience driving observability, automation and operational excellence.
* The ability to build strong relationships and influence stakeholders across Engineering, Product, Security and Data.
* A pragmatic approach to balancing reliability, innovation and customer impact.

**It would be great if you also had**

* Experience with monitoring and observability tools such as Grafana, LogicMonitor, or equivalent.
* Experience with ServiceNow and Jira for incident and delivery tracking.
* Hands\-on experience with AI\-assisted engineering tools (e.g. Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) beyond monitoring use cases.
* Experience operating across multi\-sector or multi\-product portfolios.
* Relevant certifications in observability platforms or cloud providers (AWS, Azure)


What We Do For You:
* **Wellbeing focused** – Our people are our greatest assets, and ensuring everyone feels their best self to come to work is integral.
* **Annual Leave** – 20 days of annual leave, plus public holidays
* **Employee Assistance Programme** – Free advice, support, and confidential counselling available 24/7\.
* **Personal Growth** \- Regardless of where you are at in your career, we’re committed to enabling your growth personally and professionally
	+ **Development Programmes** – From Future Managers to Leadership Training, our development programmes help you get where you need to go
	+ **Online Learning Platform: SkillsHub!** \- Learning at your fingertips, anytime from anywhere. You can access our online library with relevant content for your career growth.
* **Life Insurance** \- 3x annual salary
* **Personal Accident Insurance** \- providing cover in the event of serious injury/illness.
* **Performance Bonus** – Our Group\-wide bonus scheme enables you to reap the rewards of your success


Who We Are:

At OneAdvanced, we are at the forefront of delivering sector\-focused technology solutions that simplify complexity, drive meaningful progress, and help build a fairer, more inclusive society.  

We’re much more than a software company. We deliver SaaS workflow applications and IT services that power organisations across Education, Government, Healthcare, Legal, Manufacturing, Housing, Retail, and more.  

OneAdvanced is one of the UK’s largest business software and services companies. Based in Birmingham (The Mailbox), operating across the UK, Ireland, India, and Australia.  

Our secure, scalable platform, including OneAdvanced AI, our private AI service for UK organisations, powers connectivity and innovation across critical sectors. Alongside our software are our IT services, including hosting, managed services, and application modernisation.  

We strive to create an inclusive workplace that drives innovation and collaboration, championing diverse perspectives and ideas. Our Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) strategy is embedded in everything we do, guiding us to create meaningful impact for our people, our customers and the planet.  

Join us and become part of a team that’s powering the world of work and making a real difference.  

Learn more at **www.oneadvanced.com**

Leading companies including DoorDash, LinkedIn, Johnson \& Johnson, and LiveRamp trust Nexla for mission\-critical data. Named in the 2022, 2023, and 2024 Gartner Magic Quadrant™ for Data Integration Tools and top\-rated by customers on Gartner Peer Insights, headquartered in San Mateo, California.



At Nexla, our culture is built around our core values: **Have Empathy**, **Be Curious**, **Be Intellectually Honest**, **Achieve Excellence**, and **Remember to Relax**. We put our customers at the heart of everything we do, foster a data\-driven mindset, take ownership of our work, and believe in the power of teamwork to achieve ambitious goals.

### **Role, briefly**



Our Customer Success team owns the end\-to\-end client experience, from initial integration through enterprise adoption and expansion. It is a small team, and this role does two jobs at once: running your own enterprise accounts, and leading, mentoring, and coaching the CSMs around you. You work closely with Sales, Solutions, Engineering, and executive leadership, and you are the primary voice of the customer internally, including on where the platform goes next.



Our Customer Success team owns the end\-to\-end client experience, from initial integration through enterprise adoption and expansion. It is a small team, and this role does two jobs at once: running your own enterprise accounts, and leading, mentoring, and coaching the CSMs around you. You work closely with Sales, Solutions, Engineering, and executive leadership, and you are the primary voice of the customer internally, including on where the platform goes next. As part of a lean and high\-impact team, you will directly manage a portfolio of 10\-15 strategic enterprise accounts, guiding them through both initial onboarding and long\-term customer success.


### **What you'll own**


* Retention and expansion across your accounts. That starts at onboarding, overseeing complex implementations alongside our Solutions Engineers and Architects, including vector pipeline setup into existing customer infrastructure, and runs through renewals, upsells, and SOWs with Sales.
* The standard of work across the CS team. Coaching and mentoring the CSMs, and owning the playbooks, health\-score frameworks, and retention strategies they run on. The function has to scale as the company grows.
* Executive relationships at your accounts. C\-level sponsors, VP\-level data owners, and AI steering committees, aligned on business value and ROI. You run the Executive Business Reviews and technical workshops.
* What happens when things go wrong. You are the escalation point for critical issues, technical roadblocks, and at\-risk accounts, pulling in engineering and leadership and keeping it calm.


*AI tooling is part of the job here, not a side interest. Customer communication, health tracking, and account reporting are all places we expect you to use it.*


*Ninety days : You will have fully onboarded your initial pod of strategic enterprise accounts, audited and leveled up our CS playbooks. You will have joined key customer calls to assess health across your 10–15 enterprise accounts, identified the next set of strategic and tactical deliverables for each, and established clear coaching cadence and updated playbooks for the team.*


### **The hard problem**



Because Nexla's enterprise platform bridges deep data engineering (ETL/ELT, APIs, streaming) with cutting\-edge AI architectures (agentic workflows, RAG, and MCP servers), the core tension in this role is balancing technical execution with high\-level value creation.


### **Must\-haves**


* 12\+ years in customer success management, engagement management, technical delivery, professional services, or sales engineering, in B2B SaaS.
* Background in solutions engineering, sales engineering, or technical consulting where you acted as a bridge between business teams and engineering.
* Experience establishing or scaling early\-stage Customer Success frameworks (e.g., building playbook templates, health\-score scoring systems, or churn\-risk matrixes).
* Track record of identifying expansion opportunities (upsells/cross\-sells) and collaborating closely with Account Executives/Sales to close them.
* You have led, mentored, or managed team members and driven team\-wide KPIs.
* You have built, negotiated, and held relationships with C\-suite and senior enterprise stakeholders.
* You have run high\-stakes escalations and de\-escalated risk inside complex enterprise dynamics.
* Real technical depth in data operations and data engineering pipelines (ETL and ELT), plus modern AI paradigms: GenAI, retrieval\-augmented generation, vector databases, and LLM data flows.
* You use AI tools in your actual work and can say specifically where they help and where they mislead you.

### **You'll thrive here if**


* You lead from the front. You carry your own accounts while raising the standard of the people around you.
* You challenge the status quo rather than inherit it. The playbooks here are yours to rewrite.
* You are comfortable in a high\-stakes executive conversation and in a technical one about pipeline architecture, often on the same day.
* You can hold a lot of cross\-functional threads at once and still hit the dates you committed to.


*One thing to be clear about: this is a small team, so you carry accounts as well as leading. If you are looking for a pure people\-management role, this is not it.*


### **How we hire**


* Hiring Manager \- VP Of Customer Success \- Customer Engagement, Team and culture fit
* Lead Solutions Architect \- Technical understanding
* CRO \- Revenue understanding, cross selling \& upselling, collaboration with Sales \& PreSales
* Group Presentation \- Lead a discovery, escalation or kickoff call with Stakeholders

### **The practical stuff**



Bengaluru, hybrid, 2 days a week in office. Compensation includes base salary and equity, set by depth and experience rather than by title. Working hours: the previous version of this role required US West Coast coverage.

**Why Build Your Future at Nexla?** We are standing at the precipice of the GenAI revolution, but the biggest bottleneck isn't the models, it's the data. By joining Nexla, you aren't just entering a company; you are stepping into the critical layer of the modern data stack that powers the AI economy. We are the **Data Fabric** that enables industry titans like **LinkedIn, DoorDash, and J\&J** to turn messy, siloed data into ready\-to\-use products for RAG and predictive models. This is your opportunity to move beyond simple tooling and build the actual infrastructure that democratizes data access for the next decade of innovation. If you want to solve the hardest problems in data engineering and own a piece of a market projected to hit billions, your career belongs here.

title: Technical Support Engineer (Customer Engagement Specialist)
description:
**Technical Support Engineer (Customer Engagement Specialist), Enterprise LMS**

**Location:** Chenai  
**Experience:** 5 to 12 years  
**Function:** Product and Customer Engagement

**About the role**

This is not a ticket\-routing job.

**PeopleOne** which is earlier called as **ExpertusONE** is an enterprise learning platform used by global organisations to run compliance training, certification programs, instructor\-led and virtual sessions, and skills development at scale across tens of thousands of learners. When something behaves unexpectedly in an environment like that, the question is rarely "did the user click the wrong button." It is usually a configuration interaction, an integration payload, a permissions model edge case, or a genuine defect hiding behind three layers of plausible explanations.

We are looking for someone who can tell the difference, and prove it.

You will own customer\-reported issues end to end: reproduce them, isolate the root cause, resolve what can be resolved through configuration or guidance, and hand the rest to Engineering with a diagnosis sharp enough that they can start fixing instead of start investigating. You are the person who makes the difference between a bug report that says "enrollment is broken for this customer" and one that says "enrollment fails when a training plan has sequencing enforced and the learner holds a prior exempted module, here is the reproduction path, here are the three affected tenants, here is the query that identifies them."

***If you enjoy the puzzle more than the ticket count, read on...***

**What you will do**

**Investigate and diagnose**

* Take ownership of escalated customer issues across the platform: enrollments, training plans, compliance and certification workflows, ILT and virtual classroom sessions, content playback (SCORM, xAPI, AICC, cmi5\), reporting and analytics, notifications, mobile, and integrations.
* Reproduce issues in test environments. Establish what is configuration, what is data, what is expected behaviour that the customer did not expect, and what is a genuine defect.
* Query production data (read\-only) to quantify blast radius: how many learners, which tenants, since when, and under what conditions.
* Read application and integration logs, trace API request and response payloads, and inspect webhook and SSO flows to isolate where a transaction actually failed.
* Distinguish correlation from causation. The most recent change is not automatically the cause.

**Resolve and communicate**

* Resolve issues directly where the fix is configuration, data correction, workflow redesign, or customer enablement.
* Write customer\-facing responses that a non\-technical LMS administrator can act on: what happened, what the impact is, what we are doing, what they need to do, and by when.
* Manage expectations honestly on issues that will not be fixed quickly. Vague reassurance is worse than an inconvenient timeline.
* Run live troubleshooting sessions with customer administrators and IT teams, including screen shares with enterprise security and identity teams.

**Escalate with a prognosis, not a summary**

* Package defects for Engineering with a reproduction path, environment details, affected versions and tenants, log evidence, expected versus actual behaviour, and a stated hypothesis on root cause.
* Assign severity and business impact yourself, and defend that assessment. Everything is not a P1\.
* Stay attached to the issue through to resolution. Escalation is a handoff of ownership for the fix, not a handoff of ownership for the customer.

**Improve the system**

* Identify recurring issue patterns and drive them to permanent elimination: product change, documentation gap, onboarding defect, or default configuration problem.
* Build and maintain internal diagnostic runbooks and customer\-facing knowledge articles. Reduce the number of issues that need you at all.
* Feed themes and evidence back into the product roadmap. You will have a direct line to Product Management and your input is expected to be substantiated with data, not anecdote.

**What success looks like**

**By 90 days:** You are independently resolving escalated issues across at least three functional areas without shadowing. Your defect reports are accepted by Engineering without a round trip for missing information.

**By six months:** Your average escalated\-to\-Engineering rate is falling because you are resolving more at source. You have shipped knowledge articles or runbooks that measurably reduce repeat issues. You have raised at least two product changes that were accepted onto the roadmap.

**By twelve months:** You are the person other engineers and CSMs come to when an issue does not make sense. You are trusted to speak directly to enterprise customers during a severity incident without supervision.

**What you need**

**Non\-negotiable:**

* **5 to 12 years** in technical support, application support, product support engineering, or solutions engineering for a B2B SaaS or enterprise software product. **Consumer support and pure L1 experience will not transfer.**
* Working SQL. You must be able to write joins, aggregations, and filtered queries against a relational schema to investigate an issue yourself, without asking an engineer.
* Practical fluency with REST APIs: reading documentation, constructing requests, interpreting status codes and error payloads, and using Postman or an equivalent tool.
* Demonstrated ability to read application logs and trace a transaction across systems.
* Structured diagnostic reasoning. You form a hypothesis, test it, and discard it when the evidence disagrees.
* Written English strong enough for direct communication with enterprise customers in EMEA and North America.
* Comfort with ambiguity and with saying "I do not know yet, here is how I will find out."

**Strongly preferred:**

* Prior experience with an LMS, LXP, HCM, or talent management platform (Cornerstone, Docebo, Absorb, SuccessFactors Learning, Workday Learning, Saba, or similar).
* Understanding of e\-learning standards: SCORM 1\.2 and 2004, xAPI, AICC, cmi5, and LRS concepts.
* Enterprise integration experience: SAML and OIDC single sign\-on, SCIM provisioning, HRIS data feeds, webhooks, and file\-based imports.
* Exposure to BI or reporting tools (Superset, Tableau, Power BI) and the ability to validate a reporting discrepancy against source data.
* Experience supporting multi\-tenant SaaS, including the reasoning required to separate tenant\-specific configuration issues from platform defects.
* BE, BTech, MCA, or equivalent technical education. We care more about what you can do than where you learned it.

**What we are not looking for**

To save everyone time:

* This role does not involve reading from a script or routing tickets to a queue.
* This is not a Customer Success Manager role. It is not primarily about renewals, QBRs, or adoption metrics, although you will work closely with the people who own those.
* If your last three years have been spent exclusively in a tier\-one queue with a strict escalation\-after\-fifteen\-minutes policy, this will be a difficult jump.
* If you are looking for a step towards a pure development role, be honest about that in the interview and we will tell you honestly whether this is the right path.

**How we evaluate**

Beyond conversation, we will put a real anonymised issue in front of you: a description, some log output, and a data extract. We will ask you to tell us what you think is happening and what you would check next. We are assessing how you reason, not whether you already know our product.

**Why this role is worth your time**

You will get read\-only production access, direct access to Engineering, and a direct line into Product Management where your findings shape what gets built. You will work on genuinely complex enterprise problems for recognisable global customers. And you will be measured on whether problems stay solved, not on how many tickets you closed.

If you're interested, please share your resume with **swethav@peopleone.co** or apply directly through this job post.

**We look forward to connecting with talented professionals and wish you the very best in your career journey!**

* Data products and analytics

Adaptability and ability to quickly learn new business domains.

**Job Description**
 As the primary point of contact for assigned customers and partners within Gracenote, this role involves comprehensive relationship management. Key responsibilities include handling escalations, developing action plans, managing reports and dashboards, coordinating product updates and integrations, and maintaining customer\-specific playbooks. This role demands a blend of customer service, industry expertise, and strategic thinking to ensure customer satisfaction and to drive business growth.

* Solid Presentation skills
* Strong attention to detail
* Ability to prioritize tasks and manage multiple responsibilities efficiently

title: Compliance officer
description:
**About Us**
 Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
   

  

 At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
   

  

 Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Compliance Officer \& Senior Manager, Client Services – Visa GIFT City
   

  

* Location \- GIFT City, Gujarat, India
* Business Function \- Compliance, Client Services, Regulatory Governance, Client Implementation, Operational Support
* Level \- Senior Manager
* Reports To \- Principal Officer \& Head – Visa GIFT City Branch Dotted\-line reporting to India / Regional Compliance, Risk, Legal, Regulatory Affairs, and Client Services Leadership, as applicable.


**Role Summary**
 The Compliance Officer \& Senior Manager, Client Services – Visa GIFT City will serve a dual mandate: acting as the designated Compliance Officer for Visa’s IFSCA\-licensed GIFT City entity and leading client services delivery for all Visa GIFT City clients.
   

  

 This role is designed for a senior professional who can combine regulatory discipline, operational excellence, client\-facing execution, and cross\-functional leadership. The person will support the Principal Officer in ensuring that Visa’s GIFT City activities are conducted in accordance with applicable IFSCA requirements, internal Visa policies, risk and control standards, and the scope of the entity’s ancillary license.
   

  

 At the same time, the individual will be responsible for ensuring that GIFT City clients — including banks, payment service providers, fintechs, financial institutions, and other eligible entities — receive high\-quality client support across onboarding, implementation, issue resolution, operational readiness, reporting, service reviews, and ongoing relationship servicing.
   

  

 This role will be critical in building a strong control environment while enabling a seamless client experience for Visa’s GIFT City business.
   

  

 What the Compliance Officer \& Senior Manager, Client Services Will Do:
   

  

**Compliance Officer For Visa GIFT City Entity**
* Serve as Visa’s designated Compliance Officer for its IFSCA\-licensed GIFT City entity.
* Support the Principal Officer in maintaining ongoing compliance with applicable IFSCA regulations, circulars, guidelines, license conditions, and internal governance standards.
* Monitor the GIFT City entity’s activities to ensure they remain within the approved scope of Visa’s ancillary license.
* Maintain a compliance calendar covering applicable regulatory filings, submissions, periodic reporting, renewals, certifications, governance reviews, and internal deliverables.
* Coordinate with Legal, Compliance, Risk, Regulatory Affairs, Finance, Tax, Operations, and Client Services teams to ensure regulatory obligations are understood, assigned, tracked, and completed on time.
* Assist in preparing responses to IFSCA information requests, regulatory inspections, supervisory reviews, internal audits, compliance testing, and governance reviews.
* Ensure accurate maintenance of compliance documentation, records, approvals, licenses, policies, SOPs, client records, filings, and audit evidence.
* Track changes in applicable regulations and coordinate with relevant internal stakeholders to assess impact on Visa’s GIFT City activities.
* Support regulatory change management by helping translate legal and regulatory requirements into operational procedures, controls, checklists, and staff awareness materials.
* Escalate actual or potential compliance breaches, regulatory issues, control gaps, conflicts, and operational risks in a timely and structured manner.
* Help build and maintain a culture of compliance, accountability, documentation discipline, and ethical business conduct across the GIFT City office.


**Client Services Leadership For GIFT City Clients**
* Lead client services delivery for all Visa GIFT City clients, including banks, payment service providers, fintechs, financial institutions, and other approved or eligible clients.
* Act as the primary senior client services contact for GIFT City clients, ensuring a consistent, responsive, and high\-quality client experience.
* Own operational readiness, implementation coordination, client onboarding support, issue resolution, service reviews, and ongoing client engagement from a servicing perspective.
* Partner with Sales, Product, Technology, Risk, Legal, Finance, Client Implementation, and regional Client Services teams to deliver Visa solutions efficiently and effectively.
* Help clients understand Visa processes, operating requirements, service models, implementation timelines, documentation needs, support channels, and escalation protocols.
* Manage complex client service issues, ensuring timely triage, internal ownership, root\-cause analysis, escalation, resolution, and client communication.
* Monitor service performance, client satisfaction, open issues, implementation milestones, operational risks, and service\-level trends.
* Conduct periodic client service reviews to discuss operational performance, upcoming initiatives, pain points, risk items, product adoption, and improvement opportunities.
* Serve as the consolidated voice of GIFT City clients for service experience, operational feedback, product usability, process friction, reporting needs, and implementation challenges.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to simplify client onboarding, reduce service issues, enhance operational transparency, and improve client satisfaction.


**Regulatory, Risk \& Control Ownership**
* Support strong risk and control discipline across Visa’s GIFT City operations.
* Ensure Client Services activities are aligned with applicable compliance requirements, internal controls, policies, and risk standards.
* Coordinate with Risk and Compliance stakeholders to provide accurate, timely, and consolidated business inputs across clients, consistent with the governance discipline described in the source JD.
* Own documentation standards, audit readiness, and governance discipline for Compliance and Client Services outputs, consistent with the source JD’s emphasis on documentation, audit readiness, and control ownership.
* Maintain structured evidence for client onboarding, implementation approvals, client communications, issue escalations, service reviews, and regulatory\-relevant activities.
* Identify potential operational, compliance, client, reputational, or regulatory risks and coordinate appropriate remediation plans.
* Help establish and maintain standard operating procedures, checklists, controls, and review mechanisms for GIFT City client servicing.
* Participate in internal risk assessments, control reviews, audits, compliance monitoring, and remediation activities.
* Ensure client\-related issues with regulatory or compliance implications are escalated promptly to the Principal Officer \& and appropriate internal teams.


**Client Onboarding, Implementation \& Operational Readiness**
* Coordinate onboarding of new GIFT City clients onto Visa products, services, platforms, and operating processes.
* Ensure client implementation plans are clearly documented, agreed, tracked, and governed.
* Partner with Implementation, Product, Technology, Risk, Legal, Finance, and Sales teams to support timely launch of client programs.
* Help manage dependencies related to contracts, technical setup, testing, certifications, documentation, billing setup, operational procedures, and go\-live readiness.
* Ensure clients are appropriately educated on operational responsibilities, compliance requirements, processing flows, reporting processes, and service channels.
* Track implementation risks, blockers, delays, dependencies, and escalations.
* Provide regular updates to the Principal Officer, Sales leads, Client Services leadership, and other stakeholders on client implementation status.
* Support post\-launch stabilization, early\-life support, issue triage, and transition to business\-as\-usual servicing.


**Issue Management, Escalations \& Service Excellence**
* Own the end\-to\-end coordination of client service issues for GIFT City clients.
* Establish clear escalation pathways for operational, technical, product, billing, compliance, and implementation issues.
* Ensure each issue has clear ownership, severity classification, resolution timeline, client communication plan, and closure evidence.
* Partner with regional and global Visa support teams to resolve complex client issues.
* Track recurring issues and drive root\-cause analysis to prevent repeat incidents.
* Provide timely and professional client communications during high\-impact issues.
* Create dashboards or structured reporting on open issues, aging, service themes, resolution performance, and improvement actions.
* Drive service excellence by improving responsiveness, transparency, accountability, and follow\-through.
* Support the development of service playbooks, FAQs, process maps, and internal knowledge repositories for GIFT City servicing.


**Business Operations, Reporting \& Governance**
* Build and maintain operational dashboards for GIFT City client services, compliance actions, regulatory deliverables, implementation milestones, and issue management.
* Deliver timely, accurate, and actionable updates to the Principal Officer and senior stakeholders.
* Translate client service data, compliance status, and operational trends into clear recommendations and management insights.
* Support strategic initiatives related to service model design, operational readiness, client support infrastructure, regulatory reporting, and process improvement.
* Partner with Sales and Finance teams to support accurate client, contract, billing, service, and implementation inputs.
* Contribute to governance forums including branch operating reviews, client review meetings, compliance reviews, risk/control reviews, and management updates.
* Maintain clear minutes, action logs, decisions, approvals, and evidence for governance meetings.
* Drive consistent use of internal tools for issue tracking, client documentation, implementation tracking, CRM updates, reporting, and operational workflows.


**Sales, Product \& Cross\-Functional Partnership**
* Partner closely with the Principal Officer and Sales teams to support client growth through strong service delivery and operational execution.
* Provide client services input during deal planning, solution design, implementation planning, contract discussions, and client readiness assessments.
* Help identify operational dependencies, client requirements, product limitations, service risks, and implementation complexity early in the sales cycle.
* Work with Product and Solutions teams to provide structured feedback from GIFT City clients on Visa products, implementation requirements, service needs, and market expectations.
* Build strong partnerships across Sales, Finance, Product, Strategy, Risk, Legal, HR, and Client Services, consistent with the source JD’s stakeholder management expectations.
* Support client workshops, onboarding sessions, implementation reviews, service reviews, and operating model discussions.
* Ensure that service commitments are realistic, documented, aligned with Visa capabilities, and operationally executable.


**Key Measures Of Success**
* Regulatory compliance \- Timely filings, no material compliance breaches, strong audit outcomes, complete regulatory records
* License governance \- Activities remain within approved license scope, timely escalation of material changes or issues
* Client satisfaction \- Improved client feedback, successful service reviews, reduced complaints, strong relationship health
* Implementation delivery \- On\-time client onboarding, reduced launch delays, clear issue tracking, smooth go\-live support
* Issue resolution \- Faster resolution times, reduced aged issues, effective escalation management, lower repeat incidents
* Control discipline \- Strong documentation, audit\-ready records, effective SOPs, clear governance evidence
* Operational excellence \- Reduced manual interventions, improved process consistency, better dashboards and reporting
* Stakeholder confidence \- Positive feedback from Principal Officer, Sales, Compliance, Risk, Legal, Product, and Client Services teams


 Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Basic Qualifications:
   

  

* 8–12\+ years of experience in compliance, client services, client implementation, operations, risk, payments, banking, fintech, financial services, or a related regulated environment.
* Experience supporting financial institutions, banks, payment service providers, fintechs, enterprise clients, or regulated entities.
* Strong understanding of compliance, governance, documentation standards, operational controls, issue management, and audit readiness.
* Demonstrated ability to manage client\-facing service responsibilities while maintaining strong regulatory and control discipline.
* Experience coordinating cross\-functional work across Sales, Product, Risk, Legal, Compliance, Finance, Technology, Operations, and Client Services.
* Strong project management and implementation coordination skills, including action tracking, dependency management, escalation management, and executive reporting.
* Strong analytical capability and comfort using dashboards, reporting tools, CRM systems, service management tools, and Microsoft Office applications.
* Proven ability to translate complex operational or regulatory requirements into practical processes, checklists, SOPs, and client guidance.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with ability to engage senior internal and external stakeholders.
* High integrity, professionalism, sound judgment, attention to detail, and ability to remain effective under pressure.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Prior experience in payments, card networks, digital payments, cross\-border payments, acquiring, issuing, processing, fintech platforms, or payment infrastructure.
* Familiarity with GIFT City, IFSCA, IFSC\-regulated entities, ancillary services, financial services regulation, or offshore financial center operations.
* Experience acting as or supporting a Compliance Officer, Nodal Officer, MLRO, branch compliance lead, risk/control lead, or regulated entity governance role.
* Experience with client onboarding, certification, implementation, technical support, service reviews, and operational readiness for financial services products.
* Experience in regulatory reporting, compliance monitoring, internal audits, control testing, governance forums, and policy implementation.
* Ability to manage ambiguity in a growing business environment and build processes from the ground up.
* Strong stakeholder network or working familiarity with banks, PSPs, fintechs, and financial institutions operating in or around GIFT City.
* Bachelor’s degree in business, finance, commerce, law, economics, engineering, technology, or a related discipline.
* Professional certifications in compliance, risk, payments, project management, audit, or financial services operations would be advantageous.


**Leadership Capabilities**
 The ideal candidate will demonstrate:
   

  

* Compliance mindset — ability to interpret obligations, track deliverables, maintain evidence, and escalate issues appropriately.
* Client centricity — commitment to delivering a high\-quality service experience for GIFT City clients.
* Operational rigor — strong command of process, documentation, governance, controls, dashboards, and follow\-through.
* Issue ownership — ability to drive resolution across multiple internal teams and communicate clearly with clients.
* Cross\-functional influence — ability to work effectively across Sales, Product, Legal, Risk, Finance, Technology, and Client Services.
* Judgment and integrity — ability to balance client needs, business objectives, regulatory requirements, and Visa’s reputation.
* Structured execution — ability to manage competing priorities, deadlines, implementations, escalations, and compliance obligations.
* Continuous improvement — willingness to simplify processes, improve controls, and enhance service delivery over time.


**Candidate Profile**
 This role is best suited for a Senior Manager\-level professional with experience in payments, banking, fintech, client services, compliance, operations, or risk. The candidate should be comfortable operating in a regulated environment while also being highly client\-facing and execution\-oriented.
   

  

 They should be able to support Visa’s GIFT City regulatory obligations, manage client service delivery, coordinate implementation and issue resolution, and build scalable operating processes for a growing business. The ideal candidate will be detail\-oriented, commercially aware, service\-minded, and confident working with senior clients and internal stakeholders.
   

  

**Visa is an EEO Employer**
 Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

title: Territory Sales Manager(TSM)
description:
**Company Description** 
 NoBrokerHood is a technologically advanced visitor, community, and finance \& asset management platform designed to make life secure and convenient for gated societies. Launched in 2018 as a subsidiary of NoBroker—India’s first prop\-tech unicorn—it has quickly become a market leader, managing over 25,000 societies and serving more than 4\.8 million families across India. The platform provides dedicated interfaces for society admins, management committees, guards, and residents, and offers services ranging from home maintenance to renting or selling property. NoBrokerHood also enables revenue generation for societies and partner businesses through monetisation and marketplace features. Backed by Level 1 PCI\-DSS, GDPR, PDPB 2019, and ISO 27001 certifications, and supported by a recent $5 million investment from Google, NoBrokerHood is focused on secure, scalable growth in community management.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Territory Sales Manager (TSM) will be responsible for driving NoBrokerHood’s growth in the Mumbai region through on\-site customer acquisition, relationship management, and revenue expansion. This is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Mumbai, involving regular visits to gated communities and meetings with society management committees to present product offerings and negotiate contracts. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include identifying and qualifying leads, conducting product demos, closing sales, and ensuring smooth onboarding of societies onto the platform. The TSM will collaborate with internal teams to address customer needs, provide post\-sales support, and gather feedback to improve service delivery. The role also includes tracking sales performance, preparing reports, and training society staff on effective use of NoBrokerHood’s features to maximize value and satisfaction.
   

**Qualifications**
* Candidates should possess strong Communication skills, including the ability to present, negotiate, and build long\-term stakeholder relationships.
* Candidates should possess Sales and Sales Management skills for lead generation, pipeline management, forecasting, and achieving territory revenue targets.
* Candidates should possess Customer Service skills to handle queries, resolve issues promptly, and maintain high satisfaction among societies and residents.
* Candidates should possess Training skills to onboard new clients, educate society staff, and conduct product walkthroughs and refresher sessions.
* Relevant experience in B2B or field sales, preferably in SaaS, prop\-tech, or community management solutions.
* Ability to work independently in a fast\-paced environment, with strong planning, time management, and reporting capabilities.
* Comfort with using digital tools, CRM systems, and mobile applications for sales tracking and client communication.
* Graduate degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field is preferred; equivalent practical experience in sales will also be considered.

The Channel Account Manager (CAM) is a mission\-critical role responsible for driving Mitel’s market share and revenue growth across India. You will act as the primary strategic consultant to our partners (Value\-Added Resellers, System Integrators, and Distributors), empowering them to sell Mitel’s full portfolio of Unified Communications (UC), Contact Center (CC), and AI\-driven customer experience solutions.


You will be responsible for "hunting" new partners and "farming" existing high\-potential accounts, ensuring they are enabled, motivated, and aligned with Mitel’s go\-to\-market strategy.

**1\. Channel Partner Management**

**2\. Revenue Growth \& Business Development**

* Own the revenue target for assigned partners and deliver **quarter\-on\-quarter and year\-on\-year growth**.

* Build joint GTM initiatives, campaigns and customer acquisition programs with partners.

**3\. End\-Customer Engagement**

* Participate in customer meetings, presentations, solution discussions, negotiations and executive engagements.

**4\. Pipeline \& Forecast Management**

* Maintain a healthy and accurate sales pipeline across assigned partners.
* Provide **weekly/monthly/quarterly** **forecasts with high accuracy**.

**Requirements:**

* Experience in **Voice, UC, UCaaS, CCaaS, Networking, Cloud or related technology solutions** preferred.
* Demonstrated track record of achieving revenue targets through partners.

**Must\-Have Skills**

* Channel Account Management

title: Territory Manager
description:
### **Job Description**


**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**



When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.


### **Role Purpose**



Lead MWM’s direct commercial development in India by identifying, developing and closing new equipment and lifecycle service opportunities with end users and other direct project stakeholders. The Territory Manager will establish MWM as a visible, technically credible and commercially responsive partner in the Indian power generation market, with priority on gas engine generator applications.


**This is a direct market role.**The position is not responsible for building or managing a dealership network. The successful candidate will create demand, own strategic customer relationships, and lead opportunities directly for MWM, while coordinating qualified EPCs, engineering firms, and service providers on a project\-specific basis as required.


### **Key Responsibilities**


* Own MWM’s direct sales development across India for gas engine generator sets, power modules, combined heat and power solutions, and related lifecycle offerings.
* Build and manage a strong pipeline of direct opportunities with industrial end users, utilities, independent power producers, data centers, oil and gas companies, petrochemical and chemical plants, steel, cement, mining, food and beverage, textiles, pharmaceuticals, commercial infrastructure and other energy\-intensive industries.
* Develop strategic account plans for priority customers and convert market potential into qualified projects, tenders, orders and long\-term customer relationships.
* Engage early with customer decision\-makers, plant engineering teams, consultants, EPC organizations and project developers to position MWM during concept development, feasibility studies, FEED and specification stages.
* Lead the complete opportunity cycle from prospecting and qualification through application definition, solution positioning, proposal development, negotiation, order intake and structured handover.
* Translate customer operating requirements into clear technical\-commercial inputs, including fuel composition, gas pressure, site conditions, load profile, operating mode, heat recovery requirements, installation concept and commissioning expectations.
* Coordinate closely with application engineering, quotation, project management, service, finance, legal, and commercial teams to prepare compliant and competitive solutions.
* Lead value\-based selling by quantifying customer benefits such as fuel efficiency, availability, lifecycle cost, emissions performance, operational flexibility and serviceability.
* Develop and maintain relationships with relevant EPCs, consultants and engineering companies as project influencers and execution partners, without assigning dealer or territory rights.
* Identify service, overhaul, long\-term maintenance, upgrade, spare parts, and installed\-base opportunities that strengthen customer lifecycle value.
* Maintain accurate opportunity, forecast, customer and activity data in the company CRM system and provide clear monthly outlooks, risks, actions and market intelligence.
* Represent MWM at targeted customer workshops, technical seminars, industry associations, conferences and exhibitions in India.
* Monitor competitive activity, pricing dynamics, regulations, gas availability, segment trends, and customer investment plans, and convert findings into actionable sales priorities.
* Achieve agreed order intake, revenue, margin, pipeline quality and strategic account development objectives while following internal governance and approval processes.

### **Target Candidate Profile**


* 8 to 12 years of progressive experience in technical B2B sales, business development or key\-account management in the Indian power generation market.
* Preferred experience with gas engine generators, reciprocating engine power plants, cogeneration or trigeneration, distributed energy, captive power, waste\-to\-energy, biogas, natural gas, special gas or hybrid power solutions.
* Demonstrated success in direct selling to end users and managing complex, project\-based sales cycles with multiple technical and commercial stakeholders.
* Established market access and customer relationships in one or more priority segments such as industrial captive power, oil and gas, petrochemicals, data centers, utilities, infrastructure, manufacturing or process industries.
* Strong understanding of the Indian project ecosystem, including direct customers, EPCs, consultants, tender processes, regulatory considerations and commercial practices.
* Ability to engage at plant, engineering, procurement, finance, and senior management levels and to build credibility with both technical and commercial decision\-makers.
* Commercial ownership, disciplined follow\-up and a proven ability to progress opportunities from early\-stage lead to signed order.
* Willingness to travel extensively within India and, when required, internationally for customer meetings, factory visits, training and business reviews.

### **Education**



Preferred degrees:


* Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, power engineering, energy engineering, or a closely related technical discipline.
* B.E. or B. Tech is preferred. An M.E., MTech, or an MBA in Sales, Marketing, Strategy, or General Management is advantageous.
* Candidates with another relevant engineering degree may be considered where supported by strong, directly relevant power\-generation sales experience.

### **Technical and Commercial Knowledge**


* Working knowledge of gas engines, generator sets, alternators, balance of plant, electrical integration and power plant operating concepts.
* Understanding of captive power, grid\-parallel and island operation, base\-load applications, CHP or CCHP, containerized and powerhouse installations, and high\-ambient site conditions.
* Ability to interpret customer specifications, single\-line concepts, fuel\-gas data, load profiles and technical\-commercial tender requirements.
* Competence in solution selling, financial justification, contract negotiation, risk identification, pricing discipline and stakeholder management.
* Experience with CRM\-based pipeline management and forecasting. Salesforce experience is preferred.
* Strong written and spoken English. Proficiency in Hindi and additional Indian languages is advantageous.

### **Core Competencies**


* Direct customer acquisition and strategic account development
* Technical sales and consultative value selling
* Business development and market creation
* Complex opportunity and tender management
* Negotiation, commercial judgment, and closing discipline
* Customer focus and long\-term relationship management
* Cross\-functional coordination and clear communication
* Decision\-making, accountability, and structured execution
* Market intelligence and competitive positioning
* Forecast accuracy and CRM discipline

### **Measures of Success**


* Achievement of approved new equipment and service order\-intake, revenue, and margin objectives.
* Growth and quality of the qualified direct\-customer pipeline.
* Conversion of strategic opportunities and acquisition of new MWM customers in India.
* Early specification and positioning of MWM in priority projects.
* Development of sustainable relationships with end users, EPCs and consultants.
* Forecast accuracy, opportunity data quality and timely execution of agreed next steps.
* Customer satisfaction and effective coordination from opportunity development through handover.

### **Positioning Statement for Candidates**



This role offers the opportunity to shape MWM’s direct market presence in India. It is suited to a commercially ambitious power\-generation professional who wants to build strategic customer relationships, influence complex energy projects and take visible ownership of growth in one of MWM’s priority markets.


**Job Description Notice**



This job description is intended as a general guide to the role. It is not an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, or effort required. The company may revise the description to address evolving business and organizational needs. Final title, grade, reporting line, targets, and employment conditions remain subject to approval by management and Human Resources.



Additional information: This job requires 5days in a week working from office.

September 9, 2026 \- September 23, 2026 Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

 Hevo’s customers are data engineers, analytics leaders, and platform teams who rely on us for critical data infrastructure. Customer Success here goes well beyond satisfaction surveys. The job is to help technical teams get real value from their pipelines, cut the time it takes to get to insight, and grow their data operations.
 



 We’re looking for a strong leader to build and run the CS function. You’ll own the full post\-sales journey (onboarding, adoption, renewal, expansion) and be directly accountable for Net Revenue Retention and customer health across our global base.
 



  





**The Setup** 



* A growing team of TAMs, based primarily in Bangalore and Pune
* A product with 1000\+ customers but an evolving post\-sales playbook for 250\-300 accounts
* A customer base spanning SMB to enterprise across e\-commerce, fintech, medtech and B2B Software companies.
* Strong executive support and buy\-in for investing in Technical Account Management
* A chance to shape CS strategy at a company that’s defining the data pipeline category



  





**Responsibilities** 




**Build and Own the TAM Program** 



* Design and roll out Hevo\-specific TAM playbooks covering onboarding, adoption, health scoring, renewal, and expansion
* Segment the customer base (enterprise, mid\-market, self\-serve) and build the right engagement model for each

**Drive Customer Outcomes** 



* Improve renewal rates and reduce churn by driving deeper product adoption and making sure customers see tangible results
* Work with Sales on cross\-sell and upsell opportunities, always leading with retention
* Build customer advocacy through NPS programs, case studies, and community engagement
* Grow lifetime value by catching risks early through health monitoring and having clear playbooks for when to step in



**Customer Lifecycle** 



* Map out the customer journey for Hevo’s technical buyers and end users
* Set up the right checkpoints across the lifecycle (usage data, satisfaction signals, support sentiment) and create standard responses for each stage
* Keep improving based on what the data and customer feedback tell you



**Lead and Grow the Team** 



* Hire and develop strong TAMs
* Put together an onboarding process that gets new hires productive fast
* Build a team culture where people are technically curious, care about customers, and take ownership of outcomes



**Measure What Matters** 



* Define and track operational metrics: time\-to\-value, adoption rates, health scores, NRR, GRR.

**Cross\-Functional Work** 



* Work with Product to make sure customer insights feed into the roadmap
* Coordinate with Sales on ideal customer definition, handoff process, and expansion pipeline
* Team up with Marketing on customer campaigns, advocacy programs, and lifecycle comms
* Work with Finance on forecasting, renewal projections, and unit economics



**Invest in CS/TAM Technology** 



* Use AI and automation to make the program more efficient and scale the team’s impact without growing headcount at the same rate



  





**Who We’re Looking For** 




**Must\-Have** 



* 10\+ years of overall experience, and 5\+ years leading Technical Customer Success or Tech Account Mgmt teams in B2B SaaS, with experience building or scaling a technical CS/TAM function
* Experience with technical or developer\-facing products, ideally in data infrastructure, analytics, or related areas like ETL/ELT, data warehousing, observability, or DevOps
* Track record of owning and improving net revenue retention in a subscription / recurring\-revenue business
* Comfortable managing technical CSEs who spend their days working with data engineers and analysts
* Analytical and numbers\-driven. You make decisions based on data and you build the systems to track it
* Strong communication skills. Comfortable presenting to the board and working across functions to get things done



  





**Nice\-to\-Have** 



* Time spent at a modern data stack company (Fivetran, dbt, Snowflake, Databricks, Airbyte, or similar)
* Familiarity with usage\-based or consumption\-based pricing models
* Mix of technical (engineering, solutions) and business (CS, account management) experience
* Experience managing CSEs across multiple geographies or time zones



  





**Why Hevo** 



* We’re in a large, growing market (data integration is projected to hit $17B\+) and we’re one of the leaders
* Our customers actually like the product. Top\-rated on G2, with strong word\-of\-mouth growth
* Sequoia Capital\-backed with strong investor support
* CS is treated as a growth function here, not a cost center. You’ll have real ownership
* Low\-ego team with deep engineering and product roots

title: ITSM - Knowledge Management - Associate/Senior Associate
description:
### **Description**

  

The Knowledge Manager owns the operational governance and full lifecycle of IT knowledge used by the Service Desk, resolver teams and end users. Reporting to the Senior Lead Associate \- Service Desk and Knowledge Management, the role converts technical and operational expertise into accurate, searchable, reusable and user\-friendly content.  

The role works across Incident, Request, Problem and Change Management to embed knowledge capture and reuse into day\-to\-day practices, strengthen first\-contact resolution and improve self\-service. This is an individual\-contributor role; Service Desk leadership, staffing, escalation ownership and strategic direction remain with the Senior Lead Associate.### **Key Responsibilities**

  

* Execute and continually improve the Knowledge Management roadmap under the direction of the Senior Lead Associate.
* Maintain KM policies, standards, article templates, ownership models, approval workflows and review schedules.
* Govern the complete article lifecycle, including creation, validation, publication, review, update, archive and retirement.
* Maintain taxonomy, metadata, naming and tagging standards to improve findability and consistency.
* Coordinate knowledge health reviews and remediate stale, duplicate, inaccurate or low\-value content.
* Embed knowledge capture, reuse and improvement into Incident, Request, Problem and Change workflows.
* Facilitate knowledge harvesting after major incidents, recurring incidents, problem investigations, releases and significant changes.
* Work with Service Desk analysts, subject matter experts, resolver groups and service owners to capture and validate solutions.
* Ensure known errors, workarounds and standard resolutions are converted into governed knowledge where appropriate.
* Support operational readiness by ensuring new or changed services have approved support knowledge before go\-live.
* Apply Knowledge\-Centred Service principles and coach authors, reviewers and approvers on contribution behaviours and quality standards.
* Curate clear, task\-based content for self\-service and approved support channels.
* Use search results, user feedback and ticket trends to identify content gaps and improvement priorities.
* Administer and improve ServiceNow KM workflows, including templates, approvals, feedback and lifecycle controls.
* Identify automation opportunities for classification, tagging, review reminders, duplicate detection and content recommendations.
* Support controlled use of AI\-assisted knowledge capabilities with human review and governance.
* Maintain measures for article quality, freshness, reuse, findability, contribution and self\-service success.
* Produce regular KM reporting and maintain a prioritised improvement backlog for the Senior Lead Associate.

  

### **Skills, Knowledge \& Expertise**

  

* Mandatory total professional experience: 7 to 12 years.
* Mandatory relevant experience: 4 to 7 years in Knowledge Management, KCS, ITSM knowledge governance, technical content governance or a related discipline.
* Practical experience in an IT Service Desk, technical support or IT operations environment.
* Hands\-on experience managing knowledge in ServiceNow Knowledge Management or a comparable enterprise ITSM platform.
* Experience improving KM governance, workflows, taxonomies, article standards and review controls.
* Experience integrating knowledge activities with Incident, Request, Problem and Change Management.
* Experience using reports and analytics to identify knowledge gaps and drive continual improvement.
* Experience facilitating knowledge\-harvesting sessions and coaching contributors.
* Minimum education: Bachelor's degree in information technology, Computer Science, Business, Communications or a related discipline.
* Desirable: experience with KCS maturity, self\-service portals, enterprise search, chatbots, virtual agents, ServiceNow AI capabilities or global shared services.

**Knowledge, Skill, ability*** Strong understanding of ITIL 4 Knowledge Management and its relationship with Service Desk and core ITSM practices.
* Practical knowledge of KCS principles, knowledge lifecycle governance and content quality controls.
* Hands\-on understanding of ServiceNow Knowledge Management, article structures, workflows and reporting.
* Ability to design and maintain taxonomies, metadata, tagging structures and content templates.
* Ability to translate complex technical information into concise and audience\-appropriate content.
* Strong analytical skills across search, usage, quality, feedback and operational data.
* Strong facilitation, coaching and stakeholder\-influencing skills without direct reporting authority.
* Sound understanding of accessibility, version control, auditability and responsible AI governance.

  

**Essential requirement (non\-negotiable) \**** Total professional experience within the 7 to 12\-year range.
* Minimum 4 years of directly relevant Knowledge Management, KCS or ITSM knowledge\-governance experience.
* Hands\-on ServiceNow Knowledge Management or comparable enterprise ITSM knowledge\-platform experience.
* Practical experience in a Service Desk, technical support or IT operations environment.
* ITIL 4 Foundation certification.
* Strong written communication and ability to simplify technical information.
* Ability to work the stated UK shift from Pune.

We are a specialist professional services and technology firm, working in partnership with leading insurance, highly regulated and global businesses.  

  

We help our clients to manage risk, operate their core business processes, transform and grow. We deliver professional services and technology solutions across the risk and insurance value chain, including excellence in claims, underwriting, distribution, regulation \& risk, customer experience, human capital, digital transformation \& change management.  

  

Our global team of more than 8,000 professionals operate across ten countries, including the UK \& the U.S. Over the past ten years Davies has grown its annual revenues more than 20\-fold, investing heavily in research \& development, innovation \& automation, colleague development, and client service. title: Principal Fullstack Engineer
description:
**About the Client**


Our client is a global leading, end\-to\-end enterprise volunteer engagement platform powering over 100 million volunteer hours. They exist to connect communities to events and causes they are passionate about. Used by over 3 million volunteers across 26 different countries, their SaaS platform powers mass volunteer programs across the globe for Not\-for\-Profits, local government, sporting federations, and major events. Our all in one solution helps our clients to recruit, retain, reward and train their volunteers, whilst also ensuring compliance.

**About Teamified**


Teamified is a talent partner helping companies build exceptional remote teams across IT, software, product, and digital innovation. We collaborate with leading enterprises and fast\-


scaling tech businesses worldwide to help them access world class talent and


accelerate growth. With operations across the globe our mission is to make building high


performing global teams simple, fast, and cost\-effective. Teamified has hundreds of clients with more than 200 engineers, testers, product managers,


designers, and technology experts delivering impactful solutions every day.

**About The Role**


As a Principal Software Engineer at Rosterfy, you are the most senior individual contributor in the engineering team, responsible for setting technical direction while staying deeply hands\-on. You work across our two product squads as a force multiplier: designing architecture, pairing on hard problems, and unblocking delivery on critical initiatives. Reporting to the HoE, you connect product strategy to implementation detail, ensuring the client’s v3 (event\-driven, domain\-driven, AI\-augmented) is robust, scalable, and maintainable across our PHP/Laravel backend, Next.js frontend, and AWS/GCP infrastructure. You spend a significant portion of your time building (coding, reviewing, debugging, pairing) while also shaping engineering standards, architecture, and long\-term platform evolution. You do not manage people directly; instead, you lead through technical excellence, influence, and mentoring.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Own the architecture and technical direction for core platform domains used by both squads (e.g. event\-driven workflows, modular boundaries, AI capabilities).
* Spend 60–80% of your time hands\-on: designing, coding, reviewing, pairing, and debugging in Laravel, Next.js and our cloud environments.
* Lead the technical discovery and delivery of high\-impact initiatives, especially those that cross team boundaries or require significant architectural change.
* Define, document, and evangelize architectural principles, coding standards, and patterns for scalable, resilient, observable systems.
* Raise the bar for quality: champion shift\-left testing, CI/CD improvements, and production observability; model best practices in test design and validation.
* Mentor senior and mid\-level engineers through design reviews, pairing, and feedback, helping them own systems end\-to\-end rather than taking work away.
* Evaluate and prototype emerging technologies (e.g. Vertex AI, GenAI workflows, data pipelines) and guide pragmatic adoption into product and platform.
* Act as a senior engineering voice in roadmap planning, estimation and trade\-off decisions, ensuring technical health is represented alongside product goals
* Works across both product squads rather than being embedded in one team, focusing on cross\-cutting systems and the hardest technical problems.
* Partners with the Engineering Leadership on long\-term architecture and with Tech Leads on execution and engineering practices.

**Technical**

* 8\+ years in software engineering, including experience as a staff/principal engineer or architect in a SaaS company
* Deep expertise in backend engineering with Laravel (Laravel 10\+ and PHP 8\+) or similar languages, SQL/relational databases, caching, and RESTful APIs
* Strong frontend design and architectural experience with React/Next.js
* Experience working with scalable, secure cloud infrastructure (AWS required, \& CGP)
* Familiarity with event\-driven or modular architectures and containerized environments (e.g., EKS/Kubernetes)
* Deep understanding of software testing strategies and CI/CD pipelines
* Bonus: experience with Looker, BigQuery, ML pipelines, or distributed system performance tuning
* Bonus: Agent AI Architecture

**AI Driven Skills**

* Feature delivery velocity (Copilot, Gemini, test automation, scaffolding)
* Building AI\-augmented product experiences (LLM API usage, prompt design)
* Coaching others on integrating GenAI into workflows

**Character \& Mindset**

* Resilient and adaptable – You embrace change and help others navigate ambiguity with calm and confidence.
* Proactive problem solver – You identify issues early, take ownership, and push solutions forward without waiting to be asked.
* Clear communicator – You articulate ideas clearly, write well, and listen with intent. You create shared understanding.
* Product\-minded – You’re curious about customer needs, ask “why?”, and advocate for solutions that deliver real value.
* Leads through influence – You raise the bar by mentoring others, setting standards, and sharing knowledge — not by authority.
* Documentation\-first thinker – You value written clarity, and help your team by documenting decisions, code, and processes.

**Shift\-Left QA Expectation**

* Lead by example in test strategy and validation
* Own test coverage, pipeline health, and regression control

**Success Measures**

* Enables long\-term scalability and stability through architectural design
* Mentors and unblocks engineers across teams, raising overall technical quality
* Drives alignment on technical priorities and engineering direction
* Trusted advisor to Product sharing functional knowledge
* Proactively identifies and resolves system\-level challenges
* Supports successful implementation of new platform capabilities (e.g., AI readiness, multi\-cloud architecture)

**Nice to have:**

* Experience with data products like Looker, BigQuery, or analytics pipelines
* Exposure to event\-driven systems, asynchronous workflows, or message
* queues (e.g. AWS SQS, Kafka, Pub/Sub)
* Experience with design systems \| frontend architecture
* Passionate about product quality and customer experience
* Experience with platform engineering or building shared infrastructure in modular monoliths
* Any exposure to AI driven tooling, systems

**Benefits**

* Flexibility in work hours and location, with a focus on managing energy rather than time.
* Access to online learning platforms and a budget for professional development
* A collaborative, no\-silos environment, encouraging learning and growth across teams
* A dynamic social culture with team lunches, social events, and opportunities for creative input
* Health insurance
* Leave Benefits
* Provident Fund
* Gratuity


If you possess the required skills and are eager to contribute to our team's success, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity. **Apply now!**

title: Data Platform Consultant (DBT)
description:
### **Description**

  

**The headlines...**  

  

**Immediate Joiners Preferred**  

**Location** \- Hybrid in our central Pune office  

  

**A few application tips…**  

  

We want to help you put your best foot forward. Here are a few things we look for:* Clear, specific examples of your work and impact
* Relevant experience aligned with the role’s focus
* A thoughtful response to any application questions
* A resume that highlights both what you did and why it mattered

If you’re unsure whether your background is the “perfect fit,” we still encourage you to apply. We value potential and growth just as much as experience.  

  

**Why this role exists…**  

This role is designed to strengthen our delivery capability across our most strategic accounts in industries like Consumer Goods, Financial Services and Energy.  

As the demand for data and AI\-driven transformation grows, so does the need for structured, proactive project leadership. At Snap Analytics, we help clients unlock the full potential of their data, and we’re scaling fast**.**  

  

We’re building DBT capability on a project. As a small, agile organisation, we’re investing in people who can help us deliver quickly and grow our competency in India with support from UK colleagues. You’ll have clear impact from day one and room to move across projects as you develop.### **What you’ll be doing…**

  

You’ll play a central role in designing and delivering data transformations that power a high‑visibility project. You’ll work closely with project leads, project managers, and senior engineers to ship quality outcomes with increasing autonomy.  

  

**Your responsibilities will include:**
* **Data Modelling:** Design, develop, and maintain complex data models using dbt Core to support various business functions.
* **Pipeline Optimization:** Build and manage scalable data transformation pipelines within Snowflake, ensuring high performance and cost\-efficiency.
* **Code Quality:** Implement software engineering best practices in the data stack, including version control (Git), modularity, and CI/CD.
* **Testing \& Documentation:** Ensure data integrity by writing robust dbt tests and maintaining comprehensive documentation via dbt docs.
* **Performance Tuning:** Optimize Snowflake compute and storage by managing clustering keys, materialized views, and efficient SQL querying.
* **Stakeholder Collaboration:** Work closely with Data Analysts and Business Leads to translate business requirements into technical data schemas.

**In your first 3–6 months, success might look like:*** Delivering the majority of your assigned work independently, to a high standard (quality \+ on‑time)
* Demonstrating holistic project understanding \- how your work fits the wider data flow and business goals
* Building healthy working relationships across the India team and, over time, with UK stakeholders

  

### **What you’ll need to succeed…**

  

We’re looking for someone who brings a mix of experience, curiosity, and collaboration.  

  

**You might be a great fit if you have:**
* **2 years’ experience** in dbt Core, including macros, packages (like dbt\-utils), and Jinja templating (we’re not considering freshers for this role)
* Strong **SQL** fundamentals and practical exposure to **DBT**
* Deep understanding of Snowflake\-specific features such as Tasks, Streams, Snowpipe, and Zero\-copy cloning.
* Familiarity with **Git/Bitbucket** and awareness of **CI/CD** concepts (nice to have)
* **Clear communication \-** you can articulate your thinking to technical and non‑technical partners
* **A** **learning mindset**: proactive, curious, and willing to work “a notch above” expectations (automation, generalising code, improving process)
* **Transparency** and ownership \- comfortable asking for help early and taking accountability for outcomes

**This role might not be the right fit if you’re looking for:*** Highly siloed work with very narrow task scopes (we value holistic project thinking)
* Constant step‑by‑step guidance (we expect growing autonomy and initiative)

  

### **Why choose Snap**

  

* **Impact from day one** on a new, high‑visibility project
* **Growth in a small, agile company** with opportunities to rotate across projects as you develop
* **Supportive team culture \-** mentorship from seniors, collaboration with India \& UK colleagues, open feedback and help‑seeking encouraged

### **About Snap Analytics**


We're a high\-growth data analytics consultancy on a mission to help enterprise businesses unlock the full potential of their data. With offices in the UK, India, and South Africa, we specialise in cutting\-edge cloud analytics solutions, transforming complex data challenges into actionable business insights.  

  

We partner with some of the biggest brands worldwide to modernise their data platforms, enabling smarter decision\-making through Snowflake, Databricks, Matillion, and other cloud technologies. Our approach is customer\-first, innovation\-driven, and results\-focused, delivering impactful solutions with speed and precision.  

  

At Snap, we’re not just consultants, we’re problem\-solvers, engineers, and strategists who thrive on tackling complex data challenges. Our culture is built on collaboration, continuous learning, and pushing boundaries, ensuring our people grow just as fast as our business.  

  

Join us and be part of a team that’s shaping the future of data analytics!
