title: Customer Success Manager-Deputy Manager-Bangalore
description:
**Who we are**
--------------



VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology \& Transformation.
  

As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next\-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry\-first model which brings together the best of in\-house and 3rd party capability.
  

We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
  

\#VOIS \#BeUnrivalled \#CreateTheFuture

**About this Role**
-------------------



We are seeking a Customer Success professional who will manage long\-term relationships with international enterprise customers, ensuring retention, satisfaction, and service adoption. This role focuses on delivering an exceptional customer experience by overseeing service performance, driving improvements, resolving escalations, and guiding customers across connectivity, cloud, cybersecurity, IoT, SD\-WAN and other telecom services. The individual will be responsible for customer engagement across multiple global regions, support contract commitments, and contribute to financial performance through commercial awareness and service optimisation.

**What you’ll do**
------------------


* Drive customer satisfaction, retention and experience, ensuring high Net Promoter Scores (NPS).
* Manage end\-to\-end relationships with global enterprise customers across multiple regions and segments including multinational corporations and public sector organisations.
* Act as the primary point of contact for all service\-related discussions with senior customer decision\-makers.
* Oversee contract management, ensuring operational and enabling teams meet all obligations.
* Analyse service performance, identify gaps, and drive continuous service improvements.
* Lead monthly and quarterly customer service reviews, maintaining documentation and follow\-up actions.
* Manage service lifecycle across sell–build–run phases.Guide various service and delivery teams in resolving escalations outside business\-as\-usual processes.
* Maintain accurate customer and service inventories, updating reports and dashboards as required.
* Identify opportunities for cross\-selling, upselling, and plugging revenue leakages.
* Support delivery teams in clearing on\-hold orders and coordinating with cross‑functional teams.
* Champion digitalisation by identifying areas where manual reporting can be automated.
* Mentor and provide guidance to service management analysts.
**Who you are**
---------------


* Experienced in customer‑facing international Customer Success roles (4\+ years).
* Skilled in telecom products such as Fixed Line, Mobility, Cybersecurity, SD\-WAN, IoT, SaaS, MPN, Cloud and Unified Communications.
* ITIL 4 certified with strong understanding of service lifecycle management.
* An effective communicator able to engage confidently with senior customer stakeholders.
* Technically sound in networking fundamentals (SDH, DWDM, MPLS, LAN/WAN, Internet, Fixed Voice, SD\-WAN).
* A collaborative influencer who can work across global teams and resolve conflicts.
* Commercially aware with the ability to interpret P\&L statements.
* Proficient in data analysis to identify trends and enable decision\-making.Adaptable, resilient, and comfortable in dynamic customer environments.
* Knowledge of automation tools such as Power BI, SQL or Python is beneficial.
* Able to mentor others and demonstrate accountability, critical thinking, and strong organisational skills.
**Not a perfect fit?**
----------------------



Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.

**What's in it for you**
------------------------


* Opportunity to work with global enterprise customers and develop deep expertise across telecom and digital services.
* Exposure to senior\-level stakeholder management and strategic customer engagement.
* Experience in contract governance, service reviews, and P\&L\-linked decision\-making.
* Involvement in digital transformation initiatives and modernisation of service reporting.
* Growth through collaboration with cross\-functional teams across multiple countries.
**What skills you will learn**
------------------------------


* Advanced customer success strategies for global enterprise environments.
* Enhanced technical understanding of evolving telecom technologies and digital solutions.
* Strong commercial acumen through hands\-on exposure to financial analysis and P\&L impact.
* Leadership and stakeholder management across diverse geographies.
* Analytical, data\-driven decision\-making and dashboard streamlining using automation tools.

title: Learning & Development Operations
description:
Job Description
**About Persistent**

  

We are an AI\-led, platform\-driven Digital Engineering and Enterprise Modernization partner, combining deep technical expertise and industry experience to help our clients anticipate what’s next. Our offerings and proven solutions create a unique competitive advantage for our clients by giving them the power to see beyond and rise above. We work with many industry\-leading organizations across the world, including 20 Fortune 50 companies and 4 of the 5 top banks in both the US and India, and numerous innovators across the healthcare ecosystem.

  

Our disruptor’s mindset, commitment to client success, and agility to thrive in the dynamic environment have enabled us to sustain our growth momentum. Persistent has been recognized across top industry platforms for innovation, leadership, and inclusion. We reported $1,654\.4M FY26 revenue with 17\.4% Y\-o\-Y growth. We have delivered 24 sequential quarters of growth with $436\.0M in Q4 FY26 revenue, up 3\.2% Q\-o\-Q and 16\.2% Y\-o\-Y growth. Our 27,500\+ global team members, located in 18 countries, have been instrumental in helping the market leaders transform their industries. We have been recognized as the Fastest Growing IT Services Brand Globally in the 2026 Brand Finance IT Services 25 Report. We named a Leader in the Everest Group Private Equity (PE) Services PEAK Matrix*®* Assessment 2026 and Software Product Engineering PEAK Matrix*®* Assessment 2026\.

 **About Position:**

  

To execute training operations for either training or assessment offering types, including creation of schedules, trainer interactions, logistics arrangement and feedback collection. The candidate should possess strong MS Excel skills for maintaining reports and tracking training\-related data, effective communication skills to coordinate with stakeholders, trainers, and participants, and good analytical ability to manage queries, interpret feedback, and support smooth execution of training and assessment operations.

* **Role: Learning \& Development Operations**
* **Location: Pune**
* **Experience: 6 to 12 years**
* **Job Type: Full Time Employment**

 **What You'll Do:**

  

* Stakeholder Management: Should interact with training requestors to collect training requirements. Should coordinate/interact with internal/external trainers for training schedule. Should facilitate the evaluation calls/meetings between internal SMEs and external trainers, if required. Should ensure that all internal customer / stakeholder queries are addressed and closed in a timely fashion. In case of assessment operations, should co\-ordinate with all internal/external trainers and assessment requestors for creating questions, review and evaluation of assessments and scheduling the same.
* Training/ Assessment Planning: Should manage the scheduling in the system as per the calendar planned by the Operations Manager and/or Lead. Should ensure logistics including room booking, virtual machine management, and any other learning material requirements, are taken care of for any training/assessments allocated. Should ensure that training/assessments are scheduled as per SLA.
* Training Execution \- Nomination tracking: Should keep track of nomination data and ensure that the minimum quorum for any training is met. Should continuously follow up with the relevant grades by sending out nuggets/mailers to increase nominations. Should send mailers to employees who have a particular training mapped as part of their Individual Learning Plan. In case of low nominations, should communicate the same to the management and implement the decisions given.
* Assessment Execution: For each assessment event, handle the following event logistics: \- Should send mailers to employees providing venue and other test details. Ensure that all assessments start and end at the stipulated time, and that all invigilators are performing their assigned duties properly. Ensure that subjective assignments are uploaded on server, and a backup is maintained for future use. Handle queries (at first level) from assessment participants and redirect them to respective POCs if required. Ensure that all queries are taken to a logical closure.
* Training Execution \- Logistics: Should manage end\-to\-end execution on the day of training. Should kickstart training sessions with a short introduction to set participant expectations and address any queries that may arise. Should manage last\-minute cancellations, in unavoidable situations. Should maintain attendance records for all training courses executed.
* Training/Assessment Execution \- Feedback: Should ensure that desired feedback is obtained for any particular training/ assessments. Should take corrective action based on feedback and inform the respective candidate. Should follow up with participants for submitting feedback in the system. Should collate manager (of participant) feedback for quarterly project request surveys.
* Reports: Should maintain and update reports for all training transactions on a daily basis. Should update the same on a timely basis. Should log and maintain various status reports for different offerings. Should address any adhoc queries for reports arising from management and any other internal stakeholders.

 **Expertise You'll Bring:**

  

* Experience in Learning \& Development operations, including training coordination, scheduling, logistics, participant communication, feedback collection, and post\-training support.
* Ability to manage multiple training and assessment programs while coordinating effectively with stakeholders, trainers, participants, and internal teams.
* Proactive and detail\-oriented, with strong ownership, a learning mindset, and the ability to support process improvements and deliver a positive learner experience.

 **Benefits:**

  

* Competitive salary and benefits package
* Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company\-sponsored higher education and certifications
* Opportunity to work with cutting\-edge technologies
* Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards
* Annual health check\-ups
* Insurance coverage: group term life, personal accident, and Mediclaim hospitalization for self, spouse, two children, and parents

Persistent is dedicated to fostering diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We invite applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities, and regardless of gender or gender preference. We welcome diverse candidates from all backgrounds.

**Role Overview** 




  





 The Manager – Member Engagement \& Experience will lead member engagement and experience initiatives for CPA Australia in India, with a focus on creating meaningful connections and delivering ongoing value to members.
 



  





 The role will develop and execute programmes, events, thought leadership and other engagement initiatives that strengthen members’ connection with CPA Australia throughout their membership journey.
 



  





 The role will also develop a strong understanding of member needs and insights, using these to continually enhance the member experience and shape relevant initiatives for the India market.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Member Engagement \& Experience** 




  




* Develop and execute initiatives that strengthen member engagement, connection and the overall member experience.
* Build meaningful relationships with members and understand their needs, expectations and interests.
* Identify opportunities to enhance the value and relevance of CPA Australia membership.
* Develop initiatives that encourage greater member participation, connection and advocacy.
* Engage with members at different stages of their membership journey and ensure a consistent and positive experience.



  





**Member Programmes, Events \& Thought Leadership** 




  




* Plan and deliver relevant member events, programmes and engagement activities across India.
* Develop opportunities for members to connect with peers, industry leaders and the broader CPA Australia community.
* Support the delivery of thought leadership, professional development and networking initiatives that are relevant to members.
* Work with internal teams and external stakeholders to ensure high\-quality execution and member participation.
* Ensure effective communication and follow\-up before and after member activities.



  





**Member Insights \& Experience Improvement** 




  




* Develop a strong understanding of the India member community, including member needs, interests and engagement patterns.
* Gather and use member feedback and insights to identify opportunities to improve the member experience.
* Identify emerging trends and opportunities to enhance member value and engagement.
* Share member insights with relevant stakeholders to inform future programmes, services and initiatives.



  





**Stakeholder Collaboration** 




  




* Work closely with India and CPA Australia teams across membership, marketing, communications, events and other relevant functions.
* Build effective relationships with internal and external stakeholders to deliver member initiatives.
* Coordinate multiple initiatives and ensure timely and effective delivery across markets.



  





**Key Skills \& Experience** 




  




* 8–10 years of experience in
 **member engagement, customer experience, relationship management, membership organisations, events or a related field** 
 .
* Strong relationship\-building and interpersonal skills, with a genuine member/customer\-centric approach.
* Demonstrated ability to develop and execute engaging programmes, events or experiences.
* Excellent communication, presentation and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Strong organisational and project\-management capabilities, with attention to detail.
* Ability to understand customer/member insights and translate them into meaningful initiatives.
* Proactive, creative and solutions\-oriented, with the ability to identify new ways of engaging members.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across teams.
* Experience in a professional association, membership organisation, professional services or education environment would be an advantage.

title: Assistant Manager / Manager – Corporate Sales Hospitality sector
description:
**Location:** 
 New Delhi
 



**Industry:** 
 Hospitality / Leisure
 



  





**Experience:** 
 5\+ years in Hospitality Sales
 **(Mandatory)** 




**Education:** 
 Graduate or above
 



**CTC:** 
 ₹7\.20LPA – ₹9\.60LPA
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We are looking for experienced, energetic Corporate \& MICE Sales professionals to drive corporate and group revenue across a portfolio of leisure properties owned by our Client. This is not a conventional city\-hotel corporate sales role. You will be selling leisure destinations as corporate offsite, retreat, conference, and incentive\-travel venues to Delhi\-NCR corporates. This means engaging with a different set of decision\-makers — including HR, Administration, CXO offices, corporate event teams, and MICE agencies — and developing long\-term relationships that generate group and corporate business.
 



  





**What You'll Be Responsible For** 




 Corporate Account Management
 


* Identify, prospect, pitch, and close corporate accounts across Delhi\-NCR.
* Generate business for individual corporate travel as well as offsites, retreats, and group bookings.
* Negotiate and manage corporate rate agreements and annual contracts.
* Build, maintain, and grow relationships with existing corporate clients and travel agents.



 MICE \& Group Sales
 


* Drive revenue from conferences, incentive travel, corporate retreats, and group bookings.
* Respond to and manage RFPs, proposals, negotiations, and group contracts.
* Build strong relationships with MICE agencies, event planners, and corporate HR/Admin teams.
* Work closely with property operations, banquet, and F\&B teams to convert enquiries into confirmed events and ensure smooth execution.



 Business Development
 


* Conduct regular sales calls, client meetings, and property/site visits.
* Represent the company at trade shows, networking events, and industry platforms.
* Organize FAM trips and client entertainment to strengthen relationships and showcase properties.
* Develop new corporate and MICE accounts and expand the existing market.



 Sales Performance \& Reporting
 


* Maintain an active sales pipeline and track opportunities through to conversion.
* Monitor revenue, conversion, and achievement against sales targets.
* Provide regular daily/monthly sales reports and business updates to the Senior General Manager – Sales.



  





 You won't simply be selling hotel room nights.
 



 You'll be selling experiences and destinations — corporate retreats, offsites, conferences, incentive trips, and group experiences — to some of the most relevant corporate and MICE buyers in the Delhi\-NCR market.
 




 For the right candidate, this is also an opportunity to take on greater responsibility and grow toward a GM – Sales career path as the business expands.
 




  





**Requirements** 



* 5\+ years of experience in hospitality sales, preferably in corporate, MICE, group, or resort/leisure sales.
* Strong and demonstrable Delhi\-NCR corporate and/or MICE network.
* Existing relationships with corporate decision\-makers, event planners, MICE agencies, HR/Admin teams, and relevant travel partners.
* Proven experience handling RFPs, group contracts, negotiations, and corporate accounts.
* Strong understanding of hotel operations, particularly the coordination required between Sales, Operations, Banquets, and F\&B for group events.
* Understanding of how leisure/resort properties differ from city hotels in terms of the product, sales proposition, and buyer.
* Excellent communication, presentation, networking, and negotiation skills.
* Strong organizational and leadership abilities.
* Energetic, collaborative, relationship\-oriented, and highly results\-driven.
* Comfortable with a hands\-on, field\-sales approach, including regular client visits and site inspections.



  





**Benefits:** 



* Meals
* Medical Insurance
* Performance Bonus

title: Associate (CCA) - Customer CoE
description:
**About us**


Bain \& Company is a global management consulting that helps the world’s most ambitious change makers define the future. Across 65 offices in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperform the competition and redefine industries. Since our founding in 1973, we have measured our success by the success of our clients, and we proudly maintain the highest level of client advocacy in the industry.


In 2004, the firm established its presence in the Indian market by opening the Bain Capability Center (BCC) in New Delhi. The BCC is now known as BCN (Bain Capability Network) with its nodes across various geographies. BCN is an integral and largest unit of (ECD) Expert Client Delivery. ECD plays a critical role as it adds value to Bain's case teams globally by supporting them with analytics and research solutioning across all industries, specific domains for corporate cases, client development, private equity diligence or Bain intellectual property. The BCN comprises of Consulting Services, Knowledge Services and Shared Services.

  

  

**Who you will work with**


The CoE enhances Bain’s global Customer practice by delivering expertise, speed, and competitive advantage. It co\-develops client pitch decks, consulting IP, and Go\-to\-Market solutions, while delivering projets that help clients unlock value across the full sales value chain and customer journey


Our fast\-paced, innovative environment emphasizes continuous learning and problem\-solving. We offer strong professional development and a global experience, enabling collaboration with experts and clients worldwide.

  

  

**Position Summary**  

  



This role plays a critical role in driving proposal and client development efforts by partnering with Bain’s leadership, Customer practice (Customer experience Transformation), and subject\-matter experts. You will lead high\-level discussions with senior stakeholders, bringing strong structured problem\-solving, clear points of view, and persuasive storytelling to ambiguous or open\-ended commercial situations.

**mea** 




  





 At mea, our mission is to make customers’ lives easier by delivering insurance specific technology that just works. We’re building an intelligent operating layer for the insurance industry—combining a domain\-specific language model (dsLM) with an insurance knowledge graph to automate workflows end\-to\-end and deliver operational impact from day one.
 



  





 Founded in 2021 and bootstrapped to 4 straight years of profitability, mea raised $50 million from SEP in February 2026 and now serves clients across 21 countries. We are a fully remote global team of over 100 insurance veterans and technologists, spanning the UK, US, India, continental Europe, and the Middle East. With the future for innovation in insurance looking more positive than it ever has before, you will be joining us at a moment in time where what we build now will define the next era of insurance operations.
 



  





**Senior Support Engineer** 




  





**Job Overview** 




  





 At mea platform, we have an opening for Senior Support Engineer, he/she will have the chance to work alongside tech and operations team to help troubleshoot and optimize the platform. The individual should have a problem\-solving and technical mindset and should be open to learning about our platform capabilities, tech stack, SQL, security operations, cloud security (AWS), and compliance requirements.
 



  





**Key responsibilities** 




  




* Understand our Product, its AI modules, and cloud\-based services.
* Act as a bridge between the tech and client solutions team, escalating and resolving technical issues efficiently.
* Provide hands\-on troubleshooting and debugging support related challenges.
* Work with developers to identify performance bottlenecks and recommend optimizations.
* Assist in incident management, system monitoring, and root cause analysis.
* Support CI/CD workflows, deployments, and cloud infrastructure maintenance.
* Create internal documentation, knowledge bases, and best practices for the team.
* Stay updated with new technologies and proactively suggest improvements.



  





**Education and Skills** 




  




* Minimum of 5\+ years of industry experience is required.
* B.Tech/B.Sc. in Computer Science.
* Detail\-oriented with a strong focus on accuracy and quality, ability to work independently and as part of a team alongside developers.
* Willing to skill up on tech stack, web development and AWS. Familiarity with Git/GitHub for tracking changes in code.
* Exposure to SQL (MySQL, PostgreSQL)
* Ability to diagnose and troubleshoot technical issues effectively.
* A logical mindset to break down complex problems into simpler parts.

 Competitive salary
 



 Medical Insurance
 



 Paid holidays

 As a
 **Akeneo Support** 
 , you are passionate about experience innovation and eager to push the boundaries of what’s possible. You bring
 **6\+ Years** 
 of experience, a growth mindset and a drive to make a lasting impact.
   

  

**You Will Thrive In This Role If You Are:**
* A curious problem solver who challenges the status quo
* A collaborator who values teamwork and knowledge\-sharing
* Excited by the intersection of technology, creativity and data
* Experienced in Agile methodologies and consulting (a plus)
* Role Responsibilities
* Experience Level: 6\+ Years


 Primary Technology: Akeneo PIM \- hands\-on experience in identifying and resolving PIM contribution/data issues
   

  

**Secondary Technology:** 
 Salesforce B2C Commerce (SFB2C) — hands\-on experience in identifying and resolving storefront/data reflection issues
   

  

 (Both skills require actual hands\-on issue resolution experience, not just conceptual/functional familiarity.)
   

  

**Good to have:** 
 MuleSoft, Content Management Systems (e.g., Oracle Commerce Business Control Center (BCC)), Oracle SQL
   

  

****Role Overview:****
 We are looking for an experienced L2 Support Engineer for a rotational support team, responsible for hands\-on troubleshooting of issues across both Akeneo PIM and Salesforce B2C Commerce (SFB2C) — analyzing problems from the point of PIM data contribution through to final data reflection on the storefront.
 **Key Responsibilities**
 Hands\-on troubleshooting of Akeneo PIM issues — data contribution errors, workflow failures, enrichment/export issues
   

  

 Hands\-on troubleshooting of SFB2C issues — data ingestion, catalog sync, storefront display/reflection issues
   

  

 Analyze end\-to\-end data flow — from PIM contribution through integration/middleware until data reflects correctly on the SFB2C storefront
   

  

 Perform root cause analysis (RCA) across both systems for recurring or complex data issues
   

  

 Collaborate with L1/L3 teams and cross\-functional stakeholders to drive resolution within SLA
   

  

 Participate in 24/7 rotational on\-call/shift support
   

  

 Document known issues, fixes, and runbooks for the support knowledge base.
   

  

****Required Skills \& Experience****
 5\+ years of overall IT/technical support experience
   

  

 Hands\-on experience troubleshooting Akeneo PIM issues (catalog management, product enrichment, workflows, data export/import failures)
   

  

 Hands\-on experience troubleshooting SFB2C issues (storefront data sync, catalog feed issues, display/reflection problems)
   

  

 Ability to trace data flow issues end\-to\-end across PIM → integration/middleware → storefront
   

  

 Familiarity with API/integration troubleshooting (REST APIs, connectors, or middleware tools) — assumed relevant, confirm if applicable
   

  

 Strong analytical and RCA skills
   

  

 Willingness to work 24/7 rotational shifts
   

  

**Good to Have**
 Experience with e\-commerce data governance or catalog data quality processes
   

  

 Exposure to ticketing/ITSM tools (JIRA Service Management, ServiceNow, etc.)
   

  

 Basic scripting/SQL knowledge for data validation
   

  

****Soft Skills****
 Strong communication skills to interface with client/stakeholder teams
   

  

 Ownership mindset for issue resolution until closure
   

  

 Ability to work independently in a rotational shift environment
   

  

**Scope Of Work:**
 ) L2 Incident Resolution: Manage daily tickets in the support queue, including initial analysis, implementing workarounds, and ensuring timely acknowledgment and resolution within established Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
   

  

* Troubleshooting \& Diagnosis: Resolve advanced technical issues escalated from L1 support, conducting in\-depth troubleshooting and diagnosing complex problems across SFCC, PWA, and associated commerce applications. This includes analyzing application logs, errors, and alerts.


 Client Interaction: Serve as a primary technical contact for clients, providing clear and timely communication on incident status, resolution plans, and technical explanations.
   

  

 War Room Leadership: Lead and actively participate in "War Room" situations during critical outages or incidents, coordinating efforts with cross\-functional teams (development, QA, L2, DevOps, client) to drive rapid resolution. High reactivity and availability are key during these times.
   

  

 On\-Call Support: Provide dedicated on\-call support outside of standard business hours on a rotational basis to ensure 24/7 coverage for critical incidents. This is not shift\-based, but rather dedicated on\-call availability.
   

  

 Knowledge Management: Create and maintain comprehensive documentation, knowledge base articles, runbooks, and troubleshooting guides to empower L1/L2 teams and improve incident resolution efficiency.
   

  

 Collaboration: Work closely with development, QA, and DevOps teams to escalate complex issues, provide insights for permanent fixes, and support new feature deployments or platform upgrades.
   

  

 If you do not meet all the listed qualifications or have gaps in your experience, we still encourage you to apply. At Valtech, we recognize that talent comes in many forms, and we value diverse perspectives and a willingness to learn.
   

  

 Commitment to reaching all kinds of people

 position based in

title: Technical Engineer
description:
Why Valtech? We’re the experience innovation company \- a trusted partner to the world’s most recognized brands. To our people we offer growth opportunities, a values\-driven culture, international careers and the chance to shape the future of experience.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 At Valtech, you’ll find an environment designed for continuous learning, meaningful impact, and professional growth. Whether you're pioneering new digital solutions, challenging conventional thinking or building the next generation of customer experiences, your work will help transform industries.
   

  

**We Are Proud Of**
* The work we do and the innovation we drive
* Our values of share, care and dare
* A workplace culture that fosters creativity, diversity and autonomy
* Our borderless, global framework, which enables seamless collaboration


**The role**
 As a
 **Technical Engineer** 
 , you are passionate about experience innovation and eager to push the boundaries of what’s possible. You bring
 **6\+** 
 of experience, a growth mindset and a drive to make a lasting impact.
   

  

**You Will Thrive In This Role If You Are**
* A curious problem solver who challenges the status quo
* A collaborator who values teamwork and knowledge\-sharing
* Excited by the intersection of technology, creativity and data
* Experienced in Agile methodologies and consulting (a plus)


**Role Responsibilities**
 Provide day\-to\-day service management for real\-time fraud detection and the bank's centralised audit database, required for SOX compliance.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Subject Matter Expertise \- Develop deep working knowledge of Banks (Retail \& Corporate) applications, their services, batch jobs, and integration points.
   

  

 Incident \& Problem Management \- Monitor and manage incidents in ServiceNow, ensuring timely triage, escalation, and resolution across both platforms.
   

  

 Proactive Monitoring \- Oversee Pre\-Production and Production environments during working hours using Dynatrace, Kibana, and other monitoring tools to catch issues early.
   

  

 Drive Best Practices \- Apply ITIL Service Management principles to continuously improve incident, problem, and change processes.
   

  

 Out\-of\-Hours Support \- Participate in planned out of hours patching and change activities (\~2\-3 times per month), coordinating with Unix, DBA, and infrastructure teams to minimise disruption.
   

  

 Obsolescence \& Migration Support \- Contribute to strategic infrastructure programmes including:
   

  

* Application replatforming from RHEL 7\.9 to RHEL 9 and removal of legacy clustering
* General obsolescence such as RHEL 7\.9\-\> 8 updates or RabbitMQ/IBM MQ upgrades


**Must Have Qualifications**
 To be considered for this role, you must meet the following essential qualifications:
   

  

* IT Service Management experience in financial services or a regulated environment
* Strong ITIL knowledge (Incident, Problem, Change Management)
* ServiceNow experience
* Familiarity with Linux/RHEL and on\-premises hosting
* Comfortable with periodic and planned out\-of\-hours working
* Strong stakeholder management across multiple technical teams


**Nice To Have Qualifications**
* Elasticsearch, Kibana, Dynatrace, or equivalent monitoring tools
* Message queue technologies (IBM MQ, RabbitMQ)
* Batch scheduling (Control\-M)
* Mainframe technologies (DB2 z/OS) or mainframe migration experience
* Oracle Exadata / Oracle databases
* SOX compliance and audit controls
* Fraud detection/prevention domain knowledge


**If you do not meet all the listed qualifications or have gaps in your experience, we still encourage you to apply. At Valtech, we recognize that talent comes in many forms, and we value diverse perspectives and a willingness to learn.**
**Commitment to reaching all kinds of people**
 We design experiences that work for all kinds of people \- and that starts with our own teams. At Valtech, we’re intentional about building an inclusive culture where everyone feels supported to grow, thrive and achieve their goals. No matter your background, you belong here. Explore our Diversity \& Inclusion site to see how we’re creating a more equitable Valtech for all.
   

  

**The Benefits**
 This is a fulltime position based in
 **Bengaluru** 
 .
   

  

**Beyond a Competitive Compensation Package, We Offer**
* Flexibility, with remote and hybrid work options (country\-dependent)
* Career advancement, with international mobility and professional development programs
* Learning and development, with access to cutting\-edge tools, training and industry experts


 Our benefits are tailored to each location. Your Talent Partner will provide full details during the hiring process.
   

  

**Your application process**
 Once you apply, our Talent Acquisition team will review your application. Your CV should cover key information on relevant experiences and expertise. We do not require information such as age, gender, marital status, or a headshot in your application. We review all candidates based on skills, experience, and potential.
   

  

 ⚠️ Beware of recruitment fraud! Only engage with official Valtech email addresses ending in
 **@valtech.com** 
 .
   

  

 We are committed to inclusion and accessibility. If you need reasonable accommodations during the interview process, please either indicate it in your application or let your Talent Partner know.
   

  

**About Valtech**
 Valtech is the experience innovation company that exists to unlock a better way to experience the world. By blending crafts, categories, and cultures, we help brands unlock new value in an increasingly digital world.
   

  

 At the intersection of data, AI, creativity, and technology, we drive transformation for leading organizations, including L’Oréal, Mars, Audi, P\&G, Volkswagen Dolby, and more.
   

  

 At Valtech, we don’t just talk about transformation. We make it happen. Our people are the heart of our success, and we foster a workplace where everyone has the support to thrive, grow and innovate.
   

  

 Are you ready to create what’s next? Join us.

title: ITSM Administrator/Developer
description:
Be an essential element to a brighter future.
   

  

 We work together to transform essential resources into critical ingredients for mobility, energy, connectivity and health. Join our values\-led organization committed to building a more resilient world with people and planet in mind. Our core values are the foundation that make us successful for ourselves, our customers and the planet.
   

  

**Job Description**
**The Role**
 The Freshservice Developer \& Administrator owns the configuration, automation, integration, and day\-to\-day administration of Albemarle's enterprise ITSM platform. Following the transition of Service Management from ServiceNow to Freshworks — this role is central to sustaining and scaling the platform across IT and business workspaces (HR, Facilities, Supply Chain, Finance, Procurement, Manufacturing \& Engineering, Accounts Payable etc).
   

  

**The Role Blends Two Hats**
* Administrator — configuring, securing, and maintaining the workspace and account environment so agents have the right access, tools, and workflows to deliver service.
* Developer — designing, building, testing, and promoting automations within the federated "DEV\-to\-PROD" governance model, where individual IT teams build in a controlled DEV environment and a central team governs, reviews, and promotes to production.


 It supports Albemarle's broader strategic direction of Digital Transformation through automation as the foundation for AI\-driven processes, including Freshservice as the "front door" to HR and other functions.
   

  

**Key Skill Set**
**Platform \& Administration**
* Deep hands\-on Freshservice administration across both Workspace Admin and Account Admin scopes — branding, business hours, SLAs/OLAs, service catalog, field/form management, and RBAC (custom roles and permissions).
* Command of core ITSM modules: Incident, Major Incident, Problem, Change (normal/emergency/expedited), Release, Service Request, Asset/ITAM, and Alert Management.
* CMDB / Configuration Management and Device42 integration (discovery, CI data accuracy, incident/change linkage).


**Automation \& Development**
* Expert in Workflow Automator, Scenario Automations, Supervisor rules, Scheduler, and orchestration/business rules.
* Ability to build well\-structured workflows — triggers, nested conditions, labelled branches, single\-action nodes, and error paths for external calls.


**Integrations \& APIs**
* Experience integrating Freshservice with Active Directory / Azure (Entra ID) orchestration via the Freshservice App \+ PowerShell, Workday Connector (RaaS\-based and event\-based onboarding/offboarding journeys), UiPath RPA, SAP, MS Exchange, SharePoint Search Connector, and BlueCoat.
* Familiarity with REST APIs, OAuth 2\.0 / API\-key / Basic auth, webhooks, and custom HTTP\-based flows; awareness of Copilot Studio and the Freshservice MCP Server for advanced/AI\-driven scenarios.
* Understanding of AI service agent integration (Aisera) for ticket create/update/close, KB ingestion, and Freddy AI capabilities.


**Governance, Knowledge \& Analytics**
* Analytics, dashboards, KPIs, SLA compliance reporting, and audit\-readiness.
* Comfort operating within a sandbox\-first approach — testing new configurations and major updates before syncing to production.


**Soft Skills**
 Process standardization mindset, cross\-functional collaboration (HR, IT, IAM, Security, Infrastructure), clear documentation, and stakeholder communication.
   

  

**What will you be doing?**
**Administration \& Configuration**
* Configure and maintain workspaces (branding, business hours, SLAs/OLAs, service catalogs, custom fields, forms, and templates) tailored to departmental needs.
* Manage agents, groups, roles, and RBAC; configure the Change Advisory Board (CAB) for change processes.
* Administer all Freshservice modules and monitor platform health, troubleshooting performance and proactively addressing risks.
* Review Freshworks biannual/product release notes, test updates in sandbox, re\-activate/republish affected configurations, and communicate changes to agents and end users.


**Development \& Automation**
* Design, build, and test automations in the DEV environment following the naming convention (Module – Trigger – Action), testing every condition branch and failure scenario before submission.
* Complete pre\-work documentation and DEV\-to\-PROD promotion checklists; submit via Freshservice change requests with test evidence for central\-team review.
* Own and maintain automations post\-production across their full lifecycle.


**Integrations**
* Build and support integrations for onboarding/offboarding (Workday → Freshservice Journeys), user/AD group provisioning, mailbox/distribution\-group management, RPA\-driven ticket automation, and CMDB sync with Device42\.
* Coordinate with IAM, IT Security, Infrastructure, HRIS, and vendor teams (Freshworks, Infosys, Aisera) to configure and validate integrations securely.


**Knowledge, Analytics \& Continuous Improvement**
* Build meaningful dashboards, KPIs, and SLA/analytics reports; drive process standardization, adoption, and automation opportunities.
* Configure Announcements for centralized service communication.


**Essential**
**Who you are:**
* 4–7\+ years in IT Service Management, with 2\+ years hands\-on Freshservice administration and/or development (Enterprise plan preferred). Prior ServiceNow experience is a strong plus given the migration context.
* Demonstrable experience configuring ITIL\-aligned processes: Incident, Problem, Change, Release, Request Fulfillment, Knowledge, and Configuration/Asset Management.
* Proven track record building automations in Workflow Automator (including approvals, multi\-step workflows, and external integrations).
* Scripting/integration experience — PowerShell for AD/Entra orchestration and REST API / OAuth\-based integrations (Workday, UiPath, SAP, Exchange, SharePoint).
* Working knowledge of CMDB/ITAM concepts and tools such as Device42\.


**Desirable**
* ITIL v4 Foundation certification; Freshservice/Freshworks Academy certifications (Fundamentals, Workflow Automator – Getting Started \& Advanced Logic, SR \& Catalogue Management, Reporting \& Audit Logs).
* Exposure to AI/GenAI service agents (Aisera, Freddy AI, Copilot Studio, MCP Server) and RAG\-based knowledge retrieval.
* Experience operating within a federated/governed automation model with DEV/PROD separation, change\-controlled promotions, and central review tiers.
* Strong documentation, stakeholder management, and cross\-functional collaboration skills in a global, multi\-vendor environment.


**Benefits Of Joining Albemarle**
* Competitive compensation
* Comprehensive benefits package
* A diverse array of resources to support you professionally and personally.


 We are partners to one another in pioneering new ways to be better for ourselves, our teams, and our communities. When you join Albemarle, you become our most essential element and you can anticipate competitive compensation, a comprehensive benefits package, and resources that foster your well\-being and fuel your personal growth. Help us shape the future, build with purpose and grow together.

The role focuses on Microsoft Intune administration, Windows Autopilot deployment, application packaging, device management, compliance monitoring, and automation. The successful candidate will be responsible for ensuring secure, compliant, and efficient endpoint operations while supporting Windows 10/11 lifecycle management.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Configure and manage Windows Autopilot profiles for Windows 11 deployments, including branding, device provisioning, and policy configuration.

* Manage device enrollment, retirement, lock, wipe, and lifecycle operations as part of Endpoint Security \& Device Management.
* Administer Windows update and patch deployment rings, monitor rollout success, track compliance, and remediate failed systems.
* Manage Device Certificates and support secure device authentication and access management.
* Utilize PowerShell / Automation capabilities to streamline endpoint administration, reporting, and operational tasks.
* Support Device Compliance initiatives by monitoring endpoint health, policy adherence, and organizational security standards.
* Investigate endpoint management, compliance, and patch\-related incidents, and coordinate resolution activities.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Position: Forward Deployed Engineer
   

  

 Location: Bangalore
   

  

 ️ Working Days: Monday to Friday
   

  

 Experience Required: 6 months to 1 years
   

  

 Forward Deployed Engineer \|
   

  

**Solving agent problems across the lifecycle — build, deployment, tuning and steady state — measured on what the agent achieves.**
**About The Role**
 We are hiring a Forward Deployed Engineer to solve agent problems wherever they occur in the lifecycle. During build, that means getting a configuration to actually do what the use case requires. Through deployment and tuning, it means finding why an agent underperforms and fixing it at the right layer. In steady state, it means holding an agent's numbers where they were promised and catching drift before a client does. The common thread is not a phase; it is that an agent is not performing and you are the person who makes it perform.
   

  

 Your scorecard is the agent's outcome metrics. Connectivity, engagement and the outcome rate the use case exists to move — per agent, per use case. Tickets closed, response times and patch counts are hygiene we will look at, never the measure. A month with forty tickets closed and a drifting outcome rate is a bad month; a month with four and every agent holding its numbers is a good one.
   

  

 This role sits in the application layer, not core platform. That has a consequence worth stating plainly: you are partly an SDE. A fix that only ever helps one client is the weakest version of your work. Because you hold more context than anyone on why agents fail in the field, you are expected to recognise when a recurring fix should become a platform capability every client can use, and then to build it — pairing with SDE 1 and SDE 2 to ship it properly.
   

  

 It is hands\-on and customer\-facing at once. You will read production code, logs, transcripts and configuration; reproduce faults; write and ship changes; and speak directly to a client's operations or IT counterpart about what went wrong and what you changed. An FDE who cannot form an independent technical opinion becomes a ticket router, and a ticket router cannot move an outcome metric.
   

  

 What you are walking into
   

  

 Several enterprise accounts are live on real customer timelines while the platform is under active build. Most of what changes customer\-visible behaviour here is not code — it is configuration: a prompt, a disposition taxonomy, a threshold, a routing rule — shipping through a thinner review path than code. And our worst defects are not escaped, they are undetected: a configuration fault once put a placeholder outcome on two thirds of one campaign's calls for about a month, and the client found it, not us. None of that should discourage you; all of it is why the role exists.
   

  

 What you are measured on
   

  

 One primary metric, four supporting ones. The supporting metrics explain a movement in the primary; they never substitute for it.
   

  

 Metric Definition, and how it can be gamed
   

  

**Agent Outcome Metrics (primary)**
 Connectivity, engagement and outcome rate per agent and use case, against the committed baseline. This is the scorecard. Counter\-metric: baselines are set once and not renegotiated downward after a bad month.
   

  

**Detection latency**
 Median time from a customer\-visible regression starting to someone at our client's knowing. A fault we find in an hour is an incident; the same fault found by a client in five weeks is an account risk.
   

  

**Root\-cause accuracy**
 Share of issues where the first fix held. Re\-opens mean a symptom was patched at the wrong layer. Counter\-metric: time to first response, so accuracy is not bought with indefinite investigation.
   

  

**Escalation precision**
 Share of items sent to core platform that were genuinely platform gaps, and share you resolved that never needed to go there. Both directions fail: over\-escalation taxes platform engineering, under\-escalation buries a real signal in patches.
   

  

**Reusability**
 Share of your fixes that became a configurable capability available to every client rather than a one\-account patch. A high patch count with zero productised output is a warning sign, not throughput.
   

  

 What you will do
   

  

* Own agent performance, wherever the agent is in its lifecycle. Hold a current picture of every agent you touch: what outcome it exists to move, what it is moving this week, and what changed. When a number drifts, find out why before the client asks. Where the instrumentation to see the drift does not exist, building it is your work, not the reason it was invisible.
* Diagnose at the right layer before you change anything. Almost every issue arrives as a symptom. Place it first: context assembly, disposition or configuration error, or broken integration. These have different fixes and different owners, and a patch at the wrong layer holds for a fortnight and returns in a new shape. Read the transcripts, logs and configuration, and state a root cause you can defend.
* Treat configuration as production. A change to a prompt, a disposition taxonomy or a threshold changes what a customer experiences with no deployment at all. It gets a review, a version and a rollback path exactly as code does. Where a configuration change cannot yet be governed that way, closing that gap is your work. This is the single strongest belief we screen for.
* Sustain the trust loop with the client. Test, flag, patch, retest — visibly, on a cadence the client can see, during UAT and long after. In our verticals confidence is rebuilt by watching us find and fix our own faults, not by an absence of faults. Changes touching live campaign behaviour go out staged and reversible.
* Ship the fix, and the instrumentation that would have caught it. Every fix carries a second question: how would we have known sooner? A meaningful share of your output should be monitoring, alerting and evaluation coverage that turns the next instance of that fault into an alert rather than a client email.
* Build features with the SDEs, not requests for them. When a fix generalises, you take it to SDE 1 and SDE 2 as a designed capability — the problem, the evidence across accounts, and a proposal for how it should work — and you pair on building it. You hold the field context they do not; they hold the codebase depth you may not. Where a change touches core platform, the CTO is consulted before it is built, not after.
* Be the technical face on live accounts. You will speak directly to a client's operations and IT counterparts: what broke, why, what you changed, when it is verified. The CSM owns the relationship; you own the technical truth inside it. Being plain about a fault we caused buys more trust than a clean\-sounding account of a bad week.


 Who you will work with
   

  

 Stakeholder Your relationship with them
 **Chief Product Officer** 
 Your manager. Owns the application layer this role sits in. Reviews agent outcome metrics, reusability and escalation precision.
 **Chief Technology Officer** 
 Owns core platform engineering. Consulted when a change reaches into the platform, and the escalation point for genuine architecture gaps.
 **SDE 1 and SDE 2** 
 Your build partners. You bring the field context and the problem definition; you ship the generalised capability together.
 **Associate Product Managers** 
 Owns the change train and intake. Your changes ship under that discipline; your recurring\-failure patterns tell the APM where defects cluster.
 **Customer Success / Account Managers** 
 Own the customer relationship. They bring the escalation; you give the technical truth and a date you can defend.
 **Client operations and IT counterparts** 
 Your direct contacts on live accounts — CRM and telephony integrations, data issues, UAT and verification of fixes.
   

  

 What we are looking for
   

  

 Must\-haves
   

  

* At least 1 year building or running software in production. We are hiring on judgement and ownership, not tenure — but you must have shipped something real that other people depended on.
* Strong Python and comfort with SQL, and the ability to read an unfamiliar codebase and follow a request end to end through it.
* Hands\-on work with LLM applications: prompting, context assembly, retrieval, tool or function calling, and evaluation. If you have built an eval harness for a component whose output is a distribution rather than one correct answer, lead with that.
* Real debugging discipline — you can hold a hypothesis, test it, and discard it. We assess this on a live, messy artifact, not a whiteboard algorithm.
* API and integration work: REST, webhooks, queues, retries, auth, and the failure modes of somebody else's system that you cannot change.
* You treat configuration as production. If you have shipped systems governed by config, flags, rules or prompts, and have opinions on how those get reviewed, versioned and rolled back, say so early.
* Willingness to face a customer during a failure and be plain about it, and excellent written communication — root\-cause notes and change summaries are artifacts people act on. You will be assessed on writing, not asked about it.
* Comfort with ambiguity and half\-built process. You will operate without a runbook and then write the runbook.


 Nice\-to\-haves
   

  

* Voice or conversational AI: telephony, dialers, STT and TTS, latency and barge\-in behaviour, call\-quality debugging.
* Regulated environments — BFSI, insurance, healthcare — and the data\-handling, DPDP and audit gates that come with them.
* Observability tooling (Grafana, Looker, Metabase or equivalents), CRM and contact\-centre integrations, and Indian\-language deployments where transcription quality varies by language, accent and channel.


 Disqualifiers
   

  

* Treating a configuration change as exempt from release discipline because it is not a deploy.
* Patching symptoms — adjusting a prompt until a complaint stops, without a stated root cause.
* Escalating as a reflex, or the opposite: absorbing a genuine platform gap into patch work for months, and optimising for the queue while the agent's outcome metrics drift.
* Declaring something fixed because it worked in one test, on a component whose output is a distribution.


 What this role is not
   

  

* Core platform architecture and technical direction — layering, security model, technology choices (CTO).
* Release cadence, intake gating and cross\-service contract governance (TPM).
* Product roadmap ownership and prioritisation (Product, with your input from the field).
* Owning the customer relationship, WBRs and QBRs (CSM).
* Commercial scoping, pricing and renewal (AM).


 What success looks like
   

  

 By day 30
   

  

* You can state, for every agent you own, its intended outcome, current numbers and top two failure modes — without asking anyone.
* You have taken over the live\-issue queue end to end, and platform engineering has stopped being pulled into it by default.
* At least one recurring issue is traced to a root cause and fixed there, rather than at the symptom.


 By day 60
   

  

* Agent outcome metrics are holding at or above the baseline you measured in week one, and that baseline is written down.
* At least one customer\-visible regression was caught by us before the client raised it, and you can point at what caught it.
* At least one field fix has been generalised with the SDEs into a capability other clients can use.
* Every agent you touched has its configuration under version control and a reversible path to production.
* A written handover exists that would let a second FDE pick this up: known faults, baselines, patterns worth productising.

title: Analyst – IT Service Desk IND
description:
**About us:**  

OsbIndia (OSBI) is an offshore subsidiary of OSB Group. OSBI was incorporated in 2004 as a key part of the OSB Group’s business strategy to provide operational service support. OSBI works with the Group’s trading brands in the UK, providing exceptional customer support and service delivery to new and existing customers.
  
  

OSBI also prides itself on offering operational excellence by devising and utilizing process improvements and functional efficiencies.
  
  

The principal purpose of this role is to provide L1 Support to the end users related to technical IT queries and issues.
  
The role involves handling incidents, service requests and events ensuring delivery of IT services are of the highest standards to the Business.
  
The person fulfilling this role may need to travel to UK or Internationally as expected by the IT or Business for supporting migration, automation, or continual improvement related activities for a number of IT Services.
  
  

1\. Core Responsibilities
  
* First Point of Contact: As the first point of contact for end\-users, a ServiceDesk engineer is responsible for receiving, documenting, and prioritizing requests and incidents.
* Ticket Management: A ServiceDesk engineer is responsible for managing the ticket queue, ensuring that tickets are properly categorized, assigned and tracked to resolution.
* Troubleshooting and Support: A ServiceDesk engineer is responsible for providing technical support to end\-users, troubleshooting issues and resolving incidents within established service level agreements (SLAs).
* Communication and Customer Service: A ServiceDesk engineer is responsible for maintaining communication with end\-users, providing updates on incident status and resolution and ensuring a high level of customer satisfaction is maintained.
* Knowledge Management: A ServiceDesk engineer is responsible for maintaining and updating a knowledge base of common issues and their solutions, to improve efficiency and reduce resolution time.
* Escalation Management: A ServiceDesk engineer is responsible for escalating incidents to appropriate levels of support when necessary and ensuring that escalation paths are clearly defined and followed.
* Monitoring and Reporting: A ServiceDesk engineer is responsible for monitoring the health of IT systems, alerting appropriate support teams to issues and producing regular reports on incident trends and resolution times.
* Documentation and Process Improvement: A ServiceDesk engineer is responsible for documenting incident resolution procedures, identifying areas for process improvement, and contributing to the development and maintenance of IT service management (ITSM) processes and policies.
* Flexible to work in 24/7 rotational shifts to support End users and to monitor the health of IT Systems.
* Provide client / IT end users support and technical issue resolution via E\-Mail, phone and other electronic medium 24/7/365 days within agreed SLA and standards
* Support Clients / Internal Server – Network Infrastructure and coordinate with Service Owners / vendors for issues resolution and reporting
* Manage IT ServiceDesk tickets within SLA with minimal functional escalation.
* Assess recurring incidents and provide feedback on the accuracy of the Known Errors. Follow standard operating procedures (SOPs), Change Management Processes (CRP) and Problem Handling Procedures (PHP)
* Perform Windows (IT) / Core System operational tasks and report (E.g. Backups, Tape Rotation, VMWare, Antivirus reports etc.
* Perform operational tasks and business processes
* Maintain and manage checklists, standard reports etc.
* Provide out\-of\-hours support when required (Assigned on rotational basis)
* Create, update document/procedures etc. IT operation tasks using OSB / EG standard format in coordination with service owners
* Liaise with external suppliers / vendors
* Liaise with internal customers
* Undertake any other duties, commensurate with grade and job title, requested by Line Manager or above.
* As nominated Risk Champion for your function, work alongside the Risk function in developing and maintaining a risk management agenda, acting both to ensure the necessary levels of transparency for potential risks and promoting a positive culture of awareness and accountability throughout your function
* Maintain the company’s compliance standards and ensure timely completion of all mandatory on\-line training modules and attestations
* Performs moderately complex and varied tasks
* Guides and trains junior team members


2\. Experience Requirements
  
Essential
  
* 2 to 5 years of L1 technical support experience is essential
* Experience of working in a Windows/Citrix/VMWare/Active Directory and/or Applications service support role is essential
* Operating Systems: Experience in supporting and troubleshooting various operating systems such as Windows 10/11, MacOS and Linux.
* Software Applications: Familiarity with a range of software applications including productivity tools (e.g. Microsoft Office Suite), email clients, and web browsers.
* Remote Access: Experience in remote access technologies such as Remote Desktop, Virtual Private Network (VPN), and Remote Assistance.
* Incident Management, Knowledge Management and Service Request fulfilment.


Desirable
  
* Experience in working with ServiceNow (user level) or an equivalent ITSM system is desirable.


3\. Knowledge Requirements
  
Essential
  
* Excellent knowledge in Desktop support / End user computing / Applications support on Citrix platform/environment is essential.
* Hardware: Knowledge of computer hardware including desktops, laptops, printers, and mobile devices is essential.
* Networking: Understanding of basic networking concepts such as TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, and VPN.


Desirable
  
* Knowledge of ITSM best practices is desirable.


4\. Skill and Competency Requirements
  
Essential
  
* Strong English language skills are essential (both written \& verbal).
* Good skills in respect of stakeholder management are essential.
* Good skills in respect of documentation, problem solving, analytical and time management are essential.
* User Administration: Ability to manage Office 365 user accounts, licenses, and permissions.
* Troubleshooting Skills: The ability to diagnose and resolve technical issues related to Office 365 applications and services.
* Active Directory User and Group Management: Knowledge of how to create, manage, and delete user and group accounts in AD is necessary for responding to requests related to access and permissions.
* Active Directory Account Lockouts: Knowledge of account lockout policies and troubleshooting account lockout issues is important for resolving issues related to user account lockouts.


Desirable
  
* PowerShell Scripting: Knowledge of PowerShell scripting for automating routine AD tasks and troubleshooting issues.


Why join OSBI?
  
  

We understand your career and how you progress is as unique as your individual personality. We've created a culture and an environment that encourages personal growth and offers our people opportunities to learn and succeed. Whether you're in the early stages of your career or already have an established profession, we're constantly seeking to hire talented individuals who want to make a difference and grow with us. We're a connected company working together to create a business in which we can all take pride and prosper.
  
If you want to know more about OSBI, please click on the website link: www.osb\-india.com
  
  

To know more about OSBI culture please find us on Instagram @OSBINDIA
  
  

To find out more about the roles \& updates please follow our LinkedIn Page www.linkedin.com/company/osbi.

### **Job Description**


**Job Description – Junior IT Administrator**  


We are looking for a motivated and enthusiastic **Junior IT Administrator** to join our IT team and provide first\-level technical support across the organization. This role is ideal for someone with a strong foundation in IT support who is eager to learn and grow in areas such as Microsoft 365, Azure, endpoint management, networking, and IT operations.  


The successful candidate will support daily IT operations, assist with user onboarding and offboarding, troubleshoot hardware and software issues, and work closely with the Senior IT team to ensure a secure, reliable, and efficient IT environment. **Key Responsibilities**  

**End\-User Support**  

* Provide Level 1/2/3 IT support for hardware, software, printers, and peripheral devices.
* Troubleshoot Windows, Microsoft 365, email, Teams, and application\-related issues.
* Resolve user incidents and service requests within agreed SLAs.
* Escalate complex issues to senior team members when required.
* Assist users with remote support and troubleshooting.

 **Microsoft 365 Administration**  


Assist in administering Microsoft 365 services, including:  

* Exchange Online
* Microsoft Teams
* SharePoint Online
* OneDrive
* Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD)
* Microsoft Intune (basic administration)


Responsibilities include:  

* User account creation and management
* Password resets
* License assignment
* Distribution groups
* Shared mailboxes
* Basic permission management

 **User Onboarding \& Offboarding**  

* Create and configure user accounts.
* Provision laptops and workstations.
* Configure Microsoft 365 accounts.
* Install required applications.
* Prepare new employee devices.
* Disable accounts and recover company assets during offboarding.
* Maintain onboarding and offboarding documentation.

 **Device \& Endpoint Management**  

* Configure desktops and laptops.
* Install and update operating systems and applications.
* Assist with Microsoft Intune device enrollment.
* Monitor device compliance.
* Perform routine system maintenance and patching.
* Maintain hardware inventory.

 **IT Operations**  

* Monitor IT systems and respond to alerts.
* Perform routine health checks on infrastructure.
* Assist with backups and recovery procedures.
* Support software deployments and upgrades.
* Maintain IT asset records and documentation.
* Follow IT security policies and operational procedures.

 **Networking Support**  

* Assist with basic networking tasks.
* Troubleshoot connectivity issues.
* Support VPN configuration and remote access.
* Assist with Wi\-Fi, DNS, DHCP, and printer configuration.

 **Documentation**  

* Update IT documentation and knowledge base articles.
* Document recurring issues and resolutions.
* Maintain asset registers and support records.

 **Continuous Learning**  

* Learn Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365, Intune, and cloud technologies.
* Participate in internal training and certification programs.
* Stay updated with new technologies and IT best practices.
* Support automation and process improvement initiatives where applicable.

 **Required Skills \& Experience**  

* 2\-4 years of experience in IT Support, Helpdesk, or System Administration.
* Good understanding of Windows 10/11 and Microsoft Office.
* Knowledge of Microsoft 365 administration.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD).
* Basic networking knowledge (DNS, DHCP, VPN, TCP/IP).
* Basic understanding of Active Directory.
* Experience with laptop and desktop troubleshooting.
* Strong problem\-solving and communication skills.
* Ability to prioritize tasks and work in a fast\-paced environment.
* Virtual Machines Troubleshooting

 **Preferred Qualifications**  

* Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.
* Microsoft Fundamentals certifications (MS\-900, AZ\-900, SC\-900\) are an advantage.
* Exposure to Microsoft Intune or Azure is desirable.
* Experience with ticketing systems such as ManageEngine, Jira, Zendesk, or ServiceNow is preferred.

 **Role Expectations**  


The Junior IT Administrator will:  

* Deliver timely and professional IT support to employees.
* Take ownership of assigned support requests until resolution.
* Follow established IT processes and security standards.
* Collaborate effectively with senior team members.
* Demonstrate a willingness to learn and continuously develop technical skills.
* Maintain a customer\-focused attitude while ensuring high\-quality service delivery.
