title: IT Operations Administrator
description:
**Overview**
**Job Description:**
 We don’t simply hire employees. We invest in them. When you work at Chatham, we empower you — offering professional development opportunities to help you grow in your career, no matter if you've been here for five months or 15 years. Chatham has worked hard to create a distinct work environment that values people, teamwork, integrity, and client service. You will have immediate opportunities to partner with talented subject matter experts, work on complex projects, and contribute to the value Chatham delivers every day.
   

  

**WHY CHATHAM**
 We don’t simply hire employees — we invest in them. When you join Chatham, you are empowered with professional development opportunities designed to help you grow at every stage of your career, whether you’ve been here five months or fifteen years. You will have immediate opportunities to partner with talented subject\-matter experts, contribute to complex projects, and deliver the kind of value our clients depend on every day.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The IT Operations Team serves as the first point of contact for all technical issues across Chatham’s global organization. We partner closely with the Desktop Services, Infrastructure, Digital Workplace, and InfoSec teams to ensure that every end\-user technical issue is resolved thoroughly and without delay. Our reach spans five continents, and the work we do every day keeps Chatham’s people productive and connected.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 The IT Operations Administrator is a senior\-level role within the IT Operations Team. In addition to handling a full scope of end\-user support responsibilities, the Administrator serves as a technical leader and mentor for junior analysts, owns the administration and continuous improvement of Chatham’s ITSM platform, and acts as a key liaison between front\-line support and senior IT stakeholders. This role demands a high degree of technical proficiency, sound judgment under pressure, and a genuine commitment to service excellence.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**End\-User Support \& Service Delivery**
* Serve as a primary point of contact for inbound technical inquiries via phone, secure chat, walk\-up, and email, ensuring every interaction reflects Chatham’s commitment to world\-class service.
* Apply advanced conversational and diagnostic techniques to rapidly identify root causes, build end\-user trust, and resolve issues at first contact whenever possible.
* Take full ownership of complex or escalated tickets, coordinating across IT teams to drive issues to complete resolution.
* Proactively identify patterns in inbound inquiries and share insights with management to drive systemic improvements to IT services, operations, and policies.
* Document all end\-user correspondence and technical actions clearly, concisely, and in accordance with established standards.


**Administration \& Systems Ownership**
* Manage end\-to\-end IT administration for the Chennai location, including IT asset management, user provisioning, hardware and software support, vendor coordination, and workplace technology operations.
* Own the administration and ongoing improvement of Chatham’s ITSM solution, including ticket workflows, data integrity, reporting, and knowledge base content.
* Administer end\-user account management, hardware inventory, software procurement, and related systems.
* Conduct regular audits to validate ticket data accuracy and overall ITSM hygiene.
* Deliver timely, accurate, and actionable operational data to IT leadership as needed.


**Mentorship \& Team Development**
* Serve as a primary resource and mentor for IT Operations Analysts, actively advancing their technical knowledge, troubleshooting skills, and professional development.
* Provide guidance on escalation decisions and help analysts build confidence in handling complex support scenarios.
* Contribute to knowledge base development and team training initiatives to continuously raise the team’s capability baseline.


**YOUR IMPACT**
 As an IT Operations Administrator, you are both a practitioner and a force multiplier. Your technical depth enables you to resolve the most complex end\-user issues the team encounters, while your mentorship directly elevates the effectiveness of the analysts around you. Your ownership of the ITSM platform ensures the team operates on a reliable, accurate foundation — and your insights into root\-cause trends help leadership make better decisions for Chatham’s people and systems.
   

  

**Required**
**QUALIFICATIONS \& COMPETENCIES**
* CompTIA A\+ certification or equivalent demonstrated experience in an IT support role
* Proficiency with Microsoft Active Directory and PowerShell scripting
* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft 365 / Office suite
* Proven ability to resolve complex technical issues independently, with sound judgment and minimal supervision
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to adapt messaging for technical and non\-technical audiences
* Demonstrated ability to mentor or coach peers in a professional environment
* Ability to perform effectively under pressure, managing competing priorities in a fast\-paced environment
* Strong organizational and time management skills; ability to shift fluidly between concurrent tasks
* Comfortable working on\-site in an open office environment
* Availability to participate in rotating after\-hours on\-call schedule (one week at a time)


**Preferred**
* Experience administering an ITSM platform (e.g., Freshservice, ServiceNow, Jira Service Management)
* Familiarity with networking fundamentals and/or information security concepts
* Experience with enterprise endpoint management tooling
* Track record of process improvement or automation initiatives in a support context


**PERSONAL ATTRIBUTES**
* Genuinely service\-oriented — you care about the people you’re helping, not just closing tickets
* Analytical and pattern\-oriented — you see signal in the noise and act on it
* Accountable and self\-driven — you take ownership without being asked
* Collaborative — you make the people around you better
* Composed — you perform at your best when things get complicated


**About Chatham Financial**
 Chatham Financial is the leading independent capital markets advisor, delivering an integrated blend of expert advice and powerful technology to help you reduce risk and seize opportunity. With decades of capital markets strategy, execution, monitoring, and performance expertise, we serve as an unwavering advocate for your best interests and your innovation partner. Our technology platform unifies data across assets, debt, and derivatives, giving you unmatched agility, transparency, and insight.
   

  

**It’s clear ahead.**
 Our commitment is to carry that light forward in every partnership, every solution, and every market we serve.
   

  

 We help guide the way—giving clients the insight and momentum to move forward with confidence, no matter what lies ahead.

title: Sr Technical Support Engineer
description:
**Description**
 At Gigamon, our purpose is to protect the hybrid networks and data of the largest, most complex organizations on the planet. Certified as a Great Place to Work, we offer a deep observability pipeline that efficiently delivers network\-derived intelligence to cloud, security, and observability tools. This helps our customers to eliminate security blind spots, optimize network traffic, and dramatically reduce tool cost and complexity, enabling them to better secure and manage their hybrid cloud infrastructure. Gigamon has served more than 4,000 customers worldwide, including over 80 percent of Fortune 100 enterprises, 9 of the 10 largest mobile network providers, and hundreds of governments and educational organizations.
   

  

 The Sr. Support Engineer (I.C.) provides advanced technical support to customers using Gigamon solutions. This role troubleshoots complex networking issues across Layer 2 and Layer 3 technologies, manages escalations through resolution, and partners with internal teams to address customer concerns. The engineer also supports RMA coordination, issue documentation, and customer satisfaction analysis. Success in this role requires strong technical depth, effective cross\-functional collaboration, and a customer\-focused approach to problem resolution.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Provide advanced technical support to assigned customers through phone and email support queues.
* Troubleshoot, reproduce, and develop workarounds for complex product and networking issues.
* Apply strong knowledge of Ethernet, TCP/IP, OSPF, Layer 2 and Layer 3 VPNs, multicast protocols, VLANs, trunks, switching, stacking, and service provider technologies.
* Troubleshoot GTP correlation issues and use network test equipment, including Spirent and IXIA.
* Manage hot escalations and drive customer issues through resolution while maintaining clear communication with all involved parties.
* Document and report the status of major issues, operational conditions, customer concerns, and resolution activities.
* Coordinate RMA processes, including equipment delivery to customers and the return of hardware from customer locations to Gigamon.
* Collaborate with Quality Assurance, Sustaining Engineering, and other internal organizations to communicate customer requirements and advocate for timely resolutions.
* Analyze and report on customer satisfaction related to Gigamon products, services, and processes.
* Participate in customer support center activities and contribute to consistent, high\-quality support operations.


**What You’ve Done**
* Earned a bachelor’s degree in a relevant technical field.
* Gained at least four years of technical service or technical support experience in networking.
* Built strong working knowledge across Layer 2 and Layer 3 networking technologies.
* Demonstrated experience troubleshooting customer issues, reproducing problems, and developing effective workarounds.
* Managed technical escalations and coordinated complex issues across multiple internal teams.
* Worked directly with customers to resolve technical issues and improve customer satisfaction.
* Developed strong project management, problem\-solving, and analytical skills.
* Demonstrated the ability to document, analyze, and report on technical issues and customer feedback.


**Who You Are**
* A customer\-focused technical professional who advocates for timely and effective resolutions.
* An empowered self\-starter who works effectively in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment.
* A clear and confident communicator with strong verbal, written, and presentation skills in English.
* An active listener who builds productive relationships with customers and cross\-functional teams.
* An organized professional who can prioritize responsibilities and meet deadlines.
* A collaborative partner who takes initiative, adapts to changing priorities, and works with limited supervision.


 As an equal opportunity employer, all applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, national origin, age, sexual orientation, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other protected characteristic under applicable federal, state, and/or local law. * Proactively monitor and respond to alerts from AWS CloudWatch, AWS Security Hub, and third\-party tools such as PagerDuty or Opsgenie.
* Perform real\-time triage of incidents to determine severity and impact.


**Incident Management**
* Log, categorize, and prioritize incidents based on SLA requirements using service desk platforms like Jira Service Desk, ServiceNow, or Zendesk.
* Ensure accurate and timely documentation of all events and actions taken.


**Basic Troubleshooting \& Support**
* Conduct first\-level diagnostics for common AWS issues, including:
+ EC2 instance reachability and performance.
+ IAM access and credential resets.
+ S3 and storage\-related alerts.
+ Basic VPC and networking queries (e.g., DNS, VPN, IP ranges).


**User Request Fulfillment**
* Assist users with IAM credential resets, MFA configurations, and console access under defined permission policies.
* Verify system statuses and provide timely updates to stakeholders.


**Escalation Management**
* Follow Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to escalate complex issues to Tier 2/3 or specialized engineering teams.
* Ensure smooth handover of incidents with detailed summaries and next\-action plans.


**Communication \& Reporting**
* Provide clear, concise status updates to customers and internal stakeholders during incident resolution, adhering to SLA communication protocols.
* Maintain precise shift handover reports to ensure continuity across 24x7 operations.


**Documentation \& Process Improvement**
* Update runbooks, knowledge base articles, and incident logs based on recurring issues or resolutions.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of support processes and tools.


**Job Requirements**
**Education \& Certifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* AWS Cloud Practitioner certification (required).
* AWS Solutions Architect – Associate certification (preferred for career growth).
* ITIL v4 Foundation certification (preferred).


**Technical Skills**
* Foundational knowledge of AWS core services: EC2, S3, IAM, CloudWatch, and VPC.
* Experience with monitoring and alerting tools (e.g., AWS CloudWatch; familiarity with PagerDuty or Opsgenie is a plus).
* Understanding of IAM roles, access management, and MFA reset procedures.
* Familiarity with service desk platforms such as Jira Service Desk, ServiceNow, or Zendesk.
* Basic understanding of networking concepts (e.g., DNS, VPN, IP addressing).


**Operational Capabilities**
* Ability to adhere to Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and escalation workflows.
* Strong discipline in ticketing, documentation, and incident tracking.
* Capability to interpret and act upon CloudWatch Logs and GuardDuty alerts.
* Readiness for shift\-based 24x7 availability, including weekends and holidays.
* Comfort working under SLA pressure and meeting response time KPIs.


**Soft Skills**
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Customer\-focused attitude with the ability to remain calm and effective under pressure.
* High attention to detail, reliability, and accountability for shift handovers.
* Strong team collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with Tier 2/3 teams and cross\-functional units.


**Why Join Us?**
* Opportunity to work with cutting\-edge AWS cloud technologies.
* Clear path for career growth and skill development in cloud operations.
* Collaborative, global team environment with a focus on innovation and excellence.
* Comprehensive training and certification support.

**About the Role:** 
 We are looking for an experienced Oracle Cloud General Ledger (GL) Support Consultant with strong hands\-on functional expertise in Oracle Cloud GL, with proven experience resolving production issues, handling period\-close activities, and providing day\-to\-day operational support in a live Oracle Cloud Financials environment.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
* Provide L2/L3 production support for Oracle Cloud General Ledger module, ensuring timely resolution of incidents and service requests within defined SLAs
* Manage and troubleshoot day\-to\-day GL issues: journal posting errors, allocation failures, reconciliation mismatches, ledger balancing issues
* Support month\-end, quarter\-end, and year\-end close activities including journal review, accruals, revaluation, translation, and consolidation
* Monitor and resolve issues in scheduled processes (ESS jobs) related to GL — posting, import, allocations, period close
* Handle intercompany transactions, elimination entries, and cross\-ledger balancing issues
* Perform root cause analysis (RCA) for recurring issues and recommend permanent fixes/configuration changes
* Coordinate with Oracle Support (SRs/Service Requests) for bug fixes, patches, and quarterly update issues
* Support functional testing of Oracle Cloud quarterly patches/updates and regression testing for GL processes
* Work closely with sub\-ledger (AP, AR, FA \& CM) support teams to resolve cross\-module integration issues impacting GL
* Assist in FBDI\-based data loads, journal uploads, and correction of failed interface/import processes
* Maintain and update support documentation, SOPs, and knowledge base articles
* Handle minor enhancements, CRs (Change Requests), and configuration updates as per business need
* Provide end\-user support, training, and query resolution related to GL processes
* Track tickets via ITSM tools (ServiceNow, JIRA, Remedy, etc.) and report on SLA compliance and ticket trends
* Participate in on\-call/rotational support and be available during period\-close windows (including weekends, if required)


**Required Skills:**
* 6–8 years of experience in Oracle applications, with at least 4–5 years dedicated to Oracle Cloud GL support/operations
* Strong hands\-on experience in a production support environment
* Solid understanding of GL configurations: Chart of Accounts, Ledgers, Calendars, Journal Sources/Categories, Data Access Sets
* Practical experience with allocations, revaluation, translation, and consolidation processes
* Experience handling period\-close cycle issues and providing close\-window support
* Working knowledge of GL integration points with AP, AR, FA, CM, and Expenses
* Hands\-on experience with OTBI, FRS (Financial Reporting Studio), and Smart View for troubleshooting/reporting issues
* Familiarity with FBDI templates and resolving failed import/interface issues
* Experience raising and managing Oracle Service Requests (SRs) via My Oracle Support (MOS)
* Understanding of Oracle Cloud release cycles (quarterly updates) and their impact on GL configurations
* Good knowledge of ITSM/ticketing tools (ServiceNow, JIRA, Remedy)
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to prioritize under pressure


**Preferred/Good to Have:**
* Oracle Cloud Financials (GL) certification
* Prior experience in AMS/support engagements (as opposed to only implementation projects)
* Exposure to SLA\-driven support models and ticket\-severity frameworks (P1/P2/P3\)
* Basic understanding of SQL for data validation/debugging (not mandatory)

+ Foster long\-term customer success by building enduring relationships and contributing reusable automation tools, diagnostic scripts, and best\-practice documentation.


**Minimum Qualifications \& Experience**

* Autonomy \& Mindset: Highly self\-driven, analytical, and autonomous, with a proven track record of untangling complex technical roadblocks in high\-performance Service Provider networks.

**Technical Competencies – Service Provider Focus**
* Platforms \& Hardware: Cisco ASR 9000/1000 Series Routers; Cisco NCS 5400/5500/5600/6000 Platforms.
* Operating Systems \& Protocols: Cisco IOS XR Operating System; MPLS, Segment Routing (SR\-MPLS/SRv6\), EVPN, LDP, Carrier Ethernet, and IP/MPLS Transport.

title: Network Support Engineer — Zscaler and security - SG
description:
**Job Role: Network Support Engineer — Zscaler and security \- SG** 




**Experience: 4\-7 years** 




  





**Project context** 




 This position carries secure internet and private access operations for the whole estate. Its holder resolves the user\-facing problems that sit between the endpoint, the cloud security platform and the network.
 



 A second technology is required, and one only. Candidates are expected to be genuinely operational on Zscaler and to bring credible working knowledge of either Palo Alto firewalls, campus LAN and Wi\-Fi, or Cisco Catalyst SD\-WAN.
 



**Goals and deliverables** 




  





**Responsibilities** 




 • Resolve incidents and service requests within agreed SLA targets, with structured troubleshooting and analysis before any escalation.
 



 • Maintain complete, evidence\-based ticket documentation; escalate to Level 3 only with full diagnostic detail.
 



 • Own backlog hygiene, timely stakeholder updates and disciplined shift handovers to guarantee operational continuity.
 



 • Author and maintain Knowledge Base Articles and runbooks; identify repeat incidents suitable for shift\-left to Level 1\.
 



 • Apply ITIL incident, change and problem management, and comply with internal security and audit requirements.
 



 • Contribute to Major Incident support, KPI reporting and operational performance reviews, and to problem management investigations.
 



**Specific responsibilities** 




  





**In addition to the core responsibilities stated above:** 




 • Operate Zscaler Internet Access: ZIA Policies Management including: Bandwidth Control, DNS Security, URL Filtering, SSL Inspection, Firewall Policies, handling \& troubleshooting of ZIA\-related incidents and changes.
 



 • Operate Zscaler Private Access: App Segments and Access Policies management, App Connector health monitoring / troubleshooting.
 



 • Use Zscaler Digital Experience evidence to arbitrate between user\-side and network\-side causes.
 



 • Manage traffic forwarding: Client Connector behaviour, PAC files, GRE and IPsec tunnels, and their failover.
 



 • Support the second technology at working level within the change governance in force.
 



**Qualifications** 




 • Bachelor's degree in computer science, network engineering, information technology, or equivalent experience.
 



 • Working knowledge of TCP/IP, subnetting and end\-to\-end packet flow reasoning; Ethernet switching, VLAN, STP and 802\.1Q.
 



 • Practical exposure to Infoblox DNS, DHCP and IPAM operations.
 



 • Familiarity with ITSM tooling, BMC Helix or equivalent, and experience in SLA\-driven environments with KPI accountability.
 



 • Experience raising, chasing and challenging carrier tickets, including RFO follow\-up.
 



 • Professional working proficiency in English, written and spoken.
 



 • Availability for rotating shift work in a follow\-the\-sun model.
 



**Expected skills** 




 DHCP
 



 IPAM
 



 ZSCALER
 



 VLAN
 



 DNS
 



 Ethernet Switching

title: L2 Technical Support
description:
**Who we are** 




 Mindtickle is the leading AI\-powered revenue enablement platform, helping sales teams learn faster, practice smarter, and perform at their best. We bring together onboarding, training, coaching, content, digital sales rooms, conversation intelligence, and AI role\-plays into one platform so revenue teams have everything they need to build winning sellers.
 



 Global companies, like Fortune 500 organizations, trust Mindtickle to support their revenue teams. Customers and industry analysts have also recognized us. G2 has ranked us the \#1 Sales Training \& Onboarding platform for 28 consecutive quarters, and Forrester has recognized Mindtickle as a Leader in revenue enablement. Mindtickle was also recognized as AI\-Based Sales Solution of the Year by the 2025 AI Breakthrough Awards and has received Stevie Awards for Technology Innovation and Customer Support Excellence.
 



 At Mindtickle, we're helping companies create high\-performing revenue teams, and we're looking for people who want to help shape what's next.
 



  





**Job Brief** 




  





 Mindtickle is hiring an experienced Customer Support Engineer \- II to join our Customer Support Engineering team and become the technical heartbeat behind a global enterprise SaaS platform and our award\-winning AI solutions. In this role, you will troubleshoot and resolve complex issues in a distributed system across backend services, APIs, data platform, UI interactions, and AI\-powered solutions.
 



  





 This role demands a strong working knowledge of cloud fundamentals: debugging of distributed systems, querying and analyzing system data, logs, and traces, writing scripts, and resolving complex backend and frontend issues with precision and speed. You will collaborate directly with Engineering, Product, Quality Engineering, and DevOps, influencing product quality and strengthening customer trust at scale.
 



  





 If you thrive in solving hard technical problems, working with cross\-functional teams, excel in high\-stakes scenarios, owning outcomes end\-to\-end, and delighting customers, this role offers unparalleled influence and impact that few L2 positions can match.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**Operational Support and Issue Ownership** 



* Respond rapidly to customer queries and drive issues to resolution.
* Provide timely workarounds and temporary solutions to customers for known issues, ensuring minimal disruption while long\-term fixes are being implemented.
* Own support tickets end\-to\-end, ensuring SLA compliance and serving as an escalation point.
* Work cross\-functionally with Product, Engineering, QE and DevOps to eliminate systemic issues and reduce ticket volume.
* Work independently with strong planning and task management skills.
* Use data analysis to make actionable, data\-driven recommendations.



**Technical Investigation, Diagnostics and Root Cause Analysis** 



* Diagnose, reproduce, and debug complex issues across backend services, APIs, data flows, UI behavior, and AI\-driven components.
* Capture and analyze browser logs, HAR files, network traces, and client\-side errors using modern observability tools.
* Analyze AI\-driven decision paths, validate model outputs, and identify anomaly or drift patterns.
* Troubleshoot integrations with external systems, authentication flows, and third\-party platforms.
* Leverage tools such as Zipy, DataDog, SumoLogic, FullStory, Mixpanel, and Metabase for deep diagnostics.
* Identify, diagnose, and surface real\-world failure modes in AI workflows, partnering with Product and Engineering to address root causes and deliver more resilient, trustworthy AI experiences.
* Provide configuration guidance and technical solutions to resolve customer issues across environments.
* Perform structured impact and severity analysis before escalating to Engineering.
* Establish repeatable auditing frameworks to bring consistency to investigations.



**Knowledge Building, Documentation and Enablement** 



* Build and maintain high\-quality runbooks, playbooks, troubleshooting guides, and diagnostic frameworks to reduce repeat incidents and improve response speed.
* Convert solved issues into product and documentation improvements for L1, customers, Product, and Engineering.
* Drive internal knowledge sharing by conducting deep dive sessions and post\-incident walkthroughs.
* Communicate solutions clearly to customers and internal teams, translating complex root causes into simple explanations.



**Scripting, Tooling and Automation** 



* Write scripts (Bash/Python/SQL) to automate log extraction, data analysis, replication of issues, and health checks.
* Create lightweight internal utilities to accelerate diagnostics and reduce manual investigation time.
* Contribute to building support automation pipelines and AI\-assisted troubleshooting tools.



  





**Requirements** 




**Experience and Background:** 



* **1\-3 years** 
**L2** 
 technical support experience in enterprise SaaS platforms/products (AWS Cloud preferred) in a customer\-facing role.
* Proven track record handling technical issues in production environments, supporting distributed systems.
* Experience in supporting a multi\-tenant SaaS product or platform; familiarity with multi‑tenant architecture, integrations, and configuration management.
* Troubleshooting AI\-powered Product features
* Hands\-on experience troubleshooting AI\-powered features. Able to distinguish model issues from data, configuration, or system\-level failures with precision.
* Knowledge of Authentication, Authorization, and Enterprise Integrations
* SSO protocols (SAML, OAuth 2\.0, OpenID Connect).
* Identity and Access Management (IAM) frameworks.
* Multi\-Factor Authentication (MFA) and Role\-Based Access Control (RBAC)
* Just\-in\-time (JIT) provisioning and SCIM (System for Cross\-domain Identity Management).
* **Backend and Systems skills:**
* Strong understanding of database concepts; proficient in SQL for querying, analysis, and data validation. Experience with relational and NoSQL systems (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL) and ability to debug data inconsistencies and performance issues, and hands\-on experience in Snowflake.
* Experience querying and analyzing logs, identifying patterns (tools like Datadog, Loki, Sumologic, Splunk, Grafana).
* Proficient in debugging modern web applications across backend (GoLang/Python) and API layers (REST, GraphQL; gRPC).
* Familiarity with AWS services including, Lambada, CloudWatch, S3 as well as experience with Kafka, Kubernetes, and Snowflake.
* **Frontend and client side skills:**
* Proficient in debugging React applications.
* Capture and analyze client logs (HAR files, network waterfalls, browser dev tools, net\-export, wireshark).
* Experience with monitoring tools (Zipy, Fullstory) and BI/analytics tools (Mixpanel, Metabase).
* **Customer Relationship and Soft Skills:**
* Strong written, verbal communication skills and empathy when interacting with customers.
* Ability to build and maintain trusted relationships with customers and internal teams.
* Maintains a calm and methodical approach in high pressure situations.
* Proactive, detail oriented, thrives in ambiguity, adapts quickly to changing priorities, and manages multiple concurrent issues in a fast paced environment.
* Analyzes and prioritizes issues based on SLAs and customer impact.
* **Good to have:**
* Familiarity with prompt engineering (helpful for L2 support on AI\-powered products).
* Understanding of building or configuring AI agents, including workflows, task automation, and basic agent behavior troubleshooting.
* Experience in Mobile App troubleshooting on Android and iOS.



  





**Our Culture \& Values** 




 We hire builders, people who move fast, learn from failure, and use AI as a default part of how they work. Our values\- Delight Your Customers, Act as a Founder, and Better Together\- aren't wall decor. They're how we make decisions here.
 



 Growth at Mindtickle looks like owning more, not just doing more. Your scope will outgrow your job title if you want it to. You'll work alongside people who've scaled revenue tech globally, get direct feedback from leaders invested in your development, and take on challenges before you feel ready because that's how the best growth happens.
 



 Our team spans 5\+ countries, backgrounds, and perspectives. We believe the best products are built by people who bring different ways of seeing the same problem \- and everyone has a seat at that table.
 



 We hire for potential. Apply even if your experience doesn't match every requirement; your skills, perspective, and drive matter here. At Mindtickle, you can be yourself, build your career, and do the best work of your life alongside people who genuinely want to see you succeed.
 



 We believe the best products are built by teams with different backgrounds, experiences, and ways of seeing the world. We welcome every unique identity, and we mean that.

 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: TechOps Analyst
description:
The Applications Development Intermediate Programmer Analyst is an intermediate level position responsible for participation in the establishment and implementation of new or revised application systems and programs in coordination with the Technology team. The overall objective of this role is to contribute to applications systems analysis and programming activities.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
* Primary Focus: Production Operations, Incident \& Release Management, L3 Code\-Level Troubleshooting.


**Role Overview**
 The
 **TechOps L3 Analyst** 
 is a seasoned technical operations role dedicated to driving production stability, reliability, and operational effectiveness for enterprise applications. This is strictly an L3 Operational and Technical Support role, not a full\-time software development role. However, the position requires a high degree of code comfortability.
   

  

 The ideal candidate must be capable of reading and traversing full\-stack application codebases, identifying deep\-seated production defects, and writing/deploying minor code bug fixes and hotfixes when required. You will own production issue resolution, release deployments, incident/problem management, and environment reliability across a distributed microservices environment.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Production Stability \& L3 Support**
* Serve as the senior escalation tier (L3\) for complex production incidents, performing start\-of\-day health checks, continuous monitoring, and regional shift handovers.
* Evaluate complex, variable production issues with high business impact, balancing immediate restoration of service with long\-term stabilization.
* Adhere strictly to Service Level Agreements (SLAs), assessing risk and impact while managing business and technical communications during high\-severity events.


 Code\-Level Troubleshooting \& Minor Fixes
   

  

* Traverse and debug application code across the backend and frontend to trace failure paths and isolate bugs.
* Develop, test, and push minor code hotfixes, operational patches, and script updates to remediate recurring issues or operational gaps
* Partner with core application development teams to prioritize structural bug fixes and define support tooling requirements.
* Incident, Problem \& Release Management
* Drive end\-to\-end Problem Management, performing root cause analysis (RCA) and post\-implementation reviews to prevent incident recurrence.
* Manage release delivery into production, participating in deployment pipelines, release verification, and post\-deployment monitoring.
* Formulate contingency planning and review application resiliency to maintain high availability across operating environments.


 Infrastructure, Data \& Observability
   

  

* Monitor messaging pipelines, system metrics, and log aggregation tools to proactively identify performance bottlenecks or failures.
* Execute diagnostic queries and data patches across relational and non\-relational database systems.
* Deploy and support application components running on container orchestration platforms.


 Governance, Risk \& Leadership
   

  

* Drive Support Project items focused on Stability, Efficiency, and Effectiveness initiatives.
* Act as an advisor and mentor to L1/L2 or junior support analysts, sharing domain and technical knowledge.
* Safeguard firm assets by demonstrating risk awareness, complying with audit and change\-control policies, and managing control issues transparently.


 Technical Stack Requirements
   

  

* Core Languages \& Frameworks: Java, Spring Boot, Angular (ability to navigate, debug, and issue minor fixes)
* Databases: Oracle, SQL, MongoDB
* Event Streaming \& Messaging: Apache Kafka
* Observability \& Monitoring: Kibana, Grafana
* Hosting \& Containerization: Red Hat OpenShift
* ITS \& Operations Tools: Jira, Confluence, ServiceNow, Release Automation tools


**Qualifications \& Skills**
* Experience: 7 to 9 years of hands\-on experience in an L3 Application Support or TechOps role supporting enterprise\-grade, distributed business applications.
* Code Proficiency: Strong ability to read, navigate, and perform minor bug fixes in Java and Spring Boot microservices, alongside Angular frontend codebases.
* Database \& Querying Skills: Strong command of SQL for Oracle DBs and querying capabilities for MongoDB to analyze operational data inconsistencies.
* Operational Disciplines: Expertise in ITIL frameworks encompassing Incident, Problem, Change, and Release Management.
* Soft Skills : Excellent communication, analytical, and diplomacy skills to exchange complex technical information clearly with non\-technical business partners and engineering leads.


 This job description provides a high\-level review of the types of work performed. Other job\-related duties may be assigned as required.

title: Customer Specialist II
description:

****Customer Specialist II****
**Job Summary**
 Customer Specialist II (CS II) is responsible for delivering exceptional customer support by answering incoming calls, creating and managing cases in Salesforce, and resolving issues with a focus on first\-call resolution. This role requires a proactive, customer\-first professional who can effectively support both internal and external clients across multiple channels, ensuring issues are resolved accurately and within service level expectations.
   

  

 The ideal candidate brings proven customer service experience, strong attention to detail, and a consultative, relationship\-focused approach. The CS II must be comfortable multitasking, prioritizing workloads, and providing second\-level product expertise, especially in cases beyond the scope of first\-level support. This role plays a critical part in shaping a positive customer experience by demonstrating professionalism, transparency, and a commitment to continuous improvement.
   

  

****Competencies****
* Effective communication and verbal skills
* Flexibility \& Adaptability
* Team oriented and the ability to work collaboratively
* Proactive in taking initiative
* Ability to multi\-task in a fast paced and dynamic environment
* Executes on the Extreme WOW with every customer interaction
* Highly adaptable to process and system changes
* Knowledge of HTML, CSS, JAVASCRIPT and use of technology


**Job Expectations**
* Answer inbound calls from customers while implementing the necessary customer satisfaction skills which include phone etiquette, accountability and active listening while meeting specific service level and performance goals.
* Manage incoming support tickets to ensure all customer inquiries are resolved effectively and efficiently. This includes validating support tickets, providing updates and callbacks within a timely manner and occasionally triaging tickets that need additional support from the proper department.
* Demonstrate excellent customer service skills with the ability to take ownership, research and resolve customer inquiries with an emphasis on first call and one contact resolutions.
* Utilize an internal knowledge base system for customer interactions to help provide support and ensure accurate resolutions and information.
* Maintain and promote a positive outlook and embrace change.
* Meet and strive to exceed departmental performance goals in relation to quality, production and schedule adherence.
* Invest in ongoing personal skills development to ensure technical expertise and industry specific skills are constantly expanded and honed.
* Demonstrates the ability to deliver exceptional customer service by effectively using available resources and tools to manage and accurately document complex inquiries and requests via email, chat, and phone within the Salesforce application.
* An ability to de\-escalate customer concerns, articulate complex information to customers, and provide an optimal resolution that embodies a world class customer experience.
* Ensure that daily individual case quotas are met or exceeded, and the customer’s technical issues are resolved in a professional, empathetic, and effective fashion according to team processes.


**Required Skills/Experience**
* 4\+ years of customer service experience in a call center environment or 4\+ years of technical support delivery experience
* 2\+ years of Automotive industry experience
* Excellent written, communication and interpersonal skills
* Proficient knowledge of MS Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook) and Salesforce Service Cloud.

 Service Delivery Manager
   

  

**Job Purpose**
 The ITSM Consultant will be responsible for establishing, standardizing, implementing, and continuously improving IT Service Management (ITSM) processes across the KCM IT landscape. The role will drive the adoption of ITIL\-aligned best practices, define operational procedures, create process documentation and templates, establish governance controls, implement KPI\-driven performance measurements, and ensure consistent service delivery across all IT towers. * Develop end\-to\-end operating models for service delivery and support functions.
* Ensure standardization of processes across all technology towers.

* Service Request Management
* Change Management
* Problem Management
* Major Incident Management
* Service Level Management
* Knowledge Management
* Configuration Management (CMDB)
* Asset Management
* Availability Management
* Capacity Management

title: Service Desk Quality Analyst | Pune
description:
**OVERVIEW**  

The Service Desk Quality Analyst supports the Service Desk operation by ensuring the accuracy, consistency, and quality of ticket handling and documentation. While this role primarily operates behind the scenes, it may occasionally involve handling service tickets to support operational needs or gain deeper insight into service patterns. Key responsibilities include reviewing ticket coding for accuracy, interpreting dashboards, identifying recurring issues, and converting data into actionable insights for service leads. Tasks involve auditing tickets, flagging miscategorized entries, reporting on Service Level Agreement (SLA) compliance, monitoring backlog trends, and assisting problem management through thorough data analysis. Acting as an extension of the quality function, this role plays a critical part in enhancing ticket hygiene, improving team performance, and delivering operational insights that drive continuous service desk improvements.  

  

**DESCRIPTION**


The Service Desk Quality Analyst is a mid\-level role that works closely with the Service Desk team and leadership to:


* Monitor incoming new tickets in the Service Desk system to ensure timely and accurate assignment to the appropriate team members
* Monitor incoming escalations to promptly identify high\-priority or complex issues requiring immediate attention from Senior Analysts or Service Desk management
* Maintain real\-time oversight of ticket queues and escalation paths to prevent bottlenecks and service delays
* Provide backup support to Service Desk Analysts by handling tickets as needed during peak periods, absences, or resource shortages, helping maintain consistent service levels
* Review and audit service desk tickets for coding accuracy and categorization
* Identify and flag misclassified or incomplete entries
* Monitor SLA compliance and generate weekly/monthly performance reports
* Analyze incident and request trends to identify recurring issues and opportunities for automation or documentation improvements
* Track backlog trends and report on resolution times
* Provide support in problem management by conducting comprehensive, data\-driven root cause analysis
* Interpret dashboards and translate technical data into clear, actionable insights for service improvement
* Contribute to quality improvement initiatives by highlighting gaps and supporting process documentation
* Use dashboards (e.g., Zoho ManageEngine, ServiceNow, Jira) to extract performance insights
* Assist with the standardization of ticket documentation practices
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to ensure consistency in incident reporting and documentation
* Full\-time role with rotational shifts based on business requirements
* Collaborate with Service Desk leads and quality teams to translate data insights into actionable recommendations
* Assist in documenting known issues, process updates, and best practices to support continuous improvement initiatives
* Participate in team meetings and quality reviews, sharing insights that help drive service enhancements
* Track and analyze the volume and types of escalations to identify training needs for Service Desk staff
* Complete all other tasks deemed appropriate for the role and assigned by the manager/supervisor.

 **REQUIRED SKILLS**

* Process Documentation skills
* Advanced Excel skills
* Ability to deep dive into numbers and draw conclusions
* Understanding of Root Cause Analysis
* Strong reasoning and analytical skills
* Time Management and prioritization
* Multi\-tasking capabilities
* Ability to manage several priorities at once
* Ability to focus for long periods of time to determine a solution
* Strong communication skills (both written and verbal)
* Organize thoughts and communicate verbal messages appropriately to listeners and situations
* Demonstrated proficiency in grammar and typing skills
* Comfortable with repetitive tasks
* Good attention to detail and willingness to learn
* Ability to work independently
* Willingness to cooperate with others and work for the greater good.

**REQUIRED EXPEREINCE \& QUALIFICATIONS**

* A year of phone, email, or chat support experience in IT Service Desk, Helpdesk, Technical Support, or US customer support experience
* Two years of data analysis and reporting or a Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, Business, or a related field
* Familiar with ITIL and its processes, specifically those related to Service Request, Incident, Change, and Problem Management
* Knowledge of Customer Service principles and practices
* Familiarity with ITSM tools (e.g., Zoho Manage Engine, ServiceNow, Jira)
* Understanding of SLA metrics
* Experience in process documentation

**DESIRED SKILLS \& EXPERIENCE**

* Analytics / Data analysis and reporting in a Call Center or Service Desk environment
* Work experience in the Pharma industry
* Knowledge of computer fundamentals, software/web application
* Strong troubleshooting skills.

title: Senior Product Support Specialist
description:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.
   

  

 At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.
   

  

 A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Trust and Safety Operations team is focused (ok, maybe obsessed) on scaling Roblox’s Operations organization and transforming our customer experience through our multi\-year vision and strategy execution. Creators are the engine of Roblox. When something breaks for them, whether it is a broken publish flow, a payout that didn't land, an asset that won't upload, how quickly and how well we resolve it directly shapes whether they keep building with us.
   

  

 You will be reporting to the Trust \& Safety India Operations Manager. The team provides support to Roblox’s global players, developers, and advertisers. As a Senior Product Support Specialist on our Safety Ops Team, you’ll own the hardest escalations end to end, drive root cause analysis with engineering and product partners, and then close the loop by turning what you learn into support content that scales for both our human agents and our automated support experiences.
   

  

 Additionally, you will serve as a product expert working closely with the Product Support Management team, providing detailed synthesis of new and existing issues our users experience to prioritize and enable engineering teams to improve the platform. You'll operate with a high degree of independence.
   

  

**You Will**
**Support health and proactive gap identification**
* Co\-monitor the health of creator support: contact drivers, resolution rates, reopen and escalation rates, deflection performance, CSAT, and where creators are getting stuck.
* Mine ticket, content, and automation data for patterns: recurring issues, missing coverage, misleading documentation, product gaps and surface them proactively with a recommendation attached to the PSM.
* Independently own root cause analysis for complex, high\-impact, and ambiguous creator issues including ones that cross product, platform, and policy boundaries..
* Get ahead of launches: review upcoming product and policy changes, pressure test them from a support perspective, and make sure content, tooling, and agent readiness are in place before creators feel the change. Support PSM in preparing RCA or post launch report to surface to all concerned stakeholder (engineering, product, operations etc)
* Report clearly and regularly to support and product leadership on where creator support is strong, where it's degrading, and what you propose to do about it.
* Drive operational excellence in how creator support runs: hold the line on quality standards, tighten workflows and handoffs between support, engineering, and product, eliminate manual toil through better process and tooling, and treat every process change as something to be measured rather than assumed. Where the current way of working is the bottleneck, you name it and fix it.
* Product Feedback Loop: Partner directly with Product Managers (PMs) during alpha/beta testing phases to provide a "Supportability Scorecard" for major upcoming platform features.


**Knowledge \& Support Content**
* Author and maintain the authoritative internal knowledge base agents rely on which includes but is not restricted to troubleshooting guides, decision trees, macros, policy interpretations and keep it accurate as the product changes underneath it.
* Own creator support content, which includes (but is not limited to) intent\-ready articles, structured resolution paths, and clear, unambiguous source material for support agents to rely on.
* Build automation and self\-service experiences, supplying the content and acting as a subject\-matter judgment behind them, and flagging where automation is producing wrong or incomplete answers.
* Serve as a senior point of contact during high\-severity creator\-facing incidents, coordinating across support, engineering, and comms, when needed
* Raise the bar on escalation quality across the team by setting the standard for what a well\-formed escalation looks like, and reduce the volume that shouldn't have escalated in the first place


 You Have
   

  

* 7\+ years in technical support, product support, or a comparable operational role, including significant time at a senior or escalation tier.
* A demonstrated track record of independent root cause analysis on complex technical issues.
* Excellent written communication. You have the ability to explain a nuanced technical failure to an engineer and to a frustrated creator.
* Comfort with ambiguity and genuine self\-direction. You choose your own problems, defend your prioritization, and close things out without being managed.
* Strong cross\-functional influence without authority, you can get engineering and product to care about a support problem.


**Nice to Have**
* Experience owning support content at scale, with real evidence that your content changed outcomes (deflection, handle time, resolution quality).
* Experience writing or structuring content balancing automation driven human in the loop support, self\-service, etc.
* Prior experience supporting a developer, creator, or partner audience rather than a general consumer base.
* Working knowledge of Roblox as a creation platform; Studio, Lua, the developer economy or comparable experience with a UGC platform.
* Data \& Diagnostic Proficiency: Comfortable querying datasets (SQL, Tableau, or similar BI tools) and analyzing diagnostic logs to isolate bugs before routing to engineering.


 Roles that are based in an office are onsite Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday, with optional presence on Monday and Friday (unless otherwise noted).
   

  

 Roblox provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. Roblox also provides reasonable accommodations to candidates with qualifying disabilities or religious beliefs during the recruiting process.
   

  

 For US based roles only, please note the Company may not be able to employ candidates for this role who have United States work authorization related to certain U.S. visa categories, or support future H\-1B sponsorship at this time.

title: IT Operations - Manager
description:
**About Tarento**
 Tarento is a fast\-growing technology consulting company headquartered in Stockholm, with a strong presence in India and clients across the globe. We specialize in digital transformation, product engineering, and enterprise solutions, working across diverse industries including retail, manufacturing, and healthcare. Our teams combine Nordic values with Indian expertise to deliver innovative, scalable, and high\-impact solutions.
   

  

**We're proud to be recognized as a Great Place to Work** 
 , a testament to our inclusive culture, strong leadership, and commitment to employee well\-being and growth. At Tarento, you’ll be part of a collaborative environment where ideas are valued, learning is continuous, and careers are built on passion and purpose.
   

  

**Job Description – IT Operations / IT Manager**
**Location: Bangalore\| Experience: 10\+ years \|Team: 5–8 IT professionals \| User base: \~500\-person IT organization**
**About The Role**
 We are seeking a highly experienced and proactive IT Operations Lead / IT Manager to lead and optimize the technology environment supporting a 500\-person IT organization. The role combines strategic IT leadership with hands\-on operational ownership across infrastructure, IT service management, end\-user computing, cloud, DevOps, cybersecurity, compliance, vendor management, automation, and technology governance. The successful candidate will lead a team of 5–8 IT professionals, ensure stable and secure day\-to\-day operations, and drive continuous improvement, automation, cost optimization, and exceptional service delivery.
   

  

* IT Operations, Service Management \& Service Delivery
* 
+ Lead day\-to\-day IT operations, ensuring availability, performance, reliability, resilience, and security of infrastructure, systems, applications, networks, cloud services, and end\-user technology.
+ Own IT Service Management processes covering Incident, Problem, Change, Request, and Service Management through the IT ticketing platform.
+ Establish, govern, and continuously improve SLAs, KPIs, ticket ageing, response/resolution targets, and user satisfaction.
+ Act as the escalation point for critical and major incidents; coordinate troubleshooting, root\-cause analysis, corrective actions, and post\-incident reviews.
+ Drive continuous service improvement aligned with ITIL best practices and business priorities.
+ Develop monthly SLA and operational reports covering Internet uptime, service uptime, ticket volumes, ageing, resolution performance, and recurring issues.
+ Maintain a strong customer\-service culture and provide empathetic, professional support to internal users.

* Team Leadership \& People Management
* 
+ Lead, mentor, coach, and develop a team of 5–8 IT support and infrastructure professionals.
+ Assign work, establish priorities, monitor performance, manage escalations, and ensure timely resolution of IT issues.
+ Define objectives, KPIs, development plans, knowledge\-sharing practices, and operational ownership across the team.
+ Foster a collaborative, supportive, accountable, and continuous\-improvement\-oriented culture.
+ Coordinate cross\-functional teams during major incidents, audits, projects, technology changes, and transformation initiatives.

* IT Infrastructure, Network \& End\-User Computing
* 
+ Oversee enterprise infrastructure including networks, servers, storage, virtualization, wireless, firewalls, cloud environments, and end\-user devices.
+ Ensure high availability and reliability of critical IT systems and services.
+ Manage wireless access points, hardware firewalls, switches, network equipment, Internet circuits, and associated vendor services.
+ Manage the complete lifecycle of laptops, desktops, mobiles, peripherals, and accessories from procurement and provisioning through refresh and secure disposal.
+ Own user onboarding, role changes, access provisioning, offboarding, asset recovery, and access\-card coordination with HR.
+ Perform monthly Internet bandwidth and capacity checks and recommend upgrades based on usage and business demand.
+ Maintain disk\-capacity and infrastructure\-health reports and proactively address capacity risks.

* Cloud Management \& Cost Optimization
* 
+ Manage and optimize cloud resources across AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP), where applicable.
+ Support cloud services and customer\-facing workloads hosted on AWS, Azure, and GCP.
+ Monitor availability, performance, capacity, security, and operational health of cloud resources.
+ Track monthly cloud bills, analyze consumption trends, forecast spend, and drive FinOps\-style cost optimization.
+ Define cloud adoption standards and ensure appropriate governance, tagging, access controls, backup, and lifecycle management.
+ Balance on\-premises and cloud workloads to optimize performance, scalability, resilience, and total cost of ownership.

* Software, License, Patch \& Configuration Management
* 
+ Manage Microsoft 365/O365 licenses and project\-specific software licenses, including allocation, renewal, usage, and cost optimization.
+ Oversee software deployment, application inventory, endpoint configuration, and patch management using tools such as ManageEngine Desktop Central/Endpoint Central.
+ Implement and govern automated OS patching for employee workstations and servers.
+ Maintain accurate software and hardware inventories and ensure appropriate licensing compliance.
+ Track software renewals, support contracts, certificates, and technology lifecycle milestones.

* DevOps, Git \& CI/CD Operations
* 
+ Provide operational leadership and governance for DevOps tooling and practices.
+ Manage and support Git, GitLab, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, and Azure DevOps environments as applicable.
+ Perform periodic Git/GitLab access reviews and ensure least\-privilege access and appropriate segregation of duties.
+ Support CI/CD pipelines, automation, deployment reliability, and operational stability in collaboration with development and DevOps teams.
+ Lead infrastructure\-as\-code and configuration\-management practices using Terraform and Ansible where applicable.
+ Support containerization and orchestration platforms such as Docker and Kubernetes.

* Cybersecurity, Risk \& Compliance
* 
+ Define and implement IT security policies, standards, procedures, and operational controls.
+ Act as the IT/security escalation point and support enterprise security governance and risk management.
+ Conduct vulnerability checks and coordinate remediation of identified vulnerabilities.
+ Manage endpoint protection and antivirus/EDR platforms such as Cortex and ensure security agents remain healthy and current.
+ Oversee identity and access management, privileged access, access reviews, endpoint security, network security, and incident response.
+ Maintain the Information Security Management System (ISMS) and support ISO 27001 certification and audit requirements.
+ Participate in quarterly audits, evidence collection, remediation tracking, and management reviews.
+ Coordinate cybersecurity incidents, containment, investigation, recovery, and lessons learned.

* Enterprise Architecture, Technology Strategy \& Governance
* 
+ Define and govern enterprise IT architecture standards, technology reference models, and infrastructure principles.
+ Establish vendor evaluation frameworks and technology selection criteria.
+ Define cloud adoption policies, technology lifecycle standards, and application rationalization roadmaps aligned with business strategy.
+ Partner with C\-suite and executive leadership to translate business objectives into technology roadmaps and investment priorities.
+ Present IT performance metrics, risk posture, cybersecurity status, governance outcomes, and strategic initiatives to senior leadership.
+ Evaluate emerging technologies, including AI, automation, AIOps, and cloud platforms, and assess their operational and business value.

* AI, AIOps \& Automation
* 
+ Lead adoption of AIOps capabilities such as ML\-based event correlation, anomaly detection, predictive monitoring, and automated first\-line remediation.
+ Drive AI\-powered ITSM capabilities including intelligent ticket classification, AI\-driven routing, NLP\-based resolution recommendations, and predictive SLA\-breach alerts.
+ Identify opportunities to automate repetitive IT operations, support processes, monitoring, reporting, and remediation activities.
+ Architect and manage infrastructure for AI workloads, including on\-premises GPU platforms and cost\-optimized cloud AI services where appropriate.
+ Measure operational improvements from AI and automation initiatives, including reduced downtime, faster MTTR, and lower operating cost.

* Proactive Maintenance, Upgrades \& Business Continuity
* 
+ Plan and execute quarterly firmware upgrades for wireless access points and network equipment.
+ Implement and maintain automated OS patching and upgrade cycles for end\-user systems and servers.
+ Perform planned server OS upgrades and maintain application/platform upgrade schedules.
+ Perform quarterly GitLab version upgrades with appropriate validation, backup, rollback, and change\-management controls.
+ Maintain backup, disaster recovery, business continuity, and infrastructure resilience plans for critical services.
+ Use monitoring and capacity data to identify and resolve issues before they impact users or customers.

* Monitoring, Reporting \& Operational Governance
* 
+ Develop and maintain monthly IT dashboards covering service uptime, Internet uptime, network bandwidth, patch compliance, license renewals, ticket performance, disk usage, cloud spend, and security posture.
+ Produce monthly SLA and KPI reports for leadership and relevant stakeholders.
+ Maintain operational dashboards and trend analysis to identify recurring incidents, capacity risks, cost anomalies, and improvement opportunities.
+ Maintain accurate IT documentation, asset records, service ownership information, escalation matrices, and operational runbooks.
+ Maintain and share access\-card server details with HR in accordance with access governance procedures.

* Procurement, Vendor \& Contract Management
* 
+ Own procurement of IT hardware, software, licenses, accessories, network equipment, and technology services.
+ Manage vendor, MSP, telecom, cloud, and technology\-partner relationships.
+ Define and monitor vendor SLAs, KPIs, contracts, renewals, service quality, and operational performance.
+ Lead vendor evaluations, commercial negotiations, renewals, and corrective actions in collaboration with procurement and leadership.
+ Ensure third\-party services meet requirements for availability, security, compliance, performance, and cost.

* IT Budget \& Financial Management
* 
+ Own IT CapEx and OpEx planning, forecasting, budget tracking, and financial reporting.
+ Manage cloud spend forecasting and optimization across AWS, Azure, and GCP.
+ Optimize software licensing, infrastructure, telecom, support, and vendor costs without compromising service quality or security.
+ Present technology investment proposals and cost\-benefit analysis to leadership.

* Client \& Stakeholder Interaction
* 
+ Participate in client calls and technical discussions as required.
+ Provide service status, operational updates, logs, evidence, and technical information to clients in coordination with relevant teams.
+ Translate technical issues into clear business impact, resolution status, risk, and next steps for non\-technical stakeholders.
+ Build strong relationships with business leaders, customers, vendors, and internal technology teams.


**Preferred Qualifications \& Certifications**
* 
+ ITIL 4 certification.
+ ISO 27001 Lead Implementer or Lead Auditor; CISSP or CISM is advantageous.
+ AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud certifications.
+ CompTIA or other infrastructure/security certifications.
+ TOGAF or equivalent enterprise architecture certification.
+ PMP/PRINCE2 or equivalent project\-management certification.
+ Terraform, Kubernetes, or DevOps\-related certifications.


**Key Competencies**
* 
+ IT Operations Leadership
+ Infrastructure \& Network Management
+ Cloud \& FinOps
+ IT Service Management \& ITIL
+ Cybersecurity \& Compliance
+ DevOps \& Automation
+ AI/AIOps \& Intelligent IT Operations
+ Enterprise Architecture \& Technology Strategy
+ Vendor \& Contract Management
+ Budget \& Cost Management
+ Problem\-Solving \& Incident Management
+ Customer Service \& Empathy
+ Executive Communication \& Stakeholder Management
+ Proactive Approach \& Continuous Improvement
+ Team Leadership \& People Development


**Key Performance Indicators**
* 
+ IT infrastructure and service availability / uptime.
+ SLA compliance, ticket resolution time, backlog, and user satisfaction.
+ Major incident frequency, MTTR, recurrence, and root\-cause closure.
+ Patch compliance and vulnerability remediation performance.
+ Cloud spend against budget and measurable cost optimization.
+ Software/license compliance and renewal management.
+ Vendor/MSP performance against contractual SLAs.
+ Audit findings, security compliance, and ISO 27001/ISMS performance.
+ Change success rate and change\-related incidents.
+ Automation/AIOps adoption and measurable reduction in downtime and operational effort.
+ Successful delivery of infrastructure upgrades, lifecycle activities, and technology roadmaps.


**Role Impact**
 The IT Manager / IT Operations Lead is accountable for building a stable, secure, scalable, cost\-effective, and business\-aligned IT environment. The role combines strong operational discipline with strategic technology leadership, proactive service improvement, automation, cybersecurity governance, cloud optimization, and people leadership. The successful candidate will help transform IT into a highly reliable, measurable, customer\-focused, and continuously improving technology function.

description:

 Posha is building robot kitchens for the future.
 



 Our first product, the Posha Countertop was recognized as one of
 **TIME’s Best Inventions of 2025** 
 and received rave reviews from
 **The Verge** 
 and
 **WIRED** 
 for bringing robotics and AI into everyday kitchens.
 



 We’re a fast\-growing
 **Series A–funded** 
 startup backed by
 **Accel Partners** 
 and we’re just getting started.
 



  





 See it in action: https://youtu.be/Ubd6NkZOEkM?si\=SFex\-isehKHzvZs\_
 



  





**🤔 What can I expect from this role?** 




 Posha is building an AI\-powered automated cooking robot and needs a Supply Chain Manager to own material readiness and supplier strategy through our next phase of growth — someone equally comfortable digging into a BOM with an engineer, negotiating with a critical supplier, and building the systems that prevent the next fire before it starts.
 



  





**🔧 What will my work responsibilities look like if I join Posha?** 




  





 🌐
 **Sourcing \& Procurement** 



* Manage 50\+ vendors across off\-the\-shelf and manufactured components — servo/BLDC motors, actuators, display modules, camera modules, flow sensors, power supplies etc.,.
* Own sourcing of manufactured parts: sheet metal, casting, CNC, injection molding, gear hobbing, PCB fab/PCBA.
* Bring genuine technical fluency in specs, tolerances, and process capability to evaluate quotes, flag DFM issues, and hold real technical conversations with engineering and suppliers.
* Vet and onboard new CMs/vendors via structured RFQ.
* Lead CM transitions and qualification — DVT/PVT, tooling transfer, FAI.
* Build manufacturing partnerships ground\-up, including on\-site visits.



  





 🦾
 **Material Planning \& Readiness** 



* Own material planning across development builds, NPI, and mass production.
* Drive PO placement and tracking with proactive risk visibility.
* Manage safety stock and inventory across raw materials, WIP, and finished goods.



  





 🤝
 **Commercial Negotiation \& Supplier Relationships** 



* Build suppliers as long\-term partners, not transactions.
* Hit cost targets via should\-cost modeling; negotiate piece pricing, tooling/NRE, terms, MOQs, lead times
* Run supplier scorecards on delivery, quality, responsiveness, and financial health.



  





 👀
 **Supplier Risk \& Resilience** 



* Identify BOM single points of failure and build backup sourcing.
* Assess supplier capacity and readiness.
* Mitigate risk from lead times, design changes, and capacity constraints through alternate sourcing and risk buys.



  





 🛠️
 **Engineering Partnership** 



* Partner with Hardware/R\&D on DFM, value engineering, and component selection.
* Align with Finance on costing / cash flow and Ops on demand forecasting.



  





 📊
 **Supplier Quality** 



* Own incoming quality standards, FAI, and vendor qualification end\-to\-end.
* Track PPM, CAPA closure, and audit scores through a scorecard/review cadence.
* Lead root\-cause analysis on quality escapes and drive CAPA to closure.
* Conduct supplier audits and build quality requirements into sourcing decisions upfront.

title: Central Monitoring Associate Manager
description:
**Job Overview**
 Responsible for the execution of key central monitoring (site, subject and study level review as applicable) activities. Collaborates within a matrix environment, communicates proactively internally and externally and across functions with key stakeholders to ensure Central Monitoring is proactively and effectively executed to meet client expectations. May be responsible for the preparation and conduct of Central Monitoring tasks across a series of sponsor projects commencing with Informatics platform launch up to study reporting. Conducts review of the applicable Informatics platform and communicates findings at the country, study, site, subject level. Provides Central monitoring support to the study team and to the client. Requires working knowledge of broader drug development and clinical trials. The role is responsible for the conduct of central monitoring activities in a timely manner. Oversee the trial progress as per the defined plan and notify any changes/risk and escalate as appropriate.
   

  

**Summary Of Responsibilities**
* Performs the Central monitoring activities for multiple studies for customers and ensures accurate tracking and status reporting of studies in their remit.
* Act as the Lead for the Central Monitoring team for more than one studies for multiple customers.
* Support Manager and leadership in preparation of detailed study risk assessment and in Sponsor presentations / bid defenses.
* Ensures that tracking and status reporting are performed in a timely and accurate manner.
* Contributes to the Risk Assessment and Categorization Tool (RACT) for topics related to central Monitoring and/or medical reviews and considers risks when planning tools configuration.
* Supports the Data Expert with Critical Data and Process Definition and EDC design implementation.
* Supports the development of informatics Platform requirements, including design of the visualizations, taking into consideration the data feeds for the study (EDC, laboratory, etc.).
* Collates requirements including prescriptive risk factor mitigation strategies, SDV strategy, study\-specific risk factor definition, variable risk factor trigger levels.
* Draft the Configuration Plan and all other applicable Plans in collaboration with the study team and update these on an ongoing basis including the refinement of visualizations and any edits in line with emerging risk profile and study changes.
* Edits the Central Monitoring and other applicable plans in line with emerging risk profile and study changes.
* Populates the tools, tests variable risk factors, adjusts trigger levels, study specific risk factors and central monitoring parameters.
* Performs ongoing reviews, prepares, and recommends mitigation actions and reviews recommended monitoring levels with project team and ensures that identified issues are followed to resolution.
* Proposes potential changes to monitoring intervention level on behalf of the project team in line with overall strategies.
* Prepares and distributes the Project/Study Reports at intervals during study conduct and at study close out.
* Undertakes Central Monitoring (Site, subject and study level review as applicable) activities to ensure consistency and effectiveness.
* Take responsibility for inspection readiness for activities; support regulatory authority inspections when needed.
* Perform subject level review activities and coordinate with the stakeholders to address the findings if applicable.
* Performs study analytics reviews as per the applicable plans and communicates the findings appropriately.
* Provide data\-driven decisions and communicate these findings proactively and effectively to the key stakeholders.
* Prepares and distributes the Project Quality and Risk Reports at intervals during study conduct and at study close out.
* Performs specialized review of central data review tools, based on specific area of expertise (clinical, data or statistics).
* Implements P3 thinking to identify the need for study scope changes and risk profile changes.
* Provides technical leadership to study teams to ensure effective implementation of the process and tools.
* Evaluates and collates process improvement suggestions and submits to leadership.
* Evaluates and submits ideas and justification for improved systems and tools to leadership.
* Submits ideas to increase sales by positioning central monitoring and Informatics Platform with clients.
* If acts as line manager, the following responsibilities apply: Line management responsibilities for the training, utilization, development, and performance of Central Monitoring and/or Medical Data Review Operations Staff. Assign and classify tasks to the employees. Supervise, Mentor, and evaluate performance of staff to ensure career development, interpersonal skills, and achievement of Competency standards. Looking after the work force’s HR needs. Assist in recruitment of new staff. Budgeting and scheduling for work force required to perform tasks. Ensure the smooth functioning of department in the organization. Responsible for managing Performance review and issues of direct reports.
* All other duties as needed or assigned.


**Qualifications (Minimum Required)**
* University / college degree from an appropriately accredited institution.
* Fortrea may consider relevant and equivalent experience in lieu of educational requirements.


**Experience (Minimum Required)**
* Minimum of 6\-8 years of relevant clinical research experience in a pharmaceutical company/CRO or other equivalent experience with increasing levels of responsibility in clinical trial related roles e.g., project management, clinical monitoring, data management and informatics


**Preferred Qualifications Include**
* Post\-graduation in Life sciences or any other applicable qualification and experience.


**Physical Demands/Work Environment**
* Standard office or home working equipment required.


**Travel Requirements:**
* Global.
* % of time:15%

**Key accountabilities**
**Own the multi\-market outcomes framework and balanced scorecard**
* Define the outcomes framework across Cost/Capacity, CX, Risk/Control with standardised KPI definitions, baselines, targets, and tolerance thresholds.
* Ensure comparability across markets while allowing calibrated local targets based on regulatory, operating model and customer behaviour differences.
* Establish clear ownership for each KPI and benefit line (global vs market).


**Build and govern the outcome roadmap for Voice \& Conversational Banking**

* Ensure outcomes support customers requiring human assistance, including vulnerable customers, with appropriate guardrails.
