title: Data Science Specialist
description:
Job Title: Data Science Specialist
   

  

 Req ID: 62724
   

  

 Job Function: Service
   

  

 Posting Start Date: 11/09/2026
   

  

 Posting End Date: 15/09/2026
   

  

 Division: Openreach
   

  

 Job Location: IND\-Gurugram\-IQ
   

  

 Advertised Salary: Competitive
   

  

**About This Role**
 The Data Science Specialist will perform in depth data integration and provide analysis to improve insight and forecast accuracy for Ethernet Products. The insight will be used to define major targets (e.g. volume, market share, substitution) while supporting key commercial and operational decisions for Openreach.
   

  

 The commercial demand forecast for Ethernet has a direct and material impact on resourcing decisions, costs and revenue generation, for short, medium, and long term plans. The role holder will work closely with teams across the business, bringing a wealth of in\-depth insight not just to understand what has happened, but how the business can prepare for the future.
   

  

 The Data Science Specialist is expected to provide a range of solid analytically insight and forecast recommendations to support the core demand forecasting process. The role holder will also support input for the development of business cases and sensitivity scenarios, all related to the rapidly changing Ethernet market in a challenging and uncertain economic environment.
   

  

**You'll Have The Following Responsibilities**
* To be seen as the lead within the team for analysis and modelling relating to Ethernet insight
* To develop, build and maintain insight analyses and models to answer critical questions relating to demand and improve understanding of the Ethernet market.
* To share the output of the analysis with the team in a clear and understandable way, enabling it to be used to improve forecasting accuracy and to support commercial and operational decision making.
* To maintain, update and improve the existing suite of models utilised by the team using a number of different analytical programmes and methodologies.
* To gain a good understanding of both the marketplace and the delivery process for products
* Develop Ethernet analysis based on key value drivers and insight
* Build complex model using statistical software (e.g. Python) and database solutions (e.g. GCP), utilising fully the wealth of database knowledge available, presenting outputs to understand trends and to inform improved forecasting
* Proactively identify business areas that will benefit from the development of analysis and modelling techniques


**You'll Have The Following Skills \& Experience**
* Expert in coding languages required to interrogate large data sets and identify patterns within the data
* Ability to integrate large data sets while working with incomplete or new data streams
* Communication Skills \- Able to present complex data patterns simply to a senior audience while providing recommendations for changes to forecasting methodologies
* Innovative – able to develop statistically robust methods to answer key business questions and improve our understanding of the market. This will included interpretation of geographic variations of demand or performance in areas with various competitive presence
* Personable – creating relationships internally and externally to both gather information and communicate it at the right time to the right person
* Customer focused – understand the key drivers from the customers perspective and how these will ultimately impact demand
* Proven track record of performing advanced statistical analysis and interrogation of large complex data sets
* Able to apply a range of statistical forecasting methodologies and techniques to enhance accuracy.
* Knowledge of statistical software packages as well as expert level in Microsoft Excel
* Very strong business acumen coupled with commercial, analytical, and modelling skills
* Highly organised with ability to manage deliverables on multiple projects and priorities simultaneously
* Graduate Degree in Business, Economics, Statistics, Engineering, Science or IT


 BT Group is the UK’s leading communications group and the holding company behind some of the country’s most recognised brands – including BT, EE, Openreach and Plusnet. Our purpose is as simple as it is ambitious: we connect for good. Our customers include consumers, small, medium and large businesses, public sector organisations and other communications providers.
   

  

 BT Group’s role is about setting direction, unlocking value and creating the conditions for our brands and businesses to thrive.
   

  

 Having come through the most capital\-intensive phase of our fibre investment, our focus now is on what comes next – simplifying how we operate, using technology and AI to work smarter, and organising ourselves to serve customers better and grow sustainably. Group teams shape strategy, policy, brand, capital allocation and transformation, helping the whole organisation perform at its best.
   

  

 We have a singular culture that unites all our people: we are customer\-first challengers, who are committed, clear and connected. These behaviours unite us as one team to deliver for our colleagues, our customers, our stakeholders and the country. Joining BT Group means working at the heart of a business that matters to the UK, with the opportunity to shape decisions, influence outcomes and help set the future course of one of the country’s most important companies.

 Candidates with a background in sustainability/climate consulting, energy and decarbonisation advisory, carbon markets or climate finance would be preferred.
   

  

**Job Requirements** 
  

  

 \* Strong understanding of GHG accounting principles and methodologies, including the GHG Protocol Corporate Standard, Scope 2 Guidance and Scope 3 Standard.
   

 \* Hands\-on experience in developing and reviewing Scope 1, Scope 2 and Scope 3 GHG inventories, including activity data assessment, emission factor selection, calculation methodologies, data validation and development of emissions baselines.
   

 \* Experience in developing corporate and sector\-specific decarbonisation / Net Zero roadmaps, including identification, prioritisation and quantification of emission reduction opportunities.
   

 \* Good understanding of Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi) requirements, target\-setting methodologies, absolute and intensity\-based reduction pathways and Net Zero principles.
   

 \* Ability to identify and assess decarbonisation interventions across areas such as energy efficiency, renewable energy, electrification, fuel switching, alternative fuels, process improvements, waste and circularity, logistics and supply\-chain decarbonisation.
   

 \* Ability to quantify energy, GHG and cost reduction potential associated with individual decarbonisation interventions.
   

 \* Strong understanding of India’s Carbon Credit Trading Scheme (CCTS), Indian Carbon Market and compliance carbon market architecture, including emerging sectoral trajectories, obligated entities, GHG emission intensity targets, credit generation and compliance requirements.
   

 \* Understanding of voluntary carbon markets, carbon credit project development and major carbon standards / methodologies.
   

 \* Knowledge of Article 6 of the Paris Agreement, corresponding adjustments and international carbon market developments would be an advantage.
   

 \* Ability to assess the implications of internal and external carbon pricing on business operations, investment decisions and decarbonisation strategies.
   

 \* Experience in developing carbon price scenarios and incorporating carbon costs into investment and business\-case assessments.
   

 \* Strong financial modelling capabilities for evaluating decarbonisation investments, including:
   

    \* CAPEX and OPEX assessment
   

    \* Energy and operating cost savings
   

    \* Simple and discounted payback
   

    \* NPV
   

    \* IRR
   

    \* Cash\-flow modelling
   

    \* Sensitivity and scenario analysis
   

    \* Carbon\-price impact
   

    \* Marginal Abatement Cost / Marginal Abatement Cost Curve (MACC)
   

 \* Ability to develop business cases for decarbonisation interventions by integrating technical emission\-reduction potential with financial attractiveness.
   

 \* Understanding of financing mechanisms for decarbonisation projects, including green loans, sustainability\-linked loans, green bonds, sustainability\-linked bonds, blended finance, concessional finance, ESCO/RESCO models and other relevant financing structures.
   

 \* Ability to assess different decarbonisation financing options based on project characteristics, technology maturity, investment requirement, payback period, risk allocation and potential funding sources.
   

 \* Understanding of green and sustainable finance frameworks, taxonomies and eligibility considerations relevant to financing low\-carbon investments.
   

 \* Experience in undertaking sector research and benchmarking on emissions intensity, decarbonisation technologies, carbon prices, regulatory developments and low\-carbon transition pathways.
   

 \* Exposure to sectors such as Power, Manufacturing, Chemicals, Pharmaceuticals, Cement, Steel, Metals \& Mining, Oil \& Gas, Automotive, Infrastructure and Financial Services would be preferred.
   

 \* Ability to develop robust Excel\-based analytical and financial models and translate complex analysis into clear management insights.
   

 \* Ability to independently manage client workstreams, conduct stakeholder discussions, coordinate data collection and deliver assignments within agreed timelines.
   

 \* Ability to prepare and deliver high\-impact presentations, technical reports and recommendations to clients and internal committees.
   

 \* Support preparation of proposals, technical approaches, pitch presentations and client discussions for decarbonisation, carbon markets and climate finance opportunities.
   

 \* Contribute to thought leadership, knowledge reports, articles and sector insights on decarbonisation, CCTS, carbon markets and climate finance.
   

  

**Experience** 
 :  At least 5–6 years of relevant experience in sustainability, climate change, energy or related consulting/advisory roles.
   

  

 Candidates should preferably have hands\-on experience in at least 4–5 of the following areas:
   

  

 \* Scope 1, 2 \& 3 GHG Accounting
   

 \* Net Zero / Decarbonisation Roadmaps
   

 \* SBTi
   

 \* Energy and Emission Reduction Assessment
   

 \* Indian CCTS / Carbon Markets
   

 \* Carbon Pricing
   

 \* Carbon Credit Assessment
   

 \* Financial Modelling
   

 \* MACC Development
   

 \* Climate / Green Finance
   

 \* Decarbonisation Project Financing
   

  

**Qualification** 
 :
   

  

 \* MBA / Master’s degree in Energy, Sustainability, Environmental Management, Climate Change, Finance, Economics or related discipline; or
   

 \* Bachelor’s / Master’s degree in Engineering, Environmental Science, Energy or another relevant discipline.
   

  

 Certifications / qualifications in GHG accounting, carbon markets, energy management, climate finance or financial modelling would be an advantage.
   

  

**Preferred Skill Set**

title: Solution Cost Manager
description:
**Job Description Summary**
 GE Vernova is seeking a Solution Cost Manager to join our HVDC team. This role is responsible for managing the cost baselines for all the HVDC reference solutions to ensure a concise, accurate and competitive cost basis is available and can be applied consistently across regions and tenders/projects. The Solution Cost Manager sits at the intersection of solution strategy, sourcing excellence, design improvement and cost competitiveness.
   

  

**Job Description**
 The successful candidate will own the cost framework and baseline of each reference solution that will serve as the templates for individual bids as well as the basis for analysis and decision making as each reference solution is developed. This manager will drive the use of these cost baselines, support bid and execution teams in the correct application while coordinating contributors from various fields (NPI, Value Proposition, Sourcing, etc). A special focus shall be given on improving competitiveness, controlling risk, and protecting profitability.
   

  

**Essential Responsibilities**
* Own and develop reference solution cost baselines, templates and deployment packages, ensuring the baselines are clearly defined, accurate, user\-friendly and well maintained.
* Drive the use of these cost baselines and ensure they are readily available and accessible to all users and stakeholders
* Define, maintain, and govern standard cost baselines for end\-to\-end reference solutions
* Work with Global Sourcing and others to keep costs up\-to\-date, identify any gaps and obtain costings as needed
* Operate in close coordination with the OTR cost controllers to understand actual costs from projects and use this information to refine the reference solution cost baselines
* Work with Proposal Managers to ensure that ITOC models are used correctly and efficiency
* Participate in the tender review process to support, review and ensure the consistency of the data presented
* Support bid and project teams during tender and execution phases by ensuring the correct cost baselines are used in line with intended standards and assumptions
* Coordinate Solution Line and Regional stakeholders involved in sourcing, finance and cost control ensuring alignment between processes and regional business needs
* Provide cost input for analysis and decision making associated with the development of the existing reference solutions and the establishment of new solutions as needed
* Identify, assess, and mitigate cost\-related risks early in the lifecycle to improve execution readiness, reduce delivery uncertainty, and protect profitability
* Continuously evolve the reference solution cost baselines based on market needs, lessons learned, tendering and execution feedback, and business priorities
* Contribute to improving win rate, execution consistency, and margin performance by strengthening the quality, competitiveness, and use of reference solutions


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Electrical Engineering, Project Management, or related field
* Demonstrated experience in cost analysis, bid management, proposal management or Finance in an engineering and/or project environment
* Proven experience developing, governing, or deploying standardized cost tools and references or reusable frameworks in a multi\-project or multi\-region environment
* Strong understanding of project cost control processes and industry\-standard methodologies
* Experience with cost analysis tools and the ability to develop specific tools as needed to support the work
* Demonstrated ability to drive use of standardized tools and references and process improvement across cross\-functional teams
* Stakeholder management and coordination skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering, tendering, regional, commercial teams
* Proven ability to identify risks, resolve cross\-functional issues, and drive alignment in complex business environments
* Fluent in English with strong written and verbal communication skills


**Desired Qualifications**
* Experience in power systems, grid solutions, power conversion technologies, or other industrial infrastructure businesses
* Experience working in global organizations with regional execution models
* Familiarity with bid management, project execution, and lifecycle support processes
* Experience defining cost models, lead time assumptions, standard terms, or deployment methodologies for standard solutions
* Experience driving continuous improvement, lessons learned, and return\-on\-experience integration into standard offerings

 Collect data for regulatory and compliance reporting items such as Form PF, Form ADV, and Form 5500, supporting daily Form PF monitoring under managerial supervision. description:
The D. E. Shaw group is a global investment and technology development firm with more than $100 billion in investment capital as of June 1, 2026, and offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. description:
**Reports to:** 
 Procurement Manager / Business Head
   

  

**Location:** 
**Noida corporate office**
**Experience:** 
 2–7 years in scrap buying, metal trading, recycling, or commodity sourcing
   

  

**Travel:** 
 Regular travel to suppliers, industrial units, dismantlers, stockyards
   

  

* Department Purpose


 Sources, evaluates, negotiates, and purchases recyclable non\-ferrous metals (copper, aluminium, brass, bronze, zinc, lead, nickel alloys, insulated wires, radiators, motors, cables) at competitive prices while ensuring quality, compliance, supply continuity, and profitability.
   

  

* Team Structure


**Head/Manager – Metal Procurement \-** 
 Primary Responsibility: Strategy, margins, supplier network, approvals, team performance
   

  

**Senior Buyer \-** 
 Primary Responsibility: High\-value accounts, pricing, negotiations, volume planning
   

  

**Buyer/Procurement Executive \-** 
 Primary Responsibility: Daily sourcing, quotations, supplier visits, purchase closure
   

  

**Yard/Material Inspector \-** 
 Primary Responsibility: Material ID, grading, weighing, contamination checks
   

  

**Procurement Coordinator \-** 
 Primary Responsibility: POs, documentation, logistics, MIS, payment follow\-up
   

  

**Commercial/Market Analyst \-** 
 Primary Responsibility: Market prices, landed cost, competitor rates, profitability
   

  

* Job Description: Buyer – Non\-Ferrous Metals


**Key Responsibilities**
* Sourcing: Identify, onboard, and develop suppliers (manufacturers, dismantlers, dealers, traders); maintain supplier database; build recurring supply.
* Inspection \& grading: Verify grade/quantity/condition; classify material; coordinate with yard and quality teams.
* Pricing \& negotiation: Track market prices; price on net landed cost/recovery; negotiate terms within approved margins; escalate high\-value deals.
* Purchase execution: Prepare POs and agreements; coordinate logistics and weighment; verify documentation before dispatch approval.
* Quality \& commercial control: Reconcile declared vs. received quality; apply transparent rejection/deduction rules; prevent billing fraud or rate manipulation.
* Compliance: Maintain supplier KYC/GST/PAN; verify authorisation to trade; ensure environmental/waste/tax compliance; reject unverified or suspicious material.
* Reporting: Daily purchase/rate/stock reports; live pipeline tracking; weekly market intelligence updates.
* Skills \& Competencies
* Knowledge of non\-ferrous scrap grades, metal identification, recovery/yield, and processing losses.
* Strong negotiation and supplier relationship management.
* Landed\-cost and purchase\-profitability calculation.
* Familiarity with commodity prices, regional scrap markets, GST/e\-way bill documentation.
* Proficiency in Excel/ERP/procurement software; strong communication and field\-verification skills; high integrity.

description:
**FP\&A – Financial Planning \& Analysis**
**Location:** 
 Ahmedabad
   

  

**Work Mode:** 
 Work From Office
   

  

**Experience:** 
 1\- 2 years
   

  

**Function:** 
 Finance \& Accounts
   

  

**About Smytten**
 Smytten is one of India’s leading product discovery and trial platforms, helping consumers discover products across Beauty, Personal Care, Food \& Beverage, Health \& Wellness, and other categories.
   

  

 As we continue to scale, we are looking for an
 **FP\&A professional** 
 who can go beyond numbers and help the business understand
 **what is happening, why it is happening, and what we should do next.**
**About The Role**
 As part of the FP\&A team, you will work closely with business and finance stakeholders to drive
 **financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, performance tracking, and business decision\-making** 
 .
   

  

 You will own key financial analyses, build meaningful business dashboards/models, identify trends and risks, and provide actionable insights to leadership.
   

  

 This is a high\-ownership role suited for someone who enjoys working with numbers but is equally comfortable understanding the
 **business behind the numbers.**
**Key Responsibilities**
**Financial Planning \& Forecasting**
* Support the annual budgeting and financial planning process.
* Prepare monthly/quarterly forecasts and track performance against budgets.
* Develop financial models to support business plans, growth initiatives, and strategic decisions.
* Identify key business drivers and assess their impact on revenue, costs, margins, and profitability.


**Business Performance Analysis**
* Prepare and present monthly business performance reports for leadership.
* Analyse actuals vs. budget vs. forecast and identify key variances.
* Deep dive into revenue, gross margins, contribution margins, operating expenses, and other business KPIs.
* Translate financial data into clear business insights and actionable recommendations.
* Identify trends, risks, opportunities, and areas requiring management attention.


**Business Partnering**
* Work closely with Business, Marketing, Category, Supply Chain, Retail, and other teams to understand financial performance.
* Partner with stakeholders to evaluate business proposals, investments, campaigns, and new initiatives.
* Support leadership with data\-backed recommendations for business decisions.
* Develop a strong understanding of Smytten's business model, revenue streams, cost structures, and unit economics.


**MIS \& Management Reporting**
* Build and maintain management dashboards and financial reports.
* Streamline recurring reports and improve reporting accuracy and efficiency.
* Establish and track relevant financial and business KPIs.
* Ensure timely and accurate reporting for monthly and quarterly reviews.


**Ad\-hoc Analysis**
* Conduct scenario and sensitivity analysis for key business decisions.
* Evaluate ROI and profitability of new initiatives and investments.
* Support pricing, cost optimisation, and profitability improvement initiatives.
* Take up strategic financial analysis and projects as required by the leadership team.


**What We're Looking For**
* 1\-2 years of experience in FP\&A, Financial Planning, Business Finance, Corporate Finance, or Management Reporting.
* Strong understanding of P\&L, budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, and financial modelling.
* Excellent command of Advanced Excel; experience with financial modelling is preferred.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with a sharp eye for detail.
* Ability to work with large datasets and convert them into meaningful insights.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to present financial insights to non\-finance stakeholders.
* Strong business acumen and curiosity to understand the "why" behind the numbers.
* Ability to work independently in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment.
* Experience in a consumer, e\-commerce, D2C, FMCG, retail, or startup environment would be an advantage.


**Good to Have**
* Experience working with Power BI / Tableau / Looker Studio or similar BI tools.
* Exposure to SQL or data analytics.
* Experience with ERP/accounting systems.
* CA / CFA / MBA Finance or equivalent qualification is preferred but not mandatory.
* Experience in consumer internet, D2C, e\-commerce, FMCG, or retail businesses.


**What Success Looks Like**
 In this role, success means:
   

  

* Leadership has clear visibility into business performance and financial health.
* Budgets and forecasts are accurate, timely, and actionable.
* Variances are identified early, with clear reasons and corrective actions.
* Business teams use financial insights to make better decisions.
* Reporting becomes more automated, efficient, and insightful.
* FP\&A is seen as a business partner, not just a reporting function.


**Why Smytten?**
* Work in a fast\-paced, high\-growth consumer business.
* Get exposure to multiple functions and business verticals.
* Work closely with senior leadership and influence business decisions.
* Opportunity to build and own financial planning and business performance processes.
* Be part of a team that is shaping the next phase of Smytten's growth.

 Full\-time

 We're a small, founder\-led group of related companies based in the USA. We're looking for an experienced accountant to take genuine ownership of the books across those entities — not just process transactions, but maintain a clean, defensible set of records that stands up to a CPA’s review and a tax filing.
 



 You will be the finance function. There is no one above you doing the work — we need someone who catches problems before we do and tells us about them.
 



 As entity count and transaction volume increase, so does the scope — including standardizing processes across companies and eventually building and overseeing a small team. We're hiring for the long term, not for a gap.

* Full\-cycle bookkeeping across multiple related entities — AP, AR, bank and credit\-card reconciliations

 recording transfers, maintaining due\-to / due\-from balances between entities, and keeping both sides reconciled and documented
* Bill pay execution through our approval workflow (you prepare and code; the founder approves and releases)
* Receivables tracking and follow\-up on ageing
* Month\-end close and financial statement preparation for each entity
* Flagging what looks wrong — mis\-codings, missing documentation, balances that don't tie — rather than just closing the month
* Coordinating with our US CPA at close and at year\-end
* Over time: writing SOPs, standardizing the chart of accounts across entities, and training junior support



**What We're Looking For** 




**Essential** 



* 3\+ years doing bookkeeping or accounting for
 **US\-based clients or entities** 
 — this is the primary requirement
* Hands\-on
 **QuickBooks Online** 
 experience (not just Tally)
* Working knowledge of
 **US GAAP** 
 and US small\-business accounting practice
* Experience with
 **multi\-entity or group structures** 
 — you've maintained intercompany balances before and can explain how
* CA, CA Inter (semi\-qualified), CMA, or B.Com/M.Com with equivalent practical experience —
 **we care more about your US client experience than your credential**
* Genuinely self\-directed; comfortable owning the close calendar without being chased
* Clear written English — most of our communication is asynchronous



**Nice to have** 



* Prior experience at a US\-focused accounting KPO or outsourcing firm
* Bill.com, Ramp, Gusto, or similar workflow tools
* Payroll experience
* US: 1099 preparation, sales tax nexus, S\-corp / partnership basics
* Familiarity with agency/marketing services, financial services, or real\-estate holding entities



**What's on Offer** 



* ₹7,00,000 – ₹10,00,000 PA, reviewed as scope grows
* Direct access to the founder — no layers, no bureaucracy
* Real growth path: this role expands into a senior finance position with team responsibility as the group grows
* Fully remote to start, then Hybrid from Ahmedabad



**How to Apply** 




 We receive a high volume of applications and want to spend our time on people who are actually a fit.
 **Instead of a cover letter, please answer both questions below.** 




**1\.** 
 You're handling the books for three related companies and notice a $12,000 expense was booked under the wrong company. Walk us through how you'd fix it, and what you'd put in place to prevent it from happening again.
 



**2\.** 
 Briefly describe one thing about US accounting practice that differs from Indian practice and that you had to learn on the job.
 



 3–5 sentences each is plenty.
 



 Email your answers with your CV to
 **Shawn@compoundventures.ai**

 **Accountant Application** 
 .
 



 Applications without answers to both questions, or without the subject line code, will not be reviewed.

title: Senior Economist
description:
**About the Role** 


 Brickwork Ratings is looking for a Senior Economist to lead its macroeconomic and financial research function. You will lead and mentor a team of economists and financial analysts, build econometric and credit\-risk models, author high\-impact research for investors, policymakers, and markets, and advise senior management and regulators. The role sits at the intersection of research, credit ratings, and regulatory engagement.
   





**Key Responsibilities**

 1\. Team Leadership
 
* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of economists and financial analysts; set research priorities, assign and review deliverables, and manage timelines and quality.
* Build team capability in econometrics, statistical and machine\-learning modeling (R/Python), and research writing.



 2\. Research \& Modeling
 
* Conduct in\-depth macroeconomic and financial research across sectors and geographies, with a focus on implications for Indian credit markets.
* Develop and maintain econometric models for forecasting, scenario analysis, policy evaluation, and credit risk; continuously enhance model accuracy and efficiency using advanced statistical and machine\-learning techniques.
* Monitor global economic developments, monetary and fiscal policy, and market trends, translating them into actionable insights for ratings and research.



 3\. Publications \& Stakeholder Engagement
 
* Author high\-quality research reports, presentations, and briefing notes for internal and external audiences.
* Present findings with clarity and confidence to senior leadership, clients, rating committees, and external partners.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams (ratings, structured finance, sales, and compliance) to support strategic initiatives and client engagements.



 4\. Regulatory, ESG \& Climate Risk
 
* Track and interpret credit\-rating regulations, RBI/SEBI guidelines, and related supervisory expectations; support senior management with research and analysis for day\-to\-day regulatory requirements.
* Analyse climate risk and ESG trends — drawing on frameworks such as TCFD and NGFS — and integrate them into economic, credit, and financial analysis.
* Stay current with global regulatory changes and evolving ESG standards, and assess their impact on BWR's research and rating methodologies.


**Qualifications \& Experience** 
* Advanced degree (Master's or PhD) in Economics, Finance, Mathematics, Statistics, Financial Engineering, or a related quantitative discipline.
* 8\+ years of experience in analytical roles within the financial services industry — spanning macroeconomic research, econometrics, credit research, industry research, or financial research.
* Minimum 2 years of team leadership experience managing economists and financial analysts.
* Proven expertise in developing sectoral forecasting models, credit risk models, and authoring high\-quality research outputs.
* Working knowledge of R and/or Python for statistical modeling and data analysis (preferred).
* Advanced proficiency in the MS Office suite (Word, Excel, and PowerPoint).


**Other Competencies \& Skillsets** 
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with stakeholders at all levels — from analysts to senior leadership, regulators, and clients.
* Prior exposure to rating agencies, think tanks, or financial institutions.
* Familiarity with climate risk frameworks (e.g., TCFD, NGFS) and ESG rating methodologies.
* Understanding of model risk management principles and governance requirements.



  




**About Brickwork Ratings** 


 Brickwork Ratings (BWR) is one of India's leading credit rating agencies, committed to providing the investment community with the products and services needed to make informed investment decisions. Established in 2007, BWR is a SEBI\-registered and RBI\-accredited credit rating agency, with Canara Bank — a leading public sector bank — as its promoter and strategic partner.
 




  






 BWR is headquartered in Bengaluru with a pan\-India presence. Its rating team is led by some of the industry's most experienced credit analysts, bankers, and regulators, while the Research team brings deep global expertise and a strong track record of delivering outstanding proprietary research, econometric models, and analytical frameworks that inform investors, policymakers, and markets.
 




  






 BWR offers rating services for bank loans, non\-convertible debentures (NCDs), commercial paper, bonds, mutual funds, PPMLDs, and security receipts, and has rated over 100,000 large corporates, banks, financial institutions, state and local governments, and small businesses. BWR provides investors and lenders with timely, in\-depth research across structured finance, public finance, financial institutions, project finance, and corporate sectors.

**What We Look For**

* Experience working with multinational clients and distributed teams.

You will serve as a primary legal contact for business clients, resolve complex matters within the team’s scope with minimal supervision, and work across CELA to identify risk, resolve issues, and deliver consistent support across regions.
   

  

 This role offers the opportunity to help define the next generation of legal service delivery within CELA. In addition to supporting individual matters, you will help simplify recurring legal work, strengthen readiness, and develop more scalable ways to support the business. You will work with attorneys, legal professionals, and technology partners to improve workflows and responsibly use data, automation, and AI\-enabled capabilities to increase the speed, quality, and reach of legal support.
   

  

 Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Frontline Legal Support and Client Counseling
   

  

* Serve as a primary legal contact for business clients and complex questions submitted through Global Frontline intake channels. Provide practical legal support with minimal supervision, identify issues and risks, and consult with attorneys or subject matter experts as appropriate.
* Draft, review, negotiate, and process legal and business materials and correspondence. Apply Microsoft policies and approved legal guidance to help clients move work forward while ensuring appropriate escalation and follow\-through.
* Build strong knowledge of Microsoft’s businesses, commercial priorities, CELA processes, and relevant legal frameworks, and apply regional and cultural context to deliver practical, business\-focused support.
* Manage a high volume of matters across multiple clients, priorities, and regions, exercising sound judgment regarding risk, prioritization, escalation, and resource allocation.


 Service Delivery and Readiness
   

  

* Identify recurring client needs, readiness gaps, and process inefficiencies. Work with attorneys and other legal professionals to develop practical guidance, playbooks, intake requirements, training, and self\-service resources that allow the team to take on work deliberately and consistently.
* Use service data and stakeholder feedback to identify trends, assess quality, and recommend improvements to Global Frontline’s scope, processes, and client experience.


 Continuous Improvement and Workflow Innovation
   

  

* Help redesign repeatable legal work for scale and speed. Translate legal and business needs into improved workflows and partner with legal operations, technology, and engineering teams to implement solutions.
* Support responsible adoption of automation and AI\-enabled capabilities in legal workflows, and lead or contribute to projects that help Global Frontline adopt more effective ways of working.


**Qualifications**
 Required Qualifications
   

  

* Bachelor's Degree AND 5\+ years experience in paralegal, legal administration, or relevant experience OR Paralegal Certification that meets the requirements for the location of work AND 6\+ years experience in paralegal, legal administration, or relevant experience OR equivalent experience.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience supporting complex legal or compliance matters with limited supervision and exercising sound judgment regarding risk, prioritization, and escalation.
* Experience working directly with business clients and collaborating across legal, operational, or technical teams.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills.
* Experience in an in\-house legal department, legal service provider, law firm, compliance function, or legal operations environment.
* Experience supporting a global organization or client population across regions and time zones.
* Experience improving legal processes or workflows and developing scalable legal resources.
* Experience using data, technology, automation, or AI\-enabled tools to improve legal service delivery.

title: India Tax Lead - Tax, APAC
description:
**About Stripe**
 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies \- from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups \- use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Stripe’s mission is to increase the GDP of the internet and we have a staggering amount of work to do. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Our tax team works with Stripes across the company to build an efficient, scalable tax operating model as our international business grows, enters new markets and launches new products. We are looking for an experienced tax leader to own Stripe’s India tax agenda and serve as the principal tax partner for our business and entities in India.
   

  

 This role has a broad remit across all India tax matters — leading direct tax, tax compliance and controls, controversy, planning, policy developments, product and market expansion, and business advisory, and partnering closely with Stripe's global SME teams on India\-specific indirect tax and transfer pricing matters. A central focus will be leading India tax controversy: developing audit and litigation strategy, managing interactions with tax authorities and external advisers, and driving matters to effective resolution. You will work closely with colleagues across Finance, Legal, Treasury, Product, Partnerships, Operations and Policy. The position will be based in Bangalore and report to the APAC Head of Tax.
   

  

 What you will do
   

  

* Own and lead Stripe's end\-to\-end India tax agenda, setting priorities and providing clear, practical advice on all material India tax matters, escalating and aligning with SME teams on positions within their remit.
* Manage India tax controversy, including risk assessment, audit and litigation strategy, responses to information requests and notices, engagement with tax authorities, management of external counsel and advisers, and resolution of disputes.
* Identify emerging India tax risks and opportunities, maintain a clear view of exposures, and communicate recommendations and decisions to senior Tax, Finance and business stakeholders.
* Build and maintain robust India tax controls, documentation and processes, partnering with Accounting and other teams to ensure accurate, timely and audit\-ready compliance.
* Advise on India aspects of new products, commercial arrangements, entity and operating\-model changes, product expansion, intercompany transactions and strategic initiatives.
* Monitor and interpret legislative, regulatory and administrative developments in India, assess their impact on Stripe and lead implementation of required changes.
* Develop strong relationships with internal stakeholders, tax authorities, industry bodies and external advisers, representing Stripe effectively on India tax matters.
* Partner with the APAC and global tax teams on regional and global initiatives, sharing India expertise and ensuring consistency with Stripe’s broader tax strategy.


 We are looking for someone with
   

  

* 12\+ years of relevant India tax experience in a Big 4 firm, law firm and/or multinational organisation, with demonstrated ownership of complex tax matters.
* A professional qualification such as Chartered Accountant, lawyer or equivalent, and deep technical knowledge of Indian corporate and indirect tax law.
* Significant hands\-on experience leading India tax audits, assessments, appeals or litigation, including developing controversy strategy and engaging with tax authorities and advisers.
* Broad working knowledge of Indian direct and indirect taxes, transfer pricing, and withholding tax, with demonstrated ownership of tax compliance, controls, controversy and business advisory for a multinational group, and experience partnering effectively with global SME teams.
* Strong judgement and the ability to translate complex tax issues into clear, pragmatic recommendations for non\-tax stakeholders and senior leaders.
* A track record of working independently, setting priorities and driving cross\-functional matters to resolution in a fast\-moving environment.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the credibility to represent Stripe externally and influence stakeholders at all levels.
* Flexibility to adapt quickly to changes in tax law, administrative practice and Stripe’s business.
* A willingness to work with a diverse set of individuals who care deeply about Stripe’s tax issues and each other.


 It would be nice if you have
   

  

* Experience working in a high\-growth, rapidly scaling environment.
* Experience in technology, payments or financial services.
* Experience with tax policy or industry engagement in India.
* Familiarity with international tax issues.


 ‘Nice to have’ really means ‘nice to have’. It’s completely possible that you don’t have any of these and are still a great fit for the team.
   

  

 To apply please include the following
   

  

* \* LinkedIn profile and resume


 In\-office expectations
   

  

 Office\-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in\-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in\-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.
   

  

 Pay and benefits
   

  

 Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.
   

  

 We look forward to hearing from you.
   

  

 At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.
   

  

 Apply now

title: Legal Research Intern
description:
About Jurisphere
 


 Jurisphere is an AI\-powered legal workspace built for lawyers and legal teams, helping them streamline legal research, document review, drafting, translation, and other document\-heavy workflows. The company recently raised a $2\.2M seed round led by Info Edge Ventures, with participation from Flourish Ventures, Antler and 8i Ventures. Today, Jurisphere is used by 500\+ organisations and 20,000\+ legal professionals, including ICICI Bank, Unilever, Philips, Tata Capital, CMS IndusLaw, and other leading legal teams.
 




  





 About the role
 


 As a Legal Research Intern at Jurisphere, you become part of the team that teaches our AI models how the law actually works and does it rigorously. Your work directly fuels our reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) pipeline: the process by which practicing and student lawyers correct, rank, and refine AI outputs so the model learns to reason like a lawyer.
 




  






 This is your chance to work on the building side of legal AI and shape how the next generation of legal technology is developed, from the ground up.
 




  





**You will:** 



* **Grade AI outputs (RLHF):** 

 Read the model's answers to legal questions and rate them for accuracy, faithfulness to authority, and lawyerly reasoning. Rank competing outputs head\-to\-head. Your ratings become the reinforcement signal that trains the next version of the model.



  




* **Build legal benchmarks:** 

 Help design the tests that measure whether an AI can genuinely reason about Indian law—contract interpretation, statutory construction, precedent application, jurisdictional issues. You'll define what "getting it right" means.



  




* **Write research notes:** 

 Short doctrinal memos on niche areas of law (competition, contracts, IP, IBC, arbitration, tax, etc.) that become reference material for model training. Your synthesis becomes foundational.



  




* **Collaborate with the engineering team:** 

 Your feedback shapes what the model does next. The most valuable interns are the ones who tell us where the model is confidently wrong .



  





  





**You'll fit here if you have:** 



* **Strong legal research and writing skills \-** 

 You can find the authority, read it carefully, and summarize it accurately. You understand the difference between a supporting point and a controlling argument.



  




* **Attention to detail \-** 

 The kind of detail that catches a wrongly\-cited section or a subtle distinguishing fact. The kind that matters in law.



  




* **Comfort with sustained, focused work \-** 

 This is patient, methodical work,closer to law review editing than court hearings and you find it satisfying.



  




* **Genuine intellectual curiosity** 

 about how AI will reshape the legal profession, and the drive to be on the building side of that transformation rather than observing from the sidelines.



  





**Mandatory Requirements** 



* Law Graduate from any reputed college (enrolment not mandatory)
* Being able to commute to Bangalore Office in HSR Layout 5 days a week

title: Junior Technology and Business Lawyer
description:
**About Vectis** 




 Vectis is a technology law firm launched in April, 2026\. Our clients are funded startups, typically seed to Series C, building in AI, energy, robotics, IoT and software. We operate as product counsel and assist with large commercial transactions: understanding what the product actually does, then mapping the commercial terms onto it so that revenue, risk and failure points are all visible to the client. We also do corporate transactions from time to time.
 



 The firm is AI\-native. Our workflows are built around AI tools from the ground up, on the conviction that they make good lawyers better (and, unfortunately, bad lawyers worse) rather than replacing them.
 



 We are a operate as a small, sharp unit so everyone works directly with clients in some capacity.
 



  





**The role** 




 You will work alongside the team across the firm's matters. The work falls into five areas:
 


1. **Drafting.** 
 First drafts of agreements (SaaS, licensing, services, partnership; occasionally other arrangements too), data protection agreements and privacy documentation.
2. **Review.** 
 Reviewing counterparty paper, identifying what matters, and writing up your reasoning in a form a client can act on.
3. **Research.** 
 Legal research on Indian and cross\-border questions, with primary\-source citations and a clear answer.
4. **Proof reading.** 
 You will be required to run the pre\-final read of documentation that is prepared by another lawyer. You are expected to be able to do this with the utmost focus and diligence from the get\-go.
5. **Thought leadership.** 
 Contributing to the firm's thought leadership initiatives; we encourage you to pick a stream that works for you and we do our best to empower you in this.
6. **Discovery initiatives.** 
 Getting under the hood of a new technology, sector or practice area before a client needs us to, and turning what you learn into something the firm can use.



  





**What we are looking for** 



1. Curiosity about how technology actually works, and the patience to read documentation until you understand it.
2. Clear, precise writing. If you cannot explain a clause in plain language, you do not yet understand it.
3. Extreme diligence and organisation. This is a requirement, not a preference. The work depends on nothing being dropped, every loop being closed, and every file being where it should be.
4. Willingness to work with AI tools every day, and the judgment to know when they are wrong.
5. A law degree and enrolment with a State Bar Council (or eligibility to enrol on graduation).
6. Experience is welcome but not required. Fresh graduates and lawyers with a few years of practice are equally welcome.



  





**What we are not looking for** 



1. General corporate or corporate transaction specific practitioners that are looking to continue on that specialised track rather than advance their expertise on working with technology.
2. Someone who wants a narrow specialism from day one, we believe that early years of a practice must be broad by design.
3. Someone who treats review as a checklist. We want to know why a clause matters, not just that it deviates.
4. Someone who finds the technology side of technology law tedious.



  





**How we work** 



1. You will be trained on the firm's operating practice, which ranges from how work is handed off, how reasoning is recorded, and what review you can expect on your drafts.
2. Feedback is considered pivotal to improvement so we encourage direct, but polite and well mannered, communication within the team.
3. You will be in front of clients early, with support. You will need to be able to present yourself accordingly.

title: Associate III - AML KYC Specialist
description:
**Role Description**
**Overview of Role/Principle Responsibilities:**
 To act as subject matter expert on all core AML/KYC due diligence activities, perform robust quality assurance and handle advanced cases, directly supporting the Analysts and providing hands\-on guidance.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Advanced Due Diligence Execution


 Complex Entity Review: Review and perform due diligence on non\-standard, complex structures (e.g., layered ownership, trusts, foundations, offshore vehicles), ensuring full transparency of control and beneficial ownership.
   

  

 Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD): Lead EDD work on high\-risk clients (e.g., PEPs, complex private equity structures, high\-risk geographies):
   

  

 Analyse and corroborate sources of wealth and funds through documentary evidence and public record checks
   

  

 Conduct in\-depth open\-source investigations on high\-risk profiles or negative media hits
   

  

 Liaise with customer agreed escalation point for enhanced approval and/or further escalation
   

  

* Screening and Risk Mitigation


 Name Screening Oversight: Validate name screening s escalated by Analysts, determine false positives and true matches, and make decisions on further escalation.
   

  

 Sanctions/Adverse Media: Investigate and document all genuine matches against sanctions, PEP, and adverse media lists, with clear escalation narratives and recommendations.
   

  

* Risk Assessment \& Rating


 Risk Factor Analysis: Review risk ratings assigned by Analysts, ensure scoring methodologies are correctly applied, and correct or re\-assess where necessary.
   

  

 KYC Reviews: Lead periodic reviews of investor files. Re\-assess documentation based on trigger events—ownership changes, negative news, jurisdiction upgrade/downgrade, etc.
   

  

* Quality Control and Training


 File Review: Execute rigorous file quality checks. Maintain QA checklists, document deficiencies, and confirm corrective action by Analysts.
   

  

 Coaching: Provide hands\-on coaching and process clarification to Analysts and act as the first point of contact for technical queries.
   

  

 Knowledge Sharing: Develop guidance notes, training materials, and best practice documentation for use within the team.
   

  

* Analysis and Implementation


 Procedure Updates: Monitor changes in AML/CFT internal procedures as required. Provide operational input to Team Leaders regarding impacts on workflows.
   

  

 Project Participation: Support remediation, data clean\-up, or regulatory project work as assigned.
   

  

* Casework \& Escalation


 Complex Query Resolution: Act as initial escalation point for complex or unusual cases—either resolve or clearly summarise and escalate to Team Leader/Manager.
   

  

 Investor \& Counterparty Liaison: Handle detailed, technical queries from investors, fund managers, or distributors related to AML/KYC requirements.
   

  

* Know your distribution (KYD) – where applicable
* In\-Depth Questionnaire Analysis: Review DDQ and Wolfsberg Questionnaire responses in detail, cross\-checking answers for plausibility and completeness. Follow up directly with intermediaries if clarifications are needed.
* AML Control Framework Assessment: Conduct a review and summarise the distributor’s or platform’s Financial Crime (FC) control policies and procedures, including initial and ongoing client due diligence processes. Prepare a comparison of intermediaries’ stated practices against client’s risk appetite and regulatory expectations.
* Reliance Assessment Support: Assess whether reliance on the intermediary’s AML controls may be considered, and document the findings. Where Placement Agents are involved, assist in determining if they fulfil a different role and escalate uncertainties to the designated client function.
* Investor Profile Review: Analyse and document who the underlying investors are (retail, HNWI, professional clients, etc.), as disclosed by the distributor or obtained via DDQ.
* Quality Assurance: Review Analysts’ KYD files for thoroughness and escalate deficiencies or high\-risk findings as required.


**Skills And Behaviours Required**
* 5\-6 years’ AML/KYC experience with focus on alternative investments and complex structures
* Demonstrable expertise in risk\-based approaches, screening investigations, and EDD
* Adept communicator, able to articulate complex regulatory topics in practical terms
* Strong attention to detail, time management, and coaching ability
* High proficiency in KYC/AML databases and screening tools Proficiency with office productivity tools; prior exposure to KYC/AML systems advantageous.
* Strong interpersonal skills and team focus


**Skills**
 Anti\-Money Laundering, Attention to Detail, Time Management

description:
**Role Overview:**

We are looking for a qualified Company Secretary (mandatory) to join our organization as Manager \- Compliance \& Legal. The role will primarily focus on SEBI intermediary compliance, covering areas such as PMS, AIF, Stock Broking, and Depository operations, along with Secretarial and Legal support functions.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**SEBI Intermediary Compliance:**

\- Ensure end\-to\-end regulatory compliance as applicable to SEBI\-registered intermediaries, such as PMS, AIF, Stock Broking, and Depository Participant (DP) operations.

\- Handle periodic filings, reporting, and disclosures required under respective SEBI regulations.

\- Liaise with SEBI, Stock Exchanges, Depositories, and other regulatory/self\-regulatory bodies on compliance matters, inspections, and inquiries.

\- Monitor and implement changes arising from SEBI circulars, notifications, and amendments across applicable business lines.

\- Draft, review, and update internal compliance manuals, SOPs, and policies in line with SEBI requirements.

\- Coordinate compliance audits, inspections, and internal reviews specific to intermediary operations.

\- Handle investor grievance redressal and SCORES\-related compliance, where applicable.

\- Work closely with business, risk, and operations teams to embed compliance requirements into day\-to\-day functioning of PMS/AIF/broking/depository/ RA operations.

\- Prepare and present compliance reports/dashboards to senior management and the Board.

**Secretarial Functions:**

\- Handle Board Meetings, Committee Meetings, and General Meetings, including drafting notices, agendas, resolutions, and minutes at Group level.

\- Manage statutory filings, registers, and records under the Companies Act.

\- Coordinate with ROC/MCA/RBI on secretarial matters and ensure compliance with corporate governance and corporate restructuring requirements.

**Legal Support:**

\- Draft, vet, and review contracts, agreements, and other legal/regulatory documents.

\- Provide legal risk inputs relevant to intermediary operations and business activities.

\- Coordinate with external legal counsel as required.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications:**

\- Qualified Company Secretary (ACS/FCS) from ICSI \- mandatory.

\- 4 \- 6 years of relevant experience, with substantial exposure to SEBI or any Regulatory compliance.

\- Strong drafting, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

\- Ability to independently manage regulatory timelines and liaise with regulators.

\- High attention to detail and strong analytical ability.

We offer flexibility, competitive benefits, and a supportive culture where your ideas are valued and can truly make a difference.

The role offers the opportunity to develop into a well\-rounded resiliency professional within a dynamic, cross\-functional environment that supports enterprise resilience outcomes globally
   

  

**Primary Roles/Responsibilities**
**Operational Resilience \& Business Continuity Support**
* Support the execution of Operational Resilience and Business Continuity activities across legal entities, critical business services, and business units.
* Assist with self\-assessments, impact tolerance reviews, continuity planning activities, testing coordination, testing quality assurance, Third party due diligence reviews and evidence management.
* Maintain inventories, trackers, documentation repositories, and supporting artefacts.
* Coordinate periodic reviews and updates to resiliency documentation and supporting records.


**Governance \& Reporting**
* Produce management information, dashboards, metrics, and progress reports for leadership and governance forums.
* Support preparation of governance materials, committee packs, presentations, and executive reporting.
* Track action items, issues, risks, and remediation activities arising from resilience assessments, audits, exercises, and regulatory reviews.
* Ensure accurate and timely maintenance of reporting and governance records.


**Shared Services Delivery**
* Execute repeatable and operationally intensive activities within the Shared Services service catalogue.
* Support standardization of processes, templates, methodologies, and documentation.
* Perform quality assurance reviews and validation checks to improve consistency and data quality.
* Assist in identifying opportunities to centralize activities and improve process efficiency.


**Regulatory, Audit \& Issue Management Support**
* Assist with regulatory requests, audit inquiries, evidence collection, and documentation reviews.
* Support issue management activities including action tracking, status reporting, and remediation monitoring.
* Contribute to the preparation of materials supporting regulatory submissions and resilience attestations.


**Data Analysis \& Process Improvement**
* Analyze resilience data and identify trends, gaps, and improvement opportunities.
* Support workflow optimization, automation initiatives, and process enhancement activities.
* Assist in reducing manual effort through improved reporting, data management, and technology utilization.
* Contribute to the development of scalable operating procedures and controls.


**Stakeholder Engagement**
* Partner with ERO teams and business stakeholders to support delivery of resilience objectives.
* Coordinate activities across multiple workstreams and maintain strong working relationships with internal partners.
* Provide timely updates on deliverables, dependencies, and execution risks.


**Key Qualifications**
* Min a Bachelor's degree.
* Overall, 10\-15 years of work experience in the financial services sector is required.
* Min 2\-5 years of experience in Operational Resilience, Business Continuity, Risk Management, Compliance, Audit, Operations, Project Management, or a related discipline.
* Understanding of Operational Resilience, Business Continuity, Crisis Management, Third\-Party Risk, or Regulatory Risk frameworks preferred.
* Experience supporting audits, regulatory reviews, or enterprise\-wide programs preferred.
* Experience with workflow automation, reporting tools, Power BI, ServiceNow, or process improvement initiatives preferred.
* Relevant industry certifications such as CBCP, MBCP, ISO 22301 preferred.
* Experience supporting governance, reporting, documentation, or risk management processes required
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills are required.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills essential
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint, and reporting tools.


**About State Street**
 Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.
   

  

 We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential.  \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
   

  

**Position Summary**
**Material Compliance Engineer – Hyderabad, India (2\-4 Years Experience)**
 As a
 **Material Compliance Engineer** 
 , based in Hyderabad, India, you will be a key individual contributor driving global material compliance initiatives, with a deep focus on
 **RoHS, REACH, Prop 65, EU WFD, TSCA, EU Pop, Extended Minerals and Conflict Minerals Regulation** 
 . You will lead the implementation and continuous improvement of formalized compliance processes, ensuring all plants and suppliers globally meet these standards. Working with cross\-functional teams, you will focus on optimizing compliance strategies, handling escalations, and ensuring seamless coordination between Regal suppliers, plants, and third\-party partners.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead the execution of global Material Compliance processes, including the introduction, coordination, and alignment of suppliers and plants with global compliance policies (RoHS, REACH, EU WFD, EMRT, EU POP, TSCA ,Conflict Minerals \& others).
* Supporting for campaign via third party SAAS tool. Setting up suppliers, leading campaign runs, data collection using 3rd party platform.
* Act as the primary driver for material compliance initiatives resulting from customer requests, ensuring timely and accurate responses.
* Serve as a subject matter expert (SME) on all regulatory compliance, including providing guidance and leadership on compliance projects.
* Coordinate with global suppliers and internal stakeholders to gather Bill of Materials (BOM) data and ensure full regulatory compliance.
* Issue certificates (RoHS, REACH, Conflict Minerals, EU WFD, PFAS, TSCA etc) to customers, maintaining consistent communication and updates on compliance status.
* Support and drive continuous improvement of global compliance processes by partnering closely with the Global Material Compliance Manager.
* Lead audit and risk assessment activities for suppliers, driving performance improvements through supplier development initiatives.
* Manage project progress using project management tools, ensuring shortened lead times and the effective completion of key milestones.
* Conduct compliance audits and provide technical support to both internal and external stakeholders, leading campaigns for non\-responding suppliers.
* Act as a key change agent, influencing and motivating teams across regions to align with global compliance objectives.
* Stay updated on evolving regulations to ensure that the company’s compliance processes remain ahead of global legal requirements.


**Required Education / Experience / Skills**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Business, Technology, Engineering (Mechanical, Chemical, Manufacturing, etc.).
* Minimum 2\-4\+ years of experience in Material Compliance with demonstrated expertise in RoHS, REACH, Conflict Minerals, EU WFD, Prop 65, EU Pop, PFAS and TSCA regulations.
* Proven track record of leading material compliance activities for global organizations, managing complex supplier ecosystems, and driving compliance initiatives across multiple regions.
* Strong negotiation and supplier management skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders across global teams.
* Demonstrated proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Access, Word, PowerPoint, Power BI) and project management tools.
* Background in Six Sigma or Lean Manufacturing is highly desirable.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to liaise with diverse teams and senior management.
* Ability to work independently with strong customer focus and result\-oriented mindset.
* Exposure in AI tools


**Travel**
* Occasional travel as required, based on project needs.


**Language**
* Proficiency in English (Written/Spoken) is essential. Knowledge of local/regional languages is an advantage.


**About Regal Rexnord**
 Regal Rexnord is a publicly held global industrial manufacturer with 30,000 associates around the world who help create a better tomorrow by providing sustainable solutions that power, transmit and control motion. The Company’s electric motors and air moving subsystems provide the power to create motion. A portfolio of highly engineered power transmission components and subsystems efficiently transmits motion to power industrial applications. The Company’s automation offering, comprised of controls, actuators, drives, and precision motors, controls motion in applications ranging from factory automation to precision control in surgical tools.
   

  

 The Company’s end markets benefit from meaningful secular demand tailwinds, and include factory automation, food \& beverage, aerospace, medical, data center, warehouse, alternative energy, residential and commercial buildings, general industrial, construction, metals and mining, and agriculture.

title: Manager, External Affairs
description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose\-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.
   

  

**Your work could help protect millions of patients. Here's how.**
 Every medicine that reaches a patient has a story and behind that story is a team of people making sure it's safe. That's where
 **you** 
 come in.
   

  

 We're looking for someone who wants to do more than manage documents. We want someone who understands that every Pharmacovigilance Agreement (PVA) they draft, every Safety Adverse Event Management Plan (SAEMP) they maintain, is a link in a chain that ultimately protects real people.
   

  

**At BMS, your attention to detail isn't just good practice \- it's patient safety in action.**
**So, what will you actually be doing?**
 You'll be working in the Safety Quality Management (SQM) pillar at the heart of our global
 **Patient Safety team** 
 , managing the agreements that govern how we and our external partners handle drug safety information. Think of yourself as a critical connector, bridging BMS, business partners, and CROs to make sure that when safety data matters most, the right processes are in place and running smoothly.
   

  

**Day To Day, That Means**
* Drafting, reviewing, and maintaining PVAs and SAEMPs \- the foundational agreements that keep our pharmacovigilance operations compliant and partner relationships running seamlessly
* Collaborating with global stakeholders across scientific, regulatory, and operational teams \- you won't be siloed; you'll be sought after
* Applying your regulatory knowledge to keep processes sharp, compliant, and continuously improving
* Building genuine relationships with subject matter experts inside and outside Patient Safety \- your network will grow fast here
* Working with industry\-leading platforms like Veeva Vault and SharePoint \- tools that will sharpen your digital toolkit


**What's in it for you?**
 Let's be direct about the
 **real gains** 
 this role offers:
   

  

* Global visibility \- This isn't a local role. You'll interact with colleagues and partners across geographies, giving you an international perspective that's genuinely rare at this level.
* Accelerated expertise \- You'll develop deep knowledge in pharmacovigilance regulations, partner agreement frameworks, and compliance best practices. This is a career\-defining specialism that opens doors across the pharma industry.
* A seat at the table \- You won't just execute tasks; you'll contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and quality projects that shape how Patient Safety operates globally.
* Purposeful work, every day \- The work you do directly supports BMS's mission to discover, develop, and deliver transformative medicines. You'll feel that connection \- it's not abstract here.
* Grow your influence \- You'll regularly engage with technically and culturally diverse colleagues, sharpening your ability to communicate, influence, and lead without authority \- a skill that makes professionals invaluable.
* Broaden your scope – You’ll have opportunities to contribute to additional activities across the SQM organization, expanding your experience and visibility beyond your core responsibilities.


**What You'll Bring**
 You're probably already thinking
 *"that sounds like me"* 
 but just to confirm, here's what we're looking for:
   

  

* A degree in Life Sciences, Nursing, Pharmacy, Regulatory Affairs, or Chemistry (or equivalent experience that tells a similar story)
* A solid understanding of drug development, pharmacovigilance, and regulatory requirements \- you don't need to know everything on day one, but a strong foundation matters
* The kind of organisational skills that mean you actually enjoy juggling priorities, not just surviving them
* A natural communicator who can adapt their style \- whether you're briefing a senior leader or onboarding a new partner, you know how to land a message
* Someone who's people\-first \- you build trust easily and know that great outcomes come from great relationships


 Here, your career isn't just managed. It's
 **championed** 
 .
   

  

*Ready to make your work mean something? We'd love to hear from you.*
**Apply now and become part of a team where every agreement you sign helps keep patients safer.**
 We hire for skills and capabilities, not just credentials – if this role excites you, but doesn’t perfectly match your resume, we encourage you to apply anyway.
   

  

**How We Work**
 Where you work matters – because collaboration, innovation and patient impact happen in many settings. Our roles are structured across four work models: site\-essential, site\-by\-design, field\-based and remote\-by\-design. The model assigned to this role is based on its core responsibilities. Learn more at https://careers.bms.com/ways\-of\-working.
   

  

**Supporting People With Disabilities**
 BMS is dedicated to ensuring that people with disabilities can excel through a transparent recruitment process, reasonable workplace accommodations/adjustments and ongoing support in their roles. Applicants can request a reasonable workplace accommodation/adjustment prior to accepting a job offer. If you require reasonable accommodations/adjustments in completing this application, or in any part of the recruitment process, direct your inquiries to adastaffingsupport@bms.com. Visit careers.bms.com/eeo\-accessibility to access our complete Equal Employment Opportunity statement.
   

  

**Candidate Rights**
 BMS will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, pursuant to applicable laws in your area.
   

  

 For roles based in Los Angeles County only: If you live in or expect to work from Los Angeles County if hired for this position, please visit this page for important additional information: https://careers.bms.com/california\-residents/
   

  

**Data Protection**
 We will never request payments, financial information, or social security numbers during our application or recruitment process. Learn more about protecting yourself at https://careers.bms.com/fraud\-protection.
   

  

 Any data processed in connection with role applications will be treated in accordance with applicable data privacy policies and regulations.
   

  

 If this posting is missing required information required by local law or incorrect, contact BMS at TAEnablement@bms.com with the Job Title and Requisition number. Do not send application\-related inquiries to this email. To check your application status, please login to your Candidate Home Account.

**Company Description** 
 The Law Point (TLP) is a disputes and regulatory\-focused law firm, founded in 2006, with offices in Mumbai and New Delhi. The firm represents leading private and public companies, regulators, statutory authorities, charities, and high\-net\-worth individuals before a range of judicial and quasi\-judicial forums. TLP’s practice spans commercial litigation and arbitration, regulatory advisory and disputes, white\-collar crime defence, infrastructure contract management, and pre\-dispute advisory work across multiple sectors. The team comprises a structured hierarchy of partners, counsel, and lawyers, combining the energy of a young firm with nearly two decades of experience. TLP offers a professional environment with exposure to complex matters and opportunities for growth in dispute resolution and regulatory work.
 



**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Associate Securities Lawyer role based in Mumbai. The associate will work on matters before SAT, NCLT, High Court, including advising on regulatory compliance.
 



**Qualifications** 







* Strong foundation in securities law, corporate law, and financial markets regulation, with the ability to interpret and apply relevant statutes, rules, and circulars.
* Experience or demonstrated interest in regulatory advisory work, including compliance assessments, liaison with regulators, and handling enforcement or investigative proceedings.
* Skills in legal research, analysis, and drafting, with the ability to prepare clear and precise pleadings, opinions, transaction documents, and internal notes.
* Exposure to dispute resolution, including litigation and arbitration related to securities and commercial matters, and comfort appearing before forums under guidance of senior lawyers.
* Strong communication and client\-handling abilities, including structured written communication, professional client interactions, and effective collaboration with colleagues.

 Bombay Juris Law Offices is a full\-service corporate and commercial law firm operating in a boutique, high\-touch setting. Founded on client\-centricity, excellence, and result\-oriented advocacy, the firm blends decades of legal experience with a pragmatic, solution\-driven approach. It advises both individuals and businesses across complex legal and business challenges while maintaining the highest standards of ethics, integrity, and personalized service. Recognized as a “Top Emerging Legal Advisory Firm India 2025” and for “Excellence in Corporate \& Investments Laws Advisory,” Bombay Juris serves clients in practice areas including general corporate and commercial law, banking and finance, VC/PE, M\&A, funds, startups, technology and data privacy, corporate governance, real estate, white\-collar investigations, international trade, tax, estate planning, and the not\-for\-profit sector.
