title: Compliance Officer and Company Secretary
description:
**About**
**National Investment and Infrastructure Fund Limited**





  





 National Investment and Infrastructure Fund Limited (“NIIF”) is India’s largest infrastructure and private equity fund manager, with \~ USD 7\.3\+ billion in assets under management. Anchored by the Government of India (GoI), NIIF aims to mobilize capital from international and domestic institutional investors for large scale investments in the country through its six funds. Investors in NIIF funds include: sovereign wealth funds like Abu Dhabi Investment Authority (ADIA) and Temasek; global pension funds like Ontario Teachers’ Pension Plan (OTPP), AustralianSuper, CPP Investments, PSP Investments; development financial institutions like U.S International Development Finance Corporation (USIDFC); multilateral development banks like Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank (AIIB), Asian Development Bank (ADB) and New Development Bank (NDB); and top domestic financial institutions such as State Bank of India, HDFC Group, ICICI Bank, Kotak Life and Axis Bank. 
 



  





**Job Responsibilities :**




  





**Board Advisory, Governance \& Leadership**




 • Serve as a trusted advisor to the Board and senior management on governance, fiduciary obligations and regulatory developments.
 



 • Lead Board and committee processes, including agenda setting, preparation of papers, minutes and resolutions, and tracking of action items.
 



 • Shape and institutionalise governance frameworks across the Manager, Funds, Trustee and portfolio companies.
 



 • Build and lead a high\-performing compliance and secretarial team, with responsibility for capacity, quality and execution standards across the function.
 



  





**Platform Oversight \& Stakeholder Management**




 • Act as the central point of interface with institutional investors, regulators, trustees, auditors, custodians and depositories.
 



 • Drive consistency of governance and compliance standards across a diversified fund platform and portfolio ecosystem.
 



 • Provide strategic support on fund structuring, investor onboarding and key governance aspects of capital raising.
 



  





**Regulatory Strategy \& AIF Compliance**




 • Lead compliance with SEBI (AIF) Regulations, Companies Act, FEMA and other applicable regulatory frameworks.
 



 • Oversee regulatory filings and reporting across SEBI, RBI, MCA/ROC and other authorities.
 



 • Manage fund\-level and investor\-level reporting, including FATCA/CRS, Form 64D, FLA, QAR/QCR and other statutory requirements.
 



 • Engage proactively with regulators and track regulatory developments to ensure timely, forward\-looking implementation.
 



  





**Compliance Frameworks, Risk Oversight \& Controls**




 • Design and embed robust compliance frameworks, internal controls and governance policies across entities and funds.
 



 • Lead regulatory inspections, internal audits and compliance reviews.
 



 • Partner closely with investment, finance and legal teams to enable business objectives within a disciplined risk framework.
 



  





**Fund \& Entity Lifecycle Management**




 • Oversee fund formation, structuring, documentation and regulatory approvals.
 



 • Manage lifecycle events across portfolio entities, including incorporation, restructuring and exits.
 



 • Ensure governance and compliance considerations are embedded across investment lifecycles.
 



 Secretarial \& Corporate Administration 
 



  





**Secretarial \& Corporate Administration**




 • Ensure maintenance of statutory registers, corporate records and governance documentation across entities.
 



 • Oversee filings, disclosures and completion of secretarial audits.
 



 • Draft and review resolutions, governance policies and key corporate documentation.
 



  





**Key Skills**




 • Strong judgement in regulatory and governance matters
 



 • Credibility to engage with Boards, regulators and global institutional investors
 



 • Leadership capability with experience building and managing teams
 



 • High attention to detail with a pragmatic, risk\-based approach
 



 • Commercial acumen and ability to operate in a dynamic investment platform
 



  





**Qualification and Experience**




 • Qualified Company Secretary (ICSI mandatory); LLB or equivalent preferred.
 



 • Experience in AIF / private equity / asset management / financial services.
 



 • Strong working knowledge of SEBI and IFSCA AIF Regulations, corporate law and regulatory frameworks.
 



 • Experience working with large institutional and foreign investors.
 



 • Demonstrated experience managing multi\-entity and SPV structures.

description:

**About Alfa Laval**


Alfa Laval is a leading global provider of products and solutions in heat transfer, separation, and fluid handling, serving customers across the energy, food, water, and marine industries. Headquartered in Lund, Sweden, the company operates in more than 100 countries, enabling customers to improve energy efficiency, productivity, and sustainability in industrial processes.


With a heritage of over 140 years, Alfa Laval plays a critical role in supporting the global energy transition, focusing on solutions for energy efficiency, waste heat recovery, decarbonization, and sustainable industrial growth. Sustainability and responsible use of resources are central to the company’s purpose of pioneering positive impact.

**Alfa Laval India**

Alfa Laval has been present in India since 1937 and plays a strategically important role within the group. The India headquarters is located in Pune, with eight manufacturing facilities based at Pune and Satara, and multiple sales and service locations across the country. The Manufacturing facilities supplies key components and systems in Separation, Heat Transfer, and Flow technology. It is also a hub for Centrifugal Separators, Decanters, and Flow equipment delivered to the global markets from here.


The company's products and solutions are omnipresent in over 25 multiple Indian industries including food processing, dairy, edible oil processing, sugar production, pharmaceutical \& biotechnology, brewery, distillery, starch, pulp and paper, oil \& gas, marine and energy. Alfa Laval caters to many national and international clients based across India and neighboring countries like Sri Lanka, Nepal, and Bangladesh.


We are now looking for an inspirational leader to spearhead the **Legal** **function** in India, partnering closely with the business leaders and managers.

**Role Description**


The Head of Legal for Alfa Laval India is responsible for leading the legal and compliance function by developing and executing legal strategies aligned with the organization’s business objectives. This role serves as a trusted advisor to the leadership team, providing proactive, business\-oriented legal counsel across areas such as commercial contracts, regulatory compliance, mergers and acquisitions, intellectual property, and risk management. The position ensures adherence to applicable laws and internal policies, drives robust compliance frameworks across areas like anti\-corruption, trade sanctions, competition law, and data privacy, and oversee dispute resolution and litigation in coordination with external counsel. Additionally, the Head of Legal leads and develops a high\-performing legal team, strengthens governance practices, and fosters a culture of integrity, accountability, and continuous improvement in line with Alfa Laval’s values.

**Key elements of the Role involve**

* Provide comprehensive legal expertise across specialized and generalist areas, including commercial contracts, R\&D, product liability, mergers \& acquisitions, and intellectual property (excluding patents and design), supported by robust commercial, legal, and ethical risk assessments.
* Act as a strategic business partner to management by proactively identifying and advising on legal risks and opportunities to enable informed decision\-making and drive business growth.
* Draft, review, and negotiate a wide range of complex commercial agreements, ensuring alignment with organizational objectives and regulatory requirements.
* Lead and support the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of legal policies, processes, template agreements, and supporting tools.
* Drive compliance management across key areas such as Export Control \& Sanctions, Anti\-Bribery \& Anti\-Corruption, Fair Competition, and Data Privacy, including strengthening governance frameworks and best practices.
* Conduct legal and compliance training for business stakeholders, enhancing awareness in areas such as commercial contracts, corporate governance, and regulatory compliance, while fostering knowledge sharing within the legal and compliance teams.
* Manage and coordinate disputes and litigation matters in collaboration with external counsel, ensuring effective resolution and risk mitigation.
* Monitor and interpret legislative and regulatory developments, advising the business on potential impacts and implementing proactive risk mitigation strategies.
* Oversee Company Secretarial responsibilities for Alfa Laval India Cluster companies, ensuring compliance with statutory and corporate governance requirements.
* Lead and oversee Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) initiatives, ensuring compliance with statutory requirements and alignment with the organization’s sustainability and community engagement goals.

**Strategic Skills \& Leadership Profile**

* Over 10\-15 years of relevant legal experience in in\-house and/or private practice environments with Bachelor’s Degree in Law (LL.B.) or higher
* Qualified Company Secretary (ACS/FCS)
* Proven experience in negotiating complex, high\-value commercial contracts with multinational organizations
* Strong commercial acumen with excellent stakeholder management and collaboration skills
* Expertise in compliance areas including Export Control, Trade Sanctions, Anti\-Bribery \& Anti\-Corruption, Fair Competition, and Data Privacy (preferred)
* Demonstrated experience in training, mentoring, or leading legal professionals

This role reports to the Group Affairs Manager, India

description:
**About The Opportunity**
 Job Type: Permanent

**Job Description**
**Title Associate Legal Counsel (Assistant Manager)**
**Department** 
**Legal**
**Location** 
**Gurgaon**

**Senior Legal Counsel**
**Level 4**
 We’re proud to have been helping our clients build better financial futures for over 50 years. How have we achieved this? By working together \- and supporting each other \- all over the world. So, join our team and feel like you’re part of something bigger.
   

  

**About Your Team**
 You will be part of the India Legal Team, within the Commercial Legal vertical, front\-ending drafting, review and negotiation of procurement and commercial contracts supporting Fidelity International's internal business units (Technology, HR, CPS, Marketing, Finance, etc.) and sourcing functions across global offices.
   

  

 As part of Fidelity’s General Counsel function (Group Legal and Tax ), you will work closely with our legal, tax, regulatory compliance and commercial counterparts based in the Asia Pacific, United Kingdom, Continental Europe, Canada and other jurisdictions on cross border support covering commercial contracts, business legal document, Company Secretariat and other legal documentation.
   

  

 The team’s focus is on providing agile, pragmatic, business\-aligned legal support while minimizing reliance on external counsel and ensuring minimum legal / regulatory exposure to the organisation.
   

  

**About Your Role**
 This is a fast\-paced role within the Commercial Legal team, requiring high\-quality legal analysis, risk assessment, and cross\-border engagement. You will need a strong sense of commercial understanding, attention to detail, adaptability, and the ability to work at pace with confidence.
   

  

 Key aspects of your role include:
   

  

* Providing front\-end legal support for drafting, reviewing, and negotiating a wide range of procurement and commercial agreements, with particular emphasis on emerging technologies such as cloud services and GenAI.
* Interfacing directly with global stakeholders and advising on legal and compliance issues linked to onboarding third\-party tech solutions or developing in\-house capabilities, including those involving staff augmentation and temporary workforce arrangements
* Supporting cloud regulatory compliance work including review of new cloud/technology deployment requests, Cloud Regulatory Forum coordination, entity mapping and Local Compliance notifications.
* Collaborating with colleagues across functions and geographies to deliver pragmatic, business\-aligned legal solutions.


 Contributing to continuous process improvement, knowledge sharing, and technology adoption within the team.
   

  

 We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of background, and strive to create an environment where everyone can thrive.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Draft, review and negotiate a variety of procurement and commercial contracts, including both technology and non\-technology engagements such as Cloud Outsourcing Agreements, SaaS, IaaS, Software Licences, Master Services Agreements, Statements of Work, Consulting and Facilities Agreements, Change Orders, and Data Processing Agreements.
* Independently manage strategic and complex technology vendor matters, including cloud, enterprise software, AI/GenAI, and data / market data providers, negotiating with major suppliers to secure favourable and risk\-appropriate terms.
* Support business and sourcing teams on onboarding third\-party AI and GenAI solutions or developing these in\-house, including IP, data, ethics, and regulatory considerations.
* Understand and interpret international Tech/Cloud Outsourcing regulations (ESMA, EBA, EIOPA, CSSF, DORA, EU AI Act, GDPR, DPDP Act, operational resilience requirements, etc.) and apply them to contracts.
* Review new cloud and technology deployment requests, coordinate with TRAO and Local Compliance on regulatory notifications and applicability assessments, and support Cloud Regulatory Forum processes.
* Collaborate with procurement to resolve legal and commercial issues and maintain compliance with company policies.
* Provide legal advice on matters related to existing procurement contracts and ongoing supplier service engagements, including amendments, renewals and terminations, balancing legal, regulatory, commercial and business considerations to mitigate risk and enable stakeholders to move forward with clarity and confidence.
* Research and stay current on emerging technology developments (AI, GenAI, blockchain, digital assets and tokenisation, cloud, crypto, open\-source software) and proactively assess their impact on commercial contracts and regulatory compliance.
* Prepare presentations, guidance notes and knowledge materials on emerging tech and related legal / regulatory themes for the team, sourcing and business stakeholders.
* Support legal operations and drive process improvements, including automating legal request intake, establishing knowledge\-sharing platforms, and developing AI/technology contracting playbooks and checklists for suppliers, the legal team and technology stakeholders; support training for sourcing and procurement teams on emerging tech and regulatory topics.
* Pursue relevant professional development including certifications, seminars and external sessions on data privacy, emerging tech regulation and related areas.
* Demonstrate adaptability, collaboration, and a proactive approach in all interactions.


**About You**
 In this role you will be required to have:
   

  

* LLB with 5–6 years of relevant experience, preferably in an in\-house role within a multinational organisation (Financial Services, Asset Management, or Information Technology industries preferred).
* Experience in reviewing and negotiating commercial contracts across both technology and non\-technology engagements, including cloud services (SaaS, IaaS, PaaS), outsourcing, software licensing, market data, consulting, facilities, and profeesional services (staff augmentation, consulting etc.).
* Knowledge of cloud outsourcing regulatory frameworks (e.g., ESMA, EBA, DORA) and their application to technology contracts.
* Ability to assess commercial and legal risk relating to technology and outsourcing regulatory compliance.
* Familiarity with current technology trends such as AI, GenAI, platform integration, data processing, and their legal and regulatory implications.
* General understanding of how technologies work, including APIs, data security / backups, Cloud Escrow, and SaaS/IaaS/PaaS deployments and cloud security.
* Strong oral and written communication skills; excellent judgment; business sense.
* Excellent drafting and negotiation skills.
* Commercial judgement, business acumen, pragmatic and a solutions\-oriented mindset.
* High ethical standards and professional integrity.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple matters in parallel.
* Experience working on cross\-border contracts and international engagements.
* Genuine interest in technology and emerging tech – someone who keeps up with developments in AI, GenAI, cloud, blockchain and data privacy because they want to, not because they have to.
* Experience with contract management systems, e\-signature platforms, and other legal technology tools is desirable.
* Self\-starter, research\-oriented and self\-driven – able to take ownership of new and evolving matters with limited supervision, independently learn about new technologies, understand their contractual and regulatory implications, and translate that into practical guidance for stakeholders as the organisation’s technology priorities change.
* Comfortable presenting complex tech/regulatory topics to non\-legal audiences using presentations, diagrams and practical examples.
* Demonstrated adaptability, collaboration, and a proactive approach.
* Positive, pro\-active attitude suited to be a team member within a dynamic business environment.
* Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build strong relationships with stakeholders.


**Feel rewarded**
 For starters, we’ll offer you a comprehensive benefits package. We’ll value your wellbeing and support your development. And we’ll be as flexible as we can about where and when you work – finding a balance that works for all of us. It’s all part of our commitment to making you feel motivated by the work you do and happy to be part of our team. For more about our work, our approach to dynamic working and how you could build your future here, visit careers.fidelityinternational.com.

title: Vice President, Mobility and Employment Tax
description:
**About This Role**
**About this Role**
 BlackRock is seeking a highly motivated Mobility \& Employment Tax professional to join its global Employment Tax team.
   

  

 This is a global advisory role supporting BlackRock's cross\-border workforce programs, employment tax risk management, global compensation reporting governance and strategic Mobility \& Employment Tax initiatives. The role is positioned for an experienced professional who can provide technical judgment, manage complex stakeholder discussions and support practical, risk\-balanced outcomes across multiple jurisdictions.
   

  

 The successful candidate will partner closely with stakeholders across HR, Payroll, Compensation, Corporate Tax, Finance, Legal \& Compliance and external advisors to provide employment tax advice, manage escalations, strengthen governance and support a scalable global operating model for BlackRock's Mobility \& Employment Tax programs.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Mobility \& Employment Tax Advisory**
* Provide advisory support on international assignments, permanent transfers, business traveler compliance, remote working arrangements and other cross\-border workforce matters.
* Assess employment tax, payroll withholding, reporting and social security implications arising from workforce mobility, business initiatives and regulatory developments.
* Advise on the employment tax implications of equity compensation and stock incentive programs, including RSUs, stock options, ESPPs and cross\-border vesting events.
* Review complex cross\-border scenarios and recommend practical, risk\-balanced solutions for business and employee stakeholders.


**Strategic Projects \& Transformation**
* Lead and support regional and global Mobility \& Employment Tax initiatives focused on process improvement, automation, governance and operational efficiency.
* Drive strategic projects relating to workforce mobility, employee taxation, regulatory developments and business transformation initiatives.
* Contribute to the development of scalable operating models, controls and governance frameworks across Mobility \& Employment Tax programs.


**Stakeholder Management \& Escalations**
* Act as an escalation point for complex Mobility \& Employment Tax matters, partnering with internal stakeholders and external advisors to evaluate risks and recommend solutions.
* Provide technical review and challenge of advisor recommendations, payroll positions and employee communications.
* Build strong partnerships across HR, Payroll, Compensation, Corporate Tax, Finance, Legal \& Compliance and business stakeholders globally.


**Benefits, Compensation \& Policy Initiatives**
* Provide employment tax input on new employee benefits, compensation programs, payroll changes and policy initiatives.
* Support implementation of new benefits and compensation offerings, ensuring appropriate consideration of employment tax, payroll and reporting implications.
* Monitor legislative and regulatory developments and assess potential impacts on employees, policies and programs.


**Business Traveller \& Cross\-Border Workforce Programs**
* Support global business traveller and cross\-border workforce programs by advising on employment tax, payroll and reporting obligations arising from business travel and remote working arrangements.
* Partner with stakeholders to design practical and compliant solutions for evolving workforce models.
* Identify opportunities to strengthen governance, controls and risk management across cross\-border workforce programs.


**Governance \& Risk Management**
* Develop and enhance policies, standard operating procedures (SOPs), governance frameworks and operational guidance to support consistent and scalable Mobility \& Employment Tax processes.
* Drive standardization and documentation of key processes, controls and risk mitigation practices across jurisdictions.
* Partner with stakeholders to strengthen governance, improve controls and ensure audit readiness across Mobility \& Employment Tax programs.


**Global Compensation Review \& Reporting Governance**
* Provide review and oversight of global compensation reporting processes, including equity compensation and stock incentive plans such as RSUs, stock options, ESPPs, deferred compensation arrangements and bonus programs.
* Review employment tax, payroll withholding and reporting implications of compensation and equity programs across multiple jurisdictions.
* Manage stakeholder escalations relating to compensation reporting, stock plan taxation and employee tax reporting requirements.
* Support governance and technical review of year\-end reporting processes, payroll instructions and global compensation reporting obligations.
* Partner with Compensation, Payroll, HR and external advisors to resolve technical issues, strengthen controls and drive reporting consistency globally.


**Knowledge / Qualifications**
* Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA) with 10\+ years of relevant experience in Employment Tax, Global Mobility Tax, Individual Tax or related advisory/compliance functions. Prior experience within a Big Four firm and/or a multinational organization preferred.
* Strong technical knowledge of employment tax, payroll withholding, compensation reporting, social security and individual tax compliance requirements across India and APAC jurisdictions.
* Experience advising on cross\-border workforce matters, including international assignments, business travelers, remote working arrangements and permanent transfers.
* Knowledge of equity compensation plans, including RSUs, stock options, ESPPs and related cross\-border tax implications.
* Proven ability to assess tax risks, interpret complex legislation and provide practical, commercially balanced solutions.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with experience partnering across HR, Payroll, Compensation, Finance, Legal and external advisors.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving and project management skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex tax matters to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced, dynamic global environment and manage competing priorities.


**Competencies Required**
* High level of attention to detail and accuracy.
* Strong technical and risk management mindset.
* Strong Excel, analytical and data interpretation skills.
* Ability to build strong relationships and collaborate effectively across functions, regions, and cultures.
* Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills.
* Proven ability to manage competing priorities and deliver against tight deadlines.
* Adaptable, resilient and embracing of change.
* Ability to identify, analyse and improve processes, driving continuous improvement and operational excellence.
* Discretion and sound judgement in handling confidential information.
* Strong team player with experience working effectively across global and remote teams.


**Our Benefits**
 To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
   

  

**Our hybrid work model**
 BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
   

  

**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
 At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision\-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
 **guidance** 
 on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
   

  

**About BlackRock**
 At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well\-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
   

  

 This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
   

  

 To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.
   

  

 BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

title: Financial Crime Compliance Manager
description:

 We are AML RightSource, the leading technology\-enabled managed services firm focused on fighting financial crime for our clients and the world. Headquartered in Cleveland, Ohio, and operating across the globe, we are a trusted partner to our financial institution, FinTech, money service business, and corporate clients.
   

  

 Using a blend of highly trained anti\-financial crime professionals, cutting\-edge technology tools, and industry\-leading consultants, we help clients with their AML/BSA, transaction monitoring, client onboarding (KYC), enhanced due diligence (EDD), and risk management needs.
   

  

 We support clients in meeting day\-to\-day compliance tasks, urgent projects, and strategic changes. Globally, our staff of more than 6,000 highly trained analysts and subject matter experts is the industry's largest group of full\-time compliance professionals. Together with our clients, we are Reimagining Compliance.
   

  

**About The Position**
 As a Manager within the Financial Crime Compliance Delivery Team, you will be responsible for leading a team of analysts by providing the coaching and oversight needed to ensure all projects meet organizational and client objectives. You will serve as a coach and mentor to ensure successful outcomes of engagements. In this position, you will also have direct client contact while establishing cross\-functional communication across multiple internal business units.
   

  

 You are a subject matter expert in KYC and AML domain. Your areas of focus will be to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements related to KYC, AML, and CTF, develop, implement, and maintain effective KYC, and AML policies and procedures and conduct regular reviews and audits of KYC processes and records to identify areas of improvement and ensure compliance.
   

  

 We are seeking individuals with a high level of client orientation and customer focus, experience in consulting, a dynamic fast\-paced environment with strong Financial Crime Compliance subject matter expertise and the ability to coach, mentor and lead.
   

  

**Primary Responsibilities**
* Manage a team of 25\+ analysts
* Identify top talent among the team and coach and develop leaders into Senior Analyst II roles.
* Evaluate team members for purposes of hire, termination, advancement, promotion or other job change.
* Manage client projects
* Interact regularly with major clients to strengthen the partnership, report results, and identify new opportunities for services provided.
* Oversee the team's production and results, seeking opportunities for improved efficiency and streamlined processes and conduct quality control review as necessary.
* Provide production/service reporting to senior leadership and clients.
* Work directly with partnership team to develop subject matter expertise and expand advisory services and consulting opportunities with clients.
* Involvement in certain internal strategic initiatives across the Managed Services practice working closely with Sr. Managers and others


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s Degree with 10\+ years or more of Anti\-Money Laundering (AML), or KYC Management experience

* Ability to lead projects, develop timelines, coordinate project teams and implement action items during the life of a project.
* Ability to multi\-task, work independently and as part of a team, establishing cooperative and collaborative working relationships.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Professional Certification (CAMS)
* Experience in a consulting or managed service environment
* Master’s degree
* Strong entrepreneurial spirit, highly collaborative, able to express ideas readily, manage change fluidly, able to influence and identify opportunities.


 AML RightSource is committed to fostering a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.
   

  

**Recruitment Scam Alerts**
**We’re aware of an increase in recruitment scams where individuals falsely claim to represent AML RightSource. These scammers may ask for money or personal information by offering fake job opportunities through e\-mail, text message or social media. If you encounter suspicious messages, do not respond.**

title: Legal Manager
description:
**Job Purpose**




 We are seeking an experienced and commercially minded Manager – Legal with 5–8 years of relevant experience to manage and support the company’s legal and contractual requirements. The role will provide legal support across customer and vendor contracts, commercial transactions, telecom and technology\-related matters, legal risk management, notices, disputes, compliance, and corporate governance. The Manager – Legal will work closely with Sales, Business, Procurement, Finance, Operations, Technology, HR, and senior management to ensure that business transactions are legally sound, commercially practical, and appropriately risk\-managed.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities**




  





**Contract Management \& Commercial Legal** 



* Draft, review, negotiate, and finalize customer and vendor agreements.
* Review MSAs, service agreements, NDAs, SLAs, purchase agreements, work orders, amendments, and other commercial contracts.
* Support Sales and Business teams in reviewing customer\-specific contractual requirements.
* Identify contractual risks relating to liability, indemnity, termination, payment, SLA commitments, warranties, confidentiality, data protection, intellectual property, and dispute resolution.
* Maintain a structured repository and tracker for contracts, renewals, notices, and key contractual obligations.
* Support contract negotiations while balancing business requirements and legal risk.
* Telecom \& Technology Legal Support
* Provide legal support for telecom, connectivity, cloud, data center, managed services, voice, security, and technology\-related transactions.
* Review customer and partner agreements involving network infrastructure, data centers, cloud services, voice solutions, and managed services.



**Legal Risk Management** 



* Identify legal and contractual risks in business transactions and recommend practical mitigation measures.
* Develop standard clauses, templates, contract playbooks, and negotiation guidelines.
* Support management in evaluating legal exposure arising from commercial commitments, customer disputes, and vendor relationships.
* Ensure appropriate approvals are obtained for deviations from standard contractual positions.



**Notices, Disputes \& Litigation Coordination** 



* Review and respond to legal notices received from customers, vendors, employees, or other stakeholders.
* Coordinate with external lawyers and counsel on litigation, arbitration, recovery matters, and other disputes.
* Maintain a litigation and legal\-notice tracker.
* Support management with case summaries, risk assessment, documentation, and follow\-up actions.



**Compliance \& Governance** 



* Support legal and corporate compliance requirements applicable to the organization.
* Assist in maintaining statutory and regulatory documentation in coordination with relevant internal teams and advisors.
* Support corporate governance activities and documentation where required.
* Monitor relevant legal and regulatory developments and highlight material business implications to management.



**Internal Stakeholder Management** 



* Act as a legal business partner to Sales, Procurement, Finance, Operations, Technology, and other functions.
* Conduct awareness sessions for internal teams on key contractual and legal issues.
* Help business teams understand contractual obligations in clear, practical language.
* Support faster business closure by providing commercially workable legal solutions while protecting the company’s interests.



  





**Qualification \& Experience:**



* **Education:** 
 LL.B. / LL.M. from a recognized institution; membership with the relevant Bar Council is preferred where applicable.
* **Experience:** 
 5–8 years of relevant legal experience, preferably in a corporate legal department, law firm, telecom, IT/ITES, technology, cloud, infrastructure, or related industry; strong commercial contract drafting and negotiation experience is essential.
* **Certifications / Additional Qualification (if any):** 
 Additional qualification or experience in corporate/commercial law, telecom, technology, data protection, or infrastructure contracts will be an advantage.



  





**Required Skills \& Competencies:**




  




* **Technical / Legal Skills:** 
 Commercial contract drafting and negotiation; MSA, NDA, SLA, vendor and customer agreements; legal risk assessment; dispute and notice management; corporate and commercial law; telecom and technology contracts; compliance and governance.
* **Functional Skills:** 
 Contract lifecycle management, legal research, stakeholder management, external counsel coordination, legal documentation, risk mitigation, and development of legal templates and playbooks.
* **Behavioral Competencies:** 
 Commercial acumen, analytical thinking, negotiation, problem\-solving, proactive approach, strong communication and documentation skills, attention to detail, ownership, integrity, and ability to work effectively with cross\-functional teams.

title: Lead - IR & Compliance
description:
**About Business**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
**Adani Group** 
 : Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan\-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large scale infrastructure development in India with O \& M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.
   

  

**Data Centre** 
 : Adani Data Centre has rapidly transformed from a nascent initiative to a leading innovator in the data infrastructure ecosystem. In just a few years, we have established ourselves as a key player in the data centre landscape, offering state\-of\-the\-art solutions in areas such as colocation services, cloud integration, and data security. Our commitment to reliability, scalability, and technological excellence has positioned us as a trusted partner for businesses navigating the digital age with confidence.
   

  

**Job Purpose:** 
 Lead \- Compliance Manager is responsible for ensuring adherence to financial and accounting regulations within the data centers industry. The role demands a strong understanding of finance and accounting principles, complemented by extensive experience in compliance and leadership. The ideal candidate will manage compliance initiatives, drive operational excellence, and foster a culture of accountability and integrity within the organization.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Industrial Relations
   

  

* Develop and implement the Industrial Relations strategy across project and operational data center sites.
* Foster a positive employee and workforce relations environment to ensure uninterrupted business operations.
* Establish effective engagement mechanisms with workforce representatives, contract labor, and site leadership teams.
* Handle employee grievances, disciplinary matters, domestic inquiries, misconduct investigations, and corrective actions in accordance with applicable laws and company policies.
* Conduct proactive IR risk assessments and recommend mitigation measures to prevent disputes and work stoppages.
* Lead negotiations and resolution of workforce\-related issues while maintaining organizational interests and legal compliance.
* Provide guidance and training to site leadership teams on employee relations and disciplinary processes.


 Labor Law Compliance
   

  

* Ensure full compliance with all applicable labor laws and regulations across multiple project and operational sites.
* Drive compliance under:
+ Code on Wages
+ Code on Social Security
+ Industrial Relations Code
+ Occupational Safety, Health \& Working Conditions Code
+ Contract Labour regulations
+ Shops \& Establishment provisions
+ Building \& Other Construction Workers (BOCW) requirements
+ Applicable state\-specific labor laws

* Monitor statutory registrations, licenses, renewals, returns, notices, and records.
* Establish periodic compliance reviews and compliance dashboards for management reporting.
* Coordinate compliance audits and ensure closure of observations within defined timelines.


 Contract Labor Management
   

  

* Develop and implement governance mechanisms for contract labor engagement across sites.
* Ensure compliance by contractors with all labor and statutory requirements.
* Conduct contractor due diligence and periodic compliance assessments.
* Monitor wage payments, statutory remittances, attendance records, welfare provisions, and contractor documentation.
* Lead contractor compliance audits and recommend corrective actions where required.
* Drive digitization and automation of labor compliance monitoring systems.


 Legal \& Regulatory Liaison
   

  

* Interface with labor departments, inspectors, statutory authorities, and government agencies.
* Manage labor inspections, audits, notices, and regulatory submissions.
* Coordinate with internal and external legal teams on labor\-related cases and litigation matters.
* Represent the organization before labor authorities and relevant forums as required.


 Governance, Reporting \& Risk Management
   

  

* Develop and maintain comprehensive compliance MIS and dashboards.
* Track key IR and compliance metrics across all sites.
* Identify compliance gaps, emerging labor risks, and workforce\-related concerns.
* Support business leadership with insights and recommendations for effective workforce governance.
* Develop standard operating procedures (SOPs), compliance frameworks, and governance mechanisms.


 Stakeholder Management
   

  

* Partner with Project, Operations, EHS, Procurement, Security, and Administration teams for seamless workforce management.
* Build strong working relationships with contractors, consultants, labor authorities, and local administration.
* Support site mobilization activities for new data center projects from an IR and compliance perspective.


 ESG, Safety \& Sustainability Responsibilities
   

  

* Promote AdaniConneX's commitment to ethical labor practices, human rights, diversity, equity, and inclusion.
* Ensure compliance with company ESG commitments related to labor welfare, contractor management, and responsible business practices.
* Drive adherence to workplace safety regulations and labor welfare provisions.
* Support implementation of worker welfare programs, safety awareness initiatives, and employee engagement activities.
* Ensure all workforce management practices align with organizational sustainability and governance objectives.


 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
   

  

* Zero major statutory non\-compliance observations.
* 100% timely statutory filings, registrations, and renewals.
* Contractor labor compliance score across all sites.
* Closure of labor audit observations within prescribed timelines.
* Number of industrial disputes and successful resolution rate.
* Compliance audit score and governance effectiveness.
* Workforce grievance resolution turnaround time.
* Labor\-related litigation and regulatory exposure metrics.
* Contractor welfare and compliance adherence ratings.


**Qualifications**
 Education
   

  

* MBA / PGDM in Human Resources, Labour Welfare, Personnel Management, or Industrial Relations.
* Degree in Law (LLB) will be an added advantage.


**Experience**
* 15\-17 years of experience in Industrial Relations, Labor Compliance, Workforce Management, and Statutory Governance.
* Experience in infrastructure, construction, manufacturing, power, data center, telecom, EPC, or industrial projects preferred.
* Strong exposure to managing contract labor across multiple sites.
* Proven experience in dealing with labor authorities, compliance audits, and workforce dispute resolution.

title: Compliance Officer
description:

Together, we will make the complex simple, the inaccessible accessible, and the impossible possible. Boost your innovation to an ALL TIME HIGH
 
 with us!
 



  





**Inside CoinDCX’s Compliance Team**




 Our Compliance team ensures CoinDCX operates with integrity and within regulatory frameworks, navigating the complex world of blockchain with precision. We’re dedicated to maintaining the highest standards of compliance to protect our business and users. If you’re detail\-oriented and have a strong understanding of regulatory landscapes, join us in safeguarding the future of digital finance.
 



  





**About the Role**




 The Compliance Officer (“CO”) will be responsible for establishing, implementing and independently overseeing the regulatory compliance framework for the Company’s Broker\-Dealer and Introducing Broker operations in GIFT IFSC. The CO will monitor adherence to applicable IFSCA regulations, circulars, directions and other regulatory requirements and provide independent compliance advice, monitoring and challenge to the business.
 



  





**You need to be a HODLer of these**



* A professional qualification or postgraduate degree/postgraduate diploma of at least one year in Finance, Law, Accountancy, Business Management, Commerce, Economics, Capital Markets, Banking, Insurance, Actuarial Science, FinTech, Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics; or CFA / FRM; or such other relevant qualification as may be specified by IFSCA. Provided that minimum two years of experience in the financial services market. Experience in another field may be considered with at least two years of work experience in a
 **compliance\-related role or function** 
 .
* Alternatively, a graduate degree in any discipline with at least
 **five years** 
 of work experience in the financial services market, in accordance with applicable IFSCA requirements.
* A recognised Bachelor of Laws (LL.B.) are also specifically eligible
* Relevant experience in capital markets compliance, securities/brokerage regulation, regulatory compliance, AML/CFT or financial\-services compliance is preferred.
* Strong understanding of IFSCA regulations, Broker\-Dealer requirements, regulatory reporting, client protection and compliance\-monitoring frameworks.
* Strong regulatory interpretation, analytical, monitoring and documentation skills.
* Ability to exercise independent judgement, challenge and escalation on regulatory and compliance matters.
* Strong stakeholder\-management skills, including interaction with regulators, exchanges, auditors and senior management.
* High standards of integrity, independence and regulatory judgement.
* Must be based out of the IFSC, as required under applicable IFSCA regulations.
* Must complete certification course "
 **Regulatory Framework for Capital Market Intermediaries in IFSC (ICSI)** 
 " as prescribed by IFSCA.



  





**You will be mining through these tasks**



* Establish, implement and maintain an effective regulatory compliance framework for the Broker\-Dealer and Introducing Broker activities and monitor ongoing compliance with the IFSCA (Capital Market Intermediaries) Regulations, applicable Broker\-Dealer requirements, exchange requirements and circulars and directions.
* Act as a key point of contact for IFSCA, recognised stock exchanges (India INX/ NSE IX) and other relevant authorities on compliance\-related matters, as applicable.
* Maintain a regulatory obligations and compliance calendar and oversee timely completion of regulatory filings, returns, disclosures, certifications and other periodic obligations.
* Monitor regulatory developments and assess their impact on the business products, processes, policies and control framework and ensure relevant policies, procedures and SOPs are updated accordingly.
* Oversee compliance with applicable requirements relating to client onboarding, KYC/CDD, AML/CFT, sanctions screening, transaction monitoring and record keeping, in coordination with designated AML personnel and relevant operational teams.
* Oversee compliance with applicable net worth, capital adequacy and other prudential requirements, in coordination with Finance and Compliance.
* Conduct periodic compliance monitoring, testing and reviews to assess adherence to regulatory requirements and internal policies and escalate regulatory breaches or material compliance risks, and track corrective actions to closure.
* Review and provide compliance advice/sign\-off, as appropriate, for new products, material process changes, client journeys and third\-party arrangements prior to implementation.
* Monitor compliance with requirements relating to client funds and securities/assets, segregation, conflicts of interest, investor protection and conduct of business, wherever applicable.
* Review applicable client agreements, disclosures, risk disclosures and regulatory communications from a compliance perspective.
* Coordinate regulatory inspections and compliance audits, including tracking observations, remediation and maintaining appropriate records to support regulatory and audit readiness.
* Provide periodic compliance reporting to the Board and/or relevant committees, as applicable and provide periodic regulatory and compliance training and promote awareness of applicable regulatory obligations.
* Maintain appropriate compliance records and documentary evidence to support regulatory and audit readiness.
* Provide independent compliance advice and challenge business, operations, product and technology teams.

title: Principal Officer - Compliance
description:
**The CoinDCX Journey: Building Tomorrow, today**




 At CoinDCX, we believe ‘CHANGE STARTS TOGETHER’. You are the driving force that will help us make Web3 accessible to all.
 



 In the last six years, we have skyrocketed from being India’s first crypto unicorn to carrying a community of over 125 million with us. To continue maximising the adoption and acceleration of Web3, we are now focused on developing cutting\-edge products, addressing accessibility and security challenges, and bridging the gap between people and Web3 technologies.
 



  





 While we go ahead and keep dominating the Web3 world, we would like to HODL you on our team! Join our team of passionate innovators who are breaking barriers and building the future of Web3\. Together, we will make the complex simple, the inaccessible accessible, and the impossible possible. Boost your innovation to an ALL TIME HIGH
 
 with us!
 



  





**Inside CoinDCX’s Compliance Team**




 Our Compliance team ensures CoinDCX operates with integrity and within regulatory frameworks, navigating the complex world of blockchain with precision. We’re dedicated to maintaining the highest standards of compliance to protect our business and users. If you’re detail\-oriented and have a strong understanding of regulatory landscapes, join us in safeguarding the future of digital finance.
 



  





**About the Role**




 The Principal Officer (“PO”) will be responsible for the overall operations, governance and management of the Company’s Broker\-Dealer and Introducing Broker business in GIFT IFSC. The PO will ensure that the Company’s
 **GIFT City** 
 operations are in accordance with applicable IFSCA regulations, circulars, directions and other regulatory requirements, while maintaining an effective governance, operational and control framework.
 



  





**You need to be a HODLer of these**



* A professional qualification or postgraduate degree/postgraduate diploma of at least one year in Finance, Law, Accountancy, Business Management, Commerce, Economics, Capital Markets, Banking, Insurance, Actuarial Science, FinTech, Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics; or CFA / FRM; or such other relevant qualification as may be specified by IFSCA. Provided that minimum
 **three years** 
 of experience in the financial services market.
* Alternatively, a graduate degree in any discipline with at least
 **three years** 
 of work experience in the financial services market, in accordance with applicable IFSCA requirements.
* Relevant experience in capital markets, securities brokerage, broker\-dealer operations, trading, clearing and settlement or related regulated financial\-services activities is preferred.
* Strong understanding of capital\-market regulations, brokerage operations, operational controls, governance and risk\-management frameworks.
* Strong stakeholder\-management capabilities, including interaction with regulators, exchanges, auditors, financial institutions and senior management.
* High standards of integrity, accountability and regulatory judgement.
* Must be based out of the IFSC, as required under applicable IFSCA regulations.
* Must complete certification course "
 **Regulatory Framework for Capital Market Intermediaries in IFSC (ICSI)** 
 " as prescribed by IFSCA.



  





**You will be mining through these tasks**



* Responsible for overall governance and operational oversight of the Company’s Broker\-Dealer activities in GIFT IFSC and ensure compliance with applicable regulatory requirements.
* Oversee day\-to\-day operations, including client onboarding, order and trade execution, clearing and settlement, reconciliations and operational controls, as applicable.
* Act as a key point of contact with IFSCA, recognised stock exchanges (India INX/ NSE IX) and other relevant regulatory or market institutions, as applicable. Build rapport and maintain an excellent relationship with such institutions.
* Ensure effective implementation of the Company's AML/CFT, KYC, Customer Due Diligence (CDD), Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD), sanctions screening and transaction monitoring framework in accordance with applicable regulatory requirements.
* Ensure periodic Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing (ML/TF) risk assessments are conducted and appropriate mitigating controls are implemented across the Broker\-Dealer business.
* Oversee identification, investigation and reporting of Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) or any other regulatory reports, as applicable, and ensure timely escalation to the relevant authorities in accordance with applicable laws.
* Ensure appropriate arrangements are maintained for the handling, segregation and protection of client funds and securities/assets, wherever applicable.
* Ensure adequate systems, infrastructure, internal controls, risk\-management arrangements and business continuity measures commensurate with the nature and scale of the Broker\-Dealer and Introducing Broker activities.
* Ensure that appropriate policies, procedures and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) are established and effectively implemented across the Broker\-Dealer’s operations.
* Oversee timely completion of applicable regulatory reporting, statutory filings and disclosures through the respective responsible functions.
* Coordinate with business, product, technology, operations, finance, legal and compliance teams in relation to new products, material process changes and integrations, ensuring that new products or material business initiatives are implemented only after applicable regulatory, compliance, operational and risk requirements have been addressed.
* Provide appropriate reporting and escalation to the Board and senior management regarding material operational, regulatory and business matters.



  





**Are you the one? Our missing block**



* You are knowledge\-hungry when it comes to VDA and Web3, always eager to dive deeper and stay ahead in this evolving space.
* The world of Web3 and VDA excites you, fueling your curiosity and driving you to explore new opportunities within this dynamic landscape.
* You act like an owner, constantly striving for excellence, impact, and tangible results in everything you do.
* You embrace a ‘We over Me’ mindset, growing individually while fostering the growth of those around you.
* Change is your catalyst, igniting your passion to build and innovate.
* You think outside the box, unbound by limitations or doubt, always pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.



  





**Perks That Empower You**




 Our benefits are designed to make a lasting impact on your life, giving you the freedom to create a work\-life balance that truly suits you.
 


* **Design Your Own Benefit:** 
 Tailor your perk package to fit your unique needs. Whether you’re eyeing a new gadget or welcoming a furry friend into your life, our flexible benefits ensure that you can prioritise what matters most to you.
* **Unlimited Wellness Leaves:** 
 We believe in the power of well\-being. Take the time you need to recharge, knowing that your health is our priority. With unlimited wellness leaves, you can return refreshed, ready to build and grow.
* **Mental Wellness Support:** 
 Your mental health is as important as your professional growth. Benefit from access to health experts, free counseling sessions, monthly wellness workshops, and regular team outings, all designed to help you stay balanced and connected.
* **Bi\-Weekly Learning Sessions:** 
 These sessions are more than just updates—they’re opportunities to fuel your growth. Stay ahead with the latest industry knowledge, sharpen your skills, and accelerate your career in an ever\-evolving landscape.

 Zen Tax Clinic is a specialized online platform focused on comprehensive GST litigation solutions in India. As the country’s first exclusive online service for GST\-related disputes, the clinic supports clients through every stage of litigation.  The Expert – GST role is a full\-time, on\-site position based in Coimbatore. The role involves handling GST litigation matters, including analyzing case facts, reviewing notices and orders, and preparing legally sound replies and submissions. The Expert – GST will draft representations, appeals, and other documentation, while staying updated on GST laws, rules, notifications, and relevant case law. The role includes coordinating with clients to gather information, advising on litigation strategy, and collaborating with internal teams to ensure timely and accurate case handling. The Expert – GST is expected to maintain high professional standards, adhere to compliance requirements, and contribute to the continuous improvement of internal processes and resources.
 



**Qualifications** 







* Strong knowledge of GST laws, rules, procedures, and recent amendments, with practical experience in GST litigation and dispute resolution.
* Proficiency in legal drafting, including replies to notices, appeals, representations, and professional correspondence related to GST matters.
* Ability to interpret statutes, circulars, notifications, and case law, and apply them effectively to client cases.
* Excellent research, analytical, and documentation skills, with attention to detail and accuracy in written work.
* Effective communication and client\-handling skills, including the ability to explain complex GST issues in clear language.

The role requires hands-on knowledge of welding processes and welding-related production activities , along with the ability to lead operators and manage shift operations effectively. Key Responsibilities 1. Production Execution Execute the daily production plan and achieve shift-wise production targets. Monitor machine performance, production output, and cycle times to ensure optimum productivity. Ensure smooth shift operations and timely completion of production activities. Identify and resolve operational issues to minimize machine downtime and production backlogs. 2. Welding & Manufacturing Operations Possess practical knowledge of welding processes, welding parameters, and welding practices . Monitor welding operations and ensure adherence to defined process parameters and quality requirements. Identify common welding defects and support corrective actions. Coordinate with Quality and Maintenance teams to resolve welding and process-related issues. Ensure proper handling and safe operation of welding equipment and related machinery. 3. Scrap & Defect Control Monitor production scrap, rejection, and rework and take corrective actions to minimize losses. Conduct/support Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for production and quality issues. Implement corrective and preventive actions to avoid recurrence of defects. Maintain required production and rejection records. 4. Manpower & Shift Management Allocate manpower effectively as per production requirements and machine availability. Monitor operator performance and ensure optimum manpower utilization. Coordinate shift activities and manage operator breaks to minimize machine idle time. Identify training requirements and provide necessary guidance to operators. Ensure proper shift handover covering machine status, production performance, breakdowns, and pending activities. 5. 5S, Safety & Compliance Maintain and improve 5S standards across the production area. Ensure 100% compliance with required PPE and safety practices on the shop floor. Ensure machines, tools, and work areas are properly cleaned and maintained before shift handover. Immediately report unsafe conditions, near misses, and production-related safety concerns. Follow company safety procedures and work instructions. 6. Reporting & Continuous Improvement Prepare and maintain daily/shift-wise production reports and operational data. Track production output, rejection, scrap, downtime, and machine performance. Identify opportunities for improving productivity, quality, and process efficiency. Participate in Kaizen, 5S, Root Cause Analysis, and continuous improvement initiatives . Coordinate with Quality, Maintenance, Stores, and other functions for smooth production operations. Required Qualifications & Skills BE/B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering. 1–3 years of hands-on experience in a manufacturing/production environment. Practical knowledge of welding processes and welding operations is preferred. Knowledge of welding defects, parameters, inspection practices, and basic troubleshooting. Good working knowledge of MS Excel for production reporting and data analysis. Good communication, problem-solving, leadership, and team-handling skills. Willingness to work in rotational shifts . Preferred Candidate Profile Candidates with hands-on exposure to welding, fabrication, mechanical manufacturing, production machinery, and shift-based shop-floor operations will be preferred.

 Role & responsibilities Job Title: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) AI Architect
Location: Noida
Brief Description
We are looking for an experienced OCI AI Architect to lead the design, architecture and deployment of Generative AI, Agentic AI, and traditional AI/ML solutions on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure. 
This role requires a deep understanding of OCI Architecture, Large Language Models, Agentic and AI/ML frameworks, data engineering, and OCI-native services
The ideal candidate will drive Agentic AI transformation initiatives, architect scalable AI solutions over OCI, and enable intelligent automation that can seamlessly integrate within the operational workflows of Oracle ERP and finance systems.

• Design memory strategies for agentic systems, including short-term context, long-term memory, and knowledge persistence.
• Design human-in-the-loop workflows for validation, exception handling, and continuous learning in AI systems.
• Understanding of event-driven and microservices-based architectures for scalable AI systems.
• Define testing strategies for AI systems, including prompt testing, scenario validation, and regression testing.
• Support customer presentations & solution demos, as needed with architectural insights and technical credibility.
• Collaborate with business stakeholders, SMEs, and application teams to identify AI opportunities and deliver AI-first, cloud-native solutions
Skills Required

• Strong Python programming skills and experience with data processing (JSON, APIs, etc.)
• Strong hands-on experience with LLMs (e.g. Cohere, GPT etc.) & advanced prompt engineering techniques (e.g. Zero-shot, Few-shot, Chain-of-Thought, and ReAct).

• Working experience with at least 2 OCI Pre-Built AI Services: Vision, Speech, Language, Anomaly Detection, Document Understanding etc.
• Strong understanding of AI/ML lifecycle and architecture principles: data lifecycle, feature stores, model registries, inference serving, feedback loops
• Must have working experience with semantic matching, fuzzy logic, and similarity scoring algorithms (e.g., cosine similarity, Jaccard, Levenshtein distance)
• Strong knowledge of AI governance, security, guardrails, and responsible AI.
• Must have knowledge of data ingestion, feature engineering, model training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring.
• Proficient in AI/ML/Gen AI frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, Hugging Face, LangChain) & Vector DBs (e.g., Pinecone, Milvus).
• Proficient in Agentic AI Frameworks (e.g. CrewAI, AutoGen and multi-agent orchestration workflow)
• Working knowledge with OCI Data Science, OCI Gen AI Service, OCI Gen AI Agents, Oracle ATP, Data Flow (Apache Spark), OCI Functions, API Gateway, and Monitoring
• Must have experience working with Oracle ATP, 23ai Databases and vector queries
• Strong leadership, communication, and stakeholder management abilities. 
• Good to have experience in front end programming languages such as React, Angular or Javascript etc.
• Good to have: Experience with Finance domain solutions.
• Good to Understand Oracle Cloud Deployment, architecture, networking, Security and other essential components
• Good to have: Understanding of emerging standards such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) for enabling interoperability between LLMs, tools, and enterprise systems.

 4. Employee Onboarding & HR Operations: Coordinate onboarding of selected candidates. Ensure required documentation and joining formalities are completed. Maintain employee records and recruitment documentation. Coordinate with management and operations teams for smooth onboarding. Track new employee performance during the initial period. Support employee engagement and retention initiatives.

Recruitment Performance & Reporting: Track recruitment metrics such as: Profiles sourced Candidates screened Interviews scheduled Offers released Joining ratio Time-to-hire Recruitment source effectiveness Recruiter retention Prepare weekly recruitment reports for management. Identify which recruitment channels are producing quality Bench Sales Recruiters. Continuously improve hiring strategies based on recruitment data.

Support performance management and disciplinary processes when required. Help create a professional, performance-driven work culture. Maintain confidentiality of employee and company information.

title: HR Recruiter | Domestic & International Staffing
description:
Position: HR Recruiter Domestic & International Staffing 
 Experience: 37 Years
 Location:  Doddaballapura,Bengaluru Rural
 Employment Type: Full-Time
 About the Role
 The HR Recruiter will be responsible for managing the end-to-end recruitment and staffing process for both domestic and international requirements . The role will involve understanding manpower requirements, developing sourcing strategies, identifying and screening candidates, coordinating interviews, managing offers, and supporting onboarding.
 The recruiter will work closely with hiring managers, business stakeholders, clients, and candidates across different geographies to ensure timely closure of positions while delivering a professional and positive candidate experience.
 Key Responsibilities
 1. Talent Acquisition & Staffing 
 Manage the complete recruitment lifecycle for domestic and international positions.
 Understand manpower requirements and develop effective recruitment strategies.
 Source candidates through job portals, LinkedIn, social media, referrals, professional networks, recruitment databases, and other sourcing channels.
 Build and maintain strong talent pipelines.
 Handle both volume hiring and niche/specialized recruitment requirements.
 2. Candidate Sourcing & Screening 
 Identify and attract qualified candidates across different locations, industries, and skill sets.
 Review resumes and shortlist candidates based on job requirements.
 Conduct initial screening interviews to evaluate qualifications, experience, communication skills, availability, compensation expectations, and overall suitability.
 Maintain regular candidate engagement throughout the recruitment process.
 3. Domestic & International Recruitment 
 Manage recruitment requirements across India and international markets.
 Understand different recruitment practices, talent markets, and candidate expectations across geographies.
 Coordinate with candidates across different time zones when required.
 Support international recruitment activities, including documentation, verification, interview coordination, and pre-joining formalities.
 4. Interviewing & Assessment 
 Conduct structured recruiter interviews based on defined job requirements.
 Coordinate technical, managerial, and client interviews.
 Schedule interviews across different locations and time zones.
 Collect interview feedback and ensure timely communication with candidates and stakeholders.
 5. Stakeholder & Client Management 
 Work closely with hiring managers and business stakeholders to understand manpower requirements.
 Coordinate with clients for staffing requirements, candidate submissions, interviews, and recruitment updates.
 Provide regular updates on open positions, candidate pipelines, interview status, and hiring progress.
 Build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
 6. Offer Management & Negotiation 
 Coordinate the offer process for selected candidates.
 Communicate compensation, benefits, employment terms, and joining requirements.
 Negotiate offers within approved guidelines.
 Manage candidate expectations and minimize offer dropouts through effective engagement.
 7. Recruitment Operations & Technology 
 Maintain accurate candidate information in ATS/HRMS and recruitment databases.
 Track candidate pipelines, interviews, feedback, offers, and joining status.
 Prepare recruitment reports and dashboards covering hiring progress, source effectiveness, time-to-fill, and other recruitment metrics.
 Leverage recruitment technology and sourcing tools to improve hiring efficiency.
 8. Compliance & Documentation 
 Ensure recruitment activities comply with applicable labor laws, statutory requirements, company policies, and recruitment guidelines.
 Follow appropriate documentation and verification processes for domestic and international candidates.
 Maintain accurate, confidential, and up-to-date recruitment records.
 9. Employer Branding & Candidate Experience 
 Represent Navinyaa professionally throughout the recruitment process.
 Ensure a positive candidate experience from initial interaction through onboarding.
 Maintain timely and transparent communication with candidates.
 Support employer branding and talent engagement initiatives.
 10. Recruitment Strategy & Market Research 
 Identify new talent pools and sourcing channels.
 Research talent availability, market trends, compensation trends, and competitor hiring activity.
 Develop alternate sourcing strategies for difficult-to-fill positions.
 Stay updated on recruitment technologies, sourcing techniques, and best practices.
 Requirements
 Education 
 Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
 Master's degree/MBA/PGDM in HR or a related field is preferred.
 Experience 
 37 years of proven experience in recruitment, talent acquisition, or staffing.
 Experience in domestic and international recruitment is preferred.
 Experience handling end-to-end recruitment across multiple functions and geographies.
 Experience in technical, engineering, IT, professional, manufacturing, or specialized recruitment will be an added advantage.
 Experience in a staffing agency or recruitment consultancy environment will be preferred.
 Recruitment & Technical Skills 
 Strong sourcing and candidate identification skills.
 Hands-on experience with LinkedIn Recruiter, job portals, Zoho Recruit, recruitment databases, and other sourcing platforms.
 Good understanding of Boolean search and advanced sourcing techniques.
 Proficiency in MS Office, particularly Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
 Ability to prepare recruitment trackers, reports, dashboards, and recruitment analytics.
 Communication & Interpersonal Skills 
 Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
 Strong interviewing, candidate engagement, negotiation, and persuasion skills.
 Ability to communicate effectively with candidates, hiring managers, clients, and stakeholders across different geographies.
 Strong relationship-building and stakeholder-management skills.
 Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
 Preferred Skills 
 Experience in international staffing or overseas recruitment.
 Exposure to recruitment across multiple countries or regions.
 Familiarity with international hiring processes and documentation.
 Experience working with international clients or stakeholders.
 Flexibility to work across different time zones based on business requirements.
 Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities.

title: Business Development Executive (Tour & Travel)
description:
Business Development Executive -- Tour Sales 
 Company: Edumiles Travels LLP
 Position: Business Development Executive Tour Sales
 Experience: 2+ Years
 Salary: 25,000 – 30,000 per month
 Education: Bachelor’s Degree in any field
 Job Type: Full-Time
 Work Mode: Work from Office 
 About the Role 
 Edumiles Travels LLP is looking for an experienced and target-oriented Business Development Executive – Tour Sales to handle tour and travel sales activities. The candidate will be primarily responsible for making tour-related sales calls, handling travel enquiries, understanding customer requirements, recommending suitable tour packages, following up with leads, and converting enquiries into confirmed bookings . The ideal candidate should have prior experience in tour sales/travel sales , good communication and negotiation skills, and practical knowledge of different travel destinations. The candidate should be able to confidently explain destinations, sightseeing, activities, itineraries, hotels, travel routes, and other important details to customers over calls . 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Make outbound and inbound sales calls related to tours and travel packages . Handle leads and enquiries for domestic and international tours. Understand customer travel requirements, budget, destination preferences, and trip duration. Recommend suitable tour packages, itineraries, destinations, and travel arrangements . Explain destinations to customers in detail, including popular attractions, sightseeing, activities, hotels, travel routes, best time to visit, and approximate trip duration . Use practical destination knowledge to confidently guide customers and help them select suitable tour packages. Follow up regularly with prospective customers and convert enquiries into confirmed bookings. Achieve assigned monthly sales and revenue targets . Explain tour packages, inclusions, exclusions, pricing, itineraries, hotels, transportation, and other travel services to customers. Coordinate with DMCs and the operations team for quotations, availability, costing, and booking arrangements. Negotiate with customers and close tour sales effectively. Maintain strong relationships with existing and potential customers. Handle customer queries and provide timely information throughout the sales process. Maintain accurate records of leads, calls, follow-ups, quotations, and bookings. Prepare regular sales and lead-conversion reports. Identify opportunities to generate repeat business and referrals. Stay updated on tour packages, destinations, travel trends, and market requirements. Ensure a high level of customer satisfaction throughout the sales process. 
 Requirements 
 Bachelor’s degree in any field. Minimum 2+ years of experience in Tour Sales, Travel Sales, Holiday Package Sales, or a similar role. Candidates with direct experience in tour package sales will be preferred. Good practical knowledge of domestic and international travel destinations . Candidate should have personally travelled to or extensively handled tours for multiple destinations and should be able to confidently explain those destinations to customers. Ability to explain popular places, sightseeing, activities, hotels, travel routes, best time to visit, itineraries, and key attractions of different destinations. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Strong sales, negotiation, presentation, and customer-handling skills. Experience in making tour/travel-related sales calls and handling travel enquiries. Proven ability to convert leads into bookings. Target-oriented with a strong focus on sales and revenue generation. Good follow-up and relationship-management skills. Basic knowledge of CRM, MS Office, and sales tools. Ability to handle multiple leads and follow-ups efficiently. Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively with the team. 
 Preferred Candidate Profile 
 Candidates with 2+ years of experience specifically in Tour Sales / Travel Sales / Holiday Package Sales will be preferred. Candidates who have personally travelled to multiple destinations or have extensive experience handling tours for different destinations will be an added advantage. The role is primarily focused on tour sales calls, destination explanation, lead conversion, follow-ups, quotations, and confirmed tour bookings .

Key Skills: Tours,Tour Packages,Tour Management,Tourism,Holiday Packages,Travel Sales,Sales Operations,Outbound Tours
