Work Mode: 5 days, Onsite (5 hours from the office and 4 hours from home.) Location: A1, Ofis Square Tower, Sector 3, Noida, U.P, 201301 (Near Sector 16 Metro Station) 
 Role Overview  We are looking for an Inside Sales Executive to join our growing sales team and contribute to our business development efforts in the US market. This is a 2-month paid internship opportunity with the possibility of a full-time Pre-Placement Offer (PPO) based on performance. As an Inside Sales Executive, you will be responsible for identifying potential business opportunities, connecting with prospective clients, understanding their requirements, and introducing them to Crownstack's digital engineering and technology solutions. This is a great opportunity for graduates who want to start their career in B2B sales and business development within the technology industry. 
 Responsibilities  Identify and research potential clients in the US market. Generate new business opportunities through outbound prospecting. Connect with prospective clients through calls, emails, linkedin and other relevant channels. Understand prospect requirements, business challenges, and potential technology needs. Qualify leads and identify opportunities aligned with Crownstack's services. Schedule and coordinate meetings with qualified prospects for further discussions. Build and maintain strong relationships with prospects through regular follow-ups. Research target companies, industries, and decision-makers to support sales initiatives. Maintain accurate records of sales activities, lead information, and follow-ups in the CRM. Work closely with internal sales and technical teams to support the sales process. Develop an understanding of Crownstack's services and the technology solutions we offer. Stay updated on relevant technology and industry trends. 
 Required Qualifications Graduate in any discipline. BBA / MBA candidates are preferred . B.Tech, MCA , and other technical-degree candidates are not preferred for this role. 06 months of experience; freshers are welcome. Strong verbal and written communication skills. Good interpersonal and relationship-building abilities. Ability to understand customer requirements and communicate effectively with prospects. A proactive approach toward learning and taking ownership of assigned responsibilities. Willingness to build a career in sales and business development. Basic understanding or interest in technology and IT services. Comfortable working with CRM systems, LinkedIn, email, and other sales tools. Ability to work effectively in a target-oriented and collaborative environment. 
 Internship & PPO Opportunity  Internship Duration: 2 months . Paid Internship : Selected candidates will receive a stipend during the internship period. Candidates demonstrating strong performance during the internship may be considered for a fulltime Pre-Placement Offer (PPO) . The PPO will be based on overall performance, learning ability, contribution, and suitability for the full-time role. Competitive fixed compensation with a performance-based bonus will be offered upon transition to the full-time role. The full-time role also provides opportunities for professional growth and performancebased rewards.  
 Why Join Crownstack? Opportunity to begin your career in B2B Technology Sales. Exposure to the US market and international clients. Learn about digital engineering and emerging technologies. Work closely with experienced sales, engineering, and business teams. Gain practical experience in prospecting, lead generation, client communication, and business development. Opportunity to transition into a full-time role based on performance. Competitive compensation with performance-based earning opportunities. Opportunities for professional growth and development. 
 What We Value  Proactive, dependable, and continuously learning. Open, direct, and collaborative communication. Receptive to feedback and committed to improvement. Curious about new AI tools and techniques, explores independently. Self-motivated with strong ownership of assigned work. 
 Apply Now  If you are looking to start your career in technology sales and want an opportunity to learn, grow, and work with an international client base, we would love to hear from you. Join Crownstack and start your career in B2B Technology Sales. Send your application directly to hiring@crownstack.co Crownstack is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity at all levels. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability.

 Job Summary: We are looking for a motivated and results-driven Inside Sales Executive to join our real estate sales team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for connecting with prospective buyers, understanding their property requirements, generating interest in our projects, and converting qualified leads into site visits and successful sales. 
 The role requires excellent communication, strong follow-up skills, customer relationship management, and the ability to work toward monthly sales targets. 
 Key Responsibilities Handle incoming and outgoing calls with prospective customers and leads. Understand customers property requirements, budget, preferred location, and purchase timeline. Explain project details, property features, pricing, payment plans, amenities, and offers. Qualify leads based on customer requirements and buying intent. Maintain regular follow-ups with prospects through calls, WhatsApp, email, and other communication channels. Schedule and coordinate property/site visits with interested customers. Work closely with the field sales team to ensure smooth lead handovers and follow-ups. Maintain accurate and updated customer information in the CRM system. Track lead status, follow-up activities, site visits, and conversions. Achieve daily, weekly, and monthly lead conversion and sales targets. Build strong relationships with prospects and maintain a positive customer experience. Follow up with customers after site visits and assist in moving them toward booking. Stay updated on market trends, competitor projects, property prices, and new project launches. Prepare regular sales reports and provide updates to the sales manager. Handle customer queries and objections professionally and effectively. 
 Required Skills Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Strong convincing, negotiation, and objection-handling abilities. Good interpersonal and relationship-building skills. Target-oriented and self-motivated approach. Strong follow-up and lead management skills. Ability to handle multiple leads and prioritize prospects. Basic knowledge of CRM systems, MS Office, and communication tools. Good understanding of the real estate sales process. Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and target-driven environment. 
 Qualifications & Experience Master's degree in Marketing, Sales, or a related field is preferred. Fresher's - 1 years of experience in inside sales, tele-sales, customer-facing sales role. Freshers with excellent communication and strong sales aptitude may also be considered. Prior experience in real estate sales will be an advantage. 
 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs): Number of leads contacted and qualified. Lead-to-site-visit conversion rate. Site-visit-to-booking conversion rate. Monthly sales/booking targets achieved. Follow-up and lead response efficiency. Customer engagement and CRM data accuracy. 
 What We Offer Competitive salary with attractive performance-based incentives. Career growth opportunities within the real estate sales organization. Professional training and sales development programs. Exposure to premium real estate projects and customers. Supportive and performance-driven work environment.

title: Digital Marketing Executive
description:
Sancta Maria Ecommerce Private Limited is looking for a highly motivated Digital Marketing Executive to manage and grow our online business across multiple brands and sales channels. The candidate will be responsible for marketplace operations, Shopify store management, Amazon A+ Content creation, product catalog management, inventory planning, purchase order management, supplier coordination, import activities, content creation, and achieving monthly sales targets. This is a target-driven role requiring complete ownership of assigned brands, products, and marketplaces. We are looking for individuals who are proactive, accountable, detail-oriented, and focused on delivering measurable business results. Role & Responsibilities Marketplace Operations Manage seller accounts on Amazon, Flipkart, Meesho, Snapdeal, JioMart, Shopify, and other marketplaces. Create, update, and optimize product listings. Upload new products and maintain catalog accuracy. Manage pricing, inventory, promotions, and product availability. Monitor marketplace account health and performance metrics. Resolve catalog issues, listing suppressions, listing removal, restricted products handling , and product-related errors. Ensure compliance with marketplace policies and requirements. Shopify Store Management Manage products, collections, pages, and promotional content on Shopify stores. Upload and maintain product information, specifications, pricing, and images. Create and update landing pages, banners, and website content. Coordinate website updates and promotional activities. Ensure excellent customer experience across all websites. Amazon A+ Content & Catalog Optimization Create and manage Amazon A+ Content. Optimize product titles, bullet points, descriptions, keywords, and images. Improve listing quality, search visibility, and conversion rates. Create variation listings, bundles, and cross-selling opportunities. Ensure all listings have complete content, images, videos, and specifications. Continuously improve catalog quality to maximize sales performance. Sales Growth & Target Achievement Take complete ownership of assigned monthly sales targets. Develop and execute strategies to increase sales across marketplaces and Shopify stores. Monitor daily sales performance and implement corrective actions when necessary. Identify growth opportunities and execute plans to improve revenue. Monitor competitors, pricing trends, and market opportunities. Drive continuous improvement in sales performance and business growth. Maintain strong accountability toward achieving assigned targets. Marketplace Growth Activities Plan and execute deals, discounts, coupons, and promotional campaigns. Support Amazon PPC and marketplace advertising activities. Improve product rankings through listing optimization and marketplace best practices. Analyze traffic, conversion rates, and customer behavior. Launch new products and optimize existing product performance. Coordinate seasonal sales and promotional activities. Purchase Order & Inventory Management Prepare and manage purchase orders. Coordinate with suppliers and manufacturers. Monitor inventory levels and forecast stock requirements. Ensure timely replenishment of fast-moving products. Prevent stock-outs and overstock situations. Maintain accurate inventory records across all sales channels. Import & Supplier Coordination Coordinate sourcing activities with domestic and international suppliers. Assist in product imports and procurement processes. Follow up on production schedules, shipments, and deliveries. Coordinate with freight forwarders, logistics partners, and suppliers. Maintain import-related documentation and records. Track shipment status and ensure timely stock availability. Product Launch Management Coordinate end-to-end product launches across marketplaces and Shopify stores. Create catalogs, product content, images, videos, and A+ Content for new launches. Ensure inventory availability before launch. Monitor launch performance and optimize listings based on results. Content Creation & Creative Work Design product images, banners, and marketing creatives using Canva. Perform basic image editing using Photoshop. Create and edit product videos, reels, shorts, and promotional content. Support social media and marketing teams with creative assets. Coordinate product photography and content development activities. Reporting & Analysis Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly performance reports. Analyze sales trends, inventory movement, and product performance. Monitor conversion rates and identify improvement opportunities. Track business KPIs and marketplace performance metrics. Provide recommendations for sales growth and operational improvements. title: Motion Graphic Designer
description:
Job Description We are looking for a versatile, mid-level Video/Graphic Designer to join our Brand Creative team. In this role, you will turn complex cybersecurity and digital-trust topics into clear, compelling visual stories across video, motion, and static design. Working closely with brand, campaigns, and demand generation, you will produce on-brand creative that drives awareness, pipeline, and engagement across digital channels, events, and sales enablement. The ideal candidate pairs strong design fundamentals with hands-on video editing and motion skills, and thrives in a fast-paced B2B environment where creative directly supports measurable marketing outcomes. Here are the core functions, responsibilities, and expectations for this role: Edit, animate, and produce video content for demand generation campaigns, product launches, social media, webinars, customer stories, and sales enablement. Create motion graphics, animated explainers, and short-form video that simplify complex security and technical concepts for B2B audiences. Design and produce a broad range of marketing assets - including social graphics, digital ads, landing pages, infographics, email templates, presentations, and event collateral - that are on-brand and conversion-focused. Partner with campaign and demand generation managers to develop creative concepts tied to pipeline and revenue goals, then adapt assets across channels and formats. Apply and help evolve Sectigo s brand guidelines, ensuring a consistent visual identity across every deliverable. Manage multiple projects at once, balancing quality with deadlines in a high-velocity marketing organization. Source, organize, and maintain creative assets, footage, stock, and templates to improve team efficiency and reuse. Collaborate with internal stakeholders (product marketing, content, web, and events) and external vendors or freelancers as needed. Use performance data and stakeholder feedback to iterate on creative and improve results. Additional tasks associated with this position may be assigned in response to company initiatives and business needs. More information about this role: This is a full-time and in-office position, reporting to our Chennai office 5 days a week, working in the 3PM IST schedule unless otherwise notified. This is an individual contributor role, reporting to our Director of Account Based Marketing. The targeted compensation package for this role is between INR 8,00,000 and INR 11,00,000, subject upon internal equity and years of experience. We may make further adjustments through an approval process if the targeted compensation range needs to be modified based on business needs and market trends. Qualifications Education: Bachelor s degree in Graphic Design, Digital Media, Film/Video Production, Visual Communications, or a related field - or equivalent practical experience supported by a strong portfolio. Experience: Minimum of 3-5 years of professional experience in graphic design and video production, must be within a B2B, technology, or agency environment. A portfolio or demo reel showcasing both design and video/motion work is required. Ideal Candidate Profiles, Talents, and Desired Qualifications: Proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud, particularly Premiere Pro, After Effects, Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign. Strong motion graphics and video editing skills, including pacing, sound, captioning, and exporting for multiple platforms and aspect ratios. Solid command of design fundamentals: typography, layout, color, and visual hierarchy. Experience designing for digital marketing and demand generation (paid social, display, landing pages, and email). Familiarity with Figma and collaborative, design-system-based workflows is a plus. Ability to translate complex or technical subject matter into clear, engaging visuals - experience in cybersecurity, SaaS, or technology is a strong advantage. Comfortable working from briefs, taking creative direction, and managing feedback from multiple stakeholders. Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to juggle competing priorities and deadlines. A collaborative, proactive mindset and genuine interest in how creative drives marketing performance. Bonus: experience with basic 3D, AI-assisted creative tools, photography, or live event/webinar production.

title: Finance Manager
description:
About the Role 
 We are looking for a hands-on Finance Manager Accounts & MIS to own the finance and accounting function at Zoomies. You will work closely with the founders and leadership team, managing end-to-end accounting, MIS, financial reporting, P&L and financial controls as we scale. 
 This is a high-ownership role suited for someone who has strong accounting fundamentals but also enjoys using numbers to understand business performance and drive better financial decisions. 
 What You’ll Do 
 Own end-to-end accounting and monthly financial closure , ensuring accurate books and financial statements. Prepare and drive monthly MIS, P&L, cash flow and management reports for the founders. Analyze revenue, COGS, margins, expenses and profitability to identify key business trends. Track budget vs. actuals , financial variances and cost optimization opportunities. Manage inventory accounting, stock reconciliation, COGS and inventory reporting . Handle and review marketplace, payment gateway and COD reconciliations across D2C, Amazon, Flipkart and Quick Commerce. Manage/coordinate GST, TDS, statutory compliance and audits with external CA/audit teams. Monitor AP, AR, vendor payments and working capital . Support financial planning, forecasting, fundraising and investor reporting. Build and improve finance processes, controls and MIS/reporting systems as the business grows. Manage and mentor junior accounts team members and ensure accuracy and process discipline. 
 What We’re Looking For 
 5–7 years of relevant experience in Finance & Accounts, preferably in a startup, D2C, e-commerce, FMCG or other inventory-led business. Strong hands-on experience in end-to-end accounting and monthly closure . Proven experience in MIS, P&L analysis and financial reporting . Good understanding of cost structures, profitability, margins and variance analysis . Strong knowledge of GST, TDS and statutory compliance . Advanced Excel skills and experience with accounting software such as Tally, Zoho Books or similar ERP systems . Strong analytical skills with the ability to convert financial data into actionable business insights . Comfortable working independently, taking ownership and operating in a fast-paced startup environment. CA Inter / CA / B.Com / M.Com / MBA Finance candidates with relevant experience are welcome. 
 Good to Have Experience in D2C/e-commerce, marketplace and payment gateway reconciliations. Experience with inventory-led businesses and SKU-level profitability. Exposure to financial modelling, budgeting and forecasting. Experience setting up finance processes and MIS systems from scratch. Experience working directly with founders or senior leadership. 
 Why Zoomies? This is an opportunity to take end-to-end ownership of Finance & Accounts and work directly with the founders as Zoomies scales. You will have the opportunity to build systems, improve financial visibility and grow into a larger Finance Controller / Head of Finance role with the business.

title: Key Accounts Manager
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION 
 Account Manager Department: Sales & Business Development
 Position: Key Account Manager - HORECA
 Location: Mira Road (Mumbai) 
 Reporting To: Head B2B Sales / Business Head
 Experience: 2 - 5 years
 Employment Type: Full-time 
 About the Role 
 We are looking for a dynamic and result-oriented Account Manager HORECA to manage and grow our B2B customer portfolio for our fresh cold-pressed juice business. 
 The role will be responsible for developing strong relationships with B2B customers, driving repeat sales, managing orders and deliveries, ensuring timely collections, resolving customer issues, and identifying opportunities to increase business from existing and new accounts. The ideal candidate should understand the requirements of fresh/FMCG products , have strong commercial and relationship-management skills, and be comfortable working in a fast-paced, operationally intensive environment. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 1. B2B Account Management Manage a portfolio of B2B customers and act as the primary point of contact. Build strong, long-term relationships with customers and key decision-makers. Understand customer requirements, consumption patterns, pricing expectations, and business needs. Ensure high customer satisfaction and retention. Conduct regular account reviews and identify opportunities for business expansion. 
 2. Sales & Business Development Achieve monthly and quarterly B2B sales targets. Generate new business from potential B2B customers. Develop accounts across segments such as: Hotels, Restaurants & Cafs (HoReCa) Corporate offices Gyms and fitness centres Hospitals and healthcare institutions Schools, colleges and institutions Cloud kitchens and caterers Modern trade and retail chains Corporate gifting and wellness programs Distributors and resellers Prepare quotations, negotiate commercial terms, and close orders. Identify cross-selling and upselling opportunities across the product portfolio. 
 3. Order & Delivery Coordination Coordinate with the production, dispatch and logistics teams to ensure timely fulfilment of customer orders. Monitor daily/weekly order requirements and communicate customer forecasts to the production team. Ensure correct SKU, quantity, pricing and delivery schedules. Proactively communicate any supply or delivery issues to customers. Monitor product returns, damages, shortages and delivery discrepancies. 
 4. Fresh Product & Inventory Coordination Understand the operational challenges associated with fresh cold-pressed juices, including limited shelf life, production planning and demand fluctuations. Work closely with production and planning teams to minimize product wastage. Track customer-wise demand and consumption trends. Support demand forecasting and advance order planning. Coordinate with the team to optimize production against confirmed and forecasted B2B demand. 
 5. Collections & Commercial Management Monitor customer outstanding balances and ensure timely collections. Follow up on overdue invoices and credit-limit issues. Maintain accurate customer-wise payment and outstanding records. Coordinate with the accounts team regarding invoices, credit notes, debit notes and payment reconciliation. Ensure adherence to approved customer credit terms. 
 6. Customer Service & Issue Resolution Handle customer queries and complaints promptly. Coordinate internally to resolve issues related to product quality, delivery, packaging, billing or service. Track complaints until closure and maintain proper documentation. Gather customer feedback and communicate actionable insights to management and the quality/production teams. 
 7. Reporting & MIS Maintain updated customer and sales records. Prepare daily/weekly/monthly B2B sales reports. Track: Customer-wise sales SKU-wise sales Order frequency Average order value Customer retention Outstanding payments New customer acquisition Customer complaints and returns Sales target vs. achievement Provide management with regular updates on account performance and market opportunities. 
 Education: Graduate in Business Administration, Commerce, Marketing or a related field. MBA/PGDM in Sales/Marketing is an advantage. Experience: 25 years of experience in B2B sales/account management. Experience in FMCG, food & beverage, beverages, fresh food, dairy, hospitality supply or related industries is preferred. Candidates with experience managing institutional/HoReCa accounts will be preferred. Required Skills Strong B2B sales and account-management skills. Excellent communication and negotiation abilities. Strong customer relationship management. Good commercial and numerical understanding. Ability to manage multiple customers simultaneously. Strong follow-up and collection skills. Good Excel/MIS reporting skills. Ability to coordinate effectively with production, logistics, quality and accounts teams. Strong problem-solving and decision-making ability. Target-oriented and self-motivated approach. Willingness to travel for customer meetings when required. Preferred Knowledge The candidate should have a basic understanding of: Fresh/cold-pressed juice products FMCG distribution and B2B sales Shelf-life and freshness considerations Food-service/HoReCa operations Pricing, margins and trade discounts Credit terms and collections Demand forecasting Order fulfilment and logistics Basic food-quality and customer-service requirements Personal Attributes Customer-centric mindset High ownership and accountability Strong interpersonal skills Energetic and proactive Commercially aware Detail-oriented Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup/growth environment Ability to work independently as well as with cross-functional teams Compensation Salary: [XX,XXX – XX,XXX] per month / CTC [X – X] LPA Incentives: Performance-linked incentives based on sales achievement, collections, new customer acquisition and account growth. Career Growth The successful candidate can progress into roles such as: Account Manager Senior Account Manager B2B Sales Manager Head – B2B Sales / Key Accounts Ideal Candidate The ideal candidate is someone who can win new B2B customers, build lasting relationships, grow existing accounts, ensure timely collections, and coordinate internally to deliver a consistently excellent customer experience while understanding the unique challenges of selling and distributing fresh products.

Proficio Therapy Services is a mission driven therapy organization dedicated to improving the lives of children and families. We provide high quality ABA Therapy, Speech Therapy, and Occupational Therapy through our family of licensed clinical entities: 
 AGES Learning Solutions LLC  ABA Therapy Proficio Speech Therapy Group Inc  Speech Therapy Childs Play Therapy Services PC   Occupational Therapy

title: Application Developement Sr Analyst
description:
Role Purpose The Application Development Senior Analyst designs, builds, tests and supports secure, reliable digital solutions that meet business and customer needs. Working within an Agile delivery team, the role provides hands-on development expertise, takes ownership of moderately complex work, contributes to technical decisions and helps improve engineering quality, delivery flow and operational resilience.
 Key Responsibilities Analyse user stories and technical requirements, identify dependencies and translate them into maintainable solution designs. Develop, configure, test and document application features using approved engineering standards, patterns and platforms. Own assigned work from refinement through deployment and early-life support, providing clear progress, risk and dependency updates. Produce clean, reusable and secure code or configuration, with appropriate unit tests and evidence of quality. Participate actively in peer reviews and respond constructively to feedback; support less-experienced developers through knowledge sharing and practical guidance. Collaborate with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Quality Engineering, Architecture, Security, Platform and Production Support colleagues. Use source control and CI/CD practices effectively, supporting automated quality gates and reliable, traceable releases. Troubleshoot defects and production issues using logs, monitoring and diagnostic tools; contribute to root-cause analysis and preventive actions. Create and maintain concise technical documentation, including solution notes, support guidance and operational runbooks. Contribute to sprint planning, refinement, daily stand-ups, reviews and retrospectives, and act on agreed continuous-improvement actions. Protect customer and company data by following privacy, security, access-control and change-management requirements. Keep skills current and apply relevant new capabilities where they improve quality, efficiency, reliability or customer outcomes.
 Required Experience and Capabilities Practical experience delivering application development or configuration within an enterprise environment. Strong hands-on capability in the core technologies required by the requisition, with the ability to diagnose and resolve technical issues independently. Understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including modular design, testing, debugging, version control and secure coding. Experience working in Agile teams and managing work through tools such as Jira and Confluence or equivalent. Experience with code review, automated testing and CI/CD pipelines. Ability to communicate technical information clearly to engineering and non-engineering stakeholders. Sound judgement, attention to detail, ownership and a continuous-learning mindset. Ability to balance delivery pace with quality, security, maintainability and operational support needs.
 Role-Specific Technical Skills The requisition should identify the mandatory stack. For a Salesforce / OmniStudio vacancy, the following are relevant: Salesforce platform development and configuration, including Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL and platform security concepts. OmniStudio capabilities such as OmniScripts, FlexCards, DataRaptors and Integration Procedures. Integration patterns and APIs, including REST/SOAP services, authentication and error handling. Salesforce deployment and release practices, preferably using Git-based source control and Copado or a comparable CI/CD tool. Automated and unit testing, static analysis and code-quality controls. Application monitoring and log analysis using relevant observability tools.
 Nice to Have Relevant platform certification or equivalent demonstrable experience. Experience in healthcare, insurance or another regulated industry. Experience with SAFe or delivery across multiple dependent teams. Awareness of accessibility, performance engineering and resilient integration design. Experience using approved AI-assisted development tools to support activities such as code generation, refactoring, unit-test creation, documentation, debugging or code explanation, while applying human review, secure-coding practices and data-handling controls. Experience using approved generative AI tools in day-to-day work to summarise information, improve written communication, prepare meeting outputs, explore options or streamline repeatable tasks, with appropriate validation of outputs. An interest in evaluating AI use cases based on measurable value, quality, risk and responsible-use considerations.
 What Good Performance Looks Like Delivery: Completes agreed work predictably, surfaces risks early and follows through to a stable outcome. Engineering quality: Produces maintainable, tested and secure solutions that meet agreed standards. Ownership: Handles moderately complex work with limited oversight and takes responsibility for follow-up. Collaboration: Works constructively across disciplines, contributes to reviews and shares knowledge. Improvement: Identifies practical ways to reduce rework, strengthen controls and improve team effectiveness. Responsible AI use: Uses AI as an assistive tool where permitted, validates outputs and never substitutes generated content for engineering accountability.
 Education and Professional Development Bachelor s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. Commitment to ongoing technical learning, including platform, security, cloud, automation and responsible AI capabilities relevant to the role. About The Cigna Group Cigna Healthcare, a division of The Cigna Group, is an advocate for better health through every stage of life. We guide our customers through the health care system, empowering them with the information and insight they need to make the best choices for improving their health and vitality. Join us in driving growth and improving lives.

description:
Are you ready to make an impact at DTCC 

Do you want to work on innovative projects, collaborate with a dynamic and supportive team, and receive investment in your professional development At DTCC, we are at the forefront of innovation in the financial markets. We are committed to helping our employees grow and succeed. We believe that you have the skills and drive to make a real impact. The Impact you will have in this role: Global Security Management is responsible for all facets of DTCCs physical security and life safety program with emphasis on developing, defining, and implementing industry best practices to safeguard against threats and risks to DTCC employees, facilities, business enterprise, and assets. The global security team remains abreast of world events, unexpected crises, natural disasters, and geopolitical instability to identify, communicate, and allocate resources to mitigate potential risks and threats to DTCC. Corporate Security focuses on the physical security controls and processes that ensures the security guarding operations, security alarm closed circuit television (CCTV) / Video Surveillance systems monitoring and mobile response, visitor management and mail screening processing. Corporate Security provides on-site security services, ensuring the overall safety and security of DTCC personnel, facilities and assets. Your Primary Responsibilities: Enforce the rules, regulations, and procedures of DTCC to control access, prevent trespassing, and prevent loss or damage to persons or property on premise. Assists with ensuring the safety and security of all staff and guests on site. Ensures that security posts are properly staffed and inspects such posts on a regular basis. Manage the corporate security team and ensures that corporate security officers enforce regulations and procedures. Collaborate with other departments to ensure security services are properly provided. Manage and supervise the Security Operation Center (SOC) or Security Control Center Environment. Experience using security related systems, including an incident report management system, two-way radios, and visitor management systems. Ensures risks associated with business activities are effectively identified, measured, monitored, and controlled. Adhere to written risk and compliance policies, standards, and procedures for business activities while also ensuring that the corporate security team follows these standards. Knowledge of policies, processes, and procedures in order to provide guidance and coaching for corporate seucrity team. Serve as a resource to the corporate secuirty team when inquiries and or issues are raised. Supervises the security and safety to property and delivery access at entry gates, turnstiles, and visitor lobbies. Provide information and direction to employees, visitors, and contractors. Works with and assists first responders, including federal, state, and local law enforcement agencies and other emergency services providers. Provide response and resolution to critical incidents and other security issues. Supervises the shift blotter and documents for all security shifts, ensuring that key information is communicated to team members as appropriate. A shift blotter is security document that captures the daily activity of the security operations. Ensure that administrative records are properly maintained and assist other supervisors and managers in duty assignments, daily operations, and coordinating workflow. Position is required to be physically in the office. Talents Needed for Success: Deep understanding or certification in: Physical electronic security systems C-CURE 9000 access control systems Avigilon Unity 8-9 CCTV systems Collaborates well within and across teams. Communicates openly with team members and others. Works with the team to review deliverables and ensure quality and accuracy. Adheres to established rules and procedures when performing work. title: Finance Partner - NVB Campus
description:
Be part of something bigger! 
As the world and the way people live is changing, we at Bekaert believe it s our responsibility to contribute to finding new solutions for the future. With a 140+ year old heritage of excellence, innovation, and a future-focused mindset, we strive to create value for our customers and society. We aim to do this through innovative solutions and sustainable practices. We are committed to pushing the boundaries of steel wire transformation and coatings whilst also leveraging our expertise to develop innovative solutions with new materials and services in a safe, smart, and sustainable way. Our focus extends to markets such as new mobility, low-carbon construction, and green energy. As a dynamic and growing company with over 19 000 employees worldwide, 75 nationalities, a retention rate above 90% and 3,7 billion in combined revenue in 2025, we are looking for someone like you to join our team as we continue to shape a safer, more efficient, and connected world! I. Purpose of the Role This position will focus on timely and accurate calculation and reporting of financial result of NVB (NV Bekaert) Campus in Belgium to have accurate reflection of campus costs. The candidate will also support financial reporting for the Sales / Trading entities in EMEA. The Candidate must be a team player and self-starter too as the position needs working in cross functional teams to resolve issues having impact on multiple functions. The Candidate should also be able to handle the Projects its management independently, while maintaining Confidentiality of the Project wherever required. II. Roles and Responsibilities Monthly Closing Reporting 
- Drive monthly activities, perform necessary analysis, checks and provide insights on Campus Costs.
- Ensures the timely execution of reports with data integrity in collaboration with Campus Management team and understand the build-up of the figures and be ready to concisely reply on questions; drive corrective actions when needed.
- Timely reporting of accurate campus result, including comment letter. All follow up reports are updated in time, in good quality and reported to campus management.
- Support the Campus Management by providing financial metrics reports on critical topics Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).
- Analyze all variances related to campus cost centers and reports to management.
- Support team in transforming reporting requirements on new reporting platform.
- Ad hoc financial analysis.
- Preparation of Management reports, checking of upload in consolidation tool.
- Purchase Price Variance (PPV) analysis provisioning.
- Material Price update in System.
- Calculating updating tariffs. 
- Execution of assessment cycles for cost recharge.
- Transfer Price - calculation, review, update.
- Reports - Sales reports, Inventory reports., etc. Budgeting Forecasting - Drive annual planning cycles (X+1) for Campus (cost centers), Trading businesses. - Prepare annual budget for the different campus cost centers and calculate the new rates for utilities, waste, maintenance hours.
- Maintains the master data and allocation rules to reflect correct campus costs in the budget of the plant.
- Co-ordinate with various departments for Budget data gathering and preparation.
- Presents the annual campus budget to campus management. Campus Cost Analysis Allocation - Coordinates and monitors the timely cost bookings. 
- Collect, analyze, and report on ad hoc questions about costs, and allocations.
- Monitors the different allocation keys to make sure all campus related costs are allocated to the plant by using the correct driver.
- Safeguard the accuracy of the costs booked on the campus cost centers and set up accruals if needed. 
- Check and define in cooperation with Procurement team on a monthly basis, the new prices for utilities. Adjust the master data accordingly so correct utility costs are allocated to the production plants.
- Make sure the actual rates for utilities and waste are reflected in the allocations towards the production plants.
- Partnering with local plant management to answer to ad hoc questions. Internal Control Compliance - Monitor the financial procedures to ensure that systems and internal controls within the plant meet the needs of management and ensure that financial activities comply with applicable group rules.
- Supporting in various internal / external audits. III. Skills Competencies Educational Qualifications: 
- Bachelor s degree or above, majoring in accounting, finance, or related field.
- Professional qualification as CMA, Post Graduate Programmed in Management (PGPM) Technical Skills: 
- Knowledge and understanding of operations of accounting financial function is essential. Preferably prior financial analysis reporting experience across a complex manufacturing set-up of significant scale, in a global international environment.
- Software knowledge - Expert in MS Office (Excel, PowerPivot, Power BI, Power point).
- SAP FI CO module experience. 
- Knowledge of systems (preferred) - Consolidation tools - Group Reporting, Planning tools - SAP Analytical Cloud (SAC) and Central Finance (CFIN). Be bold and take the leap! 
Were looking for individuals who are not afraid to take risks and explore new ideas. If you are passionate about personal growth and bringing your authentic self to work, we want you on our team!

title: Financial Controller
description:
Role & responsibilities Job Title: Finance Controller Location: Gurgaon, India Job type: Full time Reports To: Country Head Role Overview This is a key role in driving the future success of the Trek brand in India. As Finance Controller, you will lead the finance function end-to-end, building a high-performance culture that does the basics brilliantly while adding real value to your business partners through expense management, compelling storytelling, and data-led commercial decision-making. Beyond this core finance mandate, we are looking for someone excited to stretch into a broader leadership opportunity. This is a chance to build cross-functional leadership experience as you help scale and strengthen Trek India's Shared Services organization, with a clear path to take on full leadership of this function in the future. Objectives of the role Help ensure financial reporting is accurate and stays compliant with accounting standards, tax regulations, and company policies. Maintain strong internal controls and sound risk management practices. Bring insightful analysis on margins, profitability, working capital, and overall business performance. Support leadership with the insights they need to make informed decisions. Lead the budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning process. Keep track of performance against plans and help drive accountability for results. Oversee statutory audits, internal audits, and regulatory compliance. Help ensure audit observations are closed out on time, with corrective actions followed through. Key Responsibilities 1. Financial Reporting, Transaction Processing & Control Governance Own the monthly close process, reporting to Group under US GAAP within 3 days of month-end. All balance sheet accounts reconciled and clean. All income statement accounts analyzed and explained. Present monthly results and financial & non-financial KPIs to the US Headquarters. Lead the finance department. Oversee credit control, working to minimize past dues and DSO. Build and maintain a strong internal control environment. 2. Compliance, Taxations & Audit Stay on top of local financial and regulatory compliance, keeping a close eye on the environment to ensure we remain compliant. Maintain strong internal controls, including safeguarding of assets and compliance with external regulations and internal policies/delegation of authority. Own direct and indirect tax reporting and compliance, ensuring payments are accurate and on time. Serve as the key point of contact for internal audits, building close, cooperative working relationships. 3. Working Capital and Cash flow management Oversee dealer/customer credit management processes. Work to minimize overdue receivables and improve Days Sales Outstanding (DSO). Monitor customer risk exposure and recommend corrective actions where needed. Support effective cash flow planning and liquidity management. Partner with customers and stakeholders to establish practices that support sustainable growth and healthy cash flow. 4. Commercial Finance & Business Partnering Own the budgeting and monthly reforecasting process, delivering high accuracy with fully explained results and on-time deadlines. Analyze sales and gross margin, identifying opportunities for improvement. Monitor and build awareness of expenses, leading efforts to manage these down when needed. Support the India Country Manager in shaping strategy and long-range business plans. Provide routine and ad-hoc analysis to support sales and management. Partner closely with all departments to deliver financial support and informed decision-making. As part of the global senior finance group, liaise with functional leaders at US Headquarters. Work with customers to establish best-practice benchmarks and help them manage cash flow and grow profitably. Lead projects and ad-hoc initiatives as needed. 5. Shared Service Business Play a role in shaping and executing Trek India Shared Services strategy, in line with business objectives and global priorities. Support Trek Indias Shared Services Business / Teams to help deliver high-quality, cost-effective, customer-centric services across supported functions to global Trek subsidiaries & businesses Help set and track service delivery standards, SLAs, KPIs, and customer satisfaction metrics. Support compliance with the Income Tax Act, particularly Transfer Pricing provisions. Required Skills and Qualifications – 12-14 years of overall experience, including 5+ years in a direct leadership capacity within an accounting, auditing, or finance function. Bachelor's degree in Accounting; CA, CWA, or CPA qualification. Advanced spreadsheet skills able to turn large amounts of data into simple, workable processes with built-in sense checks. Familiarity with JD Edwards or similar ERP systems, with a proven ability to learn new systems quickly. Brings a flexible, positive attitude and energy to the team. Strong financial qualifications and demonstrable knowledge of the regulatory environment in India. Comfortable diving into the details to solve complex issues, while still seeing the bigger picture. Able to provide clear, fact-based analysis to support a recommended course of action. A natural leader and team player who holds the team to high standards. Combines empathy with assertiveness and strong influencing skills. Excellent attention to detail; tenacious and methodical. Committed to continuous improvement - always looking for a better way of doing things. Why Trek? title: IT Service Delivery Manager (Looking For Immediate Joiner)
description:
The IT Service Delivery Manager is a senior leadership role responsible for the end-to-end delivery and performance of IT Service Desk outsourcing engagements across global regions. Operating at the intersection of client service excellence and operational execution, this individual leads multidisciplinary teams distributed across geographic time zones ensuring continuous 24x7 service delivery in full compliance with contractual Service Level Agreements (SLAs). A critical dimension of this role is the ability to bridge communication between U.S.-based solution strategy, architecture, and client relationship teams and the delivery workforce based in India. The ideal candidate brings deep familiarity with how U.S. enterprise clients communicate, escalate, and define success and is skilled at translating that context into actionable guidance for in-country delivery teams. 
 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 
 Service Delivery & SLA Governance Own end-to-end delivery accountability for IT Service Desk outsourcing engagements, ensuring all contractual SLA and KPI targets are consistently met or exceeded. Lead the operational cadence across 24x7 global shifts, including escalation protocols, incident response, and service continuity planning. Drive continuous improvement initiatives analyzing ticket trends, CSAT data, and operational metrics to optimize team performance and reduce service failure risk. Oversee SLA reporting, monthly/quarterly business reviews, and executive-level client communications related to performance and outcomes. 
 Team Leadership & Global Operations Directly manage and mentor Service Desk Team Leads and shift supervisors across global locations, building a high-performance delivery culture. Serve as the operating authority across geographically distributed teams in India, ensuring seamless shift handoffs, knowledge transfer, and consistent quality standards. Define workforce planning strategies — including headcount modeling, scheduling, and cross-training — to maintain coverage across all contracted service windows. Lead talent development, performance management, and succession planning for delivery staff at all levels. 
 U.S. Client Interface & Communication Translation Act as the primary operational liaison between U.S.-based client stakeholders, solution architects, and strategy teams — and the India-based delivery organization. Interpret and translate U.S. client communication styles, escalation sensitivities, and cultural expectations into clear, actionable direction for local delivery teams. Participate in U.S. client-facing meetings, including kick-off sessions, service reviews, escalation calls, and contract renewals, representing the global delivery organization. Proactively identify gaps in client understanding or expectation alignment and implement communication strategies to close them. 
 Outsourcing Contract & Stakeholder Management Develop deep fluency in all active outsourcing contracts — understanding scope, SLA structures, penalty clauses, exclusions, and change management terms. Collaborate with sales, pre-sales, and solution teams in the U.S. during the pursuit and transition phases of new engagements. Manage risk escalations and governance processes with both the client and internal leadership, maintaining trust and transparency at all stakeholder levels. Support pricing, scope changes, and renewal discussions by providing delivery data, trend analysis, and operational insight. 
 REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS 
 Experience & Background Minimum 15 years of progressive experience in the IT industry, with the majority in IT consulting, managed services, or IT systems integration environments. Demonstrated career progression from IT Service Desk Team Lead to Service Delivery Manager in an outsourcing context — with verifiable team lead tenure. Hands-on experience managing large-scale, global 24x7 IT Service Desk engagements with resources distributed across multiple geographies. Proven experience delivering against complex, multi-tiered outsourcing SLAs in enterprise-class client environments. 
 Technical & Domain Knowledge Senior-level proficiency in ITSM frameworks including ITIL — particularly Incident, Problem, Change, and Service Level Management. Deep familiarity with Service Desk tooling platforms (e.g., ServiceNow, BMC Remedy, Jira Service Management) and workforce management systems. Strong command of outsourcing SLA structures — including design, measurement, reporting, and contractual interpretation. Experience with service transition and transformation — including knowledge of onboarding clients, building runbooks, and managing go-live risk. 
 Leadership & Communication Exceptional ability to lead, influence, and develop geographically dispersed, multidisciplinary teams without direct co-location. Demonstrated cultural intelligence and communication adaptability — specifically in bridging U.S. enterprise client expectations with India-based delivery execution. Executive presence with the ability to present to and engage with senior stakeholders on both the client and internal sides. Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, with experience in formal client reporting, RCA documentation, and executive briefings. 

 PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS ITIL v4 Foundation certification or higher; PMP or PRINCE2 a strong plus. Experience working directly with IT consulting firms, IT staffing integrators, or systems integrators in a multi-client delivery capacity. Familiarity with pre-sales processes — including supporting solutioning, contributing to proposals, or participating in client discovery sessions. Prior experience in a role that required frequent collaboration with U.S.-based or globally distributed solution strategy and architecture functions. Exposure to AI-augmented service desk tools, automation platforms (e.g., RPA), or shift-left / self-service strategies. 
 SUCCESS PROFILE — WHAT SETS THE BEST APART The ideal candidate is not simply an operations manager — they are a cross-cultural leader who understands that the distance between a client in the U.S. and a delivery team in India is not just geographic. It is contextual, communicative, and cultural. The best candidates will demonstrate: A track record of building delivery teams that consistently beat SLA targets while maintaining high CSAT scores. The ability to walk into a U.S. client QBR and earn credibility with C-suite stakeholders — then turn around and coach an India-based team lead on how to interpret and act on that feedback. An instinct for risk — knowing when to escalate, when to problem-solve quietly, and when to bring leadership in. A continuous improvement mindset backed by operational data — not intuition alone.

title: Assistant Manager / Deputy Manager - Pricing IQ/0170
description:
Assistant Manager / Deputy Manager - Pricing IQ/0170 JOB DESCRIPTION 
Assistant Manager / Deputy Manager Pricing 
Division 
Department 
Reporting To 
Location 
: Freight Forwarding Pricing 
: Sales Support 
: Regional Sales Manager 
: Chennai 
_______________________________________________________________ ___________________ 
 1. Job Purpose 
To manage and coordinate the pricing function for the freight forwarding business by obtaining 
competitive freight rates from shipping lines, airlines, overseas agents, transporters, CFS/ICD operators 
and other service providers, preparing accurate and commercially viable quotations, maintaining rate 
databases, and supporting the Sales and Operations teams in securing profitable business. 
2 . Key Responsibilities 
A. Pricing & Quotation Management 
• Receive pricing requirements from Sales, Customer Service and Operations teams and 
provide timely quotations. 
• Prepare competitive rates for Sea Freight Export/Import, Air Freight, LCL/FCL, C&F and 
related logistics services, as applicable. 
• Obtain and compare rates from shipping lines, NVOCCs, airlines, overseas agents, 
transporters, CFS/ICD and other vendors. 
• Ensure all applicable origin, destination, documentation, handling, THC, CFS, 
transportation, customs and other charges are correctly considered. 
• Calculate total landed/logistics cost and determine appropriate selling rates and margins. 
• Ensure quotations clearly specify validity, free days, inclusions/exclusions, surcharges, 
payment terms and other conditions. 
• Handle urgent and special pricing requirements from key customers and Sales teams. 
B. Carrier / Vendor Rate Management 
• Maintain updated buying rates from shipping lines, airlines, overseas agents and logistics 
vendors. 
• Negotiate with carriers and vendors to obtain competitive rates and better commercial 
terms. 
• Monitor changes in freight rates, surcharges, bunker/war-risk/peak-season charges and 
other market factors. 
• Compare vendor rates periodically and identify opportunities for cost reduction. 
• Ensure expired or revised rates are promptly updated in the pricing system/database. 
C. Sales Support 
• Provide pricing support to the Sales team for new customer acquisition, tenders and RFQs. 
• Assist Sales in developing customer-specific pricing strategies. 
• Support preparation of annual/periodical rate contracts and customer rate agreements. 
• Analyse competitor/market rates wherever information is available. 
• Participate in pricing discussions with customers, agents and Sales teams when required. 
• Ensure commercially attractive rates are offered without compromising required margins. 
D. RFQ / Tender Management 
• Coordinate pricing for customer RFQs, tenders and rate enquiries. 
• Collect rates from all relevant service providers within the required timeline. 
• Prepare rate comparison statements and pricing models. 
• Ensure accuracy and completeness of tender submissions. 
• Maintain records of submitted quotations and tender results for future reference. 
E. Margin & Commercial Control 
• Ensure minimum approved margins are maintained in all quotations. 
• Identify low-margin or loss-making quotations and obtain appropriate approval before 
submission. 
• Analyse the profitability of major customers, trade lanes and shipment categories. 
• Highlight significant variations between buying and selling rates to the reporting manager. 
• Work with Finance, Sales and Operations to resolve pricing-related revenue leakage. 
F. Coordination with Operations 
• Ensure the rates quoted to customers are practically executable by Operations. 
• Coordinate with Operations regarding additional charges, free time, routing, transit time and 
service availability. 
• Clarify any discrepancy between quoted rates and actual vendor/carrier invoices. 
• Support Operations in resolving rate-related disputes with vendors and customers. 
G. Rate Database & Documentation 
• Maintain an updated database of: 
o Shipping line rates 
o Air freight rates 
o Overseas agent rates 
o Transport rates 
o CFS/ICD charges 
o Port-related charges 
o Documentation charges 
o Customs/C&F-related charges 
o Other applicable logistics charges 
• Ensure proper documentation and approval of special rates. 
• Maintain historical rate records for comparison and analysis. 
H. Market Intelligence 
• Monitor freight market movements, capacity constraints, blank sailings, seasonal 
fluctuations and major surcharge changes. 
• Keep the management and Sales team informed about significant market rate movements. 
• Identify favourable buying opportunities and alternative carriers/service providers. 
I. Team Coordination & Supervision 
• Guide and monitor Executives/Senior Executives in the Pricing function. 
• Allocate pricing enquiries and monitor turnaround time. 
• Check important quotations prepared by team members before submission where required. 
• Train junior team members on pricing procedures, rate structures and commercial practices. 
• Ensure adherence to Company pricing policies and approval procedures. 
J. MIS & Reporting 
• Submit regular reports on: 
o Quotations handled 
o RFQs/tenders submitted 
o Conversion status 
o Buying-rate movements 
o Selling-rate movements 
o Gross margin 
o Major customer quotations 
o Special-rate approvals 
o Pending pricing enquiries 
• Provide pricing-related information required by Management, Sales and Finance. 
 3. Authority & Accountability 
• Recommend buying and selling rates within the Company's approved pricing guidelines. 
• Negotiate rates with carriers, vendors and agents within delegated authority. 
• Escalate rates falling below approved margins for management approval. 
• Recommend alternative carriers/vendors where commercially advantageous. 
• Maintain confidentiality of customer-specific rates, vendor rates and commercial 
information. 
 4. Key Performance Areas 
• Pricing turnaround time 
• Quotation accuracy 
• Quotation-to-business conversion 
• Gross margin achievement 
• Competitive buying rates 
• Rate database accuracy and updating 
• RFQ/tender response within deadlines 
• Reduction of pricing errors and revenue leakage 
• Vendor/carrier negotiation effectiveness 
• Internal customer satisfaction Sales & Operations 
5. Qualifications 
• Graduate in any discipline; preferably MBA/PG Diploma in Logistics, Supply Chain, 
International Business or Marketing. 
• Professional qualification/certification in Freight Forwarding, Shipping or Logistics will be an 
advantage. 
6. Experience 
• Assistant Manager: Preferably 47 years of relevant experience in freight 
forwarding/shipping/logistics, with substantial experience in pricing. 
• Deputy Manager: Preferably 69 years of relevant experience, including responsibility for 
pricing, rate negotiation and team coordination. 
• Candidates with strong experience in Sea Freight/Air Freight pricing and RFQ management 
will be preferred. 
 7. Essential Skills & Competencies 
• Strong knowledge of freight forwarding pricing and tariff structures. 
• Good understanding of FCL, LCL, Air Freight, Import and Export processes. 
• Excellent negotiation skills. 
• Strong commercial and analytical ability. 
• Good knowledge of freight surcharges and local charges. 
• Ability to calculate cost, selling rate and gross margin accurately. 
• Strong Excel and MIS skills. 
• Good communication and coordination skills. 
• Ability to work under pressure and meet tight quotation deadlines. 
• Attention to detail and accuracy. 
• Customer-oriented and commercially conscious approach. 
• Ability to lead and guide junior pricing personnel. 
 9. Key Interfaces 
Internal: Sales, Operations, Documentation, Customer Service, Finance, Branch Offices and Business 
Heads. 
External: Shipping Lines, Airlines, NVOCCs, Overseas Agents, Transporters, CFS/ICD Operators, 
Customs Brokers and other logistics service providers. 
 10. Overall Responsibility 
The Assistant Manager/Deputy Manager Pricing is responsible for ensuring that the Company buys 
freight and logistics services competitively, quotes customers accurately and promptly, protects the 
required gross margin, and provides effective commercial support to the Sales and Operations 
functions. 
******************* Responsibilities 
- Manage and coordinate the pricing function for the freight forwarding business.
- Prepare competitive rates for Sea Freight – Export/Import, Air Freight, LCL/FCL, C&F.
- Obtain and compare rates from various vendors.
- Provide pricing support to the Sales team for new customer acquisition, tenders, and RFQs.
- Maintain updated buying rates from shipping lines and logistics vendors.
- Coordinate pricing for customer RFQs, tenders, and rate enquiries.
- Ensure minimum approved margins are maintained in all quotations.
- Monitor changes in freight rates and market factors.
- Maintain an updated database of shipping line and freight rates.
- Submit regular reports on quotations and pricing-related information. 
 Qualification Criteria Graduate in any discipline; preferably MBA/PG Diploma in Logistics, Supply Chain, International Business or Marketing. Professional qualification/certification in Freight Forwarding, Shipping or Logistics will be an advantage.

description:

Key Responsibilities: Establishes lean/agile leadership, supports the Product Owner, and promotes quality practices; Skilled at Scrum practices of estimation and prioritization using agile techniques. Guides and coaches team members on agile practices provides developmental feedback to team members using a servant leadership style and leading by example. Fosters an environment of mutual respect and cooperation, transparency, and autonomy; facilitates getting the work done without coercion, assigning, or dictating the work. Drives adoption of agile reducing the gap between agile theory and practice; drives continuous improvement. Establishes key metrics and monitors agile metrics that impact value driven delivery and indicate potential problems; Ensures all solution documentation is complete (Definition of Done). Establishes and communicates team progress and goals using program boards, burn-up, burn-down or other methods. Supports team rules and norms and protects the team from outside interference; removes impediments for the team or finds the right personnel to remove impediments. Maintain strong relationships to deliver business value using relevant Business Relationship Management practices. Required Qualifications

 - Experience supporting Data, Analytics, BI, or Digital Transformation initiatives. 
 - Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.

 - Supply Chain Analytics domain experience. 
 - Experience with Jira, Confluence or similar Agile tools. 
 - Good to have knowledge of Power BI, Snowflake, Data Warehousing, or Analytics platforms. 
 - Experience with vendor and supplier management. 
 - Exposure to budgeting, resource forecasting, and delivery governance. 
 - Project Management experience in complex enterprise environments.

 Competencies: 
 Business insight - Applying knowledge of business and the marketplace to advance the organization s goals. 
 
 Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences. 
 
 Global perspective - Taking a broad view when approaching issues, using a global lens. 
 
 Manages conflict - Handling conflict situations effectively, with a minimum of noise. 
 
 Agile Systems Thinking - Embraces a holistic approach to analysis that focuses on the way that a systems constituent parts interrelate and how systems work over time and within the context of larger systems to ensure the economic success of the solution. 
 
 Building High Performance Teams - Identifies and applies critical skills and Lean-Agile principles and practices in the creation of high-performing Agile teams to construct high-quality, well designed technical solutions. 
 
 Continuous Delivery Pipeline - Implements the workflows, activities, and automation by providing the enterprise with the capability to shepherd a new piece of functionality all the way from ideation to an on-demand release of value to the end user. 
 
 DevOps and Release on Demand - Implements DevOps and a continuous delivery pipeline by providing the enterprise with the capability to release value, in whole or in part, at any time necessary to meet market and customer demand. 
 
 Lean Agile and SAFe Mindset - Advocates for and leads others in the concepts of the Agile Manifesto and Lean thinking in support of adopting and applying the 9 SAFe principles and practices for the organization.

 Release Planning - Plans and manages the release of capabilities, features or products using inputs from the prioritized roadmap, planning, available resources and skills to communicate expected availability and releases of capability. 
 
 Project Management - Establishes and maintains the balance of scope, schedule and resources for a temporary effort (a project ). Ensures results/impact from temporary effort are fully realized as possible. 
 
 Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Agile Certification (Certified Scrum Master - CSM), Professional Scrum Master (PSM) or Safe Scrum Master Certification (SSM) are preferred. This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Job Summary Job Type Permanent Job Description Title Senior Manager, Internal Audit Department Internal Audit Location India, Gurgaon Reports To Associate Director Level Level 6 About your team FIL Internal Audit is an independent Group function that reports directly to the Chief Executive Officer of Fidelity International and to the Group Audit and Risk Committee. Our mandate is to examine and critically evaluate the effectiveness of the Company''s internal controls and governance systems, as well as the adequacy of, and compliance with, regulatory obligations, internal strategies, policies, processes and reporting procedures. In addition, we help management and the Board to fulfil their oversight responsibilities through effective challenge to help them identify, assess and commercially manage the Company''s risk. Using a risk-based methodology, our audit plan is developed in consultation with FIL management to include audits of specific business areas as well as thematic and emerging risks through participation in new initiatives and systems developments. We are a global team with our people working from our offices the UK, Luxembourg, Germany, India, Singapore, China, and Japan. About your role The role of the Senior Manager in the Technology Internal Audit Corporate Enablers (CE) team is a critical role, to assist the Head of Audit CE in setting strategy for appropriate audit coverage of CE systems. Your role will include managing key stakeholder relationships for a portfolio of business units, ongoing business monitoring with updates to the risk assessment of the CE audit universe and leading the delivery of a suite of audit assignments across CE to verify that the business operations are effectively controlled and that risks are appropriately mitigated. Using your knowledge of the CE business, you will be required to lead audit projects, responsible for the planning and execution of audit assignments in line with the FIL audit methodology, completion of work paper reviews to ensure appropriate coverage and quality, producing audit findings and draft reports for presentation to senior management, validation of open issues when management has advised the risk is remediated and representation of the function at various governance forums as required. The role focuses on technology risk areas including IT General Controls, application controls, infrastructure, information security, data, and technology resilience About you You will have a minimum of 8 years of direct Technology audit experience covering the full audit lifecycle including planning, fieldwork, reporting, and issue validation. You will have a strong working knowledge of technology risks and controls, including IT General Controls (ITGCs) access management, change management, and IT operations You will have a strong working knowledge of technology risks and controls, including Application controls, interfaces, and batch processing You will have a strong working knowledge of technology risks and controls, including Infrastructure and platform controls, including cloud environments where relevant You will have a strong working knowledge of technology risks and controls, including Information and data security, including identity and access management and cyber risk You will have a strong working knowledge of technology risks and controls, including Technology resilience and thirdparty technology risk You will have a strong academic background and ideally hold a relevant professional qualification, such as CISA (preferred), CIA, ACA, ACCA, CPA, CIMA, or equivalent. Other relevant qualifications (e.g. CISSP) considered an advantage. You will be an effective communicator, able to present complex technical matters clearly and concisely to both technical and nontechnical stakeholders. You will be a collaborative and accountable team player, able to build effective working relationships with Technology teams and wider stakeholders. You will be curious and proactive, with an interest in emerging technologies and evolving technology risks. You will be a proficient user of Microsoft Office and ideally have experience using data analytics or audit tools to support audit testing and insight.

title: Customer Success & Onboarding Executive
description:
Job Summary The Customer Success Onboarding Executive will own the customer journey from the initial post-sale handover through successful implementation, activation and early adoption. The person will coordinate customer and internal actions, deliver product training, ensure customers achieve measurable value, and identify relevant opportunities to adopt additional features or plans. This is not pure support, chat-support or aggressive sales role. It requires consultative communication, structured follow-up, product understanding, commercial awareness and end-to-end accountability for onboarding outcomes. Responsibilities Onboarding Ownership: Own assigned customers from sales handover until onboarding completion and transition to ongoing customer success or support. Conduct structured kickoff calls to understand the customers business model, platforms, fulfillment workflow, use cases, expected outcomes and launch timeline. Prepare and maintain a clear onboarding plan with milestones, owners, dependencies, target dates, risks and next actions. Guide customers through account setup, platform connections, configuration, product mapping, testing and go-live readiness. Coordinate dependencies involving the customer, support, product, engineering, QA, operations and sales teams. Ensure the customer reaches an agreed activation milestone, such as a successful first order, inventory sync or completed production workflow. Prevent onboarding from becoming inactive by following up consistently and escalating genuine blockers. Product Training and Adoption: Conduct product demonstrations and role-based training sessions for customer stakeholders. Explain workflows in simple business language while remaining accurate about system behaviour and limitations. Recommend configurations and features based on the customers operating model rather than giving generic demonstrations. Create or improve onboarding checklists, training material, help articles, call summaries and reusable templates. Monitor whether customers are using the capabilities required to achieve their intended outcome. Identify adoption risks and conduct follow-up sessions where customers need additional guidance. Consultative Upselling and Expansion: Identify additional WebBee features, modules, integrations or plans that solve a genuine customer requirement discovered during onboarding. Explain the business value, use case and expected impact of relevant features. Qualify the opportunity by confirming need, stakeholders, timing and expected outcome. Coordinate with sales or the commercial owner for pricing, proposals and closure when required. Maintain accurate notes and opportunity status in the relevant CRM or tracking system. Avoid forced selling; recommendations must be relevant, transparent and aligned with customer success. Customer Communication and Relationship Management: Act as the primary onboarding contact and maintain professional, proactive communication. Send clear meeting summaries containing decisions, owners, deadlines, risks and next steps. Manage customer expectations regarding scope, timelines, dependencies and product limitations. Handle objections and delays calmly while keeping the onboarding plan moving. Coordinate handovers to support or the ongoing customer success owner with complete context and documentation. Capture customer feedback and communicate recurring product or process gaps internally. Issue Triage and Internal Coordination: Perform first-level analysis when onboarding is blocked and gather screenshots, examples, order identifiers, configuration details and relevant context. Distinguish between missing customer action, configuration gaps, training needs, product defects and enhancement requests. Create clear internal tickets or tasks when another teams involvement is required. Follow up on internal commitments and communicate realistic status to customers. Do not promise product changes, delivery dates or technical outcomes without internal confirmation. Metrics and Process Improvement: Maintain accurate onboarding status, milestone dates, risks, customer health and expansion notes. Track time to kickoff, time to activation, onboarding completion, feature adoption, delays and reasons for non-completion. Identify recurring onboarding friction and recommend improvements to product, documentation, training or internal processes. Participate in weekly onboarding reviews and highlight customers requiring decisions or escalation. Contribute to scalable onboarding playbooks and standard operating procedures. Requirements Required Skills and Experience Approximately three years of experience in SaaS customer onboarding, customer success, implementation, account management or a related customer-facing role. Experience conducting online product demonstrations, discovery sessions and customer training. Strong spoken and written English, including professional email and meeting communication. Ability to understand software workflows, integrations and configuration dependencies. Experience coordinating multiple customers, tasks and stakeholders with clear follow-up. Ability to understand business needs and recommend suitable product capabilities. Comfort discussing upgrades, feature value and expansion opportunities in a consultative manner. Strong ownership, organization, documentation and problem-solving skills. Willingness to work full-time from the Noida office. Preferred Skills Experience with e-commerce, fulfillment, ERP, marketplace or integration products. Exposure to Shopify, Amazon, TikTok Shop, NetSuite, WooCommerce or similar platforms. Understanding of APIs, webhooks, credentials, data synchronization and common integration failures at a functional level. Experience with Zoho CRM, Zoho Desk, Zoho Projects or similar CRM, support and task-management tools. Experience working with international customers in US, UK, Europe or Australia. Experience achieving onboarding, adoption, retention or expansion targets. Basic ability to review logs, JSON/API errors or technical evidence is advantageous but not mandatory. Job Type Full time Location Noida, Uttar Pradesh, India
