title: Senior Penetration Testing Analyst 1
description:
Role Summary Sophos is seeking an experienced and motivated Senior Penetration Testing Analyst 1 to join our Red Team. The Sophos Red Team is engaged by organizations worldwide to identify and exploit vulnerabilities within client environments, applying information security threat intelligence to uncover the same weaknesses real-world adversaries would target. As a Senior Penetration Testing Analyst 1, you will act as the point of contact for testing readiness, coordinating tasks, timelines, and communication between business, client, and project teams. Responsible for escalating issues to management and taking ownership of new challenges to add value. In addition to test readiness support, the position will focus on either application security (web application penetration testing, mobile, API testing) or network security (vulnerability assessments, external penetration tests, internal penetration tests, etc.), using both off-the-shelf and internally developed tools to execute manual testing for advanced attacks. Candidates are not expected to be experienced in both focus areas, although that would be a plus. In this role, you will be responsible for test readiness activities to ensure engagements are ready to begin by troubleshooting client readiness problems, communicating with clients and tracking readiness status, and producing professional security assessment reports detailing vulnerability and exploit information for clients. This position will lead client-facing calls throughout each engagement, from test readiness and troubleshooting, project kick-off through notification of high and critical findings to a close-out review of test findings, evidence, process steps to reproduce, and remediation recommendations. The ideal candidate for this role will bring strong technical communication skills, sound analytical and problem-solving abilities, and a proactive approach to researching new threats, vulnerabilities, and exploits. You will excel as both a self-directed individual contributor and as a member of a larger team, performing other essential duties as assigned. What you will do This is a remote position with potential travel up to 10% Coordinate activities, documentation, readiness schedules, and information between business, clients, and project teams. description:
Job Title: Sr. ITSM Process Lead ServiceNow 
 Employment Type: Full-Time
 Work Location: Chennai Onsite
 Experience: 10+ Years
About the Role
We are looking for a highly experienced Sr. ITSM Process Lead with strong expertise in ServiceNow ITSM, ITAM, and ITOM to lead the design, standardization, and deployment of enterprise IT service management processes on the ServiceNow platform.
The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in ITSM process transformation, ITIL practices, and ServiceNow , with the ability to assess the current operating model, define the target-state processes, and translate them into scalable ServiceNow solutions.
This role will act as the process SME and bridge between business stakeholders, IT leadership, process owners, and ServiceNow technical teams , ensuring that processes are designed around business outcomes, industry best practices, and ServiceNow capabilities.
Key Responsibilities
 Lead the end-to-end design and transformation of ITSM processes and their implementation within ServiceNow. Assess current processes, identify gaps and inefficiencies, and define standardized target-state processes . Define process frameworks, workflows, roles and responsibilities, governance, controls, SLAs, KPIs, and operating models. Drive the adoption of industry best practices and ServiceNow out-of-the-box capabilities , minimizing unnecessary customization. Provide functional leadership across ServiceNow ITSM, ITAM, ITOM, CMDB, and Discovery capabilities. Ensure effective integration and alignment between ITSM, ITAM, ITOM, CMDB, and related ServiceNow capabilities. Lead process discovery and design workshops with business and IT stakeholders. Translate business requirements and process designs into ServiceNow functional requirements, workflows, user stories, and acceptance criteria . Partner with ServiceNow architects, developers, administrators, and implementation partners to ensure the platform solution accurately reflects the intended process design. Establish and maintain process governance, ownership, RACI, performance metrics, and continuous improvement frameworks . Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, automate, and improve IT service management processes. Provide strategic guidance on how ServiceNow capabilities can be leveraged to improve operational efficiency, service quality, and user experience. Support solution validation, testing, implementation, adoption, and continuous improvement activities. Work closely with senior stakeholders to drive decisions, resolve process conflicts, and establish enterprise-wide standards. Define and execute a roadmap to improve ITSM process maturity and ServiceNow adoption across the organization. Required Qualifications
 10+ years of experience in ITSM, IT service management, process transformation, or a related discipline. Strong and proven expertise in ServiceNow , particularly across ITSM, ITAM, and ITOM . Extensive experience in designing, transforming, and implementing enterprise ITSM processes. Strong understanding of ITIL principles and IT service management best practices . Proven experience defining AS-IS and TO-BE processes and driving process standardization. Strong understanding of ServiceNow platform capabilities and how to translate business processes into effective ServiceNow solutions. Experience working closely with ServiceNow architects, developers, administrators, and implementation partners . Strong knowledge of CMDB, Configuration Management, Discovery, and IT asset lifecycle concepts. Ability to evaluate business requirements and determine the appropriate balance between process change, ServiceNow configuration, automation, and customization . Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence senior IT and business stakeholders. Excellent workshop facilitation, process mapping, analytical, and problem-solving skills. Demonstrated ability to lead process transformation initiatives in complex enterprise environments. Preferred Qualifications
 ITIL 4 Foundation certification; advanced ITIL certification is a plus. ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) . ServiceNow certifications in ITSM, ITOM, or IT Asset Management . Experience leading large-scale ServiceNow transformation or implementation programs . Strong experience with CMDB, Discovery, Service Mapping, Event Management, and Asset Management. Experience establishing enterprise-level ITSM process governance and operating models . Experience with process maturity assessments, continual improvement, and automation initiatives. PMP, PRINCE2, or other relevant project/transformation certification is a plus.

title: Product Owner
description:
Role & responsibilities 
 Job Description: Product Owner Insurance Domain Position Summary We are seeking an experienced Product Owner with 6+ years of overall experience, including strong exposure to the insurance domain and Agile product delivery. The Product Owner will be responsible for translating business needs into clear product requirements, managing and prioritizing the product backlog, and working closely with business stakeholders, architects, engineering, quality assurance, and implementation teams to deliver high-quality insurance solutions. The ideal candidate should have a sound understanding of insurance products, rating processes, policy administration, underwriting, and product configuration. Experience with Ratabase will be an added advantage. Key Responsibilities Own and manage the product backlog in alignment with the product vision, roadmap, client priorities, and business objectives. Work with insurance business stakeholders, subject-matter experts, clients, and internal teams to gather, analyze, and document requirements. Convert business requirements into clear and actionable: Epics Features User stories Acceptance criteria Business rules Process flows Prioritize backlog items based on business value, client impact, risk, dependencies, regulatory requirements, and delivery capacity. Ensure user stories are sufficiently refined and ready for sprint planning and development. Collaborate with engineering, architecture, UX, quality assurance, infrastructure, and implementation teams throughout the product development lifecycle. Participate in Agile ceremonies, including: Backlog refinement Sprint planning Daily stand-ups Sprint reviews and demonstrations Retrospectives Program Increment planning, where applicable Clarify functional requirements and provide timely decisions to development and testing teams. Define acceptance criteria and review completed features to ensure they meet business and functional expectations. Support functional testing, defect triage, user acceptance testing, release readiness, and production implementation activities. Evaluate defects and enhancement requests based on severity, business impact, and product strategy. Maintain product documentation, requirement traceability, release scope, and stakeholder communication. Identify dependencies, risks, assumptions, and gaps early in the delivery lifecycle and drive them to resolution. Monitor product adoption, quality, client feedback, and delivery outcomes to support continuous improvement. Contribute to product roadmap planning and provide inputs for effort estimation, release planning, and prioritization. Ensure delivered functionality complies with insurance business rules, audit requirements, security standards, and applicable regulations. Stay informed about insurance industry trends, digital transformation, automation, and emerging technologies. Required Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, Insurance, or a related field. 6+ years of overall experience in business analysis, product ownership, product management, or software delivery. At least 3 years of experience working as a Product Owner, Business Analyst, or equivalent role in an Agile software-development environment. Strong experience in the insurance domain, preferably Property and Casualty insurance. Good understanding of one or more of the following: Insurance product configuration Rating and premium calculation Underwriting rules Policy lifecycle Quotes, endorsements, renewals, cancellations, and reinstatements Forms and filings Rules, rates, factors, tables, and formulas Policy administration systems Experience creating and managing epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and product backlogs. Strong knowledge of Agile and Scrum methodologies. Experience using tools such as Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, or equivalent product-management platforms. Ability to understand technical concepts, APIs, databases, integrations, application workflows, and non-functional requirements. Strong analytical, problem-solving, decision-making, and prioritization skills. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Ability to work effectively with distributed and cross-functional teams. Strong stakeholder-management and client-facing capabilities. Preferred Qualifications Experience with commercial insurance or personal-lines products such as: Personal Auto Commercial Auto General Liability Workers’ Compensation Businessowners Policy Property Inland Marine Umbrella or Excess Liability Experience working with insurance policy-administration or rating platforms. Exposure to Guidewire, Duck Creek, Majesco, or similar insurance technology platforms. Experience supporting client implementations, migrations, upgrades, or production releases. Knowledge of insurance regulatory and bureau filings, including ISO, NCCI, or state-specific requirements. Product Owner or Agile certifications such as: Certified Scrum Product Owner SAFe Product Owner/Product Manager PMI Agile Certified Practitioner Exposure to AI-assisted product delivery, requirements analysis, automation, or software-development tools. Key Competencies Product vision and ownership Insurance-domain expertise Business and systems analysis Backlog management and prioritization Requirements elicitation and documentation Stakeholder and client management Agile product delivery Decision-making and problem-solving Cross-functional collaboration Release and dependency management Quality and client-outcome focus Preferred candidate profile

title: Project Manager, PDS Projects
description:
Job Summary 
 Role Purpose: Lead the end-to-end delivery of assigned capital projects, ensuring compliance with approved scope, schedule, budget, quality, safety and commercial requirements. The role supports the Client Project Executive and India PDS Director, serves as the primary client contact, manages the regional capital budget, and coordinates all internal and external project stakeholders. 
 
 Location 
 Bengaluru, KA 
 
 Reporting To 
 India Project Director - PDS and Client Project Executive 
 
 Preferred Background 
 MEP, with capability to manage CI projects 
 
 Project Exposure 
 Corporate interior fit-outs, Minor and Major Refurbishments, Retrofits 
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Own project delivery from initiation, planning and design through procurement, construction, commissioning, handover and closeout. Establish project objectives, execution plans, governance, roles, reporting lines, communication protocols, milestones and working procedures. Lead project meetings, track decisions and actions, manage priorities across multiple initiatives, and provide direction and coaching to project team members. Act as the single point of contact for the client and understand business objectives, requirements, constraints and expectations. Build effective relationships with senior leaders, consultants, architects, engineers, contractors, vendors and internal teams. Maintain stakeholder alignment, communicate project status clearly, and escalate critical issues with practical recommendations and resolution plans. Develop and maintain project schedules, milestone plans, procurement programmes and resource plans; monitor critical paths, approvals, long-lead items and material deliveries. Coordinate and review drawings, specifications and technical submissions for completeness, coordination, constructability and compliance; resolve design gaps and support value engineering. Manage pre-construction activities, tender documentation, bid evaluation, vendor selection, statutory approvals, permits and inspections. Administer consultant, contractor and vendor contracts, including obligations, notices, claims, variations, extensions of time, change orders and performance reviews. Manage budgets, cost plans, commitments, expenditures, accruals, invoices, forecasts, cash flows, payment cycles and revenue tracking in JLL and client systems. Prepare cost and variance reports, identify potential overruns, certify bills against verified progress, resolve financial discrepancies, and complete final reconciliation at closeout. Monitor construction through site visits, inspections, progress reviews and coordination meetings; verify compliance with approved drawings, specifications and contractual requirements. Coordinate site activities across design, procurement, construction and commissioning teams while monitoring workmanship, material quality, productivity and resource deployment. Implement QA/QC and health, safety, environmental and statutory controls; track observations, non-conformances, defects and corrective actions through closure. Maintain risk and issue registers, assign owners, develop mitigation and recovery plans, monitor residual exposure and escalate high-impact matters promptly. Prepare accurate daily, weekly and monthly reports covering progress, milestones, cost, cash flow, procurement, quality, safety, risks, issues and upcoming priorities. Maintain reliable project data in AdaptiveWork and other systems, including workplans, budgets, risks, actions, decisions, changes, approvals and meeting minutes. Maintain complete and auditable project records, including contracts, drawings, specifications, permits, correspondence, reports, checklists and approvals. Plan and coordinate testing, commissioning, inspections, snagging, final acceptance and closure of all outstanding works. Manage submission and approval of as-built drawings, OM manuals, warranties, test certificates, training records, completion certificates and statutory documentation. Support final account settlement, financial reconciliation, contract closure, lessons learned and a structured transition to the client or operations team. 
 
 Required Qualifications and Experience 
 Graduate degree in Civil, Electrical or Mechanical Engineering, Architecture (B.Arch.), or a related discipline. 9-12 years of relevant experience in project management or project management consultancy, with strong end-to-end delivery experience. Experience in corporate interior fit-outs, commercial buildings or capital works; MEP experience is preferred, with the ability to manage CI projects. Demonstrated capability in planning, design coordination, procurement, tendering, contract administration, construction monitoring, cost control, risk management and closeout. Experience managing multiple projects, budgets, cash flows, invoices, commitments, consultants, contractors, subcontractors and vendors. Working knowledge of AdaptiveWork or comparable project management platforms, project reporting portals and Microsoft Office. 
 
 Core Competencies 
 Client Focus and Ownership: Prioritises client outcomes while protecting commercial and organisational interests. Communication and Influence: Communicates complex matters clearly and engages confidently with senior stakeholders. Planning and Organisation: Applies a structured, detail-oriented approach and manages competing priorities effectively. Leadership and Collaboration: Builds trust, promotes accountability, and mentors team members to achieve shared goals. Judgement and Problem Solving: Makes sound decisions, anticipates risks, and develops practical solutions under pressure. Adaptability and Initiative: Learns quickly and performs effectively in dynamic, ambiguous and deadline-driven environments. 
 
 Location 
 On-site Bengaluru, KA 
 
 Scheduled Weekly Hours 
 48

description:

nephroplus 
 Staff Nurse Graduate Trainee (Freshers) 
 Campus Recruitment Drive 2026 | Locations Across India 
 About NephroPlus 
 NephroPlus is India's largest network of dialysis centers, providing high-quality, affordable kidney care to patients 
 across the country. With a strong presence across states and a mission to make world-class kidney care accessible, 
 NephroPlus combines clinical excellence with compassionate patient care. We invest heavily in training our clinical 
 teams, and our Staff Nurse program is designed specifically to help nursing graduates build a specialized, rewarding 
 career in nephrology and critical care nursing even with no prior dialysis experience. 
 Role Overview 
 As a Staff Nurse (Graduate Trainee) at NephroPlus, you will be the primary caregiver for patients undergoing dialysis 
 treatment. You will work under the guidance of the Unit In-Charge and Senior Therapist, receiving structured, hands- 
 on training in dialysis science, machine operation, water treatment monitoring, and direct patient care. This is an 
 excellent opportunity for freshers to specialize early in a high-demand clinical field, with clear pathways to grow into 
 Senior Staff Nurse, Sr. Therapist, and Unit In-Charge roles. 
 Why Join NephroPlus 
 No prior dialysis experience required complete, structured induction training provided through NephroPlus 
 Academy 
 Certification in dialysis care on successful completion of training 
 ¢ Hands-on mentorship from experienced Unit In-Charges and Senior Therapists 
 ¢
 Defined career growth path: Staff Nurse Senior Staff Nurse Sr. Therapist Unit In-Charge 
 ¢ Exposure to critical care skills vascular access management, emergency response, CPR, and patient 
 monitoring 
 ¢ Opportunities to work across a pan-India network of centers 
 ¢ International deployment opportunities for high-performing nurses at NephroPlus centers overseas 
 ¢ Competitive fresher stipend/CTC with statutory benefits (PF, insurance) 
 Key Responsibilities 
 1. Clinical & Technical Care 
 ¢ Assemble necessary supplies and prepare the dialyzer according to established procedures and the dialysis 
 prescription 
 ¢ Assemble and prepare the dialysis extracorporeal circuit as per protocol and prescription 
 ¢ Verify absence of residual sterilants before use 
 ¢ Test and monitor machine functions including alarms, conductivity, and temperature; set alarms per unit and 
 manufacturer protocol 
 ¢ Verify dialyzer details and complete related documentation 
 ¢ Discard used supplies and sanitize equipment as per manufacturer and unit protocol 
 ¢ Monitor RO (water treatment) readings to ensure safe limits and adequate water levels for subsequent shifts; 
 document readings accurately 
 2. Direct Patient Care 
 ¢ Record pre- and post-dialysis vital signs, weight, and temperature 
 
 
 
 ¢ Inspect the patient's dialysis access; administer local anesthesia where required and insert needles per protocol 
 and prescription 
 ¢ Document treatment parameters and promptly communicate any patient concerns to the Unit In-Charge 
 ¢ Administer anticoagulants and adjust blood flow and fluid removal rates as per protocol and physician 
 prescription 
 ¢ Safely discontinue dialysis, establish hemostasis, and clean/dress the access site as per protocol 
 ¢ Continuously monitor patients and equipment, responding to alarms and adjusting treatment as required 
 ¢ Respond appropriately to dialysis-related emergencies hypotension, needle displacement, clotting, blood 
 leaks, or air embolism 
 ¢ Initiate CPR in the event of a cardiac emergency 
 ¢ Support patient education on nutrition, lifestyle, and treatment adherence, in collaboration with the Unit In- 
 Charge and Sr. Therapist 
 ¢ Communicate emotional, medical, psychosocial, and nutritional concerns of patients to the Unit In-Charge 
 ¢ Maintain professional conduct, empathetic communication, and patient confidentiality at all times 
 3. Process, Quality & Compliance 
 ¢ Accurately update patient vitals and dialysis data in Electronic Medical Records or designated registers 
 ¢ Ensure adherence to NABH standards and other applicable clinical quality protocols 
 ¢ Ensure reprocessing and dilution procedures are carried out strictly as per unit protocol 
 ¢ Maintain overall hygiene and support proper waste management within the dialysis unit 
 4. Team & Facility Support 
 ¢ Assist in preparing patient treatment schedules alongside the care team 
 ¢ Support training of new team members on dialysis machine preparation, monitoring, and maintenance 
 ¢ Report any protocol deviations observed among staff to the Unit In-Charge 
 ¢ Help maintain minimum stock levels in the emergency trolley and check it daily 
 ¢ Ensure facilities and supplies for emergency resuscitation are always ready 
 ¢ Support adequate staffing coordination to ensure uninterrupted patient care 
 Eligibility Criteria 
 Qualification 
 Registration 
 B.Sc Nursing from a recognized institution (mandatory) 
 Valid registration with the respective State Nursing Council (mandatory before 
 joining, or in progress) 
 Experience 
 Freshers and final-semester/final-year students are welcome to apply no 
 prior dialysis experience required 
 Age 
 2028 years 
 Language 
 Proficiency in the local regional language of the posting location; working 
 knowledge of English 
 Work Conditions 
 Willingness to work in rotational shifts, including weekends, and to relocate 
 within the region (or internationally, where applicable) if required 
 Skills & Attributes We Look For 
 ¢ Genuine empathy and a patient-first attitude 
 ¢ Strong attention to detail and adherence to clinical protocols 
 
 
 
 ¢ Clear communication skills, both with patients and team members 
 ¢ Composure and quick thinking in emergency situations 
 ¢ Willingness to learn and adapt to specialized clinical protocols 
 ¢ Basic computer literacy for maintaining electronic medical records 
 ¢ Team orientation and reliability 
 Training & Career Growth 
 All selected freshers go through a structured induction program at the NephroPlus Academy, covering the scientific 
 principles of dialysis, machine operation, water treatment monitoring, patient safety, and emergency response. The 
 program combines classroom learning with supervised, on-the-job training at a NephroPlus center, culminating in a 
 certification in dialysis care. High performers have a clear path to progress into Senior Staff Nurse, Sr. Therapist, and 
 Unit In-Charge roles within the organization, including opportunities for international deployment.

title: Project Manager
description:
We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented Project Manager to lead and manage onsite passive infrastructure activities for CCTV and networking projects. 
 Experience - Minimum 8 years of experience in CCTV, Networking or structured cabling projects. 
 Key Responsibilities Plan, supervise, and execute passive infrastructure work for CCTV and networking projects. Manage installation of cable trays, conduits, GI pipes, raceways, junction boxes, and mounting structures. Oversee laying, dressing, labeling, testing, and termination of CAT6/CAT6A, Fiber Optic, Coaxial, and power cables. Supervise installation of network racks, cabinets, patch panels, cable managers, PDUs, and associated passive components. Coordinate installation of CCTV cameras, mounting accessories, network switches, wireless access points, and related hardware. Conduct site surveys and validate BOQ, drawings, route plans, and installation methodology. Ensure compliance with approved HLD, LLD, SOW, client standards, and OEM guidelines. Plan manpower deployment and manage supervisors, engineers, technicians, and subcontractors. Coordinate with civil, electrical, IT, security, and facility teams to ensure site readiness. Monitor project progress, identify execution risks, and implement corrective actions to achieve project milestones. Ensure adherence to structured cabling standards (TIA/EIA), installation best practices, and quality procedures . Conduct daily toolbox talks and enforce EHS and safety compliance across all project sites. Verify measurements, certify completed work, and support vendor billing and project documentation. Coordinate material planning, inventory management, logistics, and timely availability of project materials. Attend client meetings, provide project status updates, and resolve onsite execution issues. Prepare Daily Progress Reports (DPR), Weekly Progress Reports (WPR), MOMs, snag lists, and project completion documentation. Support testing, commissioning, client acceptance, and final project handover. 
 Required Technical Skills Strong knowledge of CCTV systems and structured cabling infrastructure. Experience in installation and termination of CAT6, CAT6A, Fiber Optic, Coaxial, and power cabling. Good understanding of LAN infrastructure, network racks, patch panels, and cable management systems. Knowledge of structured cabling standards (TIA/EIA) and industry best practices. Experience with cable tray, conduit, trunking, and GI pipe installation . Ability to read and interpret AutoCAD drawings, HLDs, LLDs, BOQs, and project layouts. Familiarity with cable testing tools such as Fluke Cable Analyzer, OTDR, Fiber Power Meter, and cable certification equipment. Knowledge of EHS requirements and site safety regulations. 
 Preferred Qualifications Diploma or Bachelor's Degree in Electrical, Electronics, Telecommunications, Computer Science, or a related engineering discipline. PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent project management certification is an added advantage. OEM certifications in CCTV, Networking, or Structured Cabling are preferred.

title: Assistant Welfare Manager (Immediate Joiner, Garment Manufacturing)
description:
Position: Assistant Manager, Welfare
 Industry: Garment Manufacturing
 Department: HR / Welfare
 Gender: Female
 Location: Bengaluru
 Reporting To: HR Manager / Factory Head 
 1. Job Purpose To manage and strengthen employee welfare activities at the garment manufacturing facility, ensuring a safe, supportive, compliant, and employee-friendly workplace, with particular focus on the needs of women employees. The role will be responsible for employee welfare facilities, grievance handling, statutory welfare requirements, employee engagement, counselling/support, and coordination with internal departments and external agencies. 
 2. Key Responsibilities A. Absenteeism, Attrition & Employee Retention Management Monitor and analyse daily, weekly, and monthly absenteeism and attrition trends. Identify root causes of absenteeism and employee turnover through employee interactions, feedback, stay interviews and exit interviews. Track department-wise, line-wise, shift-wise and tenure-wise absenteeism and attrition. Identify high-risk employees and groups and take proactive retention measures. Follow up with frequent/long-absent employees and understand their concerns to support their return to work. Conduct regular employee connect sessions to identify and resolve workplace and welfare-related concerns. Develop and implement employee engagement and retention initiatives, particularly for women employees. Coordinate with HR, Production, and supervisors to address issues related to work environment, supervisors, transport, canteen, accommodation, working hours, and other welfare concerns. Monitor early attrition, particularly employee exits within the first 30/60/90 days, and recommend corrective actions. Prepare regular absenteeism, attrition, and retention MIS reports and present key findings and action plans to management. Measure the effectiveness of retention initiatives and continuously recommend improvements to reduce absenteeism and attrition. 
 B. Employee Welfare & Facilities Manage day-to-day employee welfare activities within the factory. Ensure availability and proper maintenance of welfare facilities such as: Canteen Drinking water Rest areas Washrooms Changing rooms First-aid facilities Transport facilities Childcare/crche facilities, where applicable Conduct regular welfare-facility inspections and coordinate corrective actions. Ensure welfare facilities are clean, hygienic, safe and accessible to employees. 
 C. Women Employee Welfare Act as a key point of contact for women employees regarding welfare-related concerns. Handle women employees' grievances with sensitivity and confidentiality. Support awareness initiatives related to workplace safety, dignity and respectful behaviour. Coordinate with relevant committees and management on matters concerning women employees. Support implementation and awareness of the organisation's POSH policy and related processes. Monitor issues affecting women employees and escalate serious concerns to HR management. 
 D. Employee Grievance Handling Receive, understand, and document employee grievances. Conduct employee interaction sessions and floor-level feedback activities. Coordinate with HR, Production, Compliance, and other departments to resolve grievances. Maintain proper records of grievances and closure status. Identify recurring employee issues and recommend preventive actions. 
 E. Statutory & Social Compliance Support HR/Compliance teams in meeting applicable labour and welfare requirements. Maintain welfare-related records and documentation required for audits and inspections. Coordinate preparation for customer/social-compliance audits. Ensure welfare practices are implemented in line with company policies and applicable statutory requirements. Support inspections by government authorities and other external agencies when required. 
 F. Employee Engagement Plan and coordinate employee engagement and welfare activities. Organise events and programmes such as:
 Employee awareness programmes Health and wellness activities Women's Day programmes Sports and cultural activities Employee recognition programmes Festival celebrations Counselling / awareness sessions Promote positive employee relations and improve employee participation. 
 G. Communication & Awareness Conduct regular employee awareness sessions on welfare-related topics. Communicate HR and welfare initiatives effectively to employees. Coordinate toolbox talks, awareness campaigns, and employee meetings. Ensure employees understand available welfare facilities and support systems. 
 H. Employee Support & Counselling Maintain regular interaction with employees at the shop-floor level. Identify employee concerns relating to work environment, accommodation, transport, canteen, health, safety or personal difficulties. Provide basic counselling/support within the scope of the role and escalate sensitive or serious matters appropriately. Maintain confidentiality of employee information. 
 I. Reporting & Documentation Prepare periodic welfare reports for management. Track welfare complaints, actions and closure. Maintain records of welfare activities, inspections, meetings and employee engagement programmes. Analyse employee feedback and recommend improvements. Provide MIS reports to the HR Manager / Factory Head as required. 
 3. Key Skills & Competencies Strong communication and interpersonal skills. Good employee-handling and grievance-management skills. Empathy and patience when dealing with employees. Strong understanding of workplace welfare practices. Ability to communicate effectively with women employees and shop-floor workers. Good coordination and problem-solving skills. Ability to maintain confidentiality. Good documentation and reporting skills. Ability to work independently as well as coordinate with cross-functional teams. Basic knowledge of MS Office / Excel / HR systems. 
 4. Qualification Master's degree in HR, Social Work, Labour Welfare, MBA or related discipline. 
 5. Experience 6-10 years of relevant experience in employee welfare / HR/labour welfare, preferably in the garment, textile, manufacturing or factory environment . Experience handling a predominantly female workforce will be an advantage. Experience in social-compliance audits and employee grievance handling is preferred. 
 6. Preferred Knowledge Employee welfare practices Labour welfare requirements Grievance handling Women employee welfare POSH awareness and process coordination Social compliance requirements Factory welfare facilities Employee engagement Basic HR documentation and MIS Audit preparation and documentation 
 7. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Timely closure of employee grievances. Employee satisfaction with welfare facilities. Welfare facility inspection and corrective-action closure. Employee engagement and participation levels. Compliance with welfare-related requirements. Audit observations and timely closure. Effectiveness of employee communication and awareness programmes. Reduction in recurring employee welfare complaints. 
 8. title: Human Resource Recruiter
description:
Job Title 
 HR Recruiter Corporate Location- Powai, Mumbai 

 Role Overview We are looking for a proactive and result-oriented HR Recruiter to join our Corporate HR team. The role will be responsible for managing the end-to-end recruitment process for corporate and support functions, from understanding manpower requirements and sourcing candidates to interview coordination, selection, offer management and onboarding. The ideal candidate should have strong sourcing and stakeholder-management skills, good communication abilities, and the ability to manage multiple positions simultaneously in a fast-paced education environment. 

 Key Responsibilities 1. End-to-End Recruitment Manage the complete recruitment lifecycle from requisition to onboarding . Understand hiring requirements, job descriptions and candidate profiles from business/function heads. Source and screen candidates based on role requirements, experience and cultural fit. Conduct initial HR screening and assess candidates against defined competencies. Coordinate interviews with hiring managers and business stakeholders. Manage candidate communication throughout the hiring process. Negotiate compensation and manage offer rollouts. Follow up with selected candidates until joining and ensure a smooth onboarding experience. 2. Sourcing & Talent Acquisition Source candidates through job portals, LinkedIn, employee referrals, recruitment agencies and other channels . Build and maintain a strong candidate pipeline for recurring and critical positions. Proactively identify talent for upcoming business requirements. Develop talent pools for key corporate functions and leadership positions. 3. Stakeholder Management Work closely with hiring managers and functional heads to understand manpower requirements. Provide regular updates on open positions, candidate pipelines and recruitment status. Advise stakeholders on candidate availability, market trends and compensation expectations. Ensure recruitment timelines and hiring SLAs are met. 4. Recruitment Operations Maintain accurate recruitment trackers and candidate databases. Track interview status, offers, joining dates and recruitment TAT. Ensure recruitment documentation is complete and updated. Coordinate with HR/Payroll/Admin teams for pre-joining and onboarding formalities. Prepare regular recruitment reports and hiring dashboards. 5. Employer Branding & Talent Pipeline Support employer branding initiatives and recruitment campaigns. Build relationships with recruitment consultants, institutions and external talent sources. Explore new and innovative channels for attracting talent. 


 Ideal Candidate Profile 4–6 years of experience in recruitment/talent acquisition. Experience in corporate hiring across multiple functions is preferred. Experience in the education/edtech industry would be an advantage. Strong knowledge of sourcing techniques and recruitment platforms. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Strong follow-up and stakeholder-management abilities. Ability to work on multiple vacancies simultaneously. Good understanding of recruitment metrics such as TAT, offer-to-join ratio, source effectiveness and hiring pipeline . Hands-on experience with ATS/HRMS and recruitment portals .

Commercial Negotiation • Negotiate pricing, margins, payment terms, MOQ, delivery schedules and other commercial conditions. • Understand customer profitability and ensure deals are commercially viable for the company. • Demonstrate strong understanding of costing, pricing and gross margins. • Handle objections and convert negotiations into confirmed orders. 6. Account Management & Relationship Building • Build long-term relationships with US retailers and jewellery businesses. • Act as the primary business contact for assigned customers. • Regularly understand customer requirements, upcoming collections and purchasing plans. • Ensure smooth coordination between customers and internal teams. • Develop customers from first order to long-term strategic accounts.

description:
Job Brief We are looking for driven, resilient Sales Development Agents to grow our business in the US market, working remotely from India during US business hours (day shift US time, which corresponds to an evening/night shift IST). In this end-to-end role you will generate leads through cold calling and cold emailing, nurture prospects through follow-ups and product demos, guide customers through their trial period, and convert trials into paying customers. You will also act as the voice of the customer to our development team. This is a high-impact role for someone who is comfortable with rejection, persistent, and passionate about selling technology. 
 Role & responsibilities Cold-call prospective US customers to introduce Rigbot's products and services staying positive and resilient in the face of rejection. Run cold email outreach and email campaigns to generate and qualify new leads. Perform timely, consistent follow-ups with prospects across calls, email, and other channels to move them through the sales pipeline. Schedule and set up product demo meetings with qualified prospects. Deliver clear, compelling live demonstrations of the Rigbot platform and mobile solutions. Provide hands-on customer handholding and support throughout the trial period, ensuring customers successfully adopt and start using the product. Convert trial users into paying customers and meet or exceed sales targets. Test the product on behalf of the development team, and relay customer feedback with practical suggestions for product improvements. Understand customer needs, identify key market segments, and spot new selling opportunities. Collaborate closely with the development and support teams to deepen product knowledge and represent the customer's perspective

Good ability to speak and converse in Hindi. Comfortable with cold calling and okay with rejection; persistent, self-motivated, and target-driven. Willingness and availability to work US day-shift hours exclusively (evening/night shift IST). Tech-savvy, with working knowledge of the MS Office suite and the ability to create attractive presentations. Ability to self-learn and work with minimum supervision. Good exposure to cold calling, pre-sales activities, email campaigning, and lead generation. Graduate with prior experience in sales / BPO and a good sales aptitude. Nice to have: Prior experience in IT / Software / SaaS sales. Domain expertise in trucking and logistics. Experience supporting customers through product trials and onboarding.

title: Performance Marketer
description:
About the Role We are looking for a data-driven and results-oriented Performance Marketer to own and scale Snaphomz's digital acquisition efforts. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience managing paid advertising campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Reddit campaigns and other relevant digital channels, with a strong focus on lead generation, customer acquisition, conversion optimization, and measurable ROI. You will be responsible for turning marketing budgets into qualified leads and customers through continuous campaign optimization, audience targeting, experimentation, analytics, and performance reporting. 
 Key Responsibilities Develop and execute performance marketing strategies aligned with overall business and marketing objectives. Plan,manage, and optimize digital marketing campaigns across relevant online channels. Monitor campaign performance and identify opportunities for improvement. Manage and optimize marketing budgets to achieve desired business outcomes. Conduct market, audience, and competitor research to support campaign planning. Work closely with the creative and content teams to develop effective marketing campaigns. Monitor key marketing metrics and prepare regular performance reports. Analyze campaign data and provide actionable insights to improve overall performance. Conduct regular testing and experimentation to improve campaign effectiveness. Optimize customer acquisition and conversion efforts across the marketing funnel. Collaborate with sales and other internal teams to improve lead quality and conversion. Stay updated with the latest digital marketing trends, tools, platforms, and best practices. Identify new opportunities and channels for customer acquisition and business growth. Ensure marketing activities are aligned with brand guidelines and company objectives. Take ownership of overall campaign performance and continuously work toward improving marketing ROI. Required Skills & Experience 2-5 years of hands-on experience in Performance Marketing / Paid Digital Marketing. Strong practical experience with Google Ads, Meta Ads and Reddit campaigns. Experience with email marketing campaigns will be an added advantage. Experience with LinkedIn Ads is highly preferred. Proven experience in lead generation and customer acquisition campaigns. Strong understanding of CPC, CPM, CTR, CPL, CPA, CAC, ROAS, ROI, and conversion rates. Hands-on experience with Google Analytics 4 (GA4) and Google Tag Manager (GTM). Understanding of conversion tracking, pixels, events, attribution, and marketing funnels. Experience with landing-page optimization and A/B testing. Strong analytical and data interpretation skills. Ability to manage marketing budgets and make data-backed allocation decisions. Strong understanding of digital advertising platforms, targeting, bidding, and campaign optimization. Excellent communication and reporting skills. Preferred / Good-to-Have Experience working with B2B SaaS, PropTech, Real Estate, FinTech, Marketplace, or Technology companies. Experience managing performance marketing for a startup or high-growth company. Experience with CRM platforms and lead management systems. Familiarity with HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho, or similar CRM platforms. Experience with marketing automation and lead nurturing. Understanding of SEO, content marketing, email marketing, and organic acquisition. Experience working with attribution platforms or advanced marketing analytics tools. Basic understanding of AI tools and their application in marketing workflows. What We're Looking For We are looking for someone who is hands-on, analytical, experimental, and commercially focused. You should be comfortable managing campaigns independently, working with numbers, identifying what is and isn't working, and taking ownership of results. This role is best suited for a marketer who doesn't just run campaigns, but understands the entire acquisition funnel and can connect marketing activity to qualified leads, customers, and revenue. Why Join Snaphomz? Opportunity to work in a high-growth technology and real estate environment . High ownership and direct impact on business growth. Opportunity to build and scale performance marketing from the ground up. Work closely with leadership, sales, product, and technology teams. Fast-paced environment with significant opportunities for learning and career growth.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Accountant to manage day-to-day accounting operations, financial reporting, reconciliations, statutory compliances, and audit support. The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of accounting principles and practical experience in Tally/ERP, GST, TDS, and financial statements .

 Manage day-to-day accounting and bookkeeping activities. Pass and review journal, sales, purchase, receipt, and payment entries. Maintain and reconcile bank, ledger, vendor, and customer accounts . Coordinate with auditors during statutory, tax, and internal audits . Maintain proper accounting records and supporting documentation. Ensure timely closure of monthly and annual accounts. Assist in tax assessments and provide information/documents as required. Monitor compliance with applicable accounting and statutory requirements. Identify accounting discrepancies and implement corrective measures. Support the Finance Manager/Partner in financial analysis and other accounting-related activities. Required Skills & Qualifications 
 Bachelor's degree in Commerce/Accounting/Finance ; CA Inter/qualified, Semi-qualified CA, or equivalent qualification will be an advantage. 4-7 years of relevant accounting experience. Strong knowledge of accounting principles and financial reporting . Good working knowledge of Tally Prime/ERP and MS Excel . Practical knowledge of GST and TDS compliances . Strong reconciliation and analytical skills. Ability to independently manage accounting activities. Good communication and coordination skills. High attention to detail and accuracy.

Hands-on exposure to SAP ECC and/or SAP S/4HANA . Good analytical, problem-solving and management reporting skills. Ability to independently identify process gaps and recommend practical solutions. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills. Experience in working with senior management / audit committees will be an added advantage. title: Senior Logistics Specialist
description:
ROLE SUMMARY 
 The Logistics Department is seeking a highly experienced Senior Logistics Specialist with a minimum of 10 years of proven experience in international project logistics, preferably within EPC, energy, industrial, infrastructure or large-scale capital projects. The ideal candidate will possess extensive expertise in planning, coordinating, and executing complex global logistics operations, including multimodal transportation, heavy-lift and oversized cargo movements, customs clearance, warehousing, and supply chain optimization. A comprehensive understanding of international logistics markets, industry stakeholders, freight forwarding networks, regulatory requirements, and commercial practices is essential. The successful candidate should demonstrate strong leadership capabilities, strategic thinking, and advanced analytical and negotiation skills. They must be capable of managing logistics risks, developing transportation . strategies, and driving cost-effective solutions while ensuring the timely delivery of project materials across multiple locations and countries. 
 RESPONSIBILITIES 
 Prepare preliminary list of equipment and materials with as much detail as possible (dimensions, weights, loading ports, delivery dates...) Assist the Logistics Coordinator in the creation of RFIs for tender process. Evaluate all commercial and technical bids after clarifying and needed negotiations. Revise Purchase Orders issued by logistics department analyzing implications of the agreed INCOTERM Maintain direct contact with all suppliers since Kick Off Meeting Notify and confirm to all parties involved in the supply chain (Project Management, Client, Customs Agent, Site material receiving department...etc) all shipments that take place with their departure and estimated arrival at destination port dates. Coordinate alongside vendor and FFW, the correct compliance of the agreed delivery INCOTERMS, and the correct delivery of equipment and materials so they can be shipped on the first available departure option. Gather all documents required for customs clearance formalities in country of destination (Invoice, Certificate of Origin, Packing lists, Insurance...) and request the FFW the correct import documents (B/L, AWB, CMR). Update information regarding all shipments in all tracking documents and tools. Support Customs Team to arrange the disposition of funds for payment of taxes and duties, if so is stablished in the contract with our client. Become aware of characteristics of the assigned project and Become aware and apply Logistics Department Work procedures, and all others issued by related departments which may be of application to logistics endeavors Become aware of the established strategy for the transportation of materials and equipment. title: Regional Category Manager
description:
Job Description The Regional Commodity Manager for Batteries is responsible for developing and executing regional sourcing strategies for VRLA, lithium-ion and nickel-cadmium batteries, together with relevant accessories and services. The role will strengthen supplier competitiveness, optimize total cost, protect continuity of supply and support business growth across project-based and operational requirements. The position serves as the primary commercial interface between battery suppliers and internal stakeholders, including Engineering, Quality, Operations, Logistics, Sales, Product Management and Global Procurement. The successful candidate will combine electrical product knowledge with strong strategic sourcing, negotiation and supplier-management capabilities. Responsibilities Develop and execute regional commodity strategies for VRLA, Li-Ion and Ni-Cd batteries, battery racks, cabinets, monitoring systems and associated accessories. Align regional plans with global commodity direction, business objectives, technology roadmaps and customer requirements. Lead supplier market scans, RFIs, RFQs, e-sourcing events, bid evaluations, negotiations and sourcing recommendations. Identify, qualify and onboard competitive suppliers, including localization and alternate-source opportunities. Build should-cost, total-cost-of-ownership and price-benchmarking models to support sourcing decisions. Establish strategic relationships with battery manufacturers, system integrators and key sub-tier suppliers. Conduct regular supplier business reviews covering quality, cost, delivery, capacity, technology, service and sustainability. Develop corrective and improvement plans for underperforming suppliers and track actions to closure. Coordinate supplier development with Quality and Engineering to improve process capability, reliability and responsiveness. Deliver annual productivity and cost-reduction programs through negotiation, value engineering, localization, resourcing, specification optimization and supplier consolidation. Monitor key battery cost drivers, including lead, lithium, nickel, cobalt, freight, energy, currency and manufacturing conversion costs. Negotiate commercial agreements, pricing mechanisms, warranties, payment terms, lead times, logistics models and service obligations. Maintain contract coverage and ensure sourcing decisions comply with delegated authority and procurement governance. Assess supplier capacity, financial health, geographic concentration, logistics exposure, sub-tier dependency and raw-material risks. Create and maintain mitigation plans, including dual sourcing, safety-stock arrangements, local warehousing, capacity reservation and business-continuity actions. Partner with planning, operations and suppliers to resolve shortages, expedite critical requirements and protect customer commitments. Monitor market developments and provide timely risk and opportunity updates to leadership. Engage early in new product introduction, custome r proposals and engineering change activities to ensure competitive and supply-ready solutions. Work with Engineering and Quality on specifications, supplier qualification, testing, approvals, reliability, warranty and failure-resolution activities. Support standardization and rationalization of battery makes, models and configurations across business units and sites. Coordinate with Sales and Product Management to understand pipeline, project timing, technology needs and regional customer expectations. Ensure suppliers comply with applicable environmental, health and safety, trade, ethical sourcing and regulatory requirements. Promote responsible sourcing, recycling, end-of-life management, safe transportation and reduced environmental impact. Maintain accurate sourcing records, approvals, contracts, supplier data and audit documentation. Maintain commodity dashboards covering spend, savings, quality, delivery, lead time, inventory, contract coverage and supplier risk. Prepare periodic commodity reviews, executive updates and sourcing pipeline reports. Use data to identify supply-base, working-capital, cost and service improvement opportunities. Requirements 8-12 years Bachelors degree in Electrical Engineering Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a closely related electrical discipline. 8-12 years of experience in strategic sourcing, commodity management, procurement, supplier development or supply chain roles. Demonstrated experience sourcing electrical products, preferably industrial batteries, UPS systems, energy storage or critical-power equipment. Experience working in a project-based, engineered-to-order or high-mix, low-volume business environment is preferred. Strong commercial negotiation, contract management, analytical and stakeholder-management skills. Ability to read and interpret electrical specifications, drawings, data sheets, test requirements and supplier technical proposals. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and ERP/procurement systems; experience with Power BI or similar analytics tools is preferred. Fluent business English and willingness to travel regionally as required. VRLA/SMF, 2V cells, Li-Ion systems, Ni-Cd cells and industrial battery applications Electrical DC systems, voltage/current ratings, capacity, discharge characteristics, autonomy and short-circuit considerations Battery racks/cabinets, battery monitoring, BMS interfaces, chargers and UPS/energy-storage integration Qualification testing, inspection plans, failure analysis, warranty management and lifecycle performance Working awareness of applicable IEC, UL, transportation, environmental and recycling requirements Cost breakdowns, index-based pricing, landed cost, TCO, supplier benchmarking and scenario analysis Strategic thinking Commercial acumen Supplier negotiation Cost and value analysis Risk mitigation Technical curiosity Project management Cross-functional influence Executive communication Results orientation Supplier quality and corrective-action closure Localization and alternate-source implementation Contract coverage and sourcing compliance Supplier risk reduction and continuity readiness Candidates with sourcing or engineering exposure in the following sectors will be preferred: UPS and critical power systems Data centers and telecom power Industrial energy storage Power generation and utilities Railways, oil and gas, process industries or infrastructure Battery manufacturing, chargers, DC systems or electrical equipment Primary Skills (Must Have) BE-Btech Electrical engineering mandatory (dont touch mechanical candidates) In Procurement and supply chain function Preferable battery side only 30-50% traveling needed Education BE-Btech – Electrical Team Handling IC role Work Location Thane, Mumbai Shift General Shift Work Mode 5 days WFO 8 -15 Year Exp

title: Fashion Designer - Digital Fashion Stylist & Quality Checker
description:
About the Role : We are looking for a creative, detail-oriented, and technology-driven Fashion Designer to join our growing team. This role is ideal for candidates who are passionate about fashion design, styling, digital fashion, and AI-powered creative technologies . 
 The selected candidate will work on projects for leading fashion B2C companies and established fashion brands , contributing to digital fashion styling, garment visualization, image quality checking, fashion content development, and AI-assisted creative workflows. 
 This is an excellent opportunity for freshers and early-career fashion professionals who want to build a long-term career at the intersection of Fashion, Digital Technology, and Artificial Intelligence (AI) . 


 Key Responsibilities : 
 Digital Fashion Styling & Quality Control: 
 Work as a Digital Fashion Stylist and Digital Fashion Quality Checker (QC) for fashion-related projects. Review digital fashion outputs, product images, garment visuals, styling, proportions, colors, fit, details, and overall presentation. Identify design inconsistencies, visual errors, garment detailing issues, and deviations from the original reference/design. Ensure digital outputs meet required fashion, styling, visual quality, and brand guidelines . Analyse client requirements, references, sample images, and feedback and ensure accurate implementation. Coordinate with creative and production teams to communicate corrections and required changes. Maintain consistency across multiple products, designs, images, and project requirements. 

 Fashion Design & Styling: 
 Apply strong knowledge of Indian and Western Menswear and Womenswear to digital fashion projects. Understand fabrics, silhouettes, garment construction, fitting, styling, color combinations, prints, patterns, and garment detailing. Assist in concept development, mood boards, styling references, placement prints, and fashion presentations. Review and interpret fashion references, product images, sample garments, and design specifications. Support digital garment visualization and AI-assisted fashion content creation. 

 AI & Digital Fashion Workflows: 
 Utilize AI tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Midjourney, Leonardo AI, MNML, Magnific, Grok , and similar platforms for creative ideation and fashion workflows. Use AI tools for concept generation, image enhancement, visual development, prompt creation, trend research, and creative problem-solving . Develop and refine prompts to achieve accurate fashion-related visual outputs. Stay updated with emerging AI technologies, digital fashion tools, fashion trends, and creative workflows . Explore new AI-assisted methods to improve efficiency, quality, and accuracy in fashion projects. 

 Client & Project Coordination: 
 Understand project requirements and implement client feedback accurately. Manage project, design revisions, and quality-checking requirements simultaneously. Maintain proper communication with internal teams and ensure timely completion of assigned tasks. Follow project timelines, brand guidelines, and quality standards. Maintain confidentiality of client information, designs, references, and project-related materials. 


 Required Skills & Qualifications : 
 Bachelor's Degree in Fashion Design, Apparel Technology, Textile Design, or a related field. 
 Fresher or 1-2 years of experience in Fashion Design, Fashion Styling, Digital Fashion, Quality Checking, or related roles. 
 Strong understanding of Indian & Western Menswear and Womenswear . 
 Good knowledge of:
 Fabrics and textiles Silhouettes Garment construction Garment fitting Fashion styling Colors and combinations Prints and patterns Garment detailing 
 Proficiency in Adobe Photoshop is required. 
 Understanding of placement prints, mood boards, concept development, and tech packs . 
 Basic awareness or hands-on exposure to AI tools and AI-assisted creative workflows . 
 Strong attention to detail and visual judgement. 
 Good communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills. 
 Ability to understand and implement feedback accurately. 


 Preferred Skills & Additional Requirements : 
 Exposure to AI-assisted creative tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Midjourney, Leonardo AI or similar platforms. 
 Strong proficiency in MS Office Word, Excel, and PowerPoint . 
 Good proficiency in English, Hindi, and Bengali . 
 Professional, confident, self-motivated, and responsible approach to work. 
 Sharp memory and strong organizational skills to manage multiple sample revisions, client feedback, design changes, and project requirements. 
 Punctual and deadline-oriented with the ability to work within production timelines. 
 High professional integrity and respect for: Company policies Intellectual property Confidential client information Brand guidelines 
 Passion for fashion, creativity, technology, innovation, and continuous learning . 


 Good to Have : 
 Understanding of digital fashion and virtual garment visualization . Knowledge of AI-powered image generation and image enhancement. Interest in emerging Fashion Tech, Generative AI, and digital design technologies . Understanding of AI-assisted fashion styling and content creation. Experience with additional creative software or digital fashion tools. Knowledge of CLO 3D or 3D garment visualization. 


 Preferred Educational Institutes : 
 Candidates from reputed fashion, design, and creative institutes will be preferred, including: 
 NIFT (National Institute of Fashion Technology) J.D. Birla Institute iLEAD Bhawanipur Design Academy Amity University FDDI Kolkata ESEDS IIFD 
 Candidates from other recognized Fashion Design, Apparel, Textile, or Design institutes are also welcome to apply. 


 What You Will Get : 
 Opportunity to work on projects for leading fashion B2C companies such as Myntra and Amazon . Exposure to projects associated with leading fashion and lifestyle brands including Raymond, Park Avenue, Dressberry, Roadster, Reebok, HRX, Turtle, Van Heusen, Louis Philippe, and Allen Solly Kids . Hands-on exposure to AI-powered fashion design and creative technologies . Practical experience in digital fashion styling and fashion quality control . Exposure to real-world client projects, campaigns, product development, and production workflows. Collaborative and creative work environment. Opportunity to work at the intersection of Fashion + AI + Digital Technology . Strong learning and career-growth opportunities in emerging AI-enabled fashion workflows . 


 Location Preference : 
 Kolkata / West Bengal 
 Preference will be given to candidates currently residing in Kolkata or elsewhere in West Bengal . 
 Please Note: Applications from candidates residing outside West Bengal will not be considered. 


 How to Apply : 
 Interested candidates can apply through Naukri or share their updated CV and Portfolio at: hr@notionstudios.in

description:
Project Role : Custom Software Engineer
 Project Role Description : Design, build and configure applications to meet business process and application requirements. 
 Must have skills : SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central Payroll
 Good to have skills : NA
 Minimum 5 year(s) of experience is required
 Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education
 
 Summary
 AI Powered Tech Talent You will design, configure, and enhance SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central Payroll (ECP) solutions while utilizing AI assisted development tools and copilots to accelerate requirement analysis, configuration, testing, documentation, and issue resolution. The role focuses on delivering accurate, compliant, and efficient payroll operations, integrating pre built AI services where beneficial, and improving delivery productivity—without requiring deep AI model engineering, RAG systems, or agentic AI development.
 
 Key Responsibilities
 Payroll Functional & Technical Delivery
 Configure and optimize Employee Central Payroll including pay components, off cycle processes, gross to net calculations, retroactivity, schemas, and rules.
 Use AI copilots to rapidly generate functional specifications, configuration notes, testing scenarios, and payroll validation logic documentation.
 Support the full delivery cycle from requirements gathering and solution design to UAT, deployment, and post go live stabilization.
 Ensure seamless integration between Employee Central (EC), Time Management, HRIS Sync, BIB, and payroll relevant third party systems.
 Perform payroll simulations, validations, reconciliations, and error diagnostics with AI assisted accelerators.
 AI Assisted Productivity
 Use AI copilots for: 
 o Impact and configuration analysis
 o Test script automation
 o Defect analysis and guided troubleshooting
 o Documentation creation and updates
 Integrate pre built AI services into payroll operations (e.g., automated anomaly detection on payroll variances, automated summarization of payroll runs, intelligent categorization of payroll tickets).
 Apply AI enabled tools to accelerate compliance checks, payroll audits, and batch run reviews.
 Governance, Compliance & Collaboration
 Ensure strict compliance with local and global payroll regulations, audit requirements, data privacy laws, and security standards.
 Participate in workshops, payroll parallel runs, root cause analysis, and optimization discussions—enhanced with AI supported insights.
 Collaborate closely with HR operations, finance, technical integration teams, and external providers.
 Contribute to reusable payroll templates, configuration patterns, checklists, SOPs, and best practices incorporating AI assisted workflows.
 
 Required Skills & Experience
 SAP Payroll Expertise
 Strong hands on experience in Employee Central Payroll (ECP) and/or SAP HCM Payroll fundamentals including: 
 o PCRs, schemas, wage types
 o Retrocalculations and payroll calendars
 o Off cycle and special payroll runs
 o Integration with EC, Time Off, Time Sheet, Benefits
 Understanding of payroll posting to finance (FI/CO) and payroll reconciliation practices.
 AI Ready Skills
 Practical experience using AI copilots and LLM based tools for analysis, documentation, test generation, and troubleshooting.
 Ability to integrate pre built AI capabilities such as automated validations, anomaly detection, and summarization.
 Understanding of responsible AI usage and the limits of AI tools in regulated HR/payroll contexts.
 General Professional Skills
 Strong analytical and problem solving skills, especially in data driven payroll scenarios.
 Ability to translate business rules into accurate payroll configuration.
 Excellent communication and collaboration skills across HR, payroll, and technical teams.
 Continuous learning mindset with comfort adopting AI enabled development and support workflows.
 
 Good to Have
 SAP SuccessFactors EC/ECP Certification.
 Experience with payroll parallel testing and country specific payroll localization.
 Exposure to CPI/Boomi integrations or cloud based payroll analytics.
 Familiarity with automated testing environments.
 
 Outcome Expectations
 Deliver accurate, reliable, and compliant payroll solutions using AI enabled productivity accelerators.
 Improve cycle times, testing efficiency, and payroll accuracy through AI assisted workflows.
 Act as a connector between payroll teams, SAP engineering teams, and AI native teams when deeper AI capabilities are required.

title: Creative Designer | UI/UX & Visual Design
description:
About the Role 
 We are looking for a highly creative and versatile Designer who can work across UI/UX, product visuals, social media creatives, branding, and marketing designs . 
 The ideal candidate should be someone who can take a simple feature list, requirement, or idea from our team and turn it into a beautiful, intuitive, modern, and highly engaging visual experience . 
 We are looking for a designer with strong creative thinking not someone who simply executes predefined designs. 
 1. What You'll Do 
 Understand product features and requirements and convert them into intuitive UI/UX designs . Think from the user's perspective and create simple, engaging, and visually appealing experiences. Design app screens, user flows, feature experiences, dashboards, and other product interfaces. Create high-quality social media posts, campaigns, advertisements, banners, promotional creatives, and marketing materials . Create visually consistent designs across product, marketing, and brand communication. Develop creative concepts and multiple design directions when required. Suggest improvements to the product experience and visual presentation. Work closely with developers, marketing, and product teams. Ensure designs are practical, polished, consistent, and ready for implementation. Stay updated with modern UI/UX, graphic design, branding, and social media design trends. 
 2. What We're Looking For 
 2-4 years of experience in UI/UX + Graphic/Visual Design . Strong knowledge of Figma, Photoshop, Illustrator , or equivalent tools. Excellent understanding of: UI/UX principles Typography Color theory Layout & composition Visual hierarchy Spacing & grids Branding Design systems Social media creative design Strong creative and visual problem-solving skills. Ability to transform a rough idea or feature requirement into a polished design . Ability to independently suggest better design solutions instead of only following instructions. Strong attention to detail. Excellent portfolio demonstrating both product/UI work and graphic/creative work . 
 3. Example of the Work 
 We may give you a requirement like: "We need a new feature where users can compare two players." You should be able to: Understand the requirement Think about the user journey Create the UX Design the UI Make it visually engaging Deliver a polished final design Similarly, for marketing we may say: "Create a social media campaign for this new feature." You should be able to independently develop the creative concept, visual direction, layout, typography, graphics, and final post designs . 
 4. Important 
 This role requires a combination of UI/UX thinking and strong graphic/visual design skills . 
 We are NOT looking for: Web Designers focused primarily on websites Web Developers / Frontend Developers Designers who only create basic social media posts Designers who only execute predefined layouts Candidates with UI/UX knowledge but weak visual/graphic design skills 
 5. Ideal Candidate 
 The ideal candidate is a creative problem solver and visual thinker who can move comfortably between: 
 Product UI/UX App Screens Feature Design Branding Social Media Marketing Creatives 
 You should have the ability to take a blank canvas + a feature/idea and turn it into something that looks and feels premium, intuitive, modern, and engaging . 
 6. Portfolio Required 
 Portfolio is mandatory. 
 Your portfolio should ideally demonstrate: UI/UX & product design Mobile app designs Creative social media posts Marketing creatives Branding/visual design Ability to create original concepts 
 Candidates with a strong and diverse portfolio will be preferred.

title: Senior AI/ML Developer
description:
Job Title: Senior AI/ML Developer Employment Type:  Full Time Position Location: Hyderabad            Reports to: Delivery Head Qualifications: BE/B.Tech/MCA Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or similar relevant field  Total Experience: 6 - 10 Years   Working Model: Office Shift Timing: 12pm 9pm / 1pm to 10pm About the Role We are looking for a Senior AI/ML Developer to build and optimize intelligent matching and categorization systems. In this role, you will design and deploy a multi-tiered pipeline that processes unstructured, real-world transactional data. You will leverage a combination of deterministic rules, traditional machine learning, fuzzy matching, and Large Language Models (LLMs) to automatically map incoming records to a standardized master catalog at scale. 
 Required Experience Advanced Python, together with the data and machine-learning libraries around it such as NumPy, Pandas and Scikit-learn. Production experience with text classification and entity matching is the core of this seat. That includes string-distance and similarity methods such as Levenshtein, Jaro-Winkler, TF-IDF and cosine similarity, along with vector embeddings, applied to messy real-world product or transaction descriptions. Complex SQL against a cloud warehouse comes up daily, and the Snowflake experience needs to cover querying schemas another team owns and controls. Production machine-learning practice, covering deployment, drift monitoring, closing a human feedback loop, and tracking confidence across the distribution of results. Experience working against a taxonomy or master catalog that changes underneath you, with versioning and a migration story, transfers directly to this seat. Useful additions Experience integrating a large language model for classification or entity extraction, where the input is short, noisy commercial text and the output has to be auditable. It sits here rather than under required experience because whether the engine calls a model at all is still an open decision. Retail, grocery, restaurant or foodservice item data shortens the learning curve considerably. Knowing that a sixteen-ounce latte and a large latte are the same item, and that a menu description is not a product name, saves a good deal of time. Amazon Bedrock specifically, or any work under an AI control regime with pinned model versions and full prompt and decision logging.

title: Billing Engineer
description:
THE ROLE 
 We are looking for a rigorous Billing Engineer to independently verify contractor bills, measurements, quantities, rates, recoveries and supporting documentation across premium building projects. The role sits between the site team, contractors, procurement/contracts and finance and must protect accuracy without allowing bills to remain stuck in avoidable loops. 
 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 
 Check RA and final bills against approved BOQs, work orders, drawings, site measurements, joint measurement records and executed quantities. Verify rate applicability, extra items, deviations, deductions, advances, retention, taxes, free-issue materials, wastage and back-charges. Audit BBS and reinforcement reconciliation, concrete and major material consumption, contractor statements and scrap/debit records where applicable. Maintain package-wise bill registers showing submission, query, certification, approval and payment status with ageing and accountability. Return incomplete or incorrect bills with a single consolidated query list; track resolution and prevent repetitive back-and-forth. Coordinate with site engineers and project managers to validate physical progress and close measurement gaps promptly. Prepare certification/release sheets for management and finance, highlighting exceptions, risks and pending recoveries. Support quantity take-offs, tender BOQs, variation logs, reconciliation and cost-to-complete updates. Maintain a clear audit trail and ensure no certification occurs without required documentation and approvals. WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE 
 Complete bills are certified within agreed timelines, with transparent reasons for any hold. No duplicate quantity, incorrect rate or missed recovery passes through certification. Management can see billing ageing, cash requirement, variations and package exposure at a glance. Final accounts close with minimal unresolved measurements or documentation gaps. EXPERIENCE & CAPABILITIES 
 BE/BTech or Diploma in Civil Engineering with 5-8 years of contractor or developer-side billing experience. Strong knowledge of quantity surveying, IS measurement practices, BBS, BOQs, rate analysis, reconciliation, RA/final bills and work-order conditions. Advanced Excel capability; experience with AutoCAD quantity take-offs. ERP exposure is useful but not mandatory. Experience in high-rise residential, commercial or mixed-use construction; developer-side experience preferred. Candidates should be prepared for a practical assessment using a sample bill/BOQ. PERSONAL ATTRIBUTES 
 Numerically precise and difficult to mislead. Firm, fair and responsive with contractors. Strong documentation discipline and integrity. Able to explain discrepancies simply and close them quickly.
